Parameter sort : Set.

Parameter axiom : sort -> sort -> Prop.

Parameter rule_pi : sort -> sort -> sort -> Prop.

Parameter rule_sig : sort -> sort -> sort -> Prop.

Parameter star : sort.

=== metalib.v ===
Require Import ssreflect.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

=== grade_sig.v ===
Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Coq.Structures.Orders.

Require Import Stdlib.Init.Sumbool.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import ssreflect.

Module Type GradeSig.

Parameter grade : Set.

Parameter q_Top : grade.

Parameter q_Bot : grade.

Parameter q_C   : grade.

Parameter q_R   : grade.

Parameter q_eqb  : grade -> grade -> bool.

Parameter q_leb  : grade -> grade -> bool.

Parameter q_join : grade -> grade -> grade.

Parameter q_meet : grade -> grade -> grade.

Parameter q_eq   : grade -> grade.

Definition t := grade.

Definition eq := @Logic.eq grade.

Definition eqb  := q_eqb.

Parameter q_eq_dec : forall (A : grade) (B : grade), { A = B } + { not (A = B) }.

Parameter eqb_eq : forall (n m : grade), q_eqb n m = true <-> n = m.

Definition eq_equiv : Equivalence (@Logic.eq grade) := eq_equivalence.

Definition eq_dec := q_eq_dec.

Include BackportEq.

Definition leb  := q_leb.

Definition le n m := is_true (q_leb n m).

Definition q_lt n m := is_true (q_leb n m) /\ n <> m.

Definition size_grade : grade -> nat := fun _ => 1%nat.

Declare Scope grade_scope.

Bind Scope grade_scope with grade.

Local Open Scope grade_scope.

Infix "=?" := q_eqb (at level 70) : grade_scope.

Infix "<=?" := q_leb (at level 70) : grade_scope.

Notation "q1 <= q2" := (is_true (q_leb q1 q2)) (at level 70)  : grade_scope.

Notation "q1 < q2" := (q_lt q1 q2) (at level 70)  : grade_scope.

Notation "x * y"  := (q_join x y) : grade_scope.

Notation "x + y " := (q_meet x y)  : grade_scope.

Parameter join_assoc : forall a b c, a * (b * c) = (a * b) * c.

Parameter join_comm  : forall a b, a * b = b * a.

Parameter meet_assoc : forall a b c, a + (b + c) = (a + b) + c.

Parameter meet_comm : forall a b, a + b = b + a.

Parameter absorb_meet : forall a b, a * (a + b) = a.

Parameter absorb_join : forall a b, a + (a * b) = a.

Parameter join_idem : forall a, a * a = a.

Parameter meet_idem : forall psi, psi + psi = psi.

Parameter join_Top_r : forall a, a * q_Top = q_Top.

Parameter meet_Bot_r : forall a, a + q_Bot = q_Bot.

Parameter order_q_C_dec : forall q, { q <= q_C } + { q_C < q }.

Parameter leb_leq  : forall (n m : grade), (n <=? m) = true <-> n <= m.

Parameter join_leq : forall a b,  a <= b -> (a * b) = b.

Parameter leq_join : forall a b, (a * b) = b -> a <= b.

Parameter meet_leq : forall a b,  a <= b -> (a + b) = a.

Parameter leq_meet : forall a b, (a + b) = a -> a <= b.

End GradeSig.

Declare Module Grade : GradeSig.

Export Grade.

Section GradeFacts.

Local Open Scope grade_scope.

End GradeFacts.

# 129 — Dependent Dependency Calculus: definitional equality consistency

## Task

Show that definitional equality implies the supplied consistency judgment.

Prove this declaration in `Task.v`:

- `DefEq_Consistent`

## Input

- `input/Task.v` is the target file; in the proof workspace, it is `Task.v`.
- Any other supplied `.v` files provide support definitions. Use `_CoqProject` for the source list and library mappings.
- Rocq version: 9.1.0. Local prerequisites: Metalib.

The project already includes the listed dependencies; do not install anything for the proof run.

## Rules

- Edit only `Task.v` in the submitted solution. You may add helper definitions and lemmas there. Keep all supplied definitions and target names, statements, and hypotheses unchanged. Do not change support files or `_CoqProject`.
- Do not use `Admitted`, `admit`, or `Abort` in the submitted solution. Do not add axioms or new global assumptions (including via `Axiom`, `Parameter`, or `Conjecture`), disable kernel checks (such as guard, positivity, or universe checking), or use equivalent shortcuts.

A completed `Task.v` that compiles with Rocq using the supplied project configuration, with every listed target proved and no open goals.

To verify, run `make` from the project root. All project dependencies are included.

140	  | (a_Abs psi A a) => (fv_tm_tm A) \u (fv_tm_tm a)
141	  | (a_App a psi b) => (fv_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm b)
142	  | (a_Type s) => {}
143	  | (a_Var_b nat) => {}
144	  | (a_Var_f x) => {{x}}
145	  | (a_Sum A1 A2) => (fv_tm_tm A1) \u (fv_tm_tm A2)
146	  | (a_Inj1 a) => (fv_tm_tm a)
147	  | (a_Inj2 a) => (fv_tm_tm a)
148	  | (a_Case psi a b1 b2) => (fv_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm b1) \u (fv_tm_tm b2)
149	  | (a_WSigma psi A B) => (fv_tm_tm A) \u (fv_tm_tm B)
150	  | (a_WPair a psi b) => (fv_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm b)
151	  | (a_LetPair psi a b) => (fv_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm b)
152	  | (a_SSigma psi A B) => (fv_tm_tm A) \u (fv_tm_tm B)
153	  | (a_SPair a psi b) => (fv_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm b)
154	  | (a_Proj1 psi a) => (fv_tm_tm a)
155	  | (a_Proj2 psi a) => (fv_tm_tm a)

158	Fixpoint subst_tm_tm (a5:tm) (x5:tmvar) (a_6:tm) {struct a_6} : tm :=
159	  match a_6 with
160	  | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
161	  | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
162	  | (a_Pi psi A B) => a_Pi psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 B)
163	  | (a_Abs psi A a) => a_Abs psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a)
164	  | (a_App a psi b) => a_App (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b)
165	  | (a_Type s) => a_Type s
166	  | (a_Var_b nat) => a_Var_b nat
167	  | (a_Var_f x) => (if eq_var x x5 then a5 else (a_Var_f x))
168	  | (a_Sum A1 A2) => a_Sum (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A1) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A2)
169	  | (a_Inj1 a) => a_Inj1 (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a)
170	  | (a_Inj2 a) => a_Inj2 (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a)
171	  | (a_Case psi a b1 b2) => a_Case psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b1) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b2)
172	  | (a_WSigma psi A B) => a_WSigma psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 B)
173	  | (a_WPair a psi b) => a_WPair (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b)
174	  | (a_LetPair psi a b) => a_LetPair psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b)
175	  | (a_SSigma psi A B) => a_SSigma psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 B)
176	  | (a_SPair a psi b) => a_SPair (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b)
177	  | (a_Proj1 psi a) => a_Proj1 psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a)
178	  | (a_Proj2 psi a) => a_Proj2 psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a)
179	end.

201	Fixpoint close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (n1 : nat) (x1 : tmvar) (a1 : tm) {struct a1} : tm :=
202	  match a1 with
203	    | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
204	    | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
205	    | a_Pi psi1 A1 B1 => a_Pi psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 B1)
206	    | a_Abs psi1 A1 a2 => a_Abs psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 a2)
207	    | a_App a2 psi1 b1 => a_App (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1)
208	    | a_Type s => a_Type s
209	    | a_Var_f x2 => if (x1 == x2) then (a_Var_b n1) else (a_Var_f x2)
210	    | a_Var_b n2 => if (lt_ge_dec n2 n1) then (a_Var_b n2) else (a_Var_b (S n2))
211	    | a_Sum A1 A2 => a_Sum (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A2)
212	    | a_Inj1 a2 => a_Inj1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
213	    | a_Inj2 a2 => a_Inj2 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
214	    | a_Case psi a2 b1 b2 => a_Case psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b2)
215	    | a_WSigma psi1 A1 B1 => a_WSigma psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 B1)
216	    | a_WPair a2 psi1 b1 => a_WPair (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1)
217	    | a_LetPair psi1 a2 b1 => a_LetPair psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 b1)
218	    | a_SSigma psi1 A1 B1 => a_SSigma psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 B1)
219	    | a_SPair a2 psi1 b1 => a_SPair (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1)
220	    | a_Proj1 psi1 a2 => a_Proj1 psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
221	    | a_Proj2 psi1 a2 => a_Proj2 psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
222	  end.

226	Inductive Step : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
227	 | S_AppCong : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b a':tm),
228	     lc_tm b ->
229	     Step a a' ->
230	     Step (a_App a psi b) (a_App a' psi b)
231	 | S_Beta : forall (psi:grade) (A a b:tm),
232	     lc_tm A ->
233	     lc_tm (a_Abs psi A a) ->
234	     lc_tm b ->
235	     Step (a_App  ( (a_Abs psi A a) )  psi b)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  a   b )
236	 | S_CaseCong : forall (psi:grade) (a b1 b2 a':tm),
237	     lc_tm b1 ->
238	     lc_tm b2 ->
239	     Step a a' ->
240	     Step (a_Case psi a b1 b2) (a_Case psi a' b1 b2)
241	 | S_Case1Beta : forall (psi:grade) (a b1 b2:tm),
242	     lc_tm b2 ->
243	     lc_tm b1 ->
244	     lc_tm a ->
245	     Step (a_Case psi  ( (a_Inj1 a) )  b1 b2) (a_App b1 psi a)
246	 | S_Case2Beta : forall (psi:grade) (a b1 b2:tm),
247	     lc_tm b1 ->
248	     lc_tm b2 ->
249	     lc_tm a ->
250	     Step (a_Case psi  ( (a_Inj2 a) )  b1 b2) (a_App b2 psi a)
251	 | S_Proj1Cong : forall (psi:grade) (a a':tm),
252	     Step a a' ->
253	     Step (a_Proj1 psi a) (a_Proj1 psi a')
254	 | S_Proj2Cong : forall (psi:grade) (a a':tm),
255	     Step a a' ->
256	     Step (a_Proj2 psi a) (a_Proj2 psi a')
257	 | S_Proj1Beta : forall (psi:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
258	     lc_tm a2 ->
259	     lc_tm a1 ->
260	     Step (a_Proj1 psi (a_SPair a1 psi a2)) a1
261	 | S_Proj2Beta : forall (psi:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
262	     lc_tm a1 ->
263	     lc_tm a2 ->
264	     Step (a_Proj2 psi (a_SPair a1 psi a2)) a2
265	 | S_LetPairCong : forall (psi:grade) (a b a':tm),
266	     lc_tm (a_LetPair psi a b) ->
267	     Step a a' ->
268	     Step (a_LetPair psi a b) (a_LetPair psi a' b)
269	 | S_LetPairBeta : forall (psi:grade) (a1 a2 b:tm),
270	     lc_tm (a_LetPair psi (a_WPair a1 psi a2) b) ->
271	     lc_tm a1 ->
272	     lc_tm a2 ->
273	     Step (a_LetPair psi (a_WPair a1 psi a2) b) (a_App  (open_tm_wrt_tm  b   a1 )   q_Bot  a2).

275	Inductive P_sub : econtext -> econtext -> Prop :=
276	 | P_Empty :
277	     P_sub  nil   nil
278	 | P_Cons : forall (P1:econtext) (x:tmvar) (psi1:grade) (P2:econtext) (psi2:grade),
279	      ( psi1  <=  psi2 )  ->
280	     P_sub P1 P2 ->
281	      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  P1 )  ->
282	      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  P2 )  ->
283	     P_sub  (  ( x ~ psi1 )  ++ P1 )   (  ( x ~ psi2 )  ++ P2 ) .

286	 | CS_Empty :
287	     ctx_sub  nil   nil

289	      ( psi1  <=  psi2 )  ->
290	     ctx_sub W1 W2 ->
291	      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  W1 )  ->
292	      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  W2 )  ->
293	      True  ->

296	Inductive CGrade : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> Prop :=
297	 | CG_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (phi phi0:grade) (a:tm),
298	      ( phi0  <=  phi )  ->
299	     Grade P phi a ->
300	     CGrade P phi phi0 a
301	 | CG_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (phi phi0:grade) (a:tm),
302	     lc_tm a ->
303	      not (  (  ( phi0  <=  phi )  )  )  ->
304	      uniq  P  ->
305	     CGrade P phi phi0 a
306	with Grade : econtext -> grade -> tm -> Prop :=
307	 | G_Type : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
308	      uniq  P  ->
309	     Grade P psi (a_Type s)
310	 | G_Var : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (x:tmvar) (psi0:grade),
311	      uniq  P  ->
312	      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
313	      binds  x   psi0   P  ->
314	     Grade P psi (a_Var_f x)
315	 | G_Pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm),
316	     Grade P psi A ->
317	      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Grade  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
318	     Grade P psi (a_Pi psi0 A B)
319	 | G_Abs : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A b:tm),

321	     CGrade P psi  q_Top  A ->
322	     Grade P psi (a_Abs psi0 A b)
323	 | G_App : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (b:tm) (psi0:grade) (a:tm),
324	     Grade P psi b ->
325	     CGrade P psi psi0 a ->
326	     Grade P psi (a_App b psi0 a)
327	 | G_WSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm),
328	     Grade P psi A ->
329	      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Grade  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->

333	     Grade P psi b ->
334	     Grade P psi (a_WPair a psi0 b)
335	 | G_LetPair : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a c:tm),
336	     Grade P psi a ->
337	      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Grade  (  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm c (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
338	     Grade P psi (a_LetPair psi0 a c)
339	 | G_SSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm),
340	     Grade P psi A ->
341	      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Grade  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
342	     Grade P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A B)
343	 | G_SPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b:tm),
344	     CGrade P psi psi0 a ->
345	     Grade P psi b ->
346	     Grade P psi (a_SPair a psi0 b)
347	 | G_Proj1 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a:tm),
348	     Grade P psi a ->
349	      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
350	     Grade P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a)
351	 | G_Proj2 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a:tm),
352	     Grade P psi a ->
353	     Grade P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a)
354	 | G_Sum : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
355	     Grade P psi A ->
356	     Grade P psi B ->
357	     Grade P psi (a_Sum A B)
358	 | G_Inj1 : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1:tm),
359	     Grade P psi a1 ->
360	     Grade P psi (a_Inj1 a1)
361	 | G_Inj2 : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a2:tm),
362	     Grade P psi a2 ->
363	     Grade P psi (a_Inj2 a2)
364	 | G_Case : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b1 b2:tm),
365	     Grade P psi a ->
366	     Grade P psi b1 ->
367	     Grade P psi b2 ->
368	      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
369	     Grade P psi (a_Case psi0 a b1 b2)
370	 | G_TyUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
371	      uniq  P  ->
372	     Grade P psi a_TyUnit
373	 | G_TmUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
374	      uniq  P  ->
375	     Grade P psi a_TmUnit.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Export Metalib.LibLNgen.

Require Export Qual.grade_sig.

Require Export Qual.sort_sig.

Definition tmvar : Set := var.

Definition qualityvar : Set := atom.

Definition grade : Set := grade.

Definition sort : Set := sort.

Inductive tm : Set :=
 | a_TyUnit : tm
 | a_TmUnit : tm
 | a_Pi (psi:grade) (A:tm) (B:tm)
 | a_Abs (psi:grade) (A:tm) (a:tm)
 | a_App (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm)
 | a_Type (s:sort)
 | a_Var_b (_:nat)
 | a_Var_f (x:tmvar)
 | a_Sum (A1:tm) (A2:tm)
 | a_Inj1 (a:tm)
 | a_Inj2 (a:tm)
 | a_Case (psi:grade) (a:tm) (b1:tm) (b2:tm)
 | a_WSigma (psi:grade) (A:tm) (B:tm)
 | a_WPair (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm)
 | a_LetPair (psi:grade) (a:tm) (b:tm)
 | a_SSigma (psi:grade) (A:tm) (B:tm)
 | a_SPair (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm)
 | a_Proj1 (psi:grade) (a:tm)
 | a_Proj2 (psi:grade) (a:tm).

Definition econtext : Set := list ( atom * grade ).

Definition context : Set := list ( atom * (grade * tm) ).

Fixpoint open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (k:nat) (a5:tm) (a_6:tm) {struct a_6}: tm :=
  match a_6 with
  | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
  | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
  | (a_Pi psi A B) => a_Pi psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 B)
  | (a_Abs psi A a) => a_Abs psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 a)
  | (a_App a psi b) => a_App (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_Type s) => a_Type s
  | (a_Var_b nat) =>
      match lt_eq_lt_dec nat k with
        | inleft (left _) => a_Var_b nat
        | inleft (right _) => a5
        | inright _ => a_Var_b (nat - 1)
      end
  | (a_Var_f x) => a_Var_f x
  | (a_Sum A1 A2) => a_Sum (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A1) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A2)
  | (a_Inj1 a) => a_Inj1 (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_Inj2 a) => a_Inj2 (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_Case psi a b1 b2) => a_Case psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b1) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b2)
  | (a_WSigma psi A B) => a_WSigma psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 B)
  | (a_WPair a psi b) => a_WPair (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_LetPair psi a b) => a_LetPair psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 b)
  | (a_SSigma psi A B) => a_SSigma psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 A) (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S k) a5 B)
  | (a_SPair a psi b) => a_SPair (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 b)
  | (a_Proj1 psi a) => a_Proj1 psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
  | (a_Proj2 psi a) => a_Proj2 psi (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k a5 a)
end.

Definition open_tm_wrt_tm a5 a_6 := open_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 a_6 a5.

Inductive lc_tm : tm -> Prop :=
 | lc_a_TyUnit :
     (lc_tm a_TyUnit)
 | lc_a_TmUnit :
     (lc_tm a_TmUnit)
 | lc_a_Pi : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_Pi psi A B))
 | lc_a_Abs : forall (psi:grade) (A a:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_Abs psi A a))
 | lc_a_App : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b) ->
     (lc_tm (a_App a psi b))
 | lc_a_Type : forall (s:sort),
     (lc_tm (a_Type s))
 | lc_a_Var_f : forall (x:tmvar),
     (lc_tm (a_Var_f x))
 | lc_a_Sum : forall (A1 A2:tm),
     (lc_tm A1) ->
     (lc_tm A2) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Sum A1 A2))
 | lc_a_Inj1 : forall (a:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Inj1 a))
 | lc_a_Inj2 : forall (a:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Inj2 a))
 | lc_a_Case : forall (psi:grade) (a b1 b2:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b1) ->
     (lc_tm b2) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Case psi a b1 b2))
 | lc_a_WSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_WSigma psi A B))
 | lc_a_WPair : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b) ->
     (lc_tm (a_WPair a psi b))
 | lc_a_LetPair : forall (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_LetPair psi a b))
 | lc_a_SSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_SSigma psi A B))
 | lc_a_SPair : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b) ->
     (lc_tm (a_SPair a psi b))
 | lc_a_Proj1 : forall (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Proj1 psi a))
 | lc_a_Proj2 : forall (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Proj2 psi a)).

Fixpoint fv_tm_tm (a5:tm) : vars :=
  match a5 with
  | a_TyUnit => {}
  | a_TmUnit => {}
  | (a_Pi psi A B) => (fv_tm_tm A) \u (fv_tm_tm B)
  | (a_Abs psi A a) => (fv_tm_tm A) \u (fv_tm_tm a)
  | (a_App a psi b) => (fv_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm b)
  | (a_Type s) => {}
  | (a_Var_b nat) => {}
  | (a_Var_f x) => {{x}}
  | (a_Sum A1 A2) => (fv_tm_tm A1) \u (fv_tm_tm A2)
  | (a_Inj1 a) => (fv_tm_tm a)
  | (a_Inj2 a) => (fv_tm_tm a)
  | (a_Case psi a b1 b2) => (fv_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm b1) \u (fv_tm_tm b2)
  | (a_WSigma psi A B) => (fv_tm_tm A) \u (fv_tm_tm B)
  | (a_WPair a psi b) => (fv_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm b)
  | (a_LetPair psi a b) => (fv_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm b)
  | (a_SSigma psi A B) => (fv_tm_tm A) \u (fv_tm_tm B)
  | (a_SPair a psi b) => (fv_tm_tm a) \u (fv_tm_tm b)
  | (a_Proj1 psi a) => (fv_tm_tm a)
  | (a_Proj2 psi a) => (fv_tm_tm a)
end.

Fixpoint subst_tm_tm (a5:tm) (x5:tmvar) (a_6:tm) {struct a_6} : tm :=
  match a_6 with
  | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
  | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
  | (a_Pi psi A B) => a_Pi psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 B)
  | (a_Abs psi A a) => a_Abs psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_App a psi b) => a_App (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b)
  | (a_Type s) => a_Type s
  | (a_Var_b nat) => a_Var_b nat
  | (a_Var_f x) => (if eq_var x x5 then a5 else (a_Var_f x))
  | (a_Sum A1 A2) => a_Sum (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A1) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A2)
  | (a_Inj1 a) => a_Inj1 (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_Inj2 a) => a_Inj2 (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_Case psi a b1 b2) => a_Case psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b1) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b2)
  | (a_WSigma psi A B) => a_WSigma psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 B)
  | (a_WPair a psi b) => a_WPair (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b)
  | (a_LetPair psi a b) => a_LetPair psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b)
  | (a_SSigma psi A B) => a_SSigma psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 A) (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 B)
  | (a_SPair a psi b) => a_SPair (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a) psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 b)
  | (a_Proj1 psi a) => a_Proj1 psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a)
  | (a_Proj2 psi a) => a_Proj2 psi (subst_tm_tm a5 x5 a)
end.

Local Open Scope grade_scope.

Definition labels : context -> econtext :=
  map (fun '(u , s) => u).

Definition subst_ctx (a : tm) (x:var) : context -> context :=
  map (fun '(g, A) => (g, (subst_tm_tm a x A))).

Definition join_ctx_l (psi : grade) : context -> context :=
  map (fun '(g, A) => (psi * g, A)).

Definition join_ctx_r (psi : grade) : context -> context :=
  map (fun '(g, A) => (g * psi, A)).

Definition meet_ctx_l (psi : grade) : context -> context :=
  map (fun '(g, A) => (psi + g, A)).

Definition meet_ctx_r (psi : grade) : context -> context :=
  map (fun '(g, A) => (g + psi, A)).

Fixpoint close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (n1 : nat) (x1 : tmvar) (a1 : tm) {struct a1} : tm :=
  match a1 with
    | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
    | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
    | a_Pi psi1 A1 B1 => a_Pi psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 B1)
    | a_Abs psi1 A1 a2 => a_Abs psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 a2)
    | a_App a2 psi1 b1 => a_App (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1)
    | a_Type s => a_Type s
    | a_Var_f x2 => if (x1 == x2) then (a_Var_b n1) else (a_Var_f x2)
    | a_Var_b n2 => if (lt_ge_dec n2 n1) then (a_Var_b n2) else (a_Var_b (S n2))
    | a_Sum A1 A2 => a_Sum (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A2)
    | a_Inj1 a2 => a_Inj1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
    | a_Inj2 a2 => a_Inj2 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
    | a_Case psi a2 b1 b2 => a_Case psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b2)
    | a_WSigma psi1 A1 B1 => a_WSigma psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 B1)
    | a_WPair a2 psi1 b1 => a_WPair (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1)
    | a_LetPair psi1 a2 b1 => a_LetPair psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 b1)
    | a_SSigma psi1 A1 B1 => a_SSigma psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 B1)
    | a_SPair a2 psi1 b1 => a_SPair (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1)
    | a_Proj1 psi1 a2 => a_Proj1 psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
    | a_Proj2 psi1 a2 => a_Proj2 psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
  end.

Definition close_tm_wrt_tm x1 a1 := close_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 x1 a1.

Inductive Step : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | S_AppCong : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b a':tm),
     lc_tm b ->
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_App a psi b) (a_App a' psi b)
 | S_Beta : forall (psi:grade) (A a b:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_Abs psi A a) ->
     lc_tm b ->
     Step (a_App  ( (a_Abs psi A a) )  psi b)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  a   b )
 | S_CaseCong : forall (psi:grade) (a b1 b2 a':tm),
     lc_tm b1 ->
     lc_tm b2 ->
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_Case psi a b1 b2) (a_Case psi a' b1 b2)
 | S_Case1Beta : forall (psi:grade) (a b1 b2:tm),
     lc_tm b2 ->
     lc_tm b1 ->
     lc_tm a ->
     Step (a_Case psi  ( (a_Inj1 a) )  b1 b2) (a_App b1 psi a)
 | S_Case2Beta : forall (psi:grade) (a b1 b2:tm),
     lc_tm b1 ->
     lc_tm b2 ->
     lc_tm a ->
     Step (a_Case psi  ( (a_Inj2 a) )  b1 b2) (a_App b2 psi a)
 | S_Proj1Cong : forall (psi:grade) (a a':tm),
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_Proj1 psi a) (a_Proj1 psi a')
 | S_Proj2Cong : forall (psi:grade) (a a':tm),
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_Proj2 psi a) (a_Proj2 psi a')
 | S_Proj1Beta : forall (psi:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a2 ->
     lc_tm a1 ->
     Step (a_Proj1 psi (a_SPair a1 psi a2)) a1
 | S_Proj2Beta : forall (psi:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
     Step (a_Proj2 psi (a_SPair a1 psi a2)) a2
 | S_LetPairCong : forall (psi:grade) (a b a':tm),
     lc_tm (a_LetPair psi a b) ->
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_LetPair psi a b) (a_LetPair psi a' b)
 | S_LetPairBeta : forall (psi:grade) (a1 a2 b:tm),
     lc_tm (a_LetPair psi (a_WPair a1 psi a2) b) ->
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
     Step (a_LetPair psi (a_WPair a1 psi a2) b) (a_App  (open_tm_wrt_tm  b   a1 )   q_Bot  a2).

Inductive P_sub : econtext -> econtext -> Prop :=
 | P_Empty :
     P_sub  nil   nil
 | P_Cons : forall (P1:econtext) (x:tmvar) (psi1:grade) (P2:econtext) (psi2:grade),
      ( psi1  <=  psi2 )  ->
     P_sub P1 P2 ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  P1 )  ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  P2 )  ->
     P_sub  (  ( x ~ psi1 )  ++ P1 )   (  ( x ~ psi2 )  ++ P2 ) .

Inductive ctx_sub : context -> context -> Prop :=
 | CS_Empty :
     ctx_sub  nil   nil
 | CS_ConsTm : forall (W1:context) (x:tmvar) (psi1:grade) (A:tm) (W2:context) (psi2:grade),
      ( psi1  <=  psi2 )  ->
     ctx_sub W1 W2 ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  W1 )  ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  W2 )  ->
      True  ->
     ctx_sub  (  ( x ~( psi1 , A ))  ++ W1 )   (  ( x ~( psi2 , A ))  ++ W2 ) .

Inductive CGrade : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CG_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (phi phi0:grade) (a:tm),
      ( phi0  <=  phi )  ->
     Grade P phi a ->
     CGrade P phi phi0 a
 | CG_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (phi phi0:grade) (a:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
      not (  (  ( phi0  <=  phi )  )  )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CGrade P phi phi0 a
with Grade : econtext -> grade -> tm -> Prop :=
 | G_Type : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
      uniq  P  ->
     Grade P psi (a_Type s)
 | G_Var : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (x:tmvar) (psi0:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      binds  x   psi0   P  ->
     Grade P psi (a_Var_f x)
 | G_Pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm),
     Grade P psi A ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Grade  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Grade P psi (a_Pi psi0 A B)
 | G_Abs : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A b:tm),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Grade  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     CGrade P psi  q_Top  A ->
     Grade P psi (a_Abs psi0 A b)
 | G_App : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (b:tm) (psi0:grade) (a:tm),
     Grade P psi b ->
     CGrade P psi psi0 a ->
     Grade P psi (a_App b psi0 a)
 | G_WSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm),
     Grade P psi A ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Grade  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Grade P psi (a_WSigma psi0 A B)
 | G_WPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b:tm),
     CGrade P psi psi0 a ->
     Grade P psi b ->
     Grade P psi (a_WPair a psi0 b)
 | G_LetPair : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a c:tm),
     Grade P psi a ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Grade  (  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm c (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Grade P psi (a_LetPair psi0 a c)
 | G_SSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm),
     Grade P psi A ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Grade  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Grade P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A B)
 | G_SPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b:tm),
     CGrade P psi psi0 a ->
     Grade P psi b ->
     Grade P psi (a_SPair a psi0 b)
 | G_Proj1 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a:tm),
     Grade P psi a ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Grade P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a)
 | G_Proj2 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a:tm),
     Grade P psi a ->
     Grade P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a)
 | G_Sum : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     Grade P psi A ->
     Grade P psi B ->
     Grade P psi (a_Sum A B)
 | G_Inj1 : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1:tm),
     Grade P psi a1 ->
     Grade P psi (a_Inj1 a1)
 | G_Inj2 : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a2:tm),
     Grade P psi a2 ->
     Grade P psi (a_Inj2 a2)
 | G_Case : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b1 b2:tm),
     Grade P psi a ->
     Grade P psi b1 ->
     Grade P psi b2 ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Grade P psi (a_Case psi0 a b1 b2)
 | G_TyUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     Grade P psi a_TyUnit
 | G_TmUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     Grade P psi a_TmUnit.

Inductive CEq : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CEq_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     GEq P psi a1 a2 ->
     CEq P psi psi0 a1 a2
 | CEq_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
      not (  (  ( psi0  <=  psi )  )  )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CEq P psi psi0 a1 a2
with GEq : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | GEq_Var : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (x:tmvar) (psi0:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
      binds  x   psi0   P  ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     GEq P psi (a_Var_f x) (a_Var_f x)
 | GEq_Type : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
      uniq  P  ->
     GEq P psi (a_Type s) (a_Type s)
 | GEq_Pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     GEq P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> GEq  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     GEq P psi (a_Pi psi0 A1 B1) (a_Pi psi0 A2 B2)
 | GEq_Abs : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 b1 A2 b2:tm),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> GEq  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     CEq P psi  q_Top  A1 A2 ->
     GEq P psi (a_Abs psi0 A1 b1) (a_Abs psi0 A2 b2)
 | GEq_App : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (b1:tm) (psi0:grade) (a1 b2 a2:tm),
     GEq P psi b1 b2 ->
     CEq P psi psi0 a1 a2 ->
     GEq P psi (a_App b1 psi0 a1) (a_App b2 psi0 a2)
 | GEq_WSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     GEq P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> GEq  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     GEq P psi (a_WSigma psi0 A1 B1) (a_WSigma psi0 A2 B2)
 | GEq_WPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1:tm) (psi0:grade) (b1 a2 b2:tm),
     CEq P psi psi0 a1 a2 ->
     GEq P psi b1 b2 ->
     GEq P psi (a_WPair a1 psi0 b1) (a_WPair a2 psi0 b2)
 | GEq_LetPair : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 b1 a2 b2:tm),
     GEq P psi a1 a2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> GEq   (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )   psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     GEq P psi (a_LetPair psi0 a1 b1) (a_LetPair psi0 a2 b2)
 | GEq_SSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     GEq P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> GEq  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     GEq P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A1 B1) (a_SSigma psi0 A2 B2)
 | GEq_SPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1:tm) (psi0:grade) (b1 a2 b2:tm),
     CEq P psi psi0 a1 a2 ->
     GEq P psi b1 b2 ->
     GEq P psi (a_SPair a1 psi0 b1) (a_SPair a2 psi0 b2)
 | GEq_Proj1 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     GEq P psi a1 a2 ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     GEq P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a1) (a_Proj1 psi0 a2)
 | GEq_Proj2 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     GEq P psi a1 a2 ->
     GEq P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a1) (a_Proj2 psi0 a2)
 | GEq_Sum : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A1 A2 A1' A2':tm),
     GEq P psi A1 A1' ->
     GEq P psi A2 A2' ->
     GEq P psi (a_Sum A1 A2) (a_Sum A1' A2')
 | GEq_Inj1 : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1 a1':tm),
     GEq P psi a1 a1' ->
     GEq P psi (a_Inj1 a1) (a_Inj1 a1')
 | GEq_Inj2 : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a2 a2':tm),
     GEq P psi a2 a2' ->
     GEq P psi (a_Inj2 a2) (a_Inj2 a2')
 | GEq_Case : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b1 b2 a' b1' b2':tm),
     GEq P psi a a' ->
     GEq P psi b1 b1' ->
     GEq P psi b2 b2' ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     GEq P psi (a_Case psi0 a b1 b2) (a_Case psi0 a' b1' b2')
 | GEq_TyUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     GEq P psi a_TyUnit a_TyUnit
 | GEq_TmUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     GEq P psi a_TmUnit a_TmUnit.

Inductive CDefEq : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CDefEq_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (phi phi0:grade) (a b:tm),
      ( phi0  <=  phi )  ->
     DefEq P phi a b ->
     CDefEq P phi phi0 a b
 | CDefEq_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (phi phi0:grade) (a b:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     lc_tm b ->
      not (  (  ( phi0  <=  phi )  )  )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CDefEq P phi phi0 a b
with DefEq : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | Eq_Refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     Grade P psi a ->
     DefEq P psi a a
 | Eq_Trans : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a c b:tm),
     DefEq P psi a b ->
     DefEq P psi b c ->
     DefEq P psi a c
 | Eq_Sym : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (b a:tm),
     DefEq P psi a b ->
     DefEq P psi b a
 | Eq_Beta : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
     Grade P psi a ->
     Step a b ->
     Grade P psi b ->
     DefEq P psi a b
 | Eq_Pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     DefEq P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> DefEq  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Pi psi0 A1 B1) (a_Pi psi0 A2 B2)
 | Eq_Abs : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 b1 A2 b2:tm),
     CDefEq P psi  q_Top  A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> DefEq  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Abs psi0 A1 b1) (a_Abs psi0 A2 b2)
 | Eq_App : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (b1:tm) (psi0:grade) (a1 b2 a2:tm),
     DefEq P psi b1 b2 ->
     CDefEq P psi psi0 a1 a2 ->
     DefEq P psi (a_App b1 psi0 a1) (a_App b2 psi0 a2)
 | Eq_PiFst : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A1 A2:tm) (psi0:grade) (B1 B2:tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_Pi psi0 A1 B1) (a_Pi psi0 A2 B2) ->
     DefEq P psi A1 A2
 | Eq_PiSnd : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (B1 a1 B2 a2:tm) (psi0:grade) (A1 A2:tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_Pi psi0 A1 B1) (a_Pi psi0 A2 B2) ->
     DefEq P psi a1 a2 ->
     DefEq P psi  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B1   a1 )   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B2   a2 )
 | Eq_WSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     DefEq P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> DefEq  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_WSigma psi0 A1 B1) (a_WSigma psi0 A2 B2)
 | Eq_WSigmaFst : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A1 A2:tm) (psi0:grade) (B1 B2:tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_WSigma psi0 A1 B1) (a_WSigma psi0 A2 B2) ->
     DefEq P psi A1 A2
 | Eq_WSigmaSnd : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (B1 a B2:tm) (psi0:grade) (A1 A2:tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_WSigma psi0 A1 B1) (a_WSigma psi0 A2 B2) ->
     Grade P psi a ->
     DefEq P psi  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B1   a )   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B2   a )
 | Eq_WPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1:tm) (psi0:grade) (b1 a2 b2:tm),
     CDefEq P psi psi0 a1 a2 ->
     DefEq P psi b1 b2 ->
     DefEq P psi (a_WPair a1 psi0 b1) (a_WPair a2 psi0 b2)
 | Eq_LetPair : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 b1 a2 b2:tm),
     DefEq P psi a1 a2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> DefEq   (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )   psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_LetPair psi0 a1 b1) (a_LetPair psi0 a2 b2)
 | Eq_SSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     DefEq P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> DefEq  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A1 B1) (a_SSigma psi0 A2 B2)
 | Eq_SSigmaFst : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A1 A2:tm) (psi0:grade) (B1 B2:tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A1 B1) (a_SSigma psi0 A2 B2) ->
     DefEq P psi A1 A2
 | Eq_SSigmaSnd : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (B1 a1 B2 a2:tm) (psi0:grade) (A1 A2:tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A1 B1) (a_SSigma psi0 A2 B2) ->
     DefEq P psi a1 a2 ->
     DefEq P psi  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B1   a1 )   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B2   a2 )
 | Eq_SPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1:tm) (psi0:grade) (b1 a2 b2:tm),
     CDefEq P psi psi0 a1 a2 ->
     DefEq P psi b1 b2 ->
     DefEq P psi (a_SPair a1 psi0 b1) (a_SPair a2 psi0 b2)
 | Eq_Proj1 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     DefEq P psi a1 a2 ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a1) (a_Proj1 psi0 a2)
 | Eq_Proj2 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     DefEq P psi a1 a2 ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a1) (a_Proj2 psi0 a2)
 | Eq_Sum : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A1 A2 A1' A2':tm),
     DefEq P psi A1 A1' ->
     DefEq P psi A2 A2' ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Sum A1 A2) (a_Sum A1' A2')
 | Eq_SumFst : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A1 A1' A2 A2':tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_Sum A1 A2) (a_Sum A1' A2') ->
     DefEq P psi A1 A1'
 | Eq_SumSnd : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A2 A2' A1 A1':tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_Sum A1 A2) (a_Sum A1' A2') ->
     DefEq P psi A2 A2'
 | Eq_Inj1 : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1 a1':tm),
     DefEq P psi a1 a1' ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Inj1 a1) (a_Inj1 a1')
 | Eq_Inj2 : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a2 a2':tm),
     DefEq P psi a2 a2' ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Inj2 a2) (a_Inj2 a2')
 | Eq_Case : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b1 b2 a' b1' b2':tm),
     DefEq P psi a a' ->
     DefEq P psi b1 b1' ->
     DefEq P psi b2 b2' ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Case psi0 a b1 b2) (a_Case psi0 a' b1' b2')
 | Eq_TyUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     DefEq P psi a_TyUnit a_TyUnit
 | Eq_TmUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     DefEq P psi a_TmUnit a_TmUnit
 | Eq_SubstIrrel : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (phi:grade) (b1 a1 b2 a2:tm) (psi:grade),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
      True  ->
      True  ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> DefEq  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  phi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
      not (  (  ( psi  <=  phi )  )  )  ->
     DefEq P phi  (open_tm_wrt_tm  b1   a1 )   (open_tm_wrt_tm  b2   a2 ) .

Inductive Typing : context -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | T_Type : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (s1 s2:sort),
      uniq  W  ->
      ( psi  <=   q_C  )  ->
      axiom  s1   s2  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Type s1) (a_Type s2)
 | T_Conv : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a B A:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi a A ->
     DefEq  (labels   (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )  )   q_C  A B ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  B (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi a B
 | T_Var : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (x:tmvar) (A:tm) (psi0:grade),
      uniq  W  ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      binds  x  ( psi0 ,  A )  W  ->
      ( psi  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Var_f x) A
 | T_Pi : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm) (s3 s1 s2:sort),
     Typing W psi A (a_Type s1) ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~( psi , A ))  ++ W )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  (a_Type s2) )  ->
      rule_pi  s1   s2   s3  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Pi psi0 A B) (a_Type s3)
 | T_Abs : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A b B:tm) (s:sort),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~(  (q_join  psi0   psi )  , A ))  ++ W )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C   ( (a_Pi psi0 A B) )  (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi (a_Abs psi0 A b) (a_Pi psi0 A B)
 | T_App : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (b:tm) (psi0:grade) (a B A:tm),
     Typing W psi b (a_Pi psi0 A B) ->
     Typing W  (q_join  psi0   psi )  a A ->
      ( psi0  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_App b psi0 a)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )
 | T_AppIrrel : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (b:tm) (psi0:grade) (a B A:tm),
     Typing W psi b (a_Pi psi0 A B) ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  a A ->
      (  q_C   <  psi0 )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_App b psi0 a)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )
 | T_WSigma : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm) (s3 s1 s2:sort),
     Typing W psi A (a_Type s1) ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~( psi , A ))  ++ W )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  (a_Type s2) )  ->
      rule_sig  s1   s2   s3  ->
     Typing W psi (a_WSigma psi0 A B) (a_Type s3)
 | T_WPair : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b A B:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C   ( (a_WSigma psi0 A B) )  (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W  (q_join  psi0   psi )  a A ->
     Typing W psi b  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )  ->
      ( psi0  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_WPair a psi0 b) (a_WSigma psi0 A B)
 | T_WPairIrrel : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b A B:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C   ( (a_WSigma psi0 A B) )  (a_Type s) ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  a A ->
      (  q_C   <  psi0 )  ->
     Typing W psi b  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_WPair a psi0 b) (a_WSigma psi0 A B)
| T_LetPair : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a c C B A:tm) (s:sort),
       ( forall x , x \notin  L  ->
               Typing ((x ~ (q_C, a_WSigma psi0 A B)) ++ meet_ctx_l q_C W) q_C (open_tm_wrt_tm C (a_Var_f x)) (a_Type s))  ->
       Typing W psi a (a_WSigma psi0 A B) ->
       ( forall x , x \notin  L  ->
         forall y,  y \notin L \u {{x}} ->
               Typing ((x ~ ((q_join psi0 psi), A)) ++ W) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm c (a_Var_f x))
                    (a_Pi q_Bot (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x))
                           (close_tm_wrt_tm y (open_tm_wrt_tm C (a_WPair (a_Var_f x) psi0 (a_Var_f y)))))) ->
       (Typing W psi (a_LetPair psi0 a c)  (open_tm_wrt_tm C a))
 | T_SSigma : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm) (s3 s1 s2:sort),
     Typing W psi A (a_Type s1) ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~( psi , A ))  ++ W )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  (a_Type s2) )  ->
      rule_sig  s1   s2   s3  ->
     Typing W psi (a_SSigma psi0 A B) (a_Type s3)
 | T_SPair : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b A B:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  (a_SSigma psi0 A B) (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W  (q_join  psi0   psi )  a A ->
     Typing W psi b  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )  ->
      ( psi0  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_SPair a psi0 b) (a_SSigma psi0 A B)
 | T_Proj1 : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a A B:tm),
     Typing W psi a (a_SSigma psi0 A B) ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a) A
 | T_Proj2 : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a B A:tm),
     Typing W psi a (a_SSigma psi0 A B) ->
      ( psi0  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   (a_Proj1 psi0 a) )
 | T_Sum : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (A B:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi A (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi B (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi (a_Sum A B) (a_Type s)
 | T_Inj1 : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a1 A1 A2:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi a1 A1 ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  (a_Sum A1 A2) (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi (a_Inj1 a1) (a_Sum A1 A2)
 | T_Inj2 : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a2 A1 A2:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi a2 A2 ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  (a_Sum A1 A2) (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi (a_Inj2 a2) (a_Sum A1 A2)
| T_Case : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a b1 b2 B:tm) (A1 A2 B1 B2:tm) s,
       ( forall z, z \notin    L ->  Typing  (  (  ( z ~(  q_C  , (a_Sum A1 A2) ))  ++  (  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )  )  )  )   q_C  (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f z)) (a_Type s)) ->
     Typing W psi a (a_Sum A1 A2) ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  ->   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )  =   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   (a_Inj1 (a_Var_f x)) )    )  ->
      ( forall y , y \notin  L  ->   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f y) )  =   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   (a_Inj2 (a_Var_f y)) )    )  ->
     Typing W psi b1 (a_Pi psi0 A1 B1) ->
     Typing W psi b2 (a_Pi psi0 A2 B2) ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Case psi0 a b1 b2)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )
 | T_TmUnit : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
      uniq  W  ->
      ( psi  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi a_TyUnit (a_Type s)
 | T_TyUnit : forall (W:context) (psi:grade),
      uniq  W  ->
      ( psi  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi a_TmUnit a_TyUnit.

Inductive CTyping : context -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CT_Leq : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a A:tm),
     Typing W psi a A ->
      ( psi  <=   q_C  )  ->
     CTyping W psi a A
 | CT_Top : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a A:tm),
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  a A ->
      (  q_C   <  psi )  ->
     CTyping W psi a A.

Inductive Ctx : context -> Prop :=
 | Ctx_Empty :
     Ctx  nil
 | Ctx_Cons : forall (W:context) (x:tmvar) (psi0:grade) (A:tm) (s:sort),
     Ctx W ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  A (a_Type s) ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  W )  ->
     Ctx  (  ( x ~( psi0 , A ))  ++ W ) .

Inductive ValueType : tm -> Prop :=
 | ValueType_Type : forall (s:sort),
     ValueType (a_Type s)
 | ValueType_Unit :
     ValueType a_TyUnit
 | ValueType_Pi : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_Pi psi A B) ->
     ValueType (a_Pi psi A B)
 | ValueType_WSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_WSigma psi A B) ->
     ValueType (a_WSigma psi A B)
 | ValueType_SSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_SSigma psi A B) ->
     ValueType (a_SSigma psi A B)
 | ValueType_Sum : forall (A B:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm B ->
     ValueType (a_Sum A B).

Inductive Consistent : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | Consistent_a_Type : forall (s:sort),
     Consistent (a_Type s) (a_Type s)
 | Consistent_a_Unit :
     Consistent a_TyUnit a_TyUnit
 | Consistent_a_Pi : forall (psi:grade) (A B A' B':tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_Pi psi A B) ->
     lc_tm A' ->
     lc_tm (a_Pi psi A' B') ->
     Consistent  ( (a_Pi psi A B) )   ( (a_Pi psi A' B') )
 | Consistent_a_WSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B A' B':tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_WSigma psi A B) ->
     lc_tm A' ->
     lc_tm (a_WSigma psi A' B') ->
     Consistent  ( (a_WSigma psi A B) )   ( (a_WSigma psi A' B') )
 | Consistent_a_SSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B A' B':tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_SSigma psi A B) ->
     lc_tm A' ->
     lc_tm (a_SSigma psi A' B') ->
     Consistent  (a_SSigma psi A B)   (a_SSigma psi A' B')
 | Consistent_a_Sum : forall (A B A' B':tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm B ->
     lc_tm A' ->
     lc_tm B' ->
     Consistent  ( (a_Sum A B) )   ( (a_Sum A' B') )
 | Consistent_a_Step_R : forall (a b:tm),
     lc_tm b ->
      not ( ValueType a )  ->
     Consistent a b
 | Consistent_a_Step_L : forall (a b:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
      not ( ValueType b )  ->
     Consistent a b.

Inductive CPar : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CPar_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi a1 a2 ->
     CPar P psi psi0 a1 a2
 | CPar_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
      not (  (  ( psi0  <=  psi )  )  )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CPar P psi psi0 a1 a2
with Par : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | Par_Refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     Grade P psi a ->
     Par P psi a a
 | Par_Pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi1:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     Par P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Pi psi1 A1 B1) (a_Pi psi1 A2 B2)
 | Par_AppBeta : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b a' b' A:tm),
     Par P psi a  ( (a_Abs psi0 A a') )  ->
     CPar P psi psi0 b b' ->
     Par P psi (a_App a psi0 b)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  a'   b' )
 | Par_App : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b a' b':tm),
     Par P psi a a' ->
     CPar P psi psi0 b b' ->
     Par P psi (a_App a psi0 b) (a_App a' psi0 b')
 | Par_Abs : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 b1 A2 b2:tm),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     CPar P psi  q_Top  A1 A2 ->
     Par P psi (a_Abs psi0 A1 b1) (a_Abs psi0 A2 b2)
 | Par_WSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi1:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     Par P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Par P psi (a_WSigma psi1 A1 B1) (a_WSigma psi1 A2 B2)
 | Par_WPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1:tm) (psi0:grade) (b1 a2 b2:tm),
     CPar P psi psi0 a1 a2 ->
     Par P psi b1 b2 ->
     Par P psi (a_WPair a1 psi0 b1) (a_WPair a2 psi0 b2)
 | Par_WPairBeta : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 b1 b2 a1' a2':tm),
     Par P psi a1 (a_WPair a1' psi0 a2') ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   (open_tm_wrt_tm  b2   (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Par P psi (a_LetPair psi0 a1 b1) (a_App  (open_tm_wrt_tm  b2   a1' )   q_Bot  a2')
 | Par_LetPair : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 b1 a2 b2:tm),
     Par P psi a1 a2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Par P psi (a_LetPair psi0 a1 b1) (a_LetPair psi0 a2 b2)
 | Par_SSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi1:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     Par P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Par P psi (a_SSigma psi1 A1 B1) (a_SSigma psi1 A2 B2)
 | Par_SPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1:tm) (psi0:grade) (b1 a2 b2:tm),
     CPar P psi psi0 a1 a2 ->
     Par P psi b1 b2 ->
     Par P psi (a_SPair a1 psi0 b1) (a_SPair a2 psi0 b2)
 | Par_Proj1Beta : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a1' a2:tm),
     Par P psi a1 (a_SPair a1' psi0 a2) ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a1) a1'
 | Par_Proj1 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     Par P psi a1 a2 ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a1) (a_Proj1 psi0 a2)
 | Par_Proj2Beta : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2 a1':tm),
     Par P psi a1 (a_SPair a1' psi0 a2) ->
     Par P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a1) a2
 | Par_Proj2 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     Par P psi a1 a2 ->
     Par P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a1) (a_Proj2 psi0 a2)
 | Par_Sum : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A1 A2 A1' A2':tm),
     Par P psi A1 A1' ->
     Par P psi A2 A2' ->
     Par P psi (a_Sum A1 A2) (a_Sum A1' A2')
 | Par_Inj1 : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1 a1':tm),
     Par P psi a1 a1' ->
     Par P psi (a_Inj1 a1) (a_Inj1 a1')
 | Par_Inj2 : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a2 a2':tm),
     Par P psi a2 a2' ->
     Par P psi (a_Inj2 a2) (a_Inj2 a2')
 | Par_CaseBeta1 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b1 b2 b1' a' b2':tm),
     Par P psi a (a_Inj1 a') ->
     Par P psi b1 b1' ->
     Par P psi b2 b2' ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Case psi0 a b1 b2) (a_App b1' psi0 a')
 | Par_CaseBeta2 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b1 b2 b2' a' b1':tm),
     Par P psi a (a_Inj2 a') ->
     Par P psi b1 b1' ->
     Par P psi b2 b2' ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Case psi0 a b1 b2) (a_App b2' psi0 a')
 | Par_Case : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b1 b2 a' b1' b2':tm),
     Par P psi a a' ->
     Par P psi b1 b1' ->
     Par P psi b2 b2' ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Case psi0 a b1 b2) (a_Case psi0 a' b1' b2').

Inductive MultiPar : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | MP_Refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     Grade P psi a ->
     MultiPar P psi a a
 | MP_Step : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a a' b:tm),
     Par P psi a b ->
     MultiPar P psi b a' ->
     MultiPar P psi a a'.

Require Import Qual.defeq.
Require Import Qual.Qualitative_ott.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Open Scope grade_scope.

(* Level-indexed locally-closed predicate; bvars must be < k *)
Fixpoint lc_at (k:nat) (t:tm) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | a_TyUnit => True
  | a_TmUnit => True
  | a_Type _ => True
  | a_Var_f _ => True
  | a_Var_b n => n < k
  | a_Pi _ A B => lc_at k A /\ lc_at (S k) B
  | a_Abs _ A b => lc_at k A /\ lc_at (S k) b
  | a_App a _ b => lc_at k a /\ lc_at k b
  | a_Sum A B => lc_at k A /\ lc_at k B
  | a_Inj1 a => lc_at k a
  | a_Inj2 a => lc_at k a
  | a_Case _ a b1 b2 => lc_at k a /\ lc_at k b1 /\ lc_at k b2
  | a_WSigma _ A B => lc_at k A /\ lc_at (S k) B
  | a_WPair a _ b => lc_at k a /\ lc_at k b
  | a_LetPair _ a b => lc_at k a /\ lc_at (S k) b
  | a_SSigma _ A B => lc_at k A /\ lc_at (S k) B
  | a_SPair a _ b => lc_at k a /\ lc_at k b
  | a_Proj1 _ a => lc_at k a
  | a_Proj2 _ a => lc_at k a
  end.

Lemma lc_at_mono : forall t k j, lc_at k t -> lc_at (k+j) t.
Proof.
  induction t; simpl; intros k j H; auto; try tauto.
  - (* Var_b *) apply Nat.lt_le_trans with (m:=k); [exact H|]. lia.
  - (* Pi *) destruct H as [HA HB]. split; [apply IHt1|apply IHt2]; auto.
  - (* Abs *) destruct H as [HA Hb]. split; [apply IHt1|apply IHt2]; auto.
  - (* App *) destruct H as [Ha Hb]. split; [apply IHt1|apply IHt2]; auto.
  - (* Sum *) destruct H as [HA HB]. split; [apply IHt1|apply IHt2]; auto.
  - (* Inj1 *) apply IHt; auto.
  - (* Inj2 *) apply IHt; auto.
  - (* Case *) destruct H as [Ha [Hb1 Hb2]]. repeat split; auto.
  - (* WSigma *) destruct H as [HA HB]. split; [apply IHt1|apply IHt2]; auto.
  - (* WPair *) destruct H as [Ha Hb]. split; [apply IHt1|apply IHt2]; auto.
  - (* LetPair *) destruct H as [Ha Hb]. split; [apply IHt1|apply IHt2]; auto.
  - (* SSigma *) destruct H as [HA HB]. split; [apply IHt1|apply IHt2]; auto.
  - (* SPair *) destruct H as [Ha Hb]. split; [apply IHt1|apply IHt2]; auto.
  - (* Proj1 *) apply IHt; auto.
  - (* Proj2 *) apply IHt; auto.
Qed.
EOF

I've made a long, focused attempt at this. Let me summarize the technical findings honestly, and record the substantial infrastructure I did verify, because the blocker is structural rather than a matter of a missing tactic.

## Status: not completed

`Task.v` is left unchanged (no `admit`/`Axiom`/`Abort`, no changes to support files). The target `DefEq_Consistent` is not proved.

### What I verified along the way

I rebuilt, in a scratch project (`/tmp/scratch/`), a working layer of LN/grade infrastructure that any proof of this lemma will need, all checked by Rocq 9.1.0 against the supplied project:

- `size_tm`, and `open_tm_wrt_tm`/`open_tm_wrt_tm_rec` size laws (`size_open_var`).
- A level-indexed closedness predicate `lc_at : nat → tm → Prop`, its monotonicity, the opening lemma `lc_at k (open_rec k t B) ↔ lc_at (S k) B`, and the equivalence `lc_tm t ↔ lc_at 0 t` with `lc_at`-based opening-independence of `lc` (`lc_body_all`, `lc_open_term`).
- `Grade_lc` / `CGrade_lc` (well-graded terms are locally closed), `Grade_uniq` (`Grade` implies `uniq P`), and mutual `DefEq_lc` / `CDefEq_lc` (definitional equality implies local closure of both endpoints), including the `Eq_SubstIrrel` case via `lc_open_term`.

These all compile; they are the "easy half".

### The bottleneck

`DefEq` is an inductive *equivalence closure* (`Eq_Refl/Eq_Trans/Eq_Sym`) plus congruence, β/step, projection (`Eq_PiFst`, `Eq_PiSnd`, …) and `Eq_SubstIrrel` rules. The obvious induction on the derivation fails for four structural reasons:

1. `Eq_Trans` requires a transitive invariant. `Consistent` itself is not transitive (e.g. `Type s₁ ~ App-redex ~ Type s₂`), so the invariant must track weak-head reduction behaviour ("same VT reduct/tag"), and that must be composed through a possibly non-value middle term.
2. The projection rules (`Eq_PiFst/Snd` etc.) force the invariant to be *componentwise*, and the componentwise relation must survive `Eq_Trans` through a non-congruent middle — which makes the recursion go through reducts, i.e. a (co)inductive/bisimulation-style relation rather than a structural one.
3. `Eq_SubstIrrel`/`Eq_App`/`Eq_PiSnd` need opening/substitution commutation. The intended guard is that at grade φ the variable of grade ψ (with `not (ψ <= φ)`) is irrelevant, but proving the necessary "bodies don't use the variable" facts needs a head/grade–discipline invariant (my first attempt via "all free variables have grade ≤ φ" is refutable: `Eq_Abs` annotations are only checked by `CDefEq`, whose `Nleq` branch permits ungraded annotations).
4. `Par`/`MultiPar`/`GEq`/`Joins` in the supplied file are clearly the confluence toolkit the original proof used, but none of the necessary lemmas about them are supplied (Par-reflexivity from `Grade`, `Step`-into-`Par`, `MultiPar` confluence, GEq/Par opening/substitution and equivariance). Reconstructing that, together with the nominal LN equivariance machinery (which is absent — the file has no `permute`/renaming functions and no generic `lc`/`open` lemmas), is the missing large development.

In short: the lemma is true, but its proof is the metatheory of the calculus (confluence/parallel reduction plus nominal substitution), not a standalone induction. With only `Qualitative_ott.v` and Metalib, that is a multi-thousand-line development.

### What would unblock it

- The original development's helper files (the confluence/parallel-reduction and substitution/equivariance lemmas for `Grade`/`Par`/`MultiPar`/`GEq`) that this target lemma was originally proved from; or
- authorization to spend a much larger budget reconstructing that metatheory from scratch.

I did not find a shortcut/loophole: the grade side-conditions do block the obvious counterexample constructions (`Eq_App` with `CDefEq_Nleq` arguments, `S_Beta`/`S_Proj1Beta` into a value type), so the statement appears genuinely true and genuinely requires the missing machinery.

From Stdlib Require Import Lia.
Require Import Qual.geq.
Require Import Qual.defeq.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Open Scope grade_scope.

(* ---------- size ---------- *)
Fixpoint size_tm (u:tm) : nat :=
  match u with
  | a_TyUnit => 1 | a_TmUnit => 1 | a_Type _ => 1 | a_Var_f _ => 1 | a_Var_b _ => 1
  | a_Pi _ A B => 1 + size_tm A + size_tm B
  | a_Abs _ A b => 1 + size_tm A + size_tm b
  | a_App a _ b => 1 + size_tm a + size_tm b
  | a_Sum A B => 1 + size_tm A + size_tm B
  | a_Inj1 a => 1 + size_tm a | a_Inj2 a => 1 + size_tm a
  | a_Case _ a b1 b2 => 1 + size_tm a + size_tm b1 + size_tm b2
  | a_WSigma _ A B => 1 + size_tm A + size_tm B
  | a_WPair a _ b => 1 + size_tm a + size_tm b
  | a_LetPair _ a b => 1 + size_tm a + size_tm b
  | a_SSigma _ A B => 1 + size_tm A + size_tm B
  | a_SPair a _ b => 1 + size_tm a + size_tm b
  | a_Proj1 _ a => 1 + size_tm a | a_Proj2 _ a => 1 + size_tm a
  end.

Lemma size_tm_pos : forall u, 1 <= size_tm u.
Proof. destruct u; simpl; lia. Qed.

(* ---------- level-indexed local closedness ---------- *)
Fixpoint lc_at (k:nat) (u:tm) : Prop :=
  match u with
  | a_TyUnit => True
  | a_TmUnit => True
  | a_Type _ => True
  | a_Var_f _ => True
  | a_Var_b n => Nat.lt n k
  | a_Pi _ A B => lc_at k A /\ lc_at (S k) B
  | a_Abs _ A b => lc_at k A /\ lc_at (S k) b
  | a_App a _ b => lc_at k a /\ lc_at k b
  | a_Sum A B => lc_at k A /\ lc_at k B
  | a_Inj1 a => lc_at k a
  | a_Inj2 a => lc_at k a
  | a_Case _ a b1 b2 => lc_at k a /\ lc_at k b1 /\ lc_at k b2
  | a_WSigma _ A B => lc_at k A /\ lc_at (S k) B
  | a_WPair a _ b => lc_at k a /\ lc_at k b
  | a_LetPair _ a b => lc_at k a /\ lc_at (S k) b
  | a_SSigma _ A B => lc_at k A /\ lc_at (S k) B
  | a_SPair a _ b => lc_at k a /\ lc_at k b
  | a_Proj1 _ a => lc_at k a
  | a_Proj2 _ a => lc_at k a
  end.

Lemma lc_at_mono : forall u k j, (k <= j)%nat -> lc_at k u -> lc_at j u.
Proof.
  induction u; simpl; intros k j Hle H; auto; try tauto.
  - lia.
  - destruct H as [HA HB]. split; [exact (IHu1 k j Hle HA)|apply (IHu2 (S k) (S j)); [lia|exact HB]].
  - destruct H as [HA HB]. split; [exact (IHu1 k j Hle HA)|apply (IHu2 (S k) (S j)); [lia|exact HB]].
  - destruct H as [Ha Hb]. split; [exact (IHu1 k j Hle Ha)|exact (IHu2 k j Hle Hb)].
  - destruct H as [HA HB]. split; [exact (IHu1 k j Hle HA)|exact (IHu2 k j Hle HB)].
  - apply (IHu k j Hle); auto.
  - apply (IHu k j Hle); auto.
  - destruct H as [Ha [Hb1 Hb2]]. repeat split;
      [exact (IHu1 k j Hle Ha)|exact (IHu2 k j Hle Hb1)|exact (IHu3 k j Hle Hb2)].
  - destruct H as [HA HB]. split; [exact (IHu1 k j Hle HA)|apply (IHu2 (S k) (S j)); [lia|exact HB]].
  - destruct H as [Ha Hb]. split; [exact (IHu1 k j Hle Ha)|exact (IHu2 k j Hle Hb)].
  - destruct H as [Ha Hb]. split; [exact (IHu1 k j Hle Ha)|apply (IHu2 (S k) (S j)); [lia|exact HB]].
  - destruct H as [HA HB]. split; [exact (IHu1 k j Hle HA)|apply (IHu2 (S k) (S j)); [lia|exact HB]].
  - destruct H as [Ha Hb]. split; [exact (IHu1 k j Hle Ha)|exact (IHu2 k j Hle Hb)].
  - apply (IHu k j Hle); auto.
  - apply (IHu k j Hle); auto.
Qed.
Arguments lc_at_mono : clear implicits.
Arguments lc_at_mono u k j _ _.

Lemma lc_at_open_rec : forall B t k, lc_at 0 t ->
  (lc_at k (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k t B) <-> lc_at (S k) B).
Proof.
  induction B; intros t k Ht; simpl.
  - tauto. - tauto.
  - (* Pi *) split; intros [HA HB]; split.
    + exact (proj1 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj1 (IHB2 t (S k) Ht) HB).
    + exact (proj2 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj2 (IHB2 t (S k) Ht) HB).
  - (* Abs *) split; intros [HA HB]; split.
    + exact (proj1 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj1 (IHB2 t (S k) Ht) HB).
    + exact (proj2 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj2 (IHB2 t (S k) Ht) HB).
  - (* App *) split; intros [HA HB]; split.
    + exact (proj1 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj1 (IHB2 t k Ht) HB).
    + exact (proj2 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj2 (IHB2 t k Ht) HB).
  - tauto.
  - (* Var_b *) destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[Hlt|Heq]|Hgt]; simpl.
    + split; intros H; lia.
    + subst n. split; intros H.
      * lia.
      * exact (lc_at_mono t 0 k (Nat.le_0_l k) Ht).
    + split; intros H.
      * assert (Hn : (n - 1 < k)%nat) by lia. lia.
      * assert (Hn : (n < S k)%nat) by lia. destruct k; [lia|]. simpl. lia.
  - tauto.
  - (* Sum *) split; intros [HA HB]; split.
    + exact (proj1 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj1 (IHB2 t k Ht) HB).
    + exact (proj2 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj2 (IHB2 t k Ht) HB).
  - (* Inj1 *) split; intros H; [exact (proj1 (IHB t k Ht) H)|exact (proj2 (IHB t k Ht) H)].
  - (* Inj2 *) split; intros H; [exact (proj1 (IHB t k Ht) H)|exact (proj2 (IHB t k Ht) H)].
  - (* Case *) split; intros [HA [HB1 HB2]]; repeat split.
    + exact (proj1 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj1 (IHB2 t k Ht) HB1). + exact (proj1 (IHB3 t k Ht) HB2).
    + exact (proj2 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj2 (IHB2 t k Ht) HB1). + exact (proj2 (IHB3 t k Ht) HB2).
  - (* WSigma *) split; intros [HA HB]; split.
    + exact (proj1 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj1 (IHB2 t (S k) Ht) HB).
    + exact (proj2 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj2 (IHB2 t (S k) Ht) HB).
  - (* WPair *) split; intros [HA HB]; split.
    + exact (proj1 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj1 (IHB2 t k Ht) HB).
    + exact (proj2 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj2 (IHB2 t k Ht) HB).
  - (* LetPair *) split; intros [HA HB]; split.
    + exact (proj1 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj1 (IHB2 t (S k) Ht) HB).
    + exact (proj2 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj2 (IHB2 t (S k) Ht) HB).
  - (* SSigma *) split; intros [HA HB]; split.
    + exact (proj1 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj1 (IHB2 t (S k) Ht) HB).
    + exact (proj2 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj2 (IHB2 t (S k) Ht) HB).
  - (* SPair *) split; intros [HA HB]; split.
    + exact (proj1 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj1 (IHB2 t k Ht) HB).
    + exact (proj2 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj2 (IHB2 t k Ht) HB).
  - (* Proj1 *) split; intros H; [exact (proj1 (IHB t k Ht) H)|exact (proj2 (IHB t k Ht) H)].
  - (* Proj2 *) split; intros H; [exact (proj1 (IHB t k Ht) H)|exact (proj2 (IHB t k Ht) H)].
Qed.
Arguments lc_at_open_rec B t k _.

Lemma lc_at_S_body : forall B, (forall x, lc_at 0 (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x))) -> lc_at 1 B.
Proof.
  intros B H. destruct (atom_fresh (empty : atoms)) as [x _].
  apply (proj1 (lc_at_open_rec B (a_Var_f x) 0 I)). apply H.
Qed.

Lemma lc_tm_lc_at_0 : forall u, lc_tm u -> lc_at 0 u.
Proof.
  induction 1; simpl; auto.
  all: try (split; [auto | apply lc_at_S_body; auto]).
Qed.

  try (rewrite IHB1; auto); try (rewrite IHB2; auto);

      * apply IHn; [simpl in *; lia|exact HA].

Lemma step_lhs_shape : forall a b, Step a b ->

Proof. intros a b H; destruct H; eauto 8. Qed.

Lemma step_not_Abs : forall psi A x y, Step (a_Abs psi A x) y -> False.
Proof.
  intros psi A x y H. destruct (step_lhs_shape H) as [[u1 [g [u2 E]]]|[[g [u1 [u2 [u3 E]]]]|[[g [u1 E]]|[[g [u1 E]]|[g [u1 [u2 E]]]]]];

Qed.
Lemma step_not_Inj1 : forall x y, Step (a_Inj1 x) y -> False.
Proof.

Lemma step_not_Inj2 : forall x y, Step (a_Inj2 x) y -> False.
Proof.

Qed.

(* ---------- Grade/ CGrade yield reflexive GEq/CEq ---------- *)
Lemma Grade_GEq_refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm), Grade P psi a -> GEq P psi a a.
Proof.
  intros P psi a H. induction H using Grade_mind
    with (P0 := fun (P:econtext) (psi phi0:grade) (a:tm) (_:CGrade P psi phi0 a) => CEq P psi phi0 a a).
  - apply GEq_Type; assumption.
  - apply GEq_Var; assumption.
  - apply GEq_Pi; assumption.
  - apply GEq_Abs; assumption.
  - apply GEq_App; assumption.
  - apply GEq_WSigma; assumption.
  - apply GEq_WPair; assumption.
  - apply GEq_LetPair; assumption.
  - apply GEq_SSigma; assumption.
  - apply GEq_SPair; assumption.
  - apply GEq_Proj1; assumption.
  - apply GEq_Proj2; assumption.
  - apply GEq_Sum; assumption.
  - apply GEq_Inj1; assumption.
  - apply GEq_Inj2; assumption.
  - apply GEq_Case; assumption.
  - apply GEq_TyUnit; assumption.
  - apply GEq_TmUnit; assumption.
  - apply CEq_Leq; assumption.
  - apply CEq_Nleq; assumption.
Qed.
Arguments Grade_GEq_refl : clear implicits.
Arguments Grade_GEq_refl P psi a _.

Lemma CGrade_CEq_refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi phi0:grade) (a:tm), CGrade P psi phi0 a -> CEq P psi phi0 a a.
Proof.
  intros P psi phi0 a H. induction H.
  - apply CEq_Leq; [assumption | apply Grade_GEq_refl; assumption].
  - apply CEq_Nleq; assumption.
Qed.
Arguments CGrade_CEq_refl : clear implicits.
Arguments CGrade_CEq_refl P psi phi0 a _.

Lemma Grade_CPar_refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi phi0:grade) (a:tm), CGrade P psi phi0 a -> CPar P psi phi0 a a.
Proof.
  intros P psi phi0 a H. induction H.
  - apply CPar_Leq; [assumption | apply Par_Refl; assumption].
  - apply CPar_Nleq; assumption.
Qed.
Arguments Grade_CPar_refl : clear implicits.
Arguments Grade_CPar_refl P psi phi0 a _.

(* ---------- a single Step is simulated by Par ---------- *)
Lemma Par_of_Step : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
  Grade P psi a -> Step a b -> Grade P psi b -> Par P psi a b.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b Ga S Gb. revert Gb. induction S; intros Gb.
  - (* AppCong *) apply Par_App.
    + apply IHS. inversion Ga; assumption.
    + inversion Ga; apply Grade_CPar_refl; assumption.
  - (* Beta *) apply Par_AppBeta.
    + apply Par_Refl. inversion Ga; assumption.
    + inversion Ga; apply Grade_CPar_refl; assumption.
  - (* CaseCong *) apply Par_Case.
    + apply IHS. inversion Ga; assumption.
    + apply Par_Refl. inversion Ga; assumption.
    + apply Par_Refl. inversion Ga; assumption.
    + inversion Ga; assumption.
  - (* Case1Beta *) apply Par_CaseBeta1.
    + apply Par_Inj1. apply Par_Refl. inversion Ga; assumption.
    + apply Par_Refl. inversion Ga; assumption.
    + apply Par_Refl. inversion Ga; assumption.
    + inversion Ga; assumption.
  - (* Case2Beta *) apply Par_CaseBeta2.
    + apply Par_Inj2. apply Par_Refl. inversion Ga; assumption.
    + apply Par_Refl. inversion Ga; assumption.
    + apply Par_Refl. inversion Ga; assumption.
    + inversion Ga; assumption.
  - (* Proj1Cong *) apply Par_Proj1.
    + apply IHS. inversion Ga; assumption.
    + inversion Ga; assumption.
  - (* Proj2Cong *) apply Par_Proj2.
    + apply IHS. inversion Ga; assumption.
  - (* Proj1Beta *) apply Par_Proj1Beta.
    + apply Par_SPair.
      * inversion Ga; apply Grade_CPar_refl; inversion H; assumption.
      * inversion Ga; inversion H; apply Par_Refl; assumption.
    + inversion Ga; assumption.
  - (* Proj2Beta *) apply Par_Proj2Beta.
    + apply Par_SPair.
      * inversion Ga; apply Grade_CPar_refl; inversion H; assumption.
      * inversion Ga; inversion H; apply Par_Refl; assumption.
  - (* LetPairCong *) apply Par_LetPair.
    + apply IHS. inversion Ga; assumption.
    + inversion Ga; intros x Hx; apply Par_Refl; apply H; assumption.
  - (* LetPairBeta *) apply Par_WPairBeta.
    + apply Par_SPair.
      * inversion Ga; apply Grade_CPar_refl; inversion H; assumption.
      * inversion Ga; inversion H; apply Par_Refl; assumption.
    + inversion Ga; intros x Hx; apply Par_Refl; apply H; assumption.
Qed.
EOF

Lemma MultiPar_Pi_fst : forall P psi a b, MultiPar P psi a b ->
  forall psi0 A1 B1, a = a_Pi psi0 A1 B1 -> exists A1', MultiPar P psi A1 A1'.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H; intros psi0 A1 B1 EQ.
  - subst a. eexists. apply MP_Refl. exact (Grade_Pi_inv P psi psi0 A1 B1 H).
  - subst a. inversion H; subst.
    + eapply IHMultiPar. reflexivity.
    + assert (Heq : a_Pi psi0 A2 B2 = a_Pi psi0 A2 B2) by reflexivity; destruct (IHMultiPar psi0 A2 B2 Heq) as [Z Mp].
      exists Z. eapply MP_Step; [exact H7 | exact Mp].

Lemma MultiPar_WSigma_fst : forall P psi a b, MultiPar P psi a b ->
  forall psi0 A1 B1, a = a_WSigma psi0 A1 B1 -> exists A1', MultiPar P psi A1 A1'.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H; intros psi0 A1 B1 EQ.
  - subst a. eexists. apply MP_Refl. exact (Grade_WSigma_inv P psi psi0 A1 B1 H).
  - subst a. inversion H; subst.
    + eapply IHMultiPar. reflexivity.

      exists Z. eapply MP_Step; [exact H7 | exact Mp].
Qed.
Lemma MultiPar_SSigma_fst : forall P psi a b, MultiPar P psi a b ->
  forall psi0 A1 B1, a = a_SSigma psi0 A1 B1 -> exists A1', MultiPar P psi A1 A1'.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H; intros psi0 A1 B1 EQ.

Lemma MultiPar_Sum_fst : forall P psi a b, MultiPar P psi a b ->

Inductive VtTag : tm -> tm -> Prop :=

 | VtTag_Pi : forall psi A B A' B', VtTag (a_Pi psi A B) (a_Pi psi A' B')

Lemma VtTag_VT : forall a b, VtTag a b -> lc_tm a -> lc_tm b -> ValueType a /\ ValueType b.
Proof.
  intros a b H; induction H; intros Ha Hb; split.
  - apply ValueType_Type. - apply ValueType_Type.
  - apply ValueType_Unit. - apply ValueType_Unit.
  - apply ValueType_Pi. * inversion Ha; assumption. * assumption.
  - apply ValueType_Pi. * inversion Hb; assumption. * assumption.
  - apply ValueType_WSigma. * inversion Ha; assumption. * assumption.
  - apply ValueType_WSigma. * inversion Hb; assumption. * assumption.
  - apply ValueType_SSigma. * inversion Ha; assumption. * assumption.
  - apply ValueType_SSigma. * inversion Hb; assumption. * assumption.
  - apply ValueType_Sum. * inversion Ha; assumption. * inversion Ha; assumption.
  - apply ValueType_Sum. * inversion Hb; assumption. * inversion Hb; assumption.
Qed.
Lemma VtTag_sym : forall a b, VtTag a b -> VtTag b a.
Proof. intros a b H; induction H; econstructor. Qed.

Qed.

Lemma VtTag_sym : forall a b, VtTag a b -> VtTag b a.
Proof. intros a b H; induction H; econstructor. Qed.
Lemma VtTag_trans : forall a b c, VtTag a b -> VtTag b c -> VtTag a c.
Proof.
  intros a b c H1 H2. revert c H2. induction H1; intros c' H2; inversion H2; subst; econstructor.
Qed.
Lemma VtTag_refl : forall a, ValueType a -> VtTag a a.
Proof. intros a H; induction H; econstructor. Qed.

Proof.

(* ---------- consistency bookkeeping ---------- *)
(* From agreement of value-type heads (plus local closure) to [Consistent]. *)
Lemma Consistent_of_VtTag : forall a b, VtTag a b -> lc_tm a -> lc_tm b -> Consistent a b.
Proof.
  intros a b H. induction H; intros Ha Hb.
  - apply Consistent_a_Type.
  - apply Consistent_a_Unit.
  - apply Consistent_a_Pi.
    + inversion Ha; assumption. + assumption. + inversion Hb; assumption. + assumption.
  - apply Consistent_a_WSigma.
    + inversion Ha; assumption. + assumption. + inversion Hb; assumption. + assumption.
  - apply Consistent_a_SSigma.
    + inversion Ha; assumption. + assumption. + inversion Hb; assumption. + assumption.
  - apply Consistent_a_Sum.
    + inversion Ha; assumption. + inversion Ha; assumption.
    + inversion Hb; assumption. + inversion Hb; assumption.
Qed.
Arguments Consistent_of_VtTag : clear implicits.
Arguments Consistent_of_VtTag a b _ _ _.

Lemma Consistent_refl : forall a, lc_tm a -> Consistent a a.
Proof.
  intros a H. destruct a; try solve [apply Consistent_a_Step_R; [exact H | intro H'; inversion H']].
  - (* TyUnit *) apply Consistent_a_Unit.
  - (* Pi *) apply Consistent_a_Pi; [inversion H; assumption | assumption | inversion H; assumption | assumption].
  - (* Type *) apply Consistent_a_Type.
  - (* Sum *) apply Consistent_a_Sum; try (inversion H; assumption); try assumption.
  - (* WSigma *) apply Consistent_a_WSigma; [inversion H; assumption | assumption | inversion H; assumption | assumption].
  - (* SSigma *) apply Consistent_a_SSigma; [inversion H; assumption | assumption | inversion H; assumption | assumption].
Qed.

Ltac vt_build :=
  match goal with
  | |- ValueType (a_Type _) => apply ValueType_Type
  | |- ValueType a_TyUnit => apply ValueType_Unit
  | Ha : lc_tm (a_Pi _ _ _) |- ValueType (a_Pi _ _ _) => apply ValueType_Pi; [inversion Ha; assumption | exact Ha]
  | Ha : lc_tm (a_WSigma _ _ _) |- ValueType (a_WSigma _ _ _) => apply ValueType_WSigma; [inversion Ha; assumption | exact Ha]
  | Ha : lc_tm (a_SSigma _ _ _) |- ValueType (a_SSigma _ _ _) => apply ValueType_SSigma; [inversion Ha; assumption | exact Ha]
  | Ha : lc_tm (a_Sum _ _) |- ValueType (a_Sum _ _) => apply ValueType_Sum; [inversion Ha; assumption | inversion Ha; assumption]
  end.

Lemma Consistent_total : forall a b, lc_tm a -> lc_tm b ->
  (ValueType a -> ValueType b -> VtTag a b) -> Consistent a b.
Proof.
  intros a. destruct a; intros b Ha Hb Htag;
    try solve [apply Consistent_a_Step_R; [exact Hb | intro H'; inversion H']];
    destruct b;
    try solve [apply Consistent_a_Step_L; [exact Ha | intro H'; inversion H']].
  all: try solve [exfalso; pose proof (Htag ltac:(vt_build) ltac:(vt_build)) as HT; inversion HT].
  all: apply Consistent_of_VtTag; [ pose proof (Htag ltac:(vt_build) ltac:(vt_build)) as HT; exact HT | exact Ha | exact Hb ].
Qed.

# A dependency directory is named after its Rocq library (for example, Metalib).
LIBRARIES := $(wildcard .rocq-deps/*)
LIBRARY_FLAGS := $(foreach lib,$(LIBRARIES),-R $(lib) $(notdir $(lib)))

.PHONY: all clean
all: Makefile.coq
	$(MAKE) -f Makefile.coq

Makefile.coq: _CoqProject Makefile
	rocq makefile -f _CoqProject $(LIBRARY_FLAGS) -o Makefile.coq

clean:
	$(MAKE) -f Makefile.coq clean

  (f4 : forall s : Qualitative_ott.sort, P (a_Type s))
  (f5 : forall n : nat, P (a_Var_b n)) (f6 : forall x : tmvar, P (a_Var_f x))
  (f7 : forall A1 : tm, P A1 -> forall A2 : tm, P A2 -> P (a_Sum A1 A2))
  (f8 : forall a : tm, P a -> P (a_Inj1 a))
  (f9 : forall a : tm, P a -> P (a_Inj2 a))
  (f10 : forall (psi : grade) (a : tm),
         P a ->
         forall b1 : tm,
         P b1 -> forall b2 : tm, P b2 -> P (a_Case psi a b1 b2))
  (f11 : forall (psi : grade) (A : tm),
         P A -> forall B : tm, P B -> P (a_WSigma psi A B))
  (f12 : forall a : tm,
         P a -> forall (psi : grade) (b : tm), P b -> P (a_WPair a psi b))
  (f13 : forall (psi : grade) (a : tm),
         P a -> forall b : tm, P b -> P (a_LetPair psi a b))
  (f14 : forall (psi : grade) (A : tm),

  (f15 : forall a : tm,

  (f16 : forall (psi : grade) (a : tm), P a -> P (a_Proj1 psi a))
  (f17 : forall (psi : grade) (a : tm), P a -> P (a_Proj2 psi a)) =>
fix F (t : tm) : P t :=
  match t as t0 return (P t0) with

Scheme Grade_mind := Induction for Grade Sort Prop
  with CGrade_mind := Induction for CGrade Sort Prop.

Lemma Grade_lc : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm), Grade P psi a -> lc_tm a.
Proof.
  intros P psi a H. induction H using Grade_mind
    with (P0 := fun (P:econtext) (psi phi0:grade) (a:tm) (_:CGrade P psi phi0 a) => lc_tm a).
  - apply lc_a_Type.
  - apply lc_a_Var_f.
  - apply lc_a_Pi. * exact IHGrade. * destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x Hx]. apply (lc_body_all B x). apply (H0 x Hx).
  - apply lc_a_Abs. * exact IHGrade. * destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x Hx]. apply (lc_body_all b x). apply (H x Hx).
  - apply lc_a_App; assumption.
  - apply lc_a_WSigma. * exact IHGrade. * destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x Hx]. apply (lc_body_all B x). apply (H0 x Hx).
  - apply lc_a_WPair; assumption.
  - apply lc_a_LetPair. * exact IHGrade. * destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x Hx]. apply (lc_body_all c x). apply (H0 x Hx).
  - apply lc_a_SSigma. * exact IHGrade. * destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x Hx]. apply (lc_body_all B x). apply (H0 x Hx).
  - apply lc_a_SPair; assumption.
  - apply lc_a_Proj1. exact IHGrade.
  - apply lc_a_Proj2. exact IHGrade.
  - apply lc_a_Sum; assumption.
  - apply lc_a_Inj1. exact IHGrade.
  - apply lc_a_Inj2. exact IHGrade.
  - apply lc_a_Case; assumption.
  - apply lc_a_TyUnit.
  - apply lc_a_TmUnit.
  - exact IHGrade.
  - assumption.
Qed.
Arguments Grade_lc : clear implicits.
Arguments Grade_lc P psi a _.

Lemma CGrade_lc : forall (P:econtext) (psi phi0:grade) (a:tm), CGrade P psi phi0 a -> lc_tm a.
Proof.
  intros P psi phi0 a H. induction H.
  - exact (Grade_lc P phi a H0).
  - assumption.
Qed.
Arguments CGrade_lc : clear implicits.
Arguments CGrade_lc P psi phi0 a _.

Lemma Grade_uniq : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm), Grade P psi a -> uniq P.
Proof.
  intros P psi a H. induction H using Grade_mind
    with (P0 := fun (P:econtext) (psi phi0:grade) (a:tm) (_:CGrade P psi phi0 a) => uniq P).
  all: assumption.
Qed.
Arguments Grade_uniq : clear implicits.
Arguments Grade_uniq P psi a _.

(* ---------- DefEq / CDefEq : lc ---------- *)
Scheme DefEq_mind := Induction for DefEq Sort Prop
  with CDefEq_mind := Induction for CDefEq Sort Prop.

Lemma DefEq_lc : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm), DefEq P psi a b -> lc_tm a /\ lc_tm b.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H using DefEq_mind
