Fixpoint lc_at (k:nat) (u:tm) : Prop :=
  match u with
  | a_TyUnit => True
  | a_TmUnit => True
  | a_Type _ => True
  | a_Var_f _ => True
  | a_Var_b n => Nat.lt n k
  | a_Pi _ A B => lc_at k A /\ lc_at (S k) B
  | a_Abs _ A b => lc_at k A /\ lc_at (S k) b
  | a_App a _ b => lc_at k a /\ lc_at k b
  | a_Sum A B => lc_at k A /\ lc_at k B
  | a_Inj1 a => lc_at k a
  | a_Inj2 a => lc_at k a
  | a_Case _ a b1 b2 => lc_at k a /\ lc_at k b1 /\ lc_at k b2
  | a_WSigma _ A B => lc_at k A /\ lc_at (S k) B
  | a_WPair a _ b => lc_at k a /\ lc_at k b
  | a_LetPair _ a b => lc_at k a /\ lc_at (S k) b
  | a_SSigma _ A B => lc_at k A /\ lc_at (S k) B
  | a_SPair a _ b => lc_at k a /\ lc_at k b
  | a_Proj1 _ a => lc_at k a
  | a_Proj2 _ a => lc_at k a
  end.

Lemma lc_at_mono : forall u k j, (k <= j)%nat -> lc_at k u -> lc_at j u.
Proof.
  induction u; simpl; intros k j Hle H; auto; try tauto.
  - destruct H as [HA HB]. split; [exact (IHu1 k j Hle HA)|apply (IHu2 (S k) (S j)); [lia|exact HB]].
  - destruct H as [HA HB]. split; [exact (IHu1 k j Hle HA)|apply (IHu2 (S k) (S j)); [lia|exact HB]].
  - destruct H as [Ha Hb]. split; [exact (IHu1 k j Hle Ha)|exact (IHu2 k j Hle Hb)].
  - lia.
  - destruct H as [HA HB]. split; [exact (IHu1 k j Hle HA)|exact (IHu2 k j Hle HB)].
  - apply (IHu k j Hle); auto.
  - apply (IHu k j Hle); auto.
  - destruct H as [Ha [Hb1 Hb2]]. repeat split;
      [exact (IHu1 k j Hle Ha)|exact (IHu2 k j Hle Hb1)|exact (IHu3 k j Hle Hb2)].
  - destruct H as [HA HB]. split; [exact (IHu1 k j Hle HA)|apply (IHu2 (S k) (S j)); [lia|exact HB]].
  - destruct H as [Ha Hb]. split; [exact (IHu1 k j Hle Ha)|exact (IHu2 k j Hle Hb)].
  - destruct H as [Ha Hb]. split; [exact (IHu1 k j Hle Ha)|apply (IHu2 (S k) (S j)); [lia|exact Hb]].
  - destruct H as [HA HB]. split; [exact (IHu1 k j Hle HA)|apply (IHu2 (S k) (S j)); [lia|exact HB]].
  - destruct H as [Ha Hb]. split; [exact (IHu1 k j Hle Ha)|exact (IHu2 k j Hle Hb)].
  - apply (IHu k j Hle); auto.
  - apply (IHu k j Hle); auto.
Qed.
Arguments lc_at_mono : clear implicits.
Arguments lc_at_mono u k j _ _.

  - tauto. - tauto.

  - tauto.
  - (* Var_b *) destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[Hlt|Heq]|Hgt]; simpl.

    + split; intros H.
      * assert (Hn : (n - 1 < k)%nat) by lia. lia.

  - tauto.
  - (* Sum *) split; intros [HA HB]; split.

    + exact (proj2 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj2 (IHB2 t k Ht) HB).

    + exact (proj2 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj2 (IHB2 t k Ht) HB).
  - (* Proj1 *) split; intros H; [exact (proj1 (IHB t k Ht) H)|exact (proj2 (IHB t k Ht) H)].
  - (* Proj2 *) split; intros H; [exact (proj1 (IHB t k Ht) H)|exact (proj2 (IHB t k Ht) H)].

Lemma lc_at_S_body : forall B, (forall x, lc_at 0 (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x))) -> lc_at 1 B.

Lemma binds_In_iff : forall A (x:atom) (a:A) (E:list (atom*A)),

Proof.
  intros A. induction E as [|(y,b) E IH]; intros x a; simpl.

      * left. injection Hin as Heq Ha. auto.
      * right. apply (proj2 (IH x a)); exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma binds_perm : forall A (E F:list (atom*A)) x a,
  Permutation E F -> binds x a E -> binds x a F.
Proof.
  intros. apply (proj2 (binds_In_iff A x a F)).
  apply (Permutation_in _ H). apply (proj1 (binds_In_iff A x a E)). assumption.
Qed.

Lemma In_dom_map_fst : forall A (E:list (atom*A)) x, x \in dom E <-> In x (map fst E).
Proof.
  intros A. induction E as [|(y,b) E IH]; intros x; simpl.

    + intro H; apply AtomSetImpl.empty_1 in H; contradiction.
    + intro H; inversion H.
  - split; intro H.
    + destruct (CoqEqDec.eq_dec y x) as [E'|E'].
      * left. symmetry. exact E'.
      * right. apply (proj1 (IH x)). apply (AtomSetImpl.add_3 (dom E) y x).
        -- intro Hc; apply E'; symmetry; exact Hc.
        -- exact H.
    + destruct H as [Hin|Hin].
      * subst. apply AtomSetImpl.add_1. reflexivity.
      * apply AtomSetImpl.add_2. apply (proj2 (IH x)). exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma uniq_NoDup : forall A (E:list (atom*A)), uniq E -> NoDup (map fst E).
Proof.
  intros A E H. induction H as [|x a E Hu Hnotin IH]; simpl.
  - constructor.
  - constructor; [|exact IH]. intro Hin.
    apply Hnotin. apply (proj1 (In_dom_map_fst A E x)). exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma NoDup_uniq : forall A (E:list (atom*A)), NoDup (map fst E) -> uniq E.
Proof.
  intros A E. induction E as [|(y,b) E IH]; intros H; simpl in H.
  - apply uniq_nil.
  - inversion H as [|? ? Hnotin Hnd]; subst.
    apply uniq_push.

    + intro Hin. apply Hnotin. apply (proj2 (In_dom_map_fst A E y)). exact Hin.
Qed.

Lemma uniq_perm : forall A (E F:list (atom*A)), Permutation E F -> uniq E -> uniq F.
Proof.

Qed.

    + apply uniq_one.
    + apply (proj2 (disjoint_one_r P (x,g))). exact H0.

  MultiPar P psi a b -> forall c, MultiPar P psi b c -> MultiPar P psi a c.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H; intros c Hc.
  - exact Hc.
  - eapply MP_Step. exact H. apply IHMultiPar. exact Hc.
Qed.

212	    | a_Inj1 a2 => a_Inj1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
213	    | a_Inj2 a2 => a_Inj2 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
214	    | a_Case psi a2 b1 b2 => a_Case psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b2)
215	    | a_WSigma psi1 A1 B1 => a_WSigma psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 B1)
216	    | a_WPair a2 psi1 b1 => a_WPair (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1)
217	    | a_LetPair psi1 a2 b1 => a_LetPair psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 b1)
218	    | a_SSigma psi1 A1 B1 => a_SSigma psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 B1)
219	    | a_SPair a2 psi1 b1 => a_SPair (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1)
220	    | a_Proj1 psi1 a2 => a_Proj1 psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
221	    | a_Proj2 psi1 a2 => a_Proj2 psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
222	  end.

242	     lc_tm b2 ->

13	(* ---------- size ---------- *)
14	Fixpoint size_tm (u:tm) : nat :=
15	  match u with
16	  | a_TyUnit => 1 | a_TmUnit => 1 | a_Type _ => 1 | a_Var_f _ => 1 | a_Var_b _ => 1
17	  | a_Pi _ A B => 1 + size_tm A + size_tm B
18	  | a_Abs _ A b => 1 + size_tm A + size_tm b
19	  | a_App a _ b => 1 + size_tm a + size_tm b
20	  | a_Sum A B => 1 + size_tm A + size_tm B
21	  | a_Inj1 a => 1 + size_tm a | a_Inj2 a => 1 + size_tm a
22	  | a_Case _ a b1 b2 => 1 + size_tm a + size_tm b1 + size_tm b2
23	  | a_WSigma _ A B => 1 + size_tm A + size_tm B
24	  | a_WPair a _ b => 1 + size_tm a + size_tm b
25	  | a_LetPair _ a b => 1 + size_tm a + size_tm b
26	  | a_SSigma _ A B => 1 + size_tm A + size_tm B
27	  | a_SPair a _ b => 1 + size_tm a + size_tm b
28	  | a_Proj1 _ a => 1 + size_tm a | a_Proj2 _ a => 1 + size_tm a
29	  end.

31	Lemma size_tm_pos : forall u, (1 <= size_tm u)%nat.
32	Proof. destruct u; simpl; lia. Qed.

34	(* ---------- level-indexed local closedness ---------- *)
35	Fixpoint lc_at (k:nat) (u:tm) : Prop :=
36	  match u with
37	  | a_TyUnit => True
38	  | a_TmUnit => True
39	  | a_Type _ => True
40	  | a_Var_f _ => True
41	  | a_Var_b n => Nat.lt n k
42	  | a_Pi _ A B => lc_at k A /\ lc_at (S k) B
43	  | a_Abs _ A b => lc_at k A /\ lc_at (S k) b
44	  | a_App a _ b => lc_at k a /\ lc_at k b
45	  | a_Sum A B => lc_at k A /\ lc_at k B
46	  | a_Inj1 a => lc_at k a
47	  | a_Inj2 a => lc_at k a
48	  | a_Case _ a b1 b2 => lc_at k a /\ lc_at k b1 /\ lc_at k b2
49	  | a_WSigma _ A B => lc_at k A /\ lc_at (S k) B
50	  | a_WPair a _ b => lc_at k a /\ lc_at k b
51	  | a_LetPair _ a b => lc_at k a /\ lc_at (S k) b
52	  | a_SSigma _ A B => lc_at k A /\ lc_at (S k) B
53	  | a_SPair a _ b => lc_at k a /\ lc_at k b
54	  | a_Proj1 _ a => lc_at k a
55	  | a_Proj2 _ a => lc_at k a
56	  end.

58	Lemma lc_at_mono : forall u k j, (k <= j)%nat -> lc_at k u -> lc_at j u.
59	Proof.
60	  induction u; simpl; intros k j Hle H; auto; try tauto.
61	  - destruct H as [HA HB]. split; [exact (IHu1 k j Hle HA)|apply (IHu2 (S k) (S j)); [lia|exact HB]].
62	  - destruct H as [HA HB]. split; [exact (IHu1 k j Hle HA)|apply (IHu2 (S k) (S j)); [lia|exact HB]].
63	  - destruct H as [Ha Hb]. split; [exact (IHu1 k j Hle Ha)|exact (IHu2 k j Hle Hb)].
64	  - lia.
65	  - destruct H as [HA HB]. split; [exact (IHu1 k j Hle HA)|exact (IHu2 k j Hle HB)].
66	  - apply (IHu k j Hle); auto.
67	  - apply (IHu k j Hle); auto.
68	  - destruct H as [Ha [Hb1 Hb2]]. repeat split;
69	      [exact (IHu1 k j Hle Ha)|exact (IHu2 k j Hle Hb1)|exact (IHu3 k j Hle Hb2)].
70	  - destruct H as [HA HB]. split; [exact (IHu1 k j Hle HA)|apply (IHu2 (S k) (S j)); [lia|exact HB]].
71	  - destruct H as [Ha Hb]. split; [exact (IHu1 k j Hle Ha)|exact (IHu2 k j Hle Hb)].
72	  - destruct H as [Ha Hb]. split; [exact (IHu1 k j Hle Ha)|apply (IHu2 (S k) (S j)); [lia|exact Hb]].
73	  - destruct H as [HA HB]. split; [exact (IHu1 k j Hle HA)|apply (IHu2 (S k) (S j)); [lia|exact HB]].
74	  - destruct H as [Ha Hb]. split; [exact (IHu1 k j Hle Ha)|exact (IHu2 k j Hle Hb)].
75	  - apply (IHu k j Hle); auto.
76	  - apply (IHu k j Hle); auto.
77	Qed.

81	Lemma lc_at_open_rec : forall B t k, lc_at 0 t ->
82	  (lc_at k (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k t B) <-> lc_at (S k) B).

84	  induction B; intros t k Ht; simpl.
85	  - tauto. - tauto.
86	  - (* Pi *) split; intros [HA HB]; split.
87	    + exact (proj1 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj1 (IHB2 t (S k) Ht) HB).
88	    + exact (proj2 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj2 (IHB2 t (S k) Ht) HB).
89	  - (* Abs *) split; intros [HA HB]; split.
90	    + exact (proj1 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj1 (IHB2 t (S k) Ht) HB).
91	    + exact (proj2 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj2 (IHB2 t (S k) Ht) HB).
92	  - (* App *) split; intros [HA HB]; split.

94	    + exact (proj2 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj2 (IHB2 t k Ht) HB).
95	  - tauto.
96	  - (* Var_b *) destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[Hlt|Heq]|Hgt]; simpl.
97	    + split; intros H; lia.
98	    + subst n. split; intros H.
99	      * lia.
100	      * exact (lc_at_mono t 0 k (Nat.le_0_l k) Ht).
101	    + split; intros H.
102	      * assert (Hn : (n - 1 < k)%nat) by lia. lia.
103	      * assert (Hn : (n < S k)%nat) by lia. destruct k; [lia|]. simpl. lia.
104	  - tauto.
105	  - (* Sum *) split; intros [HA HB]; split.
106	    + exact (proj1 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj1 (IHB2 t k Ht) HB).
107	    + exact (proj2 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj2 (IHB2 t k Ht) HB).
108	  - (* Inj1 *) split; intros H; [exact (proj1 (IHB t k Ht) H)|exact (proj2 (IHB t k Ht) H)].
109	  - (* Inj2 *) split; intros H; [exact (proj1 (IHB t k Ht) H)|exact (proj2 (IHB t k Ht) H)].
110	  - (* Case *) split; intros [HA [HB1 HB2]]; repeat split.
111	    + exact (proj1 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj1 (IHB2 t k Ht) HB1). + exact (proj1 (IHB3 t k Ht) HB2).
112	    + exact (proj2 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj2 (IHB2 t k Ht) HB1). + exact (proj2 (IHB3 t k Ht) HB2).
113	  - (* WSigma *) split; intros [HA HB]; split.
114	    + exact (proj1 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj1 (IHB2 t (S k) Ht) HB).
115	    + exact (proj2 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj2 (IHB2 t (S k) Ht) HB).
116	  - (* WPair *) split; intros [HA HB]; split.
117	    + exact (proj1 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj1 (IHB2 t k Ht) HB).
118	    + exact (proj2 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj2 (IHB2 t k Ht) HB).
119	  - (* LetPair *) split; intros [HA HB]; split.
120	    + exact (proj1 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj1 (IHB2 t (S k) Ht) HB).
121	    + exact (proj2 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj2 (IHB2 t (S k) Ht) HB).
122	  - (* SSigma *) split; intros [HA HB]; split.
123	    + exact (proj1 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj1 (IHB2 t (S k) Ht) HB).
124	    + exact (proj2 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj2 (IHB2 t (S k) Ht) HB).
125	  - (* SPair *) split; intros [HA HB]; split.
126	    + exact (proj1 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj1 (IHB2 t k Ht) HB).
127	    + exact (proj2 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj2 (IHB2 t k Ht) HB).
128	  - (* Proj1 *) split; intros H; [exact (proj1 (IHB t k Ht) H)|exact (proj2 (IHB t k Ht) H)].
129	  - (* Proj2 *) split; intros H; [exact (proj1 (IHB t k Ht) H)|exact (proj2 (IHB t k Ht) H)].

257	  - apply lc_a_WSigma. * exact IHGrade. * destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x Hx]. apply (lc_body_all B x). apply (H0 x Hx).
258	  - apply lc_a_WPair; assumption.
259	  - apply lc_a_LetPair. * exact IHGrade. * destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x Hx]. apply (lc_body_all c x). apply (H0 x Hx).
260	  - apply lc_a_SSigma. * exact IHGrade. * destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x Hx]. apply (lc_body_all B x). apply (H0 x Hx).
261	  - apply lc_a_SPair; assumption.

264	  - apply lc_a_Sum; assumption.
265	  - apply lc_a_Inj1. exact IHGrade.
266	  - apply lc_a_Inj2. exact IHGrade.
267	  - apply lc_a_Case; assumption.
268	  - apply lc_a_TyUnit.

298	Lemma DefEq_lc : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm), DefEq P psi a b -> lc_tm a /\ lc_tm b.
299	Proof.
300	  intros P psi a b H. induction H using DefEq_mind
301	    with (P0 := fun (P:econtext) (psi phi0:grade) (a b:tm) (_:CDefEq P psi phi0 a b) => lc_tm a /\ lc_tm b).
302	  - split; apply (Grade_lc P psi); assumption.
303	  - destruct IHDefEq1 as [Ha Hb]; destruct IHDefEq2 as [Hb' Hc]; split; assumption.
304	  - destruct IHDefEq as [Ha Hb]; split; assumption.
305	  - split; apply (Grade_lc P psi); assumption.
306	  - (* Pi *) split; [apply lc_a_Pi | apply lc_a_Pi].
307	    * exact (proj1 IHDefEq). * destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x Hx]. apply (lc_body_all B1 x). exact (proj1 (H0 x Hx)).
308	    * exact (proj2 IHDefEq). * destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x Hx]. apply (lc_body_all B2 x). exact (proj2 (H0 x Hx)).
309	  - (* Abs *) split; [apply lc_a_Abs | apply lc_a_Abs].
310	    * exact (proj1 IHDefEq). * destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x Hx]. apply (lc_body_all b1 x). exact (proj1 (H x Hx)).
311	    * exact (proj2 IHDefEq). * destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x Hx]. apply (lc_body_all b2 x). exact (proj2 (H x Hx)).
312	  - (* App *) split; [apply lc_a_App | apply lc_a_App].
313	    * exact (proj1 IHDefEq). * exact (proj1 IHDefEq0).
314	    * exact (proj2 IHDefEq). * exact (proj2 IHDefEq0).
315	  - (* PiFst *) destruct IHDefEq as [Hp1 Hp2]; destruct (lc_Pi _ _ _ Hp1) as [HA1 _];
316	      destruct (lc_Pi _ _ _ Hp2) as [HA2 _]; split; assumption.
317	  - (* PiSnd *) destruct IHDefEq1 as [Hp1 Hp2]; destruct IHDefEq2 as [Ha1 Ha2].
318	    destruct (lc_Pi _ _ _ Hp1) as [_ HB1]; destruct (lc_Pi _ _ _ Hp2) as [_ HB2]. split.
319	    * destruct (atom_fresh (empty:atoms)) as [x _]. exact (@lc_open_term B1 x a1 (HB1 x) Ha1).
320	    * destruct (atom_fresh (empty:atoms)) as [x _]. exact (@lc_open_term B2 x a2 (HB2 x) Ha2).
321	  - (* WSigma *) split; [apply lc_a_WSigma | apply lc_a_WSigma].
322	    * exact (proj1 IHDefEq). * destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x Hx]. apply (lc_body_all B1 x). exact (proj1 (H0 x Hx)).
323	    * exact (proj2 IHDefEq). * destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x Hx]. apply (lc_body_all B2 x). exact (proj2 (H0 x Hx)).
324	  - (* WSigmaFst *) destruct IHDefEq as [Hp1 Hp2]; destruct (lc_WSigma _ _ _ Hp1) as [HA1 _];
325	      destruct (lc_WSigma _ _ _ Hp2) as [HA2 _]; split; assumption.
326	  - (* WSigmaSnd *) destruct IHDefEq as [Hp1 Hp2];
327	      destruct (lc_WSigma _ _ _ Hp1) as [_ HB1]; destruct (lc_WSigma _ _ _ Hp2) as [_ HB2].
328	      pose proof (Grade_lc P psi a g) as Ha. split.
329	    * destruct (atom_fresh (empty:atoms)) as [x _]. exact (@lc_open_term B1 x a (HB1 x) Ha).
330	    * destruct (atom_fresh (empty:atoms)) as [x _]. exact (@lc_open_term B2 x a (HB2 x) Ha).
331	  - (* WPair *) split; [apply lc_a_WPair | apply lc_a_WPair].
332	    * exact (proj1 IHDefEq). * exact (proj1 IHDefEq0).
333	    * exact (proj2 IHDefEq). * exact (proj2 IHDefEq0).
334	  - (* LetPair *) split; [apply lc_a_LetPair | apply lc_a_LetPair].
335	    * exact (proj1 IHDefEq). * destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x Hx]. apply (lc_body_all b1 x). exact (proj1 (H0 x Hx)).
336	    * exact (proj2 IHDefEq). * destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x Hx]. apply (lc_body_all b2 x). exact (proj2 (H0 x Hx)).
337	  - (* SSigma *) split; [apply lc_a_SSigma | apply lc_a_SSigma].
338	    * exact (proj1 IHDefEq). * destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x Hx]. apply (lc_body_all B1 x). exact (proj1 (H0 x Hx)).
339	    * exact (proj2 IHDefEq). * destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x Hx]. apply (lc_body_all B2 x). exact (proj2 (H0 x Hx)).
340	  - (* SSigmaFst *) destruct IHDefEq as [Hp1 Hp2]; destruct (lc_SSigma _ _ _ Hp1) as [HA1 _];
341	      destruct (lc_SSigma _ _ _ Hp2) as [HA2 _]; split; assumption.
342	  - (* SSigmaSnd *) destruct IHDefEq1 as [Hp1 Hp2]; destruct IHDefEq2 as [Ha1 Ha2];
343	      destruct (lc_SSigma _ _ _ Hp1) as [_ HB1]; destruct (lc_SSigma _ _ _ Hp2) as [_ HB2]. split.
344	    * destruct (atom_fresh (empty:atoms)) as [x _]. exact (@lc_open_term B1 x a1 (HB1 x) Ha1).
345	    * destruct (atom_fresh (empty:atoms)) as [x _]. exact (@lc_open_term B2 x a2 (HB2 x) Ha2).
346	  - (* SPair *) split; [apply lc_a_SPair | apply lc_a_SPair].
347	    * exact (proj1 IHDefEq). * exact (proj1 IHDefEq0).
348	    * exact (proj2 IHDefEq). * exact (proj2 IHDefEq0).
349	  - (* Proj1 *) split; [apply lc_a_Proj1 | apply lc_a_Proj1].
350	    * exact (proj1 IHDefEq). * exact (proj2 IHDefEq).
351	  - (* Proj2 *) split; [apply lc_a_Proj2 | apply lc_a_Proj2].
352	    * exact (proj1 IHDefEq). * exact (proj2 IHDefEq).
353	  - (* Sum *) split; [apply lc_a_Sum | apply lc_a_Sum].
354	    * exact (proj1 IHDefEq1). * exact (proj1 IHDefEq2).
355	    * exact (proj2 IHDefEq1). * exact (proj2 IHDefEq2).
356	  - (* SumFst *) destruct IHDefEq as [Hp1 Hp2]; destruct (lc_Sum _ _ Hp1) as [HA1 _];
357	      destruct (lc_Sum _ _ Hp2) as [HA2 _]; split; assumption.
358	  - (* SumSnd *) destruct IHDefEq as [Hp1 Hp2]; destruct (lc_Sum _ _ Hp1) as [_ HB1];
359	      destruct (lc_Sum _ _ Hp2) as [_ HB2]; split; assumption.
360	  - (* Inj1 *) split; [apply lc_a_Inj1 | apply lc_a_Inj1].
361	    * exact (proj1 IHDefEq). * exact (proj2 IHDefEq).
362	  - (* Inj2 *) split; [apply lc_a_Inj2 | apply lc_a_Inj2].
363	    * exact (proj1 IHDefEq). * exact (proj2 IHDefEq).
364	  - (* Case *) split; [apply lc_a_Case | apply lc_a_Case].
365	    * exact (proj1 IHDefEq1). * exact (proj1 IHDefEq2). * exact (proj1 IHDefEq3).
366	    * exact (proj2 IHDefEq1). * exact (proj2 IHDefEq2). * exact (proj2 IHDefEq3).
367	  - (* TyUnit *) split; apply lc_a_TyUnit.
368	  - (* TmUnit *) split; apply lc_a_TmUnit.
369	  - (* SubstIrrel *) split.
370	    * destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x Hx]. exact (@lc_open_term b1 x a1 (proj1 (H x Hx)) l).
371	    * destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x Hx]. exact (@lc_open_term b2 x a2 (proj2 (H x Hx)) l0).
372	  - (* CDefEq_Leq *) exact IHDefEq.
373	  - (* CDefEq_Nleq *) split; assumption.
374	Qed.

421	Lemma VtTag_VT : forall a b, VtTag a b -> lc_tm a -> lc_tm b -> ValueType a /\ ValueType b.

423	  intros a b H; induction H; intros Ha Hb; split.
424	  - apply ValueType_Type. - apply ValueType_Type.
425	  - apply ValueType_Unit. - apply ValueType_Unit.
426	  - apply ValueType_Pi. * inversion Ha; assumption. * assumption.
427	  - apply ValueType_Pi. * inversion Hb; assumption. * assumption.
428	  - apply ValueType_WSigma. * inversion Ha; assumption. * assumption.
429	  - apply ValueType_WSigma. * inversion Hb; assumption. * assumption.
430	  - apply ValueType_SSigma. * inversion Ha; assumption. * assumption.
431	  - apply ValueType_SSigma. * inversion Hb; assumption. * assumption.
432	  - apply ValueType_Sum. * inversion Ha; assumption. * inversion Ha; assumption.
433	  - apply ValueType_Sum. * inversion Hb; assumption. * inversion Hb; assumption.

444	Lemma open_head_stable : forall B a1 a2,
445	  B <> a_Var_b 0 -> ValueType (open_tm_wrt_tm B a1) ->
446	  VtTag (open_tm_wrt_tm B a1) (open_tm_wrt_tm B a2).
447	Proof.

449	  - (* TyUnit *) simpl. econstructor.

453	  - (* App *) simpl in HVT; inversion HVT.
454	  - (* Type *) simpl in *; inversion HVT; subst; econstructor.
455	  - (* Var_b *) destruct n.
456	    + exfalso; apply Hneq; reflexivity.
457	    + simpl in HVT; inversion HVT.
458	  - (* Var_f *) simpl in HVT; inversion HVT.
459	  - (* Sum *) simpl in *; inversion HVT; subst; econstructor.
460	  - (* Inj1 *) simpl in HVT; inversion HVT.

466	  - (* SSigma *) simpl in *; inversion HVT; subst; econstructor.

468	  - (* Proj1 *) simpl in HVT; inversion HVT.
469	  - (* Proj2 *) simpl in HVT; inversion HVT.

478	  - apply Consistent_a_Unit.
479	  - apply Consistent_a_Pi.
480	    + inversion Ha; assumption. + assumption. + inversion Hb; assumption. + assumption.
481	  - apply Consistent_a_WSigma.
482	    + inversion Ha; assumption. + assumption. + inversion Hb; assumption. + assumption.
483	  - apply Consistent_a_SSigma.
484	    + inversion Ha; assumption. + assumption. + inversion Hb; assumption. + assumption.
485	  - apply Consistent_a_Sum.

493	Proof.

496	  - (* Pi *) apply Consistent_a_Pi; [inversion H; assumption | assumption | inversion H; assumption | assumption].
497	  - (* Type *) apply Consistent_a_Type.
498	  - (* Sum *) apply Consistent_a_Sum; try (inversion H; assumption); try assumption.
499	  - (* WSigma *) apply Consistent_a_WSigma; [inversion H; assumption | assumption | inversion H; assumption | assumption].

506	  | |- ValueType a_TyUnit => apply ValueType_Unit
507	  | Ha : lc_tm (a_Pi _ _ _) |- ValueType (a_Pi _ _ _) => apply ValueType_Pi; [inversion Ha; assumption | exact Ha]
508	  | Ha : lc_tm (a_WSigma _ _ _) |- ValueType (a_WSigma _ _ _) => apply ValueType_WSigma; [inversion Ha; assumption | exact Ha]
509	  | Ha : lc_tm (a_SSigma _ _ _) |- ValueType (a_SSigma _ _ _) => apply ValueType_SSigma; [inversion Ha; assumption | exact Ha]
510	  | Ha : lc_tm (a_Sum _ _) |- ValueType (a_Sum _ _) => apply ValueType_Sum; [inversion Ha; assumption | inversion Ha; assumption]

513	Lemma Consistent_total : forall a b, lc_tm a -> lc_tm b ->
514	  (ValueType a -> ValueType b -> VtTag a b) -> Consistent a b.
515	Proof.
516	  intros a. destruct a; intros b Ha Hb Htag;
517	    try solve [apply Consistent_a_Step_R; [exact Hb | intro H'; inversion H']];
518	    destruct b;
519	    try solve [apply Consistent_a_Step_L; [exact Ha | intro H'; inversion H']].
520	  all: try solve [exfalso; pose proof (Htag ltac:(vt_build) ltac:(vt_build)) as HT; inversion HT].
521	  all: apply Consistent_of_VtTag; [ pose proof (Htag ltac:(vt_build) ltac:(vt_build)) as HT; exact HT | exact Ha | exact Hb ].

529	Inductive Deep (P:econtext) (phi:grade) : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
530	| Deep_Type : forall s, Deep P phi (a_Type s) (a_Type s)
531	| Deep_Unit : Deep P phi a_TyUnit a_TyUnit
532	| Deep_Pi : forall psi A1 B1 A2 B2,
533	    Deep P phi A1 A2 ->
534	    (forall x, Deep ((x~phi)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x))) ->
535	    Deep P phi (a_Pi psi A1 B1) (a_Pi psi A2 B2)
536	| Deep_WSigma : forall psi A1 B1 A2 B2,
537	    Deep P phi A1 A2 ->
538	    (forall x, Deep ((x~phi)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x))) ->
539	    Deep P phi (a_WSigma psi A1 B1) (a_WSigma psi A2 B2)
540	| Deep_SSigma : forall psi A1 B1 A2 B2,
541	    Deep P phi A1 A2 ->
542	    (forall x, Deep ((x~phi)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x))) ->
543	    Deep P phi (a_SSigma psi A1 B1) (a_SSigma psi A2 B2)
544	| Deep_Sum : forall A1 B1 A2 B2,
545	    Deep P phi A1 A2 -> Deep P phi B1 B2 ->
546	    Deep P phi (a_Sum A1 B1) (a_Sum A2 B2)
547	| Deep_NonVT : forall a b,
548	    lc_tm a -> lc_tm b -> Consistent a b ->
549	    (forall u, ValueType u -> Steps a u -> exists v, Steps b v /\ ValueType v /\ VtTag u v) ->
550	    (forall v, ValueType v -> Steps b v -> exists u, Steps a u /\ ValueType u /\ VtTag u v) ->
551	    (forall psi A1 B1 A2 B2, Steps a (a_Pi psi A1 B1) -> Steps b (a_Pi psi A2 B2) ->
552	        Deep P phi A1 A2 /\ (forall x, Deep ((x~phi)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x)))) ->
553	    (forall psi A1 B1 A2 B2, Steps a (a_WSigma psi A1 B1) -> Steps b (a_WSigma psi A2 B2) ->
554	        Deep P phi A1 A2 /\ (forall x, Deep ((x~phi)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x)))) ->
555	    (forall psi A1 B1 A2 B2, Steps a (a_SSigma psi A1 B1) -> Steps b (a_SSigma psi A2 B2) ->
556	        Deep P phi A1 A2 /\ (forall x, Deep ((x~phi)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x)))) ->
557	    (forall A1 B1 A2 B2, Steps a (a_Sum A1 B1) -> Steps b (a_Sum A2 B2) ->
558	        Deep P phi A1 A2 /\ Deep P phi B1 B2) ->
559	    Deep P phi a b.

585	Lemma MultiPar_VT : forall (P:econtext) (phi:grade) (a b:tm),
586	  MultiPar P phi a b -> ValueType a -> VtTag a b.

674	(* ---------- a single Step is simulated by Par ---------- *)
675	Lemma Par_of_Step : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
676	  Grade P psi a -> Step a b -> Grade P psi b -> Par P psi a b.
677	Proof.
678	  intros P psi a b Ga S Gb. revert Gb. induction S; intros Gb.
679	  - (* AppCong *) destruct (Grade_App_inv Ga) as [Gf CGfb]; destruct (Grade_App_inv Gb) as [Gf' _].
680	    eapply Par_App.
681	    + apply IHS; assumption.
682	    + apply Grade_CPar_refl; assumption.
683	  - (* Beta *) destruct (Grade_App_inv Ga) as [Gabs CGarg].
684	    eapply Par_AppBeta.
685	    + eapply Par_Refl; assumption.
686	    + apply Grade_CPar_refl; assumption.
687	  - (* CaseCong *) destruct (Grade_Case_inv Ga) as [Ga0 [Gb1 [Gb2 Hle]]].
688	    destruct (Grade_Case_inv Gb) as [Ga' _].
689	    eapply Par_Case.
690	    + apply IHS; assumption.
691	    + eapply Par_Refl; assumption.
692	    + eapply Par_Refl; assumption.
693	    + assumption.
694	  - (* Case1Beta *) destruct (Grade_Case_inv Ga) as [Ginj [Gb1 [Gb2 Hle]]].
695	    pose proof (Grade_Inj1_inv Ginj) as Gx.
696	    eapply Par_CaseBeta1.
697	    + eapply Par_Inj1. eapply Par_Refl; assumption.
698	    + eapply Par_Refl; assumption.
699	    + eapply Par_Refl; assumption.
700	    + assumption.
701	  - (* Case2Beta *) destruct (Grade_Case_inv Ga) as [Ginj [Gb1 [Gb2 Hle]]].
702	    pose proof (Grade_Inj2_inv Ginj) as Gx.
703	    eapply Par_CaseBeta2.
704	    + eapply Par_Inj2. eapply Par_Refl; assumption.
705	    + eapply Par_Refl; assumption.
706	    + eapply Par_Refl; assumption.
707	    + assumption.
708	  - (* Proj1Cong *) destruct (Grade_Proj1_inv Ga) as [Ga0 Hle].
709	    destruct (Grade_Proj1_inv Gb) as [Ga' _].
710	    eapply Par_Proj1; [apply IHS; assumption | assumption].
711	  - (* Proj2Cong *) pose proof (Grade_Proj2_inv Ga) as Ga0.
712	    pose proof (Grade_Proj2_inv Gb) as Ga'.
713	    eapply Par_Proj2; apply IHS; assumption.
714	  - (* Proj1Beta *) destruct (Grade_Proj1_inv Ga) as [Gsp Hle].
715	    destruct (Grade_SPair_inv Gsp) as [CGa1 Ga2].
716	    eapply Par_Proj1Beta.
717	    + eapply Par_SPair; [apply Grade_CPar_refl; assumption | eapply Par_Refl; assumption].
718	    + assumption.
719	  - (* Proj2Beta *) pose proof (Grade_Proj2_inv Ga) as Gsp.
720	    destruct (Grade_SPair_inv Gsp) as [CGa1 Ga2].
721	    eapply Par_Proj2Beta.
722	    + eapply Par_SPair; [apply Grade_CPar_refl; assumption | eapply Par_Refl; assumption].
723	  - (* LetPairCong *) destruct (Grade_LetPair_inv Ga) as [Ga0 [L HG]].
724	    destruct (Grade_LetPair_inv Gb) as [Ga' _].
725	    eapply Par_LetPair with (L := L).
726	    + apply IHS; assumption.
727	    + intros x Hx. eapply Par_Refl. apply HG; assumption.
728	  - (* LetPairBeta *) destruct (Grade_LetPair_inv Ga) as [Gwp [L HG]].
729	    destruct (Grade_WPair_inv Gwp) as [CGa1 Ga2].
730	    eapply Par_WPairBeta with (L := L).
731	    + eapply Par_WPair; [apply Grade_CPar_refl; assumption | eapply Par_Refl; assumption].
732	    + intros x Hx. eapply Par_Refl. apply HG; assumption.
733	Qed.

Declare Scope grade_scope.

Infix "<=?" := q_leb (at level 70) : grade_scope.

Notation "q1 <= q2" := (is_true (q_leb q1 q2)) (at level 70)  : grade_scope.

Notation "q1 < q2" := (q_lt q1 q2) (at level 70)  : grade_scope.

Parameter meet_assoc : forall a b c, a + (b + c) = (a + b) + c.

Parameter meet_comm : forall a b, a + b = b + a.

Parameter absorb_meet : forall a b, a * (a + b) = a.

Parameter absorb_join : forall a b, a + (a * b) = a.

Parameter join_idem : forall a, a * a = a.

Parameter meet_idem : forall psi, psi + psi = psi.

Parameter join_Top_r : forall a, a * q_Top = q_Top.

Parameter meet_Bot_r : forall a, a + q_Bot = q_Bot.

  MultiPar P psi a b ->
  forall psi0 A1 B1, a = a_Pi psi0 A1 B1 ->
  exists A1' B1', b = a_Pi psi0 A1' B1' /\
    MultiPar P psi A1 A1' /\
    exists L, forall x, x \notin L ->
      MultiPar ((x,psi)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x))
                                        (open_tm_wrt_tm B1' (a_Var_f x)).
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H as [P psi a Ha | P psi a a' b Hpar Hmp IH];
    intros psi0 A1 B1 EQ; subst a.
  - (* MP_Refl *)
    destruct (@Grade_Pi_body P psi psi0 A1 B1 Ha) as [Lbody HB].
    exists A1, B1. repeat split.
    + reflexivity.
    + apply MP_Refl. exact (@Grade_Pi_inv P psi psi0 A1 B1 Ha).
    + exists Lbody. intros x Hx. apply MP_Refl. exact (HB x Hx).
  - (* MP_Step *)
    inversion Hpar; subst.
    + (* Par_Refl *)
      apply (IH psi0 A1 B1). reflexivity.
    + (* Par_Pi *)
      destruct (IH psi1 A2 B2) as [A2' [B2' [Eb [MpA MpB]]]]; [reflexivity|].

      exists A2', B2'. repeat split.

        eapply MP_Step.
        -- exact (H4 x (@notin_union_l L L2 x Hx)).
        -- exact (HB2 x (@notin_union_r L L2 x Hx)).
Qed.

  - (* S_CaseCong *)
    destruct (Grade_Case_inv Ga) as [Gt [G1 [G2 Hle]]].

  - (* S_Case1Beta *)

    apply Grade_Inj1_inv in Ginj.

Require Import Qual.geq.
Require Import Qual.defeq.
Require Import Base.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Open Scope grade_scope.

(* ---------- Values are irreducible ---------- *)
Lemma ValueType_no_step : forall a, ValueType a -> forall b, ~ Step a b.
Proof.
  intros a H; induction H; intros b S; inversion S.
Qed.

Lemma Value_no_step : forall a, Value a -> forall b, ~ Step a b.
Proof.
  intros a H; induction H; intros y S.
  - exact (ValueType_no_step H S).
  - inversion S.
  - inversion S.
  - inversion S.
  - inversion S.
  - inversion S.
  - inversion S.
Qed.

(* a value cannot take any steps *)
Lemma Steps_value : forall a b, Value a -> Steps a b -> a = b.
Proof.
  intros a b Hv H; induction H.
  - reflexivity.
  - exfalso. eapply Value_no_step; eauto.
Qed.

Require Import Qual.geq.
Require Import Qual.defeq.
Require Import Base.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Open Scope grade_scope.

(* ---------- Values are irreducible ---------- *)
Lemma ValueType_no_step : forall a, ValueType a -> forall b, ~ Step a b.
Proof.
  intros a H; induction H; intros b S; inversion S.
Qed.

Lemma Value_no_step : forall a, Value a -> forall b, ~ Step a b.
Proof.
  intros a H; induction H; intros y S.
  - exact (ValueType_no_step H S).
  - inversion S.
  - inversion S.
  - inversion S.
  - inversion S.
  - inversion S.
  - inversion S.
Qed.

(* a value cannot take any steps *)
Lemma Steps_value : forall a b, Value a -> Steps a b -> a = b.
Proof.
  intros a b Hv H; induction H.
  - reflexivity.
  - exfalso. eapply Value_no_step; eauto.
Qed.

 | CEq_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->

     lc_tm a1 ->

cd /tmp/agentwork && cat > VTC.v <<'EOF'
Require Import Qual.geq.
Require Import Qual.defeq.
Require Import Base.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Open Scope grade_scope.

(* Core invariant: only ValueType/tag/reduction information, no structural
   clauses for non-ValueType heads.  This is the part relevant to Consistent. *)
Inductive VTC : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
| VTC_intro : forall (a b:tm),
    lc_tm a ->
    lc_tm b ->
    (ValueType a -> ValueType b -> VtTag a b) ->
    (ValueType a -> ValueType b \/ (exists b', Step b b' /\ ValueType b' /\ VtTag a b')) ->
    (ValueType b -> ValueType a \/ (exists a', Step a a' /\ ValueType a' /\ VtTag a' b)) ->
    (forall (a':tm), Step a a' -> ValueType a' -> VTC a' b) ->
    (forall (b':tm), Step b b' -> ValueType b' -> VTC a b') ->
    VTC a b.

Lemma VTC_lca : forall a b, VTC a b -> lc_tm a.
Proof.
  intros a b H.
  induction H as [a0 b0 lca lcb tag rvt lvt stepL IHstepL stepR IHstepR].
  exact lca.
Qed.

Lemma VTC_lcb : forall a b, VTC a b -> lc_tm b.
Proof.
  intros a b H.
  induction H as [a0 b0 lca lcb tag rvt lvt stepL IHstepL stepR IHstepR].
  exact lcb.
Qed.

Lemma VTC_tag : forall a b, VTC a b ->
  ValueType a -> ValueType b -> VtTag a b.
Proof.
  intros a b H.
  induction H as [a0 b0 lca lcb tag rvt lvt stepL IHstepL stepR IHstepR].
  intros Va Vb. exact (tag Va Vb).
Qed.

Lemma VTC_rvt : forall a b, VTC a b -> ValueType a ->
  ValueType b \/ (exists b', Step b b' /\ ValueType b' /\ VtTag a b').
Proof.
  intros a b H.
  induction H as [a0 b0 lca lcb tag rvt lvt stepL IHstepL stepR IHstepR].
  intros Va. exact (rvt Va).
Qed.

Lemma VTC_lvt : forall a b, VTC a b -> ValueType b ->
  ValueType a \/ (exists a', Step a a' /\ ValueType a' /\ VtTag a' b).
Proof.
  intros a b H.
  induction H as [a0 b0 lca lcb tag rvt lvt stepL IHstepL stepR IHstepR].
  intros Vb. exact (lvt Vb).
Qed.

Lemma VTC_stepL : forall a b, VTC a b ->
  forall a', Step a a' -> ValueType a' -> VTC a' b.
Proof.
  intros a b H.
  induction H as [a0 b0 lca lcb tag rvt lvt stepL IHstepL stepR IHstepR].
  intros a' Sa' Va'. exact (stepL a' Sa' Va').
Qed.

Lemma VTC_stepR : forall a b, VTC a b ->
  forall b', Step b b' -> ValueType b' -> VTC a b'.
Proof.
  intros a b H.
  induction H as [a0 b0 lca lcb tag rvt lvt stepL IHstepL stepR IHstepR].
  intros b' Sb' Vb'. exact (stepR b' Sb' Vb').
Qed.

Lemma VTC_tag_trans : forall a b c, VTC a b -> VTC b c ->
  ValueType a -> ValueType c -> VtTag a c.
Proof.
  intros a b c H1 H2 Va Vc.
  pose proof (VTC_rvt H1 Va) as [Vb | [b' [Sb' [Vb' Tab']]]].
  - exact (VtTag_trans (VTC_tag H1 Va Vb) (VTC_tag H2 Vb Vc)).
  - pose proof (VTC_lvt H2 Vc) as [Vb | [b'' [Sb'' [Vb'' Tb''c]]]].
    + exfalso. exact (ValueType_no_step Vb b' Sb').
    + assert (b' = b'') as E by (eapply step_det; eassumption).
      subst. exact (VtTag_trans Tab' Tb''c).
Qed.

Lemma VTC_rvt_trans : forall a b c, VTC a b -> VTC b c -> ValueType a ->
  ValueType c \/ (exists c', Step c c' /\ ValueType c' /\ VtTag a c').
Proof.
  intros a b c H1 H2 Va.
  pose proof (VTC_rvt H1 Va) as [Vb | [b' [Sb' [Vb' Tab']]]].
  - pose proof (VTC_rvt H2 Vb) as [Vc | [c' [Sc' [Vc' Tbc']]]].
    + left. exact Vc.
    + right. exists c'. repeat split; assumption.
  - pose proof (VTC_stepL H2 b' Sb' Vb') as H2'.
    pose proof (VTC_rvt H2' Vb') as [Vc | [c' [Sc' [Vc' Tb'c']]]].
    + left. exact Vc.
    + right. exists c'. repeat split; try assumption.
      exact (VtTag_trans Tab' Tb'c').
Qed.

Lemma VTC_lvt_trans : forall a b c, VTC a b -> VTC b c -> ValueType c ->
  ValueType a \/ (exists a', Step a a' /\ ValueType a' /\ VtTag a' c).
Proof.
  intros a b c H1 H2 Vc.
  pose proof (VTC_lvt H2 Vc) as [Vb | [b' [Sb' [Vb' Tb'c]]]].
  - pose proof (VTC_lvt H1 Vb) as [Va | [a' [Sa' [Va' Ta'b]]]].
    + left. exact Va.
    + right. exists a'. repeat split; try assumption.
      exact (VtTag_trans Ta'b (VTC_tag H2 Vb Vc)).
  - pose proof (VTC_stepR H1 b' Sb' Vb') as H1'.
    pose proof (VTC_lvt H1' Vb') as [Va | [a' [Sa' [Va' Ta'b']]]].
    + left. exact Va.
    + right. exists a'. repeat split; try assumption.
      exact (VtTag_trans Ta'b' Tb'c).
Qed.

Lemma VTC_trans : forall a b, VTC a b -> forall c, VTC b c -> VTC a c.
Proof.
  intros a b H1.
  induction H1 as [a b lca lcb tag rvt lvt stepL IHstepL stepR IHstepR].
  intros c H2.
  assert (H1 : VTC a b) by
    (eapply VTC_intro; [exact lca | exact lcb | exact tag | exact rvt
                       | exact lvt | exact stepL | exact stepR]).
  eapply VTC_intro.
  - exact lca.
  - exact (VTC_lcb H2).
  - intros Va Vc. exact (VTC_tag_trans H1 H2 Va Vc).
  - intros Va. exact (VTC_rvt_trans H1 H2 Va).
  - intros Vc. exact (VTC_lvt_trans H1 H2 Vc).
  - intros a' Sa' Va'. exact (IHstepL a' Sa' Va' c H2).
  - intros c' Sc' Vc'.
    pose proof (VTC_stepR H2 Sc' Vc') as H2'.
    eapply VTC_intro.
    + exact lca.
    + exact (VTC_lcb H2').
    + intros Va _. exact (VTC_tag_trans H1 H2' Va Vc').
    + intros _. left. exact Vc'.
    + intros _. exact (VTC_lvt_trans H1 H2' Vc').
    + intros a' Sa' Va'. exact (IHstepL a' Sa' Va' c' H2').
    + intros c'' Sc'' _. exfalso. exact (ValueType_no_step Vc' c'' Sc'').
Qed.
EOF

Require Import Qual.geq.
Require Import Qual.defeq.
Require Import Base.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Open Scope grade_scope.

Definition hasV (a:tm) : Prop := exists v, Value v /\ Steps a v.

Inductive R : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
| R_intro : forall (a b:tm),
    lc_tm a ->
    lc_tm b ->
    (hasV a <-> hasV b) ->
    (forall (v w:tm), Value v -> Steps a v -> Value w -> Steps b w -> VM v w) ->
    R a b
with VM : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
| VM_Type : forall (s:sort), VM (a_Type s) (a_Type s)
| VM_Unit : VM a_TyUnit a_TyUnit
| VM_Pi : forall (psi:grade) (A B A' B':tm),
    R A A' ->
    (forall x, R (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x))
                 (open_tm_wrt_tm B' (a_Var_f x))) ->
    VM (a_Pi psi A B) (a_Pi psi A' B')
| VM_WSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B A' B':tm),
    R A A' ->
    (forall x, R (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x))
                 (open_tm_wrt_tm B' (a_Var_f x))) ->
    VM (a_WSigma psi A B) (a_WSigma psi A' B')
| VM_SSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B A' B':tm),
    R A A' ->
    (forall x, R (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x))
                 (open_tm_wrt_tm B' (a_Var_f x))) ->
    VM (a_SSigma psi A B) (a_SSigma psi A' B')
| VM_Sum : forall (A B A' B':tm),
    R A A' -> R B B' -> VM (a_Sum A B) (a_Sum A' B')
| VM_Abs : forall (psi:grade) (A b A' b':tm),
    (forall x, R (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x))
                 (open_tm_wrt_tm b' (a_Var_f x))) ->
    VM (a_Abs psi A b) (a_Abs psi A' b')
| VM_WPair : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b a' b':tm),
    R b b' -> VM (a_WPair a psi b) (a_WPair a' psi b')
| VM_SPair : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b a' b':tm),
    R b b' -> VM (a_SPair a psi b) (a_SPair a' psi b')
| VM_Inj1 : forall (a a':tm), R a a' -> VM (a_Inj1 a) (a_Inj1 a')
| VM_Inj2 : forall (a a':tm), R a a' -> VM (a_Inj2 a) (a_Inj2 a').

Scheme R_mut_ind := Induction for R Sort Prop
with VM_mut_ind := Induction for VM Sort Prop.
EOF

<tools-used-before-summary>Bash, Read, SendMessage, ToolSearch</tools-used-before-summary>
Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   - Original task (from prior context): In a Rocq 9.1.0 project at `/workspace`, prove
     ```
     Theorem DefEq_Consistent : forall S D A B, DefEq S D A B -> Consistent A B.
     ```
     using definitions in `/workspace/Qualitative_ott.v` and the verified prefix in `/workspace/Task.v`.
   - Hard constraints stated by the launching agent/user:
     - Do NOT modify `/workspace/Task.v` or any file outside a fresh scratch directory under `/tmp` (currently `/tmp/agentwork`). Work only there.
     - Do not use `Admitted`, `admit`, `Abort`, `Axiom`, `Parameter`, `Conjecture`, or disable kernel checks in the final solution. Helper definitions/lemmas are allowed in scratch.
     - Deliverable: a self-contained proof of the target compiling in scratch, or, if unable to finish, a concise report of the most promising concrete invariant/lemma statements, exact remaining subgoals, and compiling partial lemmas.
     - Environment notes: ssreflect + Metalib loaded; `grade_scope` open; `eq_dec` is shadowed (use `CoqEqDec.eq_dec` for atoms); `eq_refl` is shadowed (use `@Logic.eq_refl`).
   - Coordinator requests in this segment:
     1. Test the proposed plain-term `VTR_trans` and report exact IH shapes/blocking subgoal.
     2. Try a mutual Fixpoint implementation, with a warning about indexed-match return types and an unindexed record alternative.
     3. Try the reachability-to-matching-head invariant: define R with lc, VT tag, rigid-head reachability fields for Abs/WPair/SPair/Inj1/Inj2 (and maybe App/Case/LetPair), VT Pi/WSigma/SSigma/Sum component fields, Steps/step fields; prove R_trans, R_sym, and assess DefEq→R; report exact counterexample/failing case. Timebox: prioritize compiling R_trans + R_sym + clear verdict on DefEq→R.
     4. Newest stronger idea: define R via **Value reducts** using deterministic Steps and `Steps_value_unique`, with `hasV a := exists v, Value v /\ Steps a v` and a recursive `VM` on rigid Values; R a b := lc a /\ lc b /\ (hasV a <-> hasV b) /\ forall v w, Value v -> Steps a v -> Value w -> Steps b w -> VM v w. Test R_trans and DefEq→R along this line; report exact failing case if any.
   - Final summary requirement: respond with text only, no tool calls.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - Rocq/Coq 9.1.0, ssreflect, Metalib locally nameless syntax, Qual grade/defeq library.
   - Terms `tm`: `a_Type sort | a_TyUnit | a_TmUnit | a_Var_f atom | a_Var_b nat | a_Pi grade A B | a_Abs grade A body | a_App f grade arg | a_Sum A B | a_Inj1 a | a_Inj2 a | a_Case grade scrut b1 b2 | a_WSigma grade A B | a_WPair a grade b | a_LetPair grade a b | a_SSigma grade A B | a_SPair a grade b | a_Proj1 grade a | a_Proj2 grade a`.
   - `Grade P psi a`, `CGrade P psi phi0 a`, `GEq`, `CEq`, `DefEq`, `CDefEq`, `Par`, `CPar`, `MultiPar`, `Joins`, `Step`, `Steps`, `Value`, `ValueType`, `VtTag`, `Consistent`.
   - `Step` is deterministic; only head reductions (App/Case/Proj/LetPair) plus congruence under the function/scrutinee/projected term; no reduction under binders. `Steps` is `Steps_refl | Steps_step : Step a b -> Steps b c -> Steps a c`.
   - `ValueType`: Type, TyUnit, Pi, WSigma, SSigma, Sum. `Value` includes ValueType, TmUnit, Abs, WPair, SPair, Inj1/2.
   - `VtTag`: Type/Type, Unit/Unit, Pi/Pi same grade, WSigma/WSigma same grade, SSigma/SSigma same grade, Sum/Sum. Lemmas: `VtTag_VT`, `VtTag_sym`, `VtTag_trans`, `VtTag_refl`, `Consistent_of_VtTag`.
   - `Consistent_total`: reduces target to lc a, lc b, and `ValueType a -> ValueType b -> VtTag a b`.
   - `Consistent_of_not_value` (new): lc a -> lc b -> (~ValueType a \/ ~ValueType b) -> Consistent a b.
   - `Steps_join` (new): `forall a b, Steps a b -> forall c, Steps a c -> Steps b c \/ Steps c b`.
   - `Steps_value_unique` (new): `forall a b, Steps a b -> Value b -> forall c, Steps a c -> Value c -> b = c`.
   - `Steps_VT_unique` (new): same for ValueType.
   - `size_tm` and `size_open_var` are defined in Task.v; `size_tm (open B x) = size_tm B`.
   - `Grade_lc`, `DefEq_lc`, `CDefEq_lc` exist.
   - `step_det` exists in Base/Task.

3. Files and Code Sections:
   - `/workspace/Task.v`
     - Target file; externally modified by main session. Current length 2931 lines.
     - Target `Theorem DefEq_Consistent` begins at line 2929; only `intros S D A B H.` present at line 2931, no Qed.
     - New verified lemmas:
       - line 2887 `Lemma Steps_join`
       - line 2899 `Lemma Consistent_of_not_value`
       - line 2909 `Lemma Steps_value_unique`
       - line 2918 `Lemma Steps_VT_unique`
     - Verified prefix used for scratch ends at line 2924 (`Qed` of Steps_VT_unique). `head -2924 /workspace/Task.v > Base.v` is the current correct rebuild.
     - Earlier in segment Task.v was 2903 then 2913 then 2931; head -2884, -2897, -2913 were used at different points; -2913 failed because it cut Steps_value_unique.
   - `/tmp/agentwork/Base.v`
     - Currently rebuilt with:
       ```
       head -2924 /workspace/Task.v > Base.v
       cat >> Base.v <<'EOF'
       (* scratch-only placeholder; not part of any deliverable *)
       Axiom DefEq_Consistent_placeholder : forall S D A B, DefEq S D A B -> Consistent A B.
       EOF
       ```
     - Compiles successfully (~2900 lines). Contains all lemmas through `Steps_VT_unique`. The placeholder axiom is scratch-only and must not be used in a final deliverable.
   - `/tmp/agentwork/VTR.v` (100 lines)
     - Original separated-field plain VTR, lines 11-71, plus projection lemmas:
       ```
       Lemma VTR_lvt : forall (a b:tm), VTR a b -> ValueType b ->
         ValueType a \/ (exists a', Step a a' /\ ValueType a' /\ VtTag a' b).
       ```
       (line 74) and
       ```
       Lemma VTR_absBody :
         forall (a b:tm) (psi0:grade) (A1 b1:tm),
           VTR a b -> a = a_Abs psi0 A1 b1 ->
           forall (A2 b2:tm), b = a_Abs psi0 A2 b2 ->
           forall x, VTR (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x))
                        (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x)).
       ```
       (line 86). Compiles.
     - Key induction pattern for VTR (fields and IHs interleaved):
       ```
       induction H as [a0 b0 lca lcb tag rvt lvt lstep IHlstep rstep IHrstep
         piDom IHpiDom piBody IHpiBody wsDom IHwsDom wsBody IHwsBody
         ssDom IHssDom ssBody IHssBody sumFst IHsumFst sumSnd IHsumSnd
         absBody IHabsBody wpFst IHwpFst wpSnd IHwpSnd spFst IHspFst
         spSnd IHspSnd inj1 IHinj1 inj2 IHinj2].
       ```
   - `/tmp/agentwork/VTR_counter.v` (71 lines, compiles)
     - `VTR_Abs_TmUnit` (line 10), `VTR_TmUnit_Abs` (line 23), `VTR_Var_Type_false` (line 37), `VTR_trans_counterexample` (line 50).
     - Counterexample statement:
       ```
       Lemma VTR_trans_counterexample :
         forall (x:atom) (s:sort) (psi0:grade) (A1 A2:tm),
           lc_tm (a_Abs psi0 A1 (a_Var_b 0)) ->
           lc_tm (a_Abs psi0 A2 (a_Type s)) ->
           VTR (a_Abs psi0 A1 (a_Var_b 0)) a_TmUnit /\
           VTR a_TmUnit (a_Abs psi0 A2 (a_Type s)) /\
           ~ VTR (a_Abs psi0 A1 (a_Var_b 0)) (a_Abs psi0 A2 (a_Type s)).
       ```
     - Proof extracts `VTR_absBody` and shows `VTR (a_Var_f x) (a_Type s)` is impossible via `VTR_lvt`: Var is not ValueType and has no Step.
     - This is a decisive Coq-checked refutation of VTR_trans. Middle `a_TmUnit` is lc and Grade (`G_TmUnit`).
   - `/tmp/agentwork/VTC.v` (195 lines, compiles after removing failed VTC_of_step)
     - Defines weakened core relation:
       ```
       Inductive VTC : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
       | VTC_intro : forall (a b:tm),
           lc_tm a -> lc_tm b ->
           (ValueType a -> ValueType b -> VtTag a b) ->
           (ValueType a -> ValueType b \/ (exists b', Step b b' /\ ValueType b' /\ VtTag a b')) ->
           (ValueType b -> ValueType a \/ (exists a', Step a a' /\ ValueType a' /\ VtTag a' b)) ->
           (forall (a':tm), Step a a' -> ValueType a' -> VTC a' b) ->
           (forall (b':tm), Step b b' -> ValueType b' -> VTC a b') ->
           VTC a b.
       ```
     - Projections: `VTC_lca`, `VTC_lcb`, `VTC_tag`, `VTC_rvt`, `VTC_lvt`, `VTC_stepL`, `VTC_stepR`.
     - Helper transitivity lemmas `VTC_tag_trans`, `VTC_rvt_trans`, `VTC_lvt_trans`.
     - `Lemma VTC_trans : forall a b, VTC a b -> forall c, VTC b c -> VTC a c.` (line 118), compiles.
     - `ValueType_lc`, `VTC_sym` (line 156), `VTC_refl_VT` (line 178) compile.
     - `VTC_of_step` was removed because a one-Step version is false; comment at line 191 explains: if `a -> b -> Type` with b non-ValueType, `VTC a Type` fails since `VTC_lvt` needs a one-step from `a` to Type, while `a` one-steps only to `b`.
   - `/tmp/agentwork/Probe*.v`, `VTR_counter.v`, `Inspect.v`, `PrintInd.v`
     - Exploratory files; Probe2 uses `Abort`, Scratch only, not deliverable.

4. Errors and fixes:
   - VTR_counter induction/destruct patterns initially omitted the interleaved IHs generated by `VTR_ind`, causing field names to bind to IH types (e.g., `rstep` got the Abs-body field type). Fixed by using the full interleaved pattern `field IHfield ...`.
   - `discriminate H1` failed because hypothesis names were different; fixed by using `try solve [intros; discriminate]`/`congruence` with `eapply VTR_intro; try solve [...]`.
   - `VTR_Var_Type_false` via `destruct H` lost index information because the goal was `False`; fixed by adding `VTR_lvt` projection and applying it to the original `H`.
   - `ValueType_no_step Vb b' Sb'` failed because the step target is implicit; correct call is `ValueType_no_step Vb Sb'`.
   - `VTC_stepL H2 b' Sb' Vb'` failed because the target `a'` is implicit; correct call is `VTC_stepL H2 Sb' Vb'`. Same for VTC_stepR.
   - `repeat split; assumption` failed in `VTC_rvt_trans` because the tag component needed `VtTag_trans`; fixed with explicit `split` and `VtTag_trans`.
   - `VTC_of_step` failed at its final stepR because one-step VTC cannot handle `a -> b -> VT` with b non-ValueType; this is a real incompleteness, not a tactic error. Removed the lemma.
   - Base rebuild from `head -2913` failed with "pending proofs in file ./Base.v: Steps_value_unique" because Task.v had grown to 2931 lines and the cut was inside `Steps_value_unique`; fixed by using `head -2924`, which includes the Qed of `Steps_VT_unique`.
   - Coordinator feedback repeatedly changed direction: first mutual Fixpoint, then reachability-to-matching-head, then Value-reduct formulation. The VTR counterexample was reported promptly to avoid wasted effort on VTR_trans.

5. Problem Solving:
   - Proved the proposed plain VTR is **not transitive**, with a Coq-checked counterexample. This is the main definitive result of this segment.
   - Identified the exact failure mechanism: VTR carries no Abs-body information through a non-Abs middle; `VTR Abs TmUnit` and `VTR TmUnit Abs` are vacuous, but `VTR Abs Abs` requires body relation.
   - Proved a weakened core `VTC_trans` (no non-VT structural clauses) compiles, plus symmetry/reflexivity for ValueType.
   - Discovered two further obstacles:
     - One-step VTC is not closed under multi-step Step chains (`VTC_of_step` false for `a -> b -> VT` with b non-VT).
     - Replacing step fields with Steps makes VTC uninhabited for ValueType endpoints because `Steps_refl` creates a self-referential constructor field.
   - Identified that VT structural fields with pointwise-at-atoms body relations still cannot handle DefEq `Eq_PiSnd`/`Eq_WSigmaSnd`/`Eq_SSigmaSnd`/`Eq_SubstIrrel`, which open/substitute with arbitrary terms; adding substitution closure would require R in a negative premise or a context-indexed relation (Par/Joins).
   - Coordinator's newest Value-reduct idea may avoid these issues because `Step` determinism and `Steps_value_unique` make the reached Value unique; R is trivial for terms with no Value reduct, and VM is structural on Values. This is now the active direction.

6. All user messages:
   - Original task message (from prior summary, key content): "You are helping with a Rocq (Coq 9.1.0) proof task in /workspace. Read /workspace/Qualitative_ott.v (all definitions) and /workspace/Task.v (a verified 2000+ line prefix of helper lemmas, ending with an unproved target). Do NOT modify /workspace/Task.v or any file outside a fresh scratch directory you create under /tmp (e.g., /tmp/agentwork). Work only there. Goal: prove Theorem DefEq_Consistent : forall S D A B, DefEq S D A B -> Consistent A B. in the environment of Task.v (ssreflect + Metalib loaded; grade_scope open; eq_dec is shadowed by a grade-specific definition, use CoqEqDec.eq_dec for atoms; eq_refl is shadowed, use @Logic.eq_refl). Already proved in Task.v (use them): DefEq_Grade (DefEq -> Grade both sides), CDefEq_CGrade, Par_Grade, CPar_CGrade, MultiPar_Grade, MultiPar_trans, GEq_trans, MultiPar_Pi_fst etc., plus Grade/substitution/context lemmas. Read the entire Task.v to see what is available. Consistent_total reduces the target to: for all ValueType A B, DefEq S D A B -> VtTag A B (all with lc). The hard obstacle: Eq_Trans and the projection rules (Eq_PiFst/Snd, WSigma/SSigma Fst/Snd, Sum Fst/Snd) and Eq_SubstIrrel. We need a proof strategy for the core. Options to explore: 1. A direct induction on DefEq with a much stronger invariant (deep component consistency / logical relation) that is closed under the rules, avoiding reduction confluence; exploit that Step has NO congruence rules under binders (see Qualitative_ott.v Step), while Par does. 2. A normalization/head-injectivity theorem for DefEq on Grade terms. 3. A Joins-based proof (Joins and Joins_Consistent are already proved in Task.v) if you can find a way around the uniformity/choice problem for binder bodies; note that a proof family forall x, MultiPar (open B1 x) (open B2 x) is not automatically a term-level MultiPar of bodies, but maybe pointwise formulations of Par/GEq can be defined to make Pi congruence work without choice. Do not use Admitted/admit/Abort, do not add axioms/Parameters/Conjectures, do not disable kernel checks. Any helper definitions/lemmas are allowed in your scratch file. Deliverable: a self-contained proof of the target (a sequence of lemmas culminating in DefEq_Consistent) which compiles in scratch. If you cannot finish, report the most promising concrete invariant/lemma statements, the exact remaining subgoals, and any partial compiling lemmas produced. Be concise in the final report: the key idea, what compiled, and what is missing."
   - Coordinator interim check-in (prior): "Interim check-in from the main session: If you have already found a concrete proof strategy or a compiling key lemma toward DefEq_Consistent, please report it soon (key invariant/lemma statements and what compiles). If you are stuck on the same binder-uniformity/choice/confluence obstacles, say briefly which specific subgoal is blocking and what you tried. Keep working if you have a promising concrete path; do not spend time restating the task. Address this before completing your current task."
   - Coordinator VTR idea message (prior): described reduction-aware inductive invariant VTR on plain terms, with fields for lc, VtTag, Step reduct existence, step fields, and structural clauses; suggested proving VTR_trans then DefEq -> VTR.
   - Coordinator follow-up on VTR_trans (prior): nested structural induction plan; outer induction on H1 with motive `forall c, VTR b c -> VTR a c`, inner induction on H2 with motive `forall a, VTR a b -> VTR a c`; report exact generated IH shapes if different.
   - Coordinator message while working (this segment, first): "Correction/stronger hint for VTR_trans: the nested `induction` tactics pollute contexts (I tested a toy). Use a mutual Fixpoint instead, structurally decreasing on the two proof arguments: Fixpoint VTR_trans1 ... with VTR_trans2 ... Calls on `F4 a' ...` / `G5 c' ...` are applications of recursive constructor fields; Coq's guard checker treats them as structurally smaller recursive arguments. ... Worth trying the mutual Fixpoint first. Address this before completing your current task."
   - Coordinator message while working (this segment, second): "Implementation pitfall for the mutual Fixpoint ... a plain `match H2 as H2' in T y z return T a z` does NOT unify ... Fix by making the return depend on the index ... `match H2 as H2' in T y z return (y = b -> T a z)` ... If the index-equality plumbing gets too heavy, an alternative is to define the relation unindexed as a record carrying endpoints ... I am testing the toy with the equality-return fix. Address this before completing your current task."
   - Coordinator message while working (this segment, third): "Please try the reachability-to-matching-head invariant next. Current /workspace/Task.v is 2913 lines (head 2913 includes Steps_join and Consistent_of_not_value); rebuild Base.v from it. Concrete suggestion: define an inductive/record relation R with fields: lc a, lc b; VT tag field; for each rigid head H in {Abs, WPair, SPair, Inj1, Inj2} and maybe Case/App/LetPair, a field saying (both syntactically H and component relations) \/ (a Steps to an H-term matching b's H-components) \/ (b Steps to H ...), plus the VT rvt/lvt/step fields; Pi/WSigma/SSigma/Sum structural component fields (these are VT heads). Transitivity through a non-matching middle should use Steps_join/step_det and the reachability fields. Then prove DefEq→R by DefEq_mind; for Eq_Beta use a Steps-based soundness lemma (multi-step version); for Eq_App/Abs/WPair/etc. congruence use the rigid fields; projections use VT structural fields; Snd/SubstIrrel use Grade_subst/opening lemmas. Finally R + lc gives Consistent via the VT tag field or Consistent_of_not_value. If R_trans or DefEq→R fails, report the exact counterexample/failing case; do not introduce axioms/admits. Timebox: prioritize compiling R_trans + R_sym + a clear verdict on DefEq→R. Address this before completing your current task."
   - Coordinator message while working (this segment, fourth, newest): "Key additional idea for the reachability invariant: use *Value reducts* and Steps_value_unique (now in Task.v, plus Steps_VT_unique/Steps_value_unique). Since Step is deterministic and Values have no Step, from a given term there is at most one Value reachable by Steps, and any two Value reducts reached by Steps from the same source are equal (Steps_value_unique). Define R a b := lc a /\ lc b /\ (hasV a <-> hasV b) /\ forall v w, Value v -> Steps a v -> Value w -> Steps b w -> VM v w, where hasV a := exists v, Value v /\ Steps a v, and VM is a recursive ValueMatch on rigid Values: Type same sort; TyUnit; Pi/WSigma/SSigma same psi + R domain + forall x R opened bodies; Sum R both components; Abs same psi0 + forall x R opened bodies (this is safe now because VM Abs _ requires both sides Abs, so the TmUnit counterexample is rejected); WPair/SPair/Inj1/Inj2 probably need component relations matching their DefEq congruence premises (CDefEq/CEq for the annotated component, R for the unannotated one); Case/App are not Values, so R is vacuous for terms with no Value reduct. R transitivity: for a,c with Value reducts, R a b and R b c give a b-reduct via hasV; uniqueness (Steps_value_unique) makes the bridge well-defined; VM transitivity is structural recursion on the Value components (Abs bodies opened pointwise, so no term-size issue if VM is an Inductive/CoInductive or defined with component R). R symmetry similar. R is trivial for pairs with no Value reducts on either side. DefEq->R: Eq_Beta: a and b=one-Step a have exactly the same Value reducts (any Value reduct of a either is a or goes via b; uniqueness), so VM is v=v. Eq_Trans uses R_trans; Eq_Sym R_sym; Eq_Refl needs VM v v (structural R_refl). Congruences use VM components; App/Case/Proj/LetPair conclusions have no Value reduct? They can reduce to Values, but R only relates their *Value reducts*; to prove R for them from IH you may need the value-reduct semantics of the function/scrutinee Values (e.g. App of two Abs Values: VM Abs-Abs gives body relations; arguments via CDefEq relation; beta reducts then VM/R). This is the applicative-bisimulation part but now finite and uniqueness-based. Final: for VT a b, they are Values, Value reducts are themselves, so VM gives VtTag/Consistent (with lc from DefEq_lc). This avoids confluence/Joins completely. Please test R_trans and DefEq->R along this line; report exact failing case if any. Address this before completing your current task."
   - Final summary request: instructions to produce this summary with text only, no tool calls.

7. Pending Tasks:
   - Implement the Value-reduct-based invariant R per the coordinator's newest message, using `hasV`, `Value`, `Steps`, `VM`, and `Steps_value_unique`/`Steps_VT_unique`.
   - Prove `R_trans` and `R_sym` (timebox priority).
   - Assess/prove `DefEq -> R`; report the exact failing case if any.
   - Derive `DefEq_Consistent` from R + lc + VM/VtTag/Consistent, or report remaining blockers.
   - Keep work in `/tmp/agentwork`, do not modify `/workspace/Task.v`; no axioms/admits in final deliverable.
   - Base.v must be rebuilt from `head -2924` of current Task.v, not head -2913.

8. Current Work:
   - Immediately before this summary, I had:
     1. Received the coordinator's Value-reduct R idea.
     2. Rebuilt `/tmp/agentwork/Base.v` from `head -2924 /workspace/Task.v` after the earlier `head -2913` failed because Task.v had grown to 2931 lines and cut inside `Steps_value_unique`.
     3. Confirmed Base.v compiles successfully and contains `Steps_join` (line 2887), `Consistent_of_not_value` (2899), `Steps_value_unique` (2909), `Steps_VT_unique` (2918).
     4. Not yet written any code for the Value-reduct R.
   - The active plan: define
     ```
     Definition hasV (a:tm) := exists v, Value v /\ Steps a v.
     ```
     and an inductive/record `VM : tm -> tm -> Prop` (or R) with fields for Value shapes, then define
     ```
     R a b := lc_tm a /\ lc_tm b /\
       (hasV a <-> hasV b) /\
       forall v w, Value v -> Steps a v -> Value w -> Steps b w -> VM v w.
     ```
     Need to decide inductive vs record, positivity, and whether VM can be a plain Inductive with recursive R in component fields so that R_trans/R_sym get IHs. Key considerations already identified:
     - `Steps_value_unique` makes the reached Value unique, so for R a b and R b c, if a has Value reduct v and c has w, b's unique Value reduct bridges; VM trans composes.
     - R is vacuous/trivial for terms with no Value reduct; such terms are not ValueType, so Consistent via `Consistent_of_not_value`.
     - Abs/VM fields must require both sides Abs (rejecting TmUnit counterexample).
     - App/Case/Proj/LetPair are not Values, so R imposes no head-shape condition on them directly; only their Value reducts matter.
     - Eq_PiSnd/WSigmaSnd/SSigmaSnd/SubstIrrel opening with arbitrary terms remains the likely hard case; must test.

9. Optional Next Step:
   - Directly follow the coordinator's newest instruction: "Please test R_trans and DefEq->R along this line; report exact failing case if any." Next concrete action is to implement `hasV`, `ValueMatch`/`VM`, and R in a new scratch file (e.g., `/tmp/agentwork/VR.v`), starting with R_trans and R_sym, using `Steps_value_unique`, `Steps_VT_unique`, `VtTag_trans`, and structural recursion on Values. If R_trans or DefEq→R fails, report the exact Coq goal/counterexample, consistent with the timebox: "prioritize compiling R_trans + R_sym + a clear verdict on DefEq→R."

cd /tmp/agentwork && cp RVM.v RVM_trans.v && cat >> RVM_trans.v <<'EOF'

Lemma R_lc_left : forall a b, R a b -> lc_tm a.
Proof. intros a b H; destruct H as [a b lca lcb hv vm]; exact lca. Qed.

Lemma R_lc_right : forall a b, R a b -> lc_tm b.
Proof. intros a b H; destruct H as [a b lca lcb hv vm]; exact lcb. Qed.

Lemma R_hasV : forall a b, R a b -> (hasV a <-> hasV b).
Proof. intros a b H; destruct H as [a b lca lcb hv vm]; exact hv. Qed.

Lemma R_vm : forall a b, R a b ->
  forall v w, Value v -> Steps a v -> Value w -> Steps b w -> VM v w.
Proof. intros a b H; destruct H as [a b lca lcb hv vm]; exact vm. Qed.

Lemma R_VM_trans :
  (forall a b, R a b -> forall c, R b c -> R a c) /\
  (forall v w, VM v w -> forall u, VM w u -> VM v u).
Proof.
  assert (Main : forall a b (H:R a b),
    (forall c, R b c -> R a c) /\
    (forall v w (HV:VM v w), True)).
  { intros a b H.
    induction H using R_mut_ind with
      (P := fun (a b:tm) (_:R a b) => forall c, R b c -> R a c)
      (P0 := fun (v w:tm) (_:VM v w) => forall u, VM w u -> VM v u).
    - (* R_intro *)
      intros c Hbc.
      apply R_intro.
      + exact (R_lc_left (R_intro l l0 i v)).
      + exact (R_lc_right Hbc).
      + exact (iff_trans i (R_hasV Hbc)).
      + intros x y Vx Sax Vy Scy.
        assert (Hbx : hasV b) by (exists x; split; assumption).
        destruct ((proj1 i) Hbx) as [z [Vz Sbz]].
        pose proof (v x z Vx Sax Vz Sbz) as Vxz.
        pose proof (IHvm x z Vx Sax Vz Sbz) as IHxz.
        exact (IHxz y (R_vm Hbc z y Vz Sbz Vy Scy)).
    - (* VM_Type *) intros u H; exact H.
    - (* VM_Unit *) intros u H; exact H.
    - (* VM_Pi *) intros u H; inversion H; subst; econstructor; [ apply IHr; assumption | intro x; apply IHr0; assumption ].
    - (* VM_WSigma *) intros u H; inversion H; subst; econstructor; [ apply IHr; assumption | intro x; apply IHr0; assumption ].
    - (* VM_SSigma *) intros u H; inversion H; subst; econstructor; [ apply IHr; assumption | intro x; apply IHr0; assumption ].
    - (* VM_Sum *) intros u H; inversion H; subst; econstructor; [ apply IHr; assumption | apply IHr0; assumption ].
    - (* VM_Abs *) intros u H; inversion H; subst; econstructor; intro x; apply IHr; assumption.
    - (* VM_WPair *) intros u H; inversion H; subst; econstructor; apply IHr; assumption.
    - (* VM_SPair *) intros u H; inversion H; subst; econstructor; apply IHr; assumption.
    - (* VM_Inj1 *) intros u H; inversion H; subst; econstructor; apply IHr; assumption.
    - (* VM_Inj2 *) intros u H; inversion H; subst; econstructor; apply IHr; assumption.
  }
  split.
  - intros a b H c Hbc. exact (proj1 (Main a b H) c Hbc).
  - intros v w H u Hu. exact (proj1 (Main v w H) u Hu).
Qed.

Lemma R_trans : forall a b, R a b -> forall c, R b c -> R a c.
Proof. intros a b H c Hc. exact (proj1 R_VM_trans a b H c Hc). Qed.

Lemma VM_trans : forall v w, VM v w -> forall u, VM w u -> VM v u.
Proof. intros v w H u Hu. exact (proj2 R_VM_trans v w H u Hu). Qed.
EOF

Require Import Qual.geq.
Require Import Qual.defeq.

From Stdlib Require Import Lia.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Open Scope grade_scope.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Infrastructure for the proof of DefEq_Consistent.            *)
(* ============================================================ *)

(* ---------- size ---------- *)
Fixpoint size_tm (u:tm) : nat :=
  match u with
  | a_TyUnit => 1 | a_TmUnit => 1 | a_Type _ => 1 | a_Var_f _ => 1 | a_Var_b _ => 1
  | a_Pi _ A B => 1 + size_tm A + size_tm B
  | a_Abs _ A b => 1 + size_tm A + size_tm b
  | a_App a _ b => 1 + size_tm a + size_tm b
  | a_Sum A B => 1 + size_tm A + size_tm B
  | a_Inj1 a => 1 + size_tm a | a_Inj2 a => 1 + size_tm a
  | a_Case _ a b1 b2 => 1 + size_tm a + size_tm b1 + size_tm b2
  | a_WSigma _ A B => 1 + size_tm A + size_tm B
  | a_WPair a _ b => 1 + size_tm a + size_tm b
  | a_LetPair _ a b => 1 + size_tm a + size_tm b
  | a_SSigma _ A B => 1 + size_tm A + size_tm B
  | a_SPair a _ b => 1 + size_tm a + size_tm b
  | a_Proj1 _ a => 1 + size_tm a | a_Proj2 _ a => 1 + size_tm a
  end.

Lemma size_tm_pos : forall u, (1 <= size_tm u)%nat.
Proof. destruct u; simpl; lia. Qed.

(* ---------- level-indexed local closedness ---------- *)
Fixpoint lc_at (k:nat) (u:tm) : Prop :=
  match u with
  | a_TyUnit => True
  | a_TmUnit => True
  | a_Type _ => True
  | a_Var_f _ => True
  | a_Var_b n => Nat.lt n k
  | a_Pi _ A B => lc_at k A /\ lc_at (S k) B
  | a_Abs _ A b => lc_at k A /\ lc_at (S k) b
  | a_App a _ b => lc_at k a /\ lc_at k b
  | a_Sum A B => lc_at k A /\ lc_at k B
  | a_Inj1 a => lc_at k a
  | a_Inj2 a => lc_at k a
  | a_Case _ a b1 b2 => lc_at k a /\ lc_at k b1 /\ lc_at k b2
  | a_WSigma _ A B => lc_at k A /\ lc_at (S k) B
  | a_WPair a _ b => lc_at k a /\ lc_at k b
  | a_LetPair _ a b => lc_at k a /\ lc_at (S k) b
  | a_SSigma _ A B => lc_at k A /\ lc_at (S k) B
  | a_SPair a _ b => lc_at k a /\ lc_at k b
  | a_Proj1 _ a => lc_at k a
  | a_Proj2 _ a => lc_at k a
  end.

Lemma lc_at_mono : forall u k j, (k <= j)%nat -> lc_at k u -> lc_at j u.
Proof.
  induction u; simpl; intros k j Hle H; auto; try tauto.
  - destruct H as [HA HB]. split; [exact (IHu1 k j Hle HA)|apply (IHu2 (S k) (S j)); [lia|exact HB]].
  - destruct H as [HA HB]. split; [exact (IHu1 k j Hle HA)|apply (IHu2 (S k) (S j)); [lia|exact HB]].
  - destruct H as [Ha Hb]. split; [exact (IHu1 k j Hle Ha)|exact (IHu2 k j Hle Hb)].
  - lia.
  - destruct H as [HA HB]. split; [exact (IHu1 k j Hle HA)|exact (IHu2 k j Hle HB)].
  - apply (IHu k j Hle); auto.
  - apply (IHu k j Hle); auto.
  - destruct H as [Ha [Hb1 Hb2]]. repeat split;
      [exact (IHu1 k j Hle Ha)|exact (IHu2 k j Hle Hb1)|exact (IHu3 k j Hle Hb2)].
  - destruct H as [HA HB]. split; [exact (IHu1 k j Hle HA)|apply (IHu2 (S k) (S j)); [lia|exact HB]].
  - destruct H as [Ha Hb]. split; [exact (IHu1 k j Hle Ha)|exact (IHu2 k j Hle Hb)].
  - destruct H as [Ha Hb]. split; [exact (IHu1 k j Hle Ha)|apply (IHu2 (S k) (S j)); [lia|exact Hb]].
  - destruct H as [HA HB]. split; [exact (IHu1 k j Hle HA)|apply (IHu2 (S k) (S j)); [lia|exact HB]].
  - destruct H as [Ha Hb]. split; [exact (IHu1 k j Hle Ha)|exact (IHu2 k j Hle Hb)].
  - apply (IHu k j Hle); auto.
  - apply (IHu k j Hle); auto.
Qed.
Arguments lc_at_mono : clear implicits.
Arguments lc_at_mono u k j _ _.

Lemma lc_at_open_rec : forall B t k, lc_at 0 t ->
  (lc_at k (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k t B) <-> lc_at (S k) B).
Proof.
  induction B; intros t k Ht; simpl.
  - tauto. - tauto.
  - (* Pi *) split; intros [HA HB]; split.
    + exact (proj1 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj1 (IHB2 t (S k) Ht) HB).
    + exact (proj2 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj2 (IHB2 t (S k) Ht) HB).
  - (* Abs *) split; intros [HA HB]; split.
    + exact (proj1 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj1 (IHB2 t (S k) Ht) HB).
    + exact (proj2 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj2 (IHB2 t (S k) Ht) HB).
  - (* App *) split; intros [HA HB]; split.
    + exact (proj1 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj1 (IHB2 t k Ht) HB).
    + exact (proj2 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj2 (IHB2 t k Ht) HB).
  - tauto.
  - (* Var_b *) destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[Hlt|Heq]|Hgt]; simpl.
    + split; intros H; lia.
    + subst n. split; intros H.
      * lia.
      * exact (lc_at_mono t 0 k (Nat.le_0_l k) Ht).
    + split; intros H.
      * assert (Hn : (n - 1 < k)%nat) by lia. lia.
      * assert (Hn : (n < S k)%nat) by lia. destruct k; [lia|]. simpl. lia.
  - tauto.
  - (* Sum *) split; intros [HA HB]; split.
    + exact (proj1 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj1 (IHB2 t k Ht) HB).
    + exact (proj2 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj2 (IHB2 t k Ht) HB).
  - (* Inj1 *) split; intros H; [exact (proj1 (IHB t k Ht) H)|exact (proj2 (IHB t k Ht) H)].
  - (* Inj2 *) split; intros H; [exact (proj1 (IHB t k Ht) H)|exact (proj2 (IHB t k Ht) H)].
  - (* Case *) split; intros [HA [HB1 HB2]]; repeat split.
    + exact (proj1 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj1 (IHB2 t k Ht) HB1). + exact (proj1 (IHB3 t k Ht) HB2).
    + exact (proj2 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj2 (IHB2 t k Ht) HB1). + exact (proj2 (IHB3 t k Ht) HB2).
  - (* WSigma *) split; intros [HA HB]; split.
    + exact (proj1 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj1 (IHB2 t (S k) Ht) HB).
    + exact (proj2 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj2 (IHB2 t (S k) Ht) HB).
  - (* WPair *) split; intros [HA HB]; split.
    + exact (proj1 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj1 (IHB2 t k Ht) HB).
    + exact (proj2 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj2 (IHB2 t k Ht) HB).
  - (* LetPair *) split; intros [HA HB]; split.
    + exact (proj1 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj1 (IHB2 t (S k) Ht) HB).
    + exact (proj2 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj2 (IHB2 t (S k) Ht) HB).
  - (* SSigma *) split; intros [HA HB]; split.
    + exact (proj1 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj1 (IHB2 t (S k) Ht) HB).
    + exact (proj2 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj2 (IHB2 t (S k) Ht) HB).
  - (* SPair *) split; intros [HA HB]; split.
    + exact (proj1 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj1 (IHB2 t k Ht) HB).
    + exact (proj2 (IHB1 t k Ht) HA). + exact (proj2 (IHB2 t k Ht) HB).
  - (* Proj1 *) split; intros H; [exact (proj1 (IHB t k Ht) H)|exact (proj2 (IHB t k Ht) H)].
  - (* Proj2 *) split; intros H; [exact (proj1 (IHB t k Ht) H)|exact (proj2 (IHB t k Ht) H)].
Qed.
Arguments lc_at_open_rec B t k _.

Lemma lc_at_S_body : forall B, (forall x, lc_at 0 (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x))) -> lc_at 1 B.
Proof.
  intros B H. destruct (atom_fresh (empty : atoms)) as [x _].
  apply (proj1 (lc_at_open_rec B (a_Var_f x) 0 I)). apply H.
Qed.

Lemma lc_tm_lc_at_0 : forall u, lc_tm u -> lc_at 0 u.
Proof.
  induction 1; simpl; auto.
  all: try (split; [auto | apply lc_at_S_body; auto]).
Qed.

Lemma size_open_var : forall B k xx, size_tm (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f xx) B) = size_tm B.
Proof.
  induction B; simpl; intros k xx; auto;
  try (rewrite IHB1; auto); try (rewrite IHB2; auto);
  try (rewrite IHB1, IHB2; auto);
  try (rewrite IHB1, IHB2, IHB3; auto);
  try (destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[?|?]|?]; auto).
Qed.

Lemma lc_at_0_lc_tm_aux : forall n u, (size_tm u <= n)%nat -> lc_at 0 u -> lc_tm u.
Proof.
  induction n as [|n IHn].
  - intros u Hn H. exfalso. destruct u; simpl in *; lia.
  - intros u Hn H.
    destruct u as [| |psi A B|psi A bd|fa g fb|s|nb|x|A1 A2|ia|ia|g a b1 b2|psi A B|wa g wb|g wa wb|psi A B|sa g sb|g pa|g pa];
      simpl in H; try (exfalso; lia).

(* ---------- Joins imply consistency ---------- *)
Lemma Joins_Consistent : forall (P:econtext) (phi:grade) (a b:tm),
  Joins P phi a b -> lc_tm a -> lc_tm b -> Consistent a b.
Proof.
  intros P phi a b H Ha Hb. destruct H as [P0 psi a1 a2 b1 b2 Mp1 Mp2 Ge].
  apply Consistent_total; [exact Ha | exact Hb |].
  intros VTa VTb.
  pose proof (MultiPar_VT P0 psi a1 b1 Mp1 VTa) as H1.
  pose proof (MultiPar_VT P0 psi a2 b2 Mp2 VTb) as H2.
  pose proof (GEq_VtTag_form P0 psi b1 b2 Ge a1 H1) as H3.
  apply VtTag_trans with b2; [exact H3 | apply VtTag_sym; exact H2].
Qed.
Arguments Joins_Consistent : clear implicits.
Arguments Joins_Consistent P phi a b _ _ _.

(* ---------- Grade/Par/LN layer for DefEq -> Joins ---------- *)

(* ---------- Grade/ CGrade yield reflexive GEq/CEq ---------- *)
Lemma Grade_GEq_refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm), Grade P psi a -> GEq P psi a a.
Proof.
  intros P psi a H. induction H using Grade_mind
    with (P0 := fun (P:econtext) (psi phi0:grade) (a:tm) (_:CGrade P psi phi0 a) => CEq P psi phi0 a a).
  all: try (apply CEq_Nleq; assumption).
  all: try (econstructor; eauto).
  all: assumption.
Qed.
Arguments Grade_GEq_refl : clear implicits.
Arguments Grade_GEq_refl P psi a _.

Lemma CGrade_CEq_refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi phi0:grade) (a:tm), CGrade P psi phi0 a -> CEq P psi phi0 a a.
Proof.
  intros P psi phi0 a H. induction H.
  - apply CEq_Leq; [assumption | apply Grade_GEq_refl; assumption].
  - apply CEq_Nleq; assumption.
Qed.
Arguments CGrade_CEq_refl : clear implicits.
Arguments CGrade_CEq_refl P psi phi0 a _.

Lemma Grade_CPar_refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi phi0:grade) (a:tm), CGrade P psi phi0 a -> CPar P psi phi0 a a.
Proof.
  intros P psi phi0 a H. induction H.
  - apply CPar_Leq; [assumption | apply Par_Refl; assumption].
  - apply CPar_Nleq; assumption.
Qed.
Arguments Grade_CPar_refl : clear implicits.
Arguments Grade_CPar_refl P psi phi0 a _.

(* ---------- Grade inversions (syntactic shape of graded terms) ---------- *)
Lemma Grade_App_inv : forall P psi b psi0 a, Grade P psi (a_App b psi0 a) -> Grade P psi b /\ CGrade P psi psi0 a.
Proof. intros. inversion H. auto. Qed.
Lemma Grade_SPair_inv : forall P psi a psi0 b, Grade P psi (a_SPair a psi0 b) -> CGrade P psi psi0 a /\ Grade P psi b.
Proof. intros. inversion H. auto. Qed.
Lemma Grade_WPair_inv : forall P psi a psi0 b, Grade P psi (a_WPair a psi0 b) -> CGrade P psi psi0 a /\ Grade P psi b.
Proof. intros. inversion H. auto. Qed.
Lemma Grade_Proj1_inv : forall P psi psi0 a, Grade P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a) -> Grade P psi a /\ psi0 <= psi.
Proof. intros. inversion H. auto. Qed.
Lemma Grade_Proj2_inv : forall P psi psi0 a, Grade P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a) -> Grade P psi a.
Proof. intros. inversion H. auto. Qed.
Lemma Grade_Inj1_inv : forall P psi a, Grade P psi (a_Inj1 a) -> Grade P psi a.
Proof. intros. inversion H. auto. Qed.
Lemma Grade_Inj2_inv : forall P psi a, Grade P psi (a_Inj2 a) -> Grade P psi a.
Proof. intros. inversion H. auto. Qed.
Lemma Grade_Case_inv : forall P psi psi0 a b1 b2, Grade P psi (a_Case psi0 a b1 b2) -> Grade P psi a /\ Grade P psi b1 /\ Grade P psi b2 /\ psi0 <= psi.
Proof. intros. inversion H. repeat split; auto. Qed.
Lemma Grade_LetPair_inv : forall P psi psi0 a b,
  Grade P psi (a_LetPair psi0 a b) ->
  Grade P psi a /\ (exists L, forall x, x `notin` L -> Grade ((x~psi0)++P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x))).
Proof. intros. inversion H. split; [assumption| eexists; eauto]. Qed.

(* ---------- a single Step is simulated by Par ---------- *)
Lemma Par_of_Step : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
  Grade P psi a -> Step a b -> Grade P psi b -> Par P psi a b.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b Ga S Gb. revert Gb. induction S; intros Gb.
  - (* AppCong *) destruct (Grade_App_inv Ga) as [Gf CGfb]; destruct (Grade_App_inv Gb) as [Gf' _].
    eapply Par_App.
    + apply IHS; assumption.
    + apply Grade_CPar_refl; assumption.
  - (* Beta *) destruct (Grade_App_inv Ga) as [Gabs CGarg].
    eapply Par_AppBeta.
    + eapply Par_Refl; assumption.
    + apply Grade_CPar_refl; assumption.
  - (* CaseCong *) destruct (Grade_Case_inv Ga) as [Ga0 [Gb1 [Gb2 Hle]]].
    destruct (Grade_Case_inv Gb) as [Ga' _].
    eapply Par_Case.
    + apply IHS; assumption.
    + eapply Par_Refl; assumption.
    + eapply Par_Refl; assumption.
    + assumption.
  - (* Case1Beta *) destruct (Grade_Case_inv Ga) as [Ginj [Gb1 [Gb2 Hle]]].
    pose proof (Grade_Inj1_inv Ginj) as Gx.
    eapply Par_CaseBeta1.
    + eapply Par_Inj1. eapply Par_Refl; assumption.
    + eapply Par_Refl; assumption.
    + eapply Par_Refl; assumption.
    + assumption.
  - (* Case2Beta *) destruct (Grade_Case_inv Ga) as [Ginj [Gb1 [Gb2 Hle]]].
    pose proof (Grade_Inj2_inv Ginj) as Gx.
    eapply Par_CaseBeta2.
    + eapply Par_Inj2. eapply Par_Refl; assumption.
    + eapply Par_Refl; assumption.
    + eapply Par_Refl; assumption.
    + assumption.
  - (* Proj1Cong *) destruct (Grade_Proj1_inv Ga) as [Ga0 Hle].
    destruct (Grade_Proj1_inv Gb) as [Ga' _].
    eapply Par_Proj1; [apply IHS; assumption | assumption].
  - (* Proj2Cong *) pose proof (Grade_Proj2_inv Ga) as Ga0.
    pose proof (Grade_Proj2_inv Gb) as Ga'.
    eapply Par_Proj2; apply IHS; assumption.
  - (* Proj1Beta *) destruct (Grade_Proj1_inv Ga) as [Gsp Hle].
    destruct (Grade_SPair_inv Gsp) as [CGa1 Ga2].
    eapply Par_Proj1Beta.
    + eapply Par_SPair; [apply Grade_CPar_refl; assumption | eapply Par_Refl; assumption].
    + assumption.
  - (* Proj2Beta *) pose proof (Grade_Proj2_inv Ga) as Gsp.
    destruct (Grade_SPair_inv Gsp) as [CGa1 Ga2].
    eapply Par_Proj2Beta.
    + eapply Par_SPair; [apply Grade_CPar_refl; assumption | eapply Par_Refl; assumption].
  - (* LetPairCong *) destruct (Grade_LetPair_inv Ga) as [Ga0 [L HG]].
    destruct (Grade_LetPair_inv Gb) as [Ga' _].
    eapply Par_LetPair with (L := L).
    + apply IHS; assumption.
    + intros x Hx. eapply Par_Refl. apply HG; assumption.
  - (* LetPairBeta *) destruct (Grade_LetPair_inv Ga) as [Gwp [L HG]].
    destruct (Grade_WPair_inv Gwp) as [CGa1 Ga2].
    eapply Par_WPairBeta with (L := L).
    + eapply Par_WPair; [apply Grade_CPar_refl; assumption | eapply Par_Refl; assumption].
    + intros x Hx. eapply Par_Refl. apply HG; assumption.
Qed.

(* ---------- GEq/CEq symmetry ---------- *)

(* ---------- symmetry of GEq / CEq ---------- *)
Scheme GEq_mind := Induction for GEq Sort Prop
  with CEq_mind := Induction for CEq Sort Prop.

Lemma GEq_sym : forall (P:econtext) (phi:grade) (a b:tm), GEq P phi a b -> GEq P phi b a.
Proof.
  intros P phi a b H. induction H using GEq_mind
    with (P0 := fun (P:econtext) (psi phi0:grade) (a b:tm) (_:CEq P psi phi0 a b) => CEq P psi phi0 b a).
  all: try (apply CEq_Nleq; assumption).
  all: try (econstructor; eauto).
  all: assumption.
Qed.
Arguments GEq_sym : clear implicits.
Arguments GEq_sym P phi a b _.

Lemma CEq_sym : forall (P:econtext) (phi phi0:grade) (a b:tm), CEq P phi phi0 a b -> CEq P phi phi0 b a.
Proof.
  intros P phi phi0 a b H. induction H.
  - apply CEq_Leq; [assumption | apply GEq_sym; assumption].
  - apply CEq_Nleq; assumption.
Qed.
Arguments CEq_sym : clear implicits.
Arguments CEq_sym P phi phi0 a b _.
