Definition open_tm_wrt_tm a5 a_6 := open_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 a_6 a5.

Inductive lc_tm : tm -> Prop :=
 | lc_a_TyUnit :
     (lc_tm a_TyUnit)
 | lc_a_TmUnit :
     (lc_tm a_TmUnit)
 | lc_a_Pi : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_Pi psi A B))
 | lc_a_Abs : forall (psi:grade) (A a:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm a (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_Abs psi A a))
 | lc_a_App : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b) ->
     (lc_tm (a_App a psi b))
 | lc_a_Type : forall (s:sort),
     (lc_tm (a_Type s))
 | lc_a_Var_f : forall (x:tmvar),
     (lc_tm (a_Var_f x))
 | lc_a_Sum : forall (A1 A2:tm),
     (lc_tm A1) ->
     (lc_tm A2) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Sum A1 A2))
 | lc_a_Inj1 : forall (a:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Inj1 a))
 | lc_a_Inj2 : forall (a:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Inj2 a))
 | lc_a_Case : forall (psi:grade) (a b1 b2:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b1) ->
     (lc_tm b2) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Case psi a b1 b2))
 | lc_a_WSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_WSigma psi A B))
 | lc_a_WPair : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b) ->
     (lc_tm (a_WPair a psi b))
 | lc_a_LetPair : forall (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_LetPair psi a b))
 | lc_a_SSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     (lc_tm A) ->
      ( forall x , lc_tm  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_tm (a_SSigma psi A B))
 | lc_a_SPair : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm b) ->
     (lc_tm (a_SPair a psi b))
 | lc_a_Proj1 : forall (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     (lc_tm a) ->
     (lc_tm (a_Proj1 psi a))
    | a_Proj1 psi1 a2 => a_Proj1 psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
    | a_Proj2 psi1 a2 => a_Proj2 psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
  end.

Definition close_tm_wrt_tm x1 a1 := close_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 x1 a1.

Inductive Step : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | S_AppCong : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b a':tm),
     lc_tm b ->
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_App a psi b) (a_App a' psi b)
 | S_Beta : forall (psi:grade) (A a b:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_Abs psi A a) ->
     lc_tm b ->
     Step (a_App  ( (a_Abs psi A a) )  psi b)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  a   b )
 | S_CaseCong : forall (psi:grade) (a b1 b2 a':tm),
     lc_tm b1 ->
     lc_tm b2 ->
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_Case psi a b1 b2) (a_Case psi a' b1 b2)
 | S_Case1Beta : forall (psi:grade) (a b1 b2:tm),
     lc_tm b2 ->
     lc_tm b1 ->
     lc_tm a ->
     Step (a_Case psi  ( (a_Inj1 a) )  b1 b2) (a_App b1 psi a)
 | S_Case2Beta : forall (psi:grade) (a b1 b2:tm),
     lc_tm b1 ->
     lc_tm b2 ->
     lc_tm a ->
     Step (a_Case psi  ( (a_Inj2 a) )  b1 b2) (a_App b2 psi a)
 | S_Proj1Cong : forall (psi:grade) (a a':tm),
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_Proj1 psi a) (a_Proj1 psi a')
 | S_Proj2Cong : forall (psi:grade) (a a':tm),
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_Proj2 psi a) (a_Proj2 psi a')
 | S_Proj1Beta : forall (psi:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a2 ->
     lc_tm a1 ->
     Step (a_Proj1 psi (a_SPair a1 psi a2)) a1
 | S_Proj2Beta : forall (psi:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
     Step (a_Proj2 psi (a_SPair a1 psi a2)) a2
 | S_LetPairCong : forall (psi:grade) (a b a':tm),
     lc_tm (a_LetPair psi a b) ->
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_LetPair psi a b) (a_LetPair psi a' b)
 | S_LetPairBeta : forall (psi:grade) (a1 a2 b:tm),
     lc_tm (a_LetPair psi (a_WPair a1 psi a2) b) ->
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
     Step (a_LetPair psi (a_WPair a1 psi a2) b) (a_App  (open_tm_wrt_tm  b   a1 )   q_Bot  a2).

Inductive P_sub : econtext -> econtext -> Prop :=
 | P_Empty :
     P_sub  nil   nil
 | P_Cons : forall (P1:econtext) (x:tmvar) (psi1:grade) (P2:econtext) (psi2:grade),
      ( psi1  <=  psi2 )  ->
     P_sub P1 P2 ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  P1 )  ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  P2 )  ->
     P_sub  (  ( x ~ psi1 )  ++ P1 )   (  ( x ~ psi2 )  ++ P2 ) .

Inductive ctx_sub : context -> context -> Prop :=
 | CS_Empty :
     ctx_sub  nil   nil
 | CS_ConsTm : forall (W1:context) (x:tmvar) (psi1:grade) (A:tm) (W2:context) (psi2:grade),
      ( psi1  <=  psi2 )  ->
     ctx_sub W1 W2 ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  W1 )  ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  W2 )  ->
      True  ->
     ctx_sub  (  ( x ~( psi1 , A ))  ++ W1 )   (  ( x ~( psi2 , A ))  ++ W2 ) .

Inductive CGrade : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CG_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (phi phi0:grade) (a:tm),
      ( phi0  <=  phi )  ->
     Grade P phi a ->
     CGrade P phi phi0 a
 | CG_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (phi phi0:grade) (a:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
      not (  (  ( phi0  <=  phi )  )  )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CGrade P phi phi0 a
with Grade : econtext -> grade -> tm -> Prop :=
 | G_Type : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
      uniq  P  ->
     Grade P psi (a_Type s)
 | G_Var : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (x:tmvar) (psi0:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      binds  x   psi0   P  ->
     Grade P psi (a_Var_f x)
 | G_Pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm),
     Grade P psi A ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Grade  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Grade P psi (a_Pi psi0 A B)
 | G_Abs : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A b:tm),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Grade  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
 | CT_Top : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a A:tm),
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  a A ->
      (  q_C   <  psi )  ->
     CTyping W psi a A.

Inductive Ctx : context -> Prop :=
 | Ctx_Empty :
     Ctx  nil
 | Ctx_Cons : forall (W:context) (x:tmvar) (psi0:grade) (A:tm) (s:sort),
     Ctx W ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  A (a_Type s) ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  W )  ->
     Ctx  (  ( x ~( psi0 , A ))  ++ W ) .

Inductive ValueType : tm -> Prop :=
 | ValueType_Type : forall (s:sort),
     ValueType (a_Type s)
 | ValueType_Unit :
     ValueType a_TyUnit
 | ValueType_Pi : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_Pi psi A B) ->
     ValueType (a_Pi psi A B)
 | ValueType_WSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_WSigma psi A B) ->
     ValueType (a_WSigma psi A B)
 | ValueType_SSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_SSigma psi A B) ->
     ValueType (a_SSigma psi A B)
 | ValueType_Sum : forall (A B:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm B ->
     ValueType (a_Sum A B).

Inductive Consistent : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | Consistent_a_Type : forall (s:sort),
     Consistent (a_Type s) (a_Type s)
 | Consistent_a_Unit :
     Consistent a_TyUnit a_TyUnit
 | Consistent_a_Pi : forall (psi:grade) (A B A' B':tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_Pi psi A B) ->
     lc_tm A' ->
     lc_tm (a_Pi psi A' B') ->
     Consistent  ( (a_Pi psi A B) )   ( (a_Pi psi A' B') )
 | Consistent_a_WSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B A' B':tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_WSigma psi A B) ->
     lc_tm A' ->
     lc_tm (a_WSigma psi A' B') ->
     Consistent  ( (a_WSigma psi A B) )   ( (a_WSigma psi A' B') )
 | Consistent_a_SSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B A' B':tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_SSigma psi A B) ->
     lc_tm A' ->
     lc_tm (a_SSigma psi A' B') ->
     Consistent  (a_SSigma psi A B)   (a_SSigma psi A' B')
 | Consistent_a_Sum : forall (A B A' B':tm),
     lc_tm A ->

Inductive Joins : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | join : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1 a2 b1 b2:tm),
     MultiPar P psi a1 b1 ->
     MultiPar P psi a2 b2 ->
     GEq P psi b1 b2 ->
     Joins P psi a1 a2.

Inductive Value : tm -> Prop :=
 | V_ValueType : forall (a:tm),
     ValueType a ->
     Value a
 | V_TmUnit :
     Value a_TmUnit
 | V_Abs : forall (psi:grade) (A a:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_Abs psi A a) ->
     Value (a_Abs psi A a)
 | V_WPair : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     lc_tm b ->
     Value (a_WPair a psi b)
 | V_SPair : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     lc_tm b ->
     Value (a_SPair a psi b)
 | V_Inj1 : forall (a:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     Value (a_Inj1 a)
 | V_Inj2 : forall (a:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     Value (a_Inj2 a).

Inductive CMultiPar : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CMP_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     MultiPar P psi a1 a2 ->
     CMultiPar P psi psi0 a1 a2
 | CMP_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->

(* ================= Stage 8: single-step reduction preserves Grade ================= *)
Lemma Grade_Abs_body : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A b:tm),
  Grade P psi (a_Abs psi0 A b) ->
  exists L, CGrade P psi q_Top A /\
    forall x, x \notin L -> Grade ((x,psi0)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x)).
Proof.
  intros. inversion H; subst. eexists. split; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma Step_Grade : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
  Step a b -> Grade P psi a -> Grade P psi b.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H; intros Ha.
  - (* AppCong *) destruct (@Grade_App_inv P psi a psi0 b Ha) as [Hfa Hcb].
    apply (@G_App P psi a' psi0 b). apply IHStep. exact Hfa. exact Hcb.
  - (* Beta *) destruct (@Grade_App_inv P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) psi0 b Ha) as [Hfa Hcb].
    destruct (@Grade_Abs_body P psi psi0 A a Hfa) as [L [HcA Hb]].
    destruct (atom_fresh (L \u (dom P \u fv_tm_tm a))) as [x Hx].
    destruct (@fresh3_facts L P a x Hx) as [HL [Hdom Hfv]].
    exact (@Grade_open_arg P psi psi0 b x a (@Grade_uniq P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) Hfa) Hdom (Hb x HL) Hcb Hfv).
  - (* CaseCong *) destruct (@Grade_Case_inv P psi psi0 a b1 b2 Ha) as [Hca [Hcb1 [Hcb2 Hle]]].
    apply (@G_Case P psi psi0 a' b1 b2). apply IHStep. exact Hca. exact Hcb1. exact Hcb2. exact Hle.
  - (* Case1Beta *) destruct (@Grade_Case_inv P psi psi0 (a_Inj1 a) b1 b2 Ha) as [Hca _].
    apply (@G_App P psi b1 psi0 a).
    + destruct (@Grade_Case_inv P psi psi0 (a_Inj1 a) b1 b2 Ha) as [_ [Hcb1 _]].
      exact Hcb1.
    + apply CGrade_of_Grade. exact (@Grade_Inj1_inv P psi a Hca).
  - (* Case2Beta *) destruct (@Grade_Case_inv P psi psi0 (a_Inj2 a) b1 b2 Ha) as [Hca _].
    apply (@G_App P psi b2 psi0 a).
    + destruct (@Grade_Case_inv P psi psi0 (a_Inj2 a) b1 b2 Ha) as [_ [_ [Hcb2 _]]].
      exact Hcb2.
    + apply CGrade_of_Grade. exact (@Grade_Inj2_inv P psi a Hca).
  - (* Proj1Cong *) destruct (@Grade_Proj1_inv P psi psi0 a Ha) as [Hga Hle].
    apply (@G_Proj1 P psi psi0 a'). apply IHStep. exact Hga. exact Hle.
  - (* Proj2Cong *) pose proof (@Grade_Proj2_inv P psi psi0 a Ha) as Hga.
    apply (@G_Proj2 P psi psi0 a'). apply IHStep. exact Hga.
  - (* Proj1Beta *) destruct (@Grade_Proj1_inv P psi psi0 (a_SPair a1 psi0 a2) Ha) as [Hsp Hle].
    destruct (@Grade_SPair_inv P psi a1 psi0 a2 Hsp) as [Hca1 Hg2].
    exact (@CGrade_leq_Grade P psi psi0 a1 Hca1 Hle).
  - (* Proj2Beta *) pose proof (@Grade_Proj2_inv P psi psi0 (a_SPair a1 psi0 a2) Ha) as Hsp.
    exact (proj2 (@Grade_SPair_inv P psi a1 psi0 a2 Hsp)).
  - (* LetPairCong *) destruct (@Grade_LetPair_inv P psi psi0 a b Ha) as [Hga [L Hbody]].
    apply (@G_LetPair L P psi psi0 a' b). apply IHStep. exact Hga. exact Hbody.
  - (* LetPairBeta *) destruct (@Grade_LetPair_inv P psi psi0 (a_WPair a1 psi0 a2) b Ha) as [Hwp [L Hbody]].
    destruct (@Grade_WPair_inv P psi a1 psi0 a2 Hwp) as [Hca1 Hg2].
    apply (@G_App P psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b a1) q_Bot a2).
    + destruct (atom_fresh (L \u (dom P \u fv_tm_tm b))) as [x Hx].

               (@Grade_uniq P psi (a_LetPair psi0 (a_WPair a1 psi0 a2) b) Ha) Hdom (Hbody x HL) Hca1 Hfv).
    + apply CGrade_of_Grade. exact Hg2.
  - inversion S.
  - inversion S.
  - inversion S.
  - inversion S.
  - inversion S.
  - inversion S.
Qed.

Lemma Steps_value : forall a b, Value a -> Steps a b -> a = b.
Proof.
  intros a b Hv H; induction H.
  - reflexivity.
  - exfalso. eapply Value_no_step; eauto.
Qed.


(* ================= Stage 15: steps from a common source are linearly ordered ================= *)
Lemma Steps_join : forall a b, Steps a b -> forall c, Steps a c -> Steps b c \/ Steps c b.
Proof.
  intros a b H. induction H as [a | a x b Hs Hrest IH]; intros c Hc.
  - left. exact Hc.
  - inversion Hc; subst.
    + right. eapply Steps_step; [exact Hs | exact Hrest].
    + assert (x = b0) as E by (eapply step_det; eassumption); subst.
      apply (IH c H0).
Qed.


(* ================= Stage 16: consistency when a side is not a value type ================= *)
Lemma Consistent_of_not_value : forall a b, lc_tm a -> lc_tm b ->
  (~ ValueType a \/ ~ ValueType b) -> Consistent a b.
Proof.
  intros a b Ha Hb [Hna|Hnb].
  - apply Consistent_a_Step_R; assumption.
  - apply Consistent_a_Step_L; assumption.
Qed.


(* ================= Stage 17: unique value endpoint of a reduction ================= *)
Lemma Steps_value_unique : forall a b, Steps a b -> Value b ->
  forall c, Steps a c -> Value c -> b = c.
Proof.
  intros a b Hb Hvb c Hc Hvc.
  destruct (@Steps_join a b Hb c Hc) as [Hbc|Hcb].
  - eapply (@Steps_value b c); [exact Hvb | exact Hbc].
  - symmetry. eapply (@Steps_value c b); [exact Hvc | exact Hcb].
Qed.

Lemma Steps_VT_unique : forall a b, Steps a b -> ValueType b ->
  forall c, Steps a c -> ValueType c -> b = c.
Proof.
  intros. eapply Steps_value_unique;
    [exact H | apply V_ValueType; exact H0 | exact H1 | apply V_ValueType; exact H2].
Qed.


(* ================= Stage 18: Steps is transitive ================= *)
Lemma Steps_trans : forall a b, Steps a b -> forall c, Steps b c -> Steps a c.
Proof.
  intros a b H. induction H as [a | a x b Hs Hrest IH]; intros c Hc.
  - exact Hc.
  - eapply Steps_step; [exact Hs | apply IH; exact Hc].
Qed.


(* ================= Stage 19: Steps preserves Grade ================= *)
Lemma Steps_Grade : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
  Steps a b -> Grade P psi a -> Grade P psi b.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H as [a | a x b Hs Hrest IH]; intros Ha.
  - exact Ha.
  - apply IH. apply (Step_Grade Hs Ha).
Qed.

Require Import Qual.geq.
Require Import Qual.defeq.
Require Import Base2.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Open Scope grade_scope.

(* Literal guarded H requested by the coordinator.  The structural
   constructors cover VT~VT pairs; H_Gen covers every pair with at least
   one non-VT endpoint and has the strict (non-reflexive) VT-reduct fields. *)

Inductive H (P:econtext) (phi:grade) : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
| H_Type : forall s, H P phi (a_Type s) (a_Type s)
| H_Unit : H P phi a_TyUnit a_TyUnit
| H_Pi : forall psi A1 B1 A2 B2,
    H P phi A1 A2 ->
    (forall x,
       H ((x ~ phi) ++ P) phi
         (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x))
         (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x))) ->
    H P phi (a_Pi psi A1 B1) (a_Pi psi A2 B2)
| H_WSigma : forall psi A1 B1 A2 B2,
    H P phi A1 A2 ->
    (forall x,
       H ((x ~ phi) ++ P) phi
         (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x))
         (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x))) ->
    H P phi (a_WSigma psi A1 B1) (a_WSigma psi A2 B2)
| H_SSigma : forall psi A1 B1 A2 B2,
    H P phi A1 A2 ->
    (forall x,
       H ((x ~ phi) ++ P) phi
         (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x))
         (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x))) ->
    H P phi (a_SSigma psi A1 B1) (a_SSigma psi A2 B2)
| H_Sum : forall A1 B1 A2 B2,
    H P phi A1 A2 ->
    H P phi B1 B2 ->
    H P phi (a_Sum A1 B1) (a_Sum A2 B2)
| H_Gen : forall a b,
    lc_tm a -> lc_tm b ->
    (~ ValueType a \/ ~ ValueType b) ->
    (forall a', Steps a a' -> ValueType a' -> a' <> a ->
                H P phi a' b) ->
    (forall b', Steps b b' -> ValueType b' -> b' <> b ->
                H P phi a b') ->
    H P phi a b.

Arguments H_Gen [P phi a b] _ _ _ _ _.

Lemma H_sym : forall (P:econtext) (phi:grade) (a b:tm),
  H P phi a b -> H P phi b a.
Proof.
  intros P phi a b H.
  induction H.
  - apply H_Type.
  - apply H_Unit.
  - apply H_Pi.
    + exact IHH.
    + intros x. apply H0.
  - apply H_WSigma.
    + exact IHH.
    + intros x. apply H0.
  - apply H_SSigma.
    + exact IHH.
    + intros x. apply H0.
  - apply H_Sum; assumption.
  - eapply H_Gen.
    + exact H0.
    + exact H.
    + destruct H1 as [Hna | Hnb]; [right | left]; assumption.
    + intros b' Hb' VTb' Hneq.
      apply IHH. exact (H3 b' Hb' VTb' Hneq).
    + intros a' Ha' VTa' Hneq.
      apply IHH. exact (H2 a' Ha' VTa' Hneq).
Qed.

(* The invariant's only useful consequence at two VT endpoints: same tag. *)
Lemma H_VtTag : forall (P:econtext) (phi:grade) (a b:tm),
  H P phi a b -> ValueType a -> ValueType b -> VtTag a b.
Proof.
  intros P phi a b HH.
  induction HH; intros VTa VTb.
  - apply VtTag_Type.
  - apply VtTag_Unit.
  - apply VtTag_Pi.
  - apply VtTag_WSigma.
  - apply VtTag_SSigma.
  - apply VtTag_Sum.
  - exfalso.
    destruct H1 as [Hna | Hnb]; contradiction.
Qed.

(* H is not transitive as literally specified.  The obstruction is a
   mixed H_Gen pair where the non-VT side has no VT reduct at all, so the
   strict reduction fields are vacuous and do not relate the two VT
   endpoints. *)

Definition hP : econtext := nil.
Definition hphi : grade := q_Top.
Definition hPi : tm := a_Pi q_Top a_TyUnit a_TyUnit.
Definition hSum : tm := a_Sum a_TyUnit a_TyUnit.

Lemma hPi_lc : lc_tm hPi.
Proof.
  unfold hPi. apply lc_a_Pi.
  - apply lc_a_TyUnit.
  - intro x. simpl. apply lc_a_TyUnit.
Qed.

Lemma hSum_lc : lc_tm hSum.
Proof.
  unfold hSum. apply lc_a_Sum; apply lc_a_TyUnit.
Qed.

Lemma hPi_VT : ValueType hPi.
Proof.
  unfold hPi. apply ValueType_Pi; [apply lc_a_TyUnit | apply hPi_lc].
Qed.

Lemma hSum_VT : ValueType hSum.
Proof.
  unfold hSum. apply ValueType_Sum; apply lc_a_TyUnit.
Qed.

Lemma hVar_not_VT : forall x, ~ ValueType (a_Var_f x).
Proof. intros x H; inversion H. Qed.

Lemma hPi_not_VT_absurd : ~ ValueType hPi -> False.
Proof. intro H; apply H; exact hPi_VT. Qed.

Lemma hSum_not_VT_absurd : ~ ValueType hSum -> False.
Proof. intro H; apply H; exact hSum_VT. Qed.

Lemma no_step_var_f : forall x b, ~ Step (a_Var_f x) b.
Proof.
  intros x b Hs. pose proof (step_redex Hs) as Hr. simpl in Hr. discriminate.
Qed.

Lemma H_Pi_Var : forall x, H hP hphi hPi (a_Var_f x).
Proof.
  intros x.
  eapply H_Gen.
  - exact hPi_lc.
  - apply lc_a_Var_f.
  - right. apply hVar_not_VT.
  - intros a' Hs VTa' Hneq.
    exfalso.
    destruct Hs as [a' | a x0 b Hs Hrest].
    + apply Hneq. reflexivity.
    + exact (ValueType_no_step hPi_VT x0 Hs).
  - intros b' Hs VTb' Hneq.
    exfalso. exact (no_step_var_f x b' Hs).
Qed.

Lemma H_Var_Sum : forall x, H hP hphi (a_Var_f x) hSum.
Proof.
  intros x.
  eapply H_Gen.
  - apply lc_a_Var_f.
  - exact hSum_lc.
  - left. apply hVar_not_VT.
  - intros a' Hs VTa' Hneq.
    exfalso. exact (no_step_var_f x a' Hs).
  - intros b' Hs VTb' Hneq.
    exfalso.
    destruct Hs as [b' | a x0 b Hs Hrest].
    + apply Hneq. reflexivity.
    + exact (ValueType_no_step hSum_VT x0 Hs).
Qed.

Lemma not_H_Pi_Sum : ~ H hP hphi hPi hSum.
Proof.
  intro HH.
  pose proof (H_VtTag HH hPi_VT hSum_VT) as HT.
  inversion HT.
Qed.

(* Therefore the requested universal H_trans is false for this H. *)
Theorem H_trans_counterexample :
  exists a b c,
    H hP hphi a b /\ H hP hphi b c /\ ~ H hP hphi a c.
Proof.
  exists hPi, (a_Var_f (AtomSetImpl.a_fresh (empty:atoms))), hSum.
  split.
  - apply H_Pi_Var.
  - split.
    + apply H_Var_Sum.
    + apply not_H_Pi_Sum.
Qed.

The refined H with strict non-reflexive VT-reduct fields still fails, but at `H_trans`, not at `H_refl`: `H_trans` is false for the literal definition. This is formalized and compiling in `/tmp/agentwork/HInvariant.v`.

## Counterexample to H_trans

Take:

```coq
P   := nil
phi := q_Top
a   := a_Pi q_Top a_TyUnit a_TyUnit
b   := a_Var_f x
c   := a_Sum a_TyUnit a_TyUnit
```

All three are locally closed; `a` and `c` are value types, while `b` is a value with no reduction.

Both mixed facts are inhabited by `H_Gen`:

- `H a b`: `a` is VT and `b` is non-VT. The reduct field for `a` is vacuous because `a` has no proper `Step`, and the reflexive path is excluded by `a' <> a`. The reduct field for the irreducible `Var_f x` is likewise vacuous.
- `H b c`: symmetrically vacuous. The only `Steps c c` path is reflexive and excluded by `c' <> c`.

But `H a c` is impossible. The compiling lemma

```coq
Lemma H_VtTag :
  forall P phi a b,
    H P phi a b -> ValueType a -> ValueType b -> VtTag a b.
```

applies, and there is no constructor of `VtTag` relating the heads `a_Pi` and `a_Sum`. Thus:

```coq
Theorem H_trans_counterexample :
  exists a b c,
    H hP hphi a b /\ H hP hphi b c /\ ~ H hP hphi a c.
```

This is a structural obstruction, not a missing reduction lemma: if the non-VT middle term has no VT reduct, the strict fields provide no relation between the two VT endpoints. The comment “the non-VT side's unique VT reduct (if any) is supplied by the field” is exactly where the problem occurs: when there is no VT reduct, `H` permits arbitrary unrelated VT heads on the two sides.

## Required strengthening

`H_Gen` needs an explicit connection for mixed pairs, for example:

```coq
(VT a -> ~ VT b -> Steps b a) ->
(~ VT a -> VT b -> Steps a b) ->
```

or an equivalent field requiring the VT endpoint to be reachable from the non-VT endpoint. With this condition, the counterexample pairs are no longer `H`-derivable, and transitivity through a mixed middle can use `Steps_value_unique`/`Steps_VT_unique`.

Require Import Qual.geq.
Require Import Qual.defeq.
Require Import Base2.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Open Scope grade_scope.

(* Guarded H with the mixed reachability fields requested by the
   coordinator.  H_Gen now contains:
     - lc on both endpoints,
     - the non-VT guard,
     - a reachability field for each mixed orientation,
     - the strict (non-reflexive) VT-reduct fields. *)

Inductive H (P:econtext) (phi:grade) : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
| H_Type : forall s, H P phi (a_Type s) (a_Type s)
| H_Unit : H P phi a_TyUnit a_TyUnit
| H_Pi : forall psi A1 B1 A2 B2,
    H P phi A1 A2 ->
    (forall x,
       H ((x ~ phi) ++ P) phi
         (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x))
         (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x))) ->
    H P phi (a_Pi psi A1 B1) (a_Pi psi A2 B2)
| H_WSigma : forall psi A1 B1 A2 B2,
    H P phi A1 A2 ->
    (forall x,
       H ((x ~ phi) ++ P) phi
         (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x))
         (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x))) ->
    H P phi (a_WSigma psi A1 B1) (a_WSigma psi A2 B2)
| H_SSigma : forall psi A1 B1 A2 B2,
    H P phi A1 A2 ->
    (forall x,
       H ((x ~ phi) ++ P) phi
         (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x))
         (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x))) ->
    H P phi (a_SSigma psi A1 B1) (a_SSigma psi A2 B2)
| H_Sum : forall A1 B1 A2 B2,
    H P phi A1 A2 ->
    H P phi B1 B2 ->
    H P phi (a_Sum A1 B1) (a_Sum A2 B2)
| H_Gen : forall a b,
    lc_tm a -> lc_tm b ->
    (~ ValueType a \/ ~ ValueType b) ->
    (ValueType a -> ~ ValueType b -> Steps b a) ->
    (~ ValueType a -> ValueType b -> Steps a b) ->
    (forall a', Steps a a' -> ValueType a' -> a' <> a ->
                H P phi a' b) ->
    (forall b', Steps b b' -> ValueType b' -> b' <> b ->
                H P phi a b') ->
    H P phi a b.

Arguments H_Gen [P phi a b] _ _ _ _ _ _ _.

Lemma H_sym : forall (P:econtext) (phi:grade) (a b:tm),
  H P phi a b -> H P phi b a.
Proof.
  intros P phi a b HH.
  induction HH.
  - apply H_Type.
  - apply H_Unit.
  - apply H_Pi.
    + exact IHHH.
    + exact H2.
  - apply H_WSigma.
    + exact IHHH.
    + exact H2.
  - apply H_SSigma.
    + exact IHHH.
    + exact H2.
  - apply H_Sum; assumption.
  - eapply H_Gen.
    + exact H1.
    + exact H0.
    + destruct H2 as [Hna | Hnb]; [right | left]; assumption.
    + exact H4.
    + exact H3.
    + exact H8.
    + exact H6.
Qed.

Lemma H_VtTag : forall (P:econtext) (phi:grade) (a b:tm),
  H P phi a b -> ValueType a -> ValueType b -> VtTag a b.
Proof.
  intros P phi a b HH.
  destruct HH; intros VTa VTb.
  - apply VtTag_Type.
  - apply VtTag_Unit.
  - apply VtTag_Pi.
  - apply VtTag_WSigma.
  - apply VtTag_SSigma.
  - apply VtTag_Sum.
  - exfalso. destruct H2 as [Hna | Hnb]; contradiction.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Second transitivity counterexample, even with the mixed Steps fields. *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Definition hP : econtext := nil.
Definition hphi : grade := q_Top.

Definition hB : tm := a_Pi q_Top a_TyUnit a_TmUnit.
Definition hC : tm := a_Pi q_Top a_TyUnit (a_Abs q_Top a_TyUnit a_TmUnit).
Definition hA : tm := a_App (a_Abs q_Top a_TyUnit hB) q_Top a_TyUnit.

Lemma hB_lc : lc_tm hB.
Proof.
  unfold hB. apply lc_a_Pi.
  - apply lc_a_TyUnit.
  - intro x. simpl. apply lc_a_TmUnit.
Qed.

Lemma hC_lc : lc_tm hC.
Proof.
  unfold hC. apply lc_a_Pi.
  - apply lc_a_TyUnit.
  - intro x. simpl. apply lc_a_Abs.
    + apply lc_a_TyUnit.
    + intro y. simpl. apply lc_a_TmUnit.
Qed.

Lemma hA_lc : lc_tm hA.
Proof.
  unfold hA. apply lc_a_App.
  - unfold hB. apply lc_a_Abs.
    + apply lc_a_TyUnit.
    + intro x. simpl. apply hB_lc.
  - apply lc_a_TyUnit.
Qed.

Lemma hB_VT : ValueType hB.
Proof.
  unfold hB. apply ValueType_Pi; [apply lc_a_TyUnit | apply hB_lc].
Qed.

Lemma hC_VT : ValueType hC.
Proof.
  unfold hC. apply ValueType_Pi; [apply lc_a_TyUnit | apply hC_lc].
Qed.

Lemma hA_not_VT : ~ ValueType hA.
Proof. intro H; inversion H. Qed.

Lemma hB_ne_hC : hB <> hC.
Proof. intro E. inversion E. Qed.

Lemma hB_no_step : forall b, ~ Step hB b.
Proof. intros b Hs. exact (@ValueType_no_step hB hB_VT b Hs). Qed.

Lemma hC_no_step : forall b, ~ Step hC b.
Proof. intros b Hs. exact (@ValueType_no_step hC hC_VT b Hs). Qed.

Lemma hA_step_hB : Step hA hB.
Proof.
  unfold hA, hB.
  eapply S_Beta with (psi := q_Top) (A := a_TyUnit).
  - apply lc_a_TyUnit.
  - apply lc_a_Abs.
    + apply lc_a_TyUnit.
    + intro x. simpl. apply lc_a_Pi.
      * apply lc_a_TyUnit.
      * intro y. simpl. apply lc_a_TmUnit.

Lemma lc_rename_tm : forall u xr yr, lc_tm u -> lc_tm (rename_tm xr yr u).
Proof.
  intros. unfold rename_tm. apply (@lc_subst_tm_tm u xr (a_Var_f yr)). assumption. apply lc_a_Var_f.
Qed.

Lemma Grade_rename : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (u:tm),
  Grade P psi u ->
  forall xr yr, xr <> yr -> xr \notin dom P -> yr \notin dom P ->
    Grade P psi (rename_tm xr yr u).
Proof.
  intros P psi u H. induction H using Grade_mind
    with (P0 := fun (P:econtext) (psi phi0:grade) (u:tm) (_:CGrade P psi phi0 u) =>
                 forall xr yr, xr <> yr -> xr \notin dom P -> yr \notin dom P ->
                   CGrade P psi phi0 (rename_tm xr yr u)).
  all: intros xr yr Hne Hx Hy; unfold rename_tm; simpl.
  - eapply G_Type; eassumption.
  - (* Var *) destruct (CoqEqDec.eq_dec x xr) as [E|E]; simpl in *.
    + exfalso. apply Hx. eapply binds_In. rewrite <- E. exact b.
    + eapply G_Var; [exact u | exact i | exact b].
  - (* Pi *) eapply (@G_Pi (L \u ({{xr}} \u {{yr}})) P psi psi0 (rename_tm xr yr A) (rename_tm xr yr B)).
    + apply IHGrade; assumption.
    + intros z Hz.
      assert (HzL : z \notin L) by (apply (@notin_union_l L ({{xr}} \u {{yr}}) z); exact Hz).
      assert (Hzr : z \notin ({{xr}} \u {{yr}})) by (apply (@notin_union_r L ({{xr}} \u {{yr}}) z); exact Hz).
      assert (Hzx : z <> xr) by (intro E; apply Hzr; apply AtomSetImpl.union_2; subst; apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2; reflexivity).
      assert (Hzy : z <> yr) by (intro E; apply Hzr; apply AtomSetImpl.union_3; subst; apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2; reflexivity).
      assert (Hxd : xr \notin dom ((z,psi)::P)) by (apply (@notin_dom_cons grade z psi P xr); [symmetry; exact Hzx | exact Hx]).
      assert (Hyd : yr \notin dom ((z,psi)::P)) by (apply (@notin_dom_cons grade z psi P yr); [symmetry; exact Hzy | exact Hy]).
      specialize (H0 z HzL xr yr Hne Hxd Hyd).
      unfold rename_tm in H0. rewrite (@subst_open_comm0 B xr (a_Var_f yr) z (lc_a_Var_f yr) Hzx) in H0.
      exact H0.
  - (* Abs *) eapply (@G_Abs (L \u ({{xr}} \u {{yr}})) P psi psi0 (rename_tm xr yr A) (rename_tm xr yr b)).
    + intros z Hz.
      assert (HzL : z \notin L) by (apply (@notin_union_l L ({{xr}} \u {{yr}}) z); exact Hz).
      assert (Hzr : z \notin ({{xr}} \u {{yr}})) by (apply (@notin_union_r L ({{xr}} \u {{yr}}) z); exact Hz).
      assert (Hzx : z <> xr) by (intro E; apply Hzr; apply AtomSetImpl.union_2; subst; apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2; reflexivity).
      assert (Hzy : z <> yr) by (intro E; apply Hzr; apply AtomSetImpl.union_3; subst; apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2; reflexivity).
      assert (Hxd : xr \notin dom ((z,psi0)::P)) by (apply (@notin_dom_cons grade z psi0 P xr); [symmetry; exact Hzx | exact Hx]).
      assert (Hyd : yr \notin dom ((z,psi0)::P)) by (apply (@notin_dom_cons grade z psi0 P yr); [symmetry; exact Hzy | exact Hy]).
      specialize (H z HzL xr yr Hne Hxd Hyd).
      unfold rename_tm in H. rewrite (@subst_open_comm0 b xr (a_Var_f yr) z (lc_a_Var_f yr) Hzx) in H.
      exact H.
    + assumption.
  - (* TyUnit *) eapply G_TyUnit; eassumption.
  - (* TmUnit *) eapply G_TmUnit; eassumption.
  - (* CG_Leq *) eapply CG_Leq. assumption. apply IHGrade; assumption.
  - (* CG_Nleq *) eapply CG_Nleq.
    + apply lc_rename_tm; assumption.
    + assumption.
    + assumption.
Qed.

Lemma GEq_rename : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
  GEq P psi a b ->
  forall xr yr, xr <> yr -> xr \notin dom P -> yr \notin dom P ->
    GEq P psi (rename_tm xr yr a) (rename_tm xr yr b).
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H using GEq_mind
    with (P0 := fun (P:econtext) (psi phi0:grade) (a b:tm) (_:CEq P psi phi0 a b) =>
                 forall xr yr, xr <> yr -> xr \notin dom P -> yr \notin dom P ->
                   CEq P psi phi0 (rename_tm xr yr a) (rename_tm xr yr b)).
  all: intros xr yr Hne Hx Hy; unfold rename_tm; simpl.
  - (* Var *) destruct (CoqEqDec.eq_dec x xr) as [E|E]; simpl in *.
    + exfalso. apply Hx. eapply binds_In. rewrite <- E. exact b.
    + eapply GEq_Var; [exact u | exact b | exact i].
  - (* Type *) eapply GEq_Type; eassumption.
  - (* Pi *) eapply (@GEq_Pi (L \u ({{xr}} \u {{yr}})) P psi psi0
                              (rename_tm xr yr A1) (rename_tm xr yr B1)
                              (rename_tm xr yr A2) (rename_tm xr yr B2)).
    + apply IHGEq; assumption.
    + intros z Hz.
      assert (HzL : z \notin L) by (apply (@notin_union_l L ({{xr}} \u {{yr}}) z); exact Hz).
      assert (Hzr : z \notin ({{xr}} \u {{yr}})) by (apply (@notin_union_r L ({{xr}} \u {{yr}}) z); exact Hz).
      assert (Hzx : z <> xr) by (intro E; apply Hzr; apply AtomSetImpl.union_2; subst; apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2; reflexivity).
      assert (Hzy : z <> yr) by (intro E; apply Hzr; apply AtomSetImpl.union_3; subst; apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2; reflexivity).
      assert (Hxd : xr \notin dom ((z,psi)::P)) by (apply (@notin_dom_cons grade z psi P xr); [symmetry; exact Hzx | exact Hx]).
      assert (Hyd : yr \notin dom ((z,psi)::P)) by (apply (@notin_dom_cons grade z psi P yr); [symmetry; exact Hzy | exact Hy]).
      specialize (H0 z HzL xr yr Hne Hxd Hyd).
      unfold rename_tm in H0.
      rewrite (@subst_open_comm0 B1 xr (a_Var_f yr) z (lc_a_Var_f yr) Hzx) in H0.
      rewrite (@subst_open_comm0 B2 xr (a_Var_f yr) z (lc_a_Var_f yr) Hzx) in H0.

Lemma Par_rename : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
  Par P psi a b ->
  forall xr yr, xr <> yr -> xr \notin dom P -> yr \notin dom P ->
    Par P psi (rename_tm xr yr a) (rename_tm xr yr b).
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H using Par_mind
    with (P0 := fun (P:econtext) (psi phi0:grade) (a b:tm) (_:CPar P psi phi0 a b) =>
                 forall xr yr, xr <> yr -> xr \notin dom P -> yr \notin dom P ->
                   CPar P psi phi0 (rename_tm xr yr a) (rename_tm xr yr b)).
  all: intros xr yr Hne Hx Hy; unfold rename_tm; simpl.
  - (* Refl *) apply Par_Refl. apply Grade_rename with (xr:=xr) (yr:=yr); assumption.
  - (* Pi *) eapply (@Par_Pi (L \u ({{xr}} \u {{yr}})) P psi psi1
                            (rename_tm xr yr A1) (rename_tm xr yr B1)
                            (rename_tm xr yr A2) (rename_tm xr yr B2)).
    + apply IHPar; assumption.
    + intros z Hz.
      assert (HzL : z \notin L) by (apply (@notin_union_l L ({{xr}} \u {{yr}}) z); exact Hz).
      assert (Hzr : z \notin ({{xr}} \u {{yr}})) by (apply (@notin_union_r L ({{xr}} \u {{yr}}) z); exact Hz).
      assert (Hzx : z <> xr) by (intro E; apply Hzr; apply AtomSetImpl.union_2; subst; apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2; reflexivity).
      assert (Hzy : z <> yr) by (intro E; apply Hzr; apply AtomSetImpl.union_3; subst; apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2; reflexivity).
      assert (Hxd : xr \notin dom ((z,psi)::P)) by (apply (@notin_dom_cons grade z psi P xr); [symmetry; exact Hzx | exact Hx]).
      assert (Hyd : yr \notin dom ((z,psi)::P)) by (apply (@notin_dom_cons grade z psi P yr); [symmetry; exact Hzy | exact Hy]).
      specialize (H0 z HzL xr yr Hne Hxd Hyd).
      unfold rename_tm in H0.
      rewrite (@subst_open_comm0 B1 xr (a_Var_f yr) z (lc_a_Var_f yr) Hzx) in H0.
      rewrite (@subst_open_comm0 B2 xr (a_Var_f yr) z (lc_a_Var_f yr) Hzx) in H0.
      exact H0.
  - (* AppBeta *)
    specialize (IHPar xr yr Hne Hx Hy).
    specialize (IHPar0 xr yr Hne Hx Hy).
    rewrite (@subst_open_term a' b' xr yr Hne).
    eapply Par_AppBeta with (a' := rename_tm xr yr a') (b' := rename_tm xr yr b').
    + unfold rename_tm in IHPar. simpl in IHPar. exact IHPar.
    + apply lc_rename_tm; assumption.
    + apply lc_rename_tm; assumption.
    + assumption.
    + assumption.
Qed.

    + apply (@G_LetPair L P psi psi0 a1 b1). exact (proj1 IHPar).
      intros x Hx. exact (proj1 (H0 x Hx)).
    + apply (@G_LetPair L P psi psi0 a2 b2). exact (proj2 IHPar).
      intros x Hx. exact (proj2 (H0 x Hx)).
  - (* SSigma *)
    split.
    + apply (@G_SSigma L P psi psi1 A1 B1).
      * exact (proj1 IHPar).
      * intros x Hx. exact (proj1 (H0 x Hx)).
    + apply (@G_SSigma L P psi psi1 A2 B2).
      * exact (proj2 IHPar).
      * intros x Hx. exact (proj2 (H0 x Hx)).
  - (* SPair *)
    split.
    + apply (@G_SPair P psi a1 psi0 b1). exact (proj1 IHPar). exact (proj1 IHPar0).
    + apply (@G_SPair P psi a2 psi0 b2). exact (proj2 IHPar). exact (proj2 IHPar0).
  - (* Proj1Beta *)
    destruct IHPar as [Ha Ha'].
    inversion Ha'; subst.
    split.
    + apply (@G_Proj1 P psi psi0 a1). exact Ha. assumption.
    + apply (@CGrade_leq_Grade P psi psi0 a1'). exact H4. assumption.
  - (* Proj1 *)
    split.
    + apply (@G_Proj1 P psi psi0 a1). exact (proj1 IHPar). assumption.
    + apply (@G_Proj1 P psi psi0 a2). exact (proj2 IHPar). assumption.
  - (* Proj2Beta *)
    destruct IHPar as [Ha Ha'].
    inversion Ha'; subst.
    split.
    + apply (@G_Proj2 P psi psi0 a1). exact Ha.
    + exact H6.
  - (* Proj2 *)
    split.
    + apply (@G_Proj2 P psi psi0 a1). exact (proj1 IHPar).
    + apply (@G_Proj2 P psi psi0 a2). exact (proj2 IHPar).
  - (* Sum *)
    split.
    + apply (@G_Sum P psi A1 A2). exact (proj1 IHPar1). exact (proj1 IHPar2).
    + apply (@G_Sum P psi A1' A2'). exact (proj2 IHPar1). exact (proj2 IHPar2).
  - (* Inj1 *)
    split.
    + eapply G_Inj1. exact (proj1 IHPar).
    + eapply G_Inj1. exact (proj2 IHPar).
  - (* Inj2 *)
    split.
    + eapply G_Inj2. exact (proj1 IHPar).
    + eapply G_Inj2. exact (proj2 IHPar).
  - (* CaseBeta1 *)
    destruct IHPar1 as [Ha Ha']. destruct IHPar2 as [Hb1 Hb1']. destruct IHPar3 as [Hb2 Hb2'].
    inversion Ha'; subst.
    split.
    + apply (@G_Case P psi psi0 a b1 b2). exact Ha. exact Hb1. exact Hb2. assumption.
    + apply (@G_App P psi b1' psi0 a').
      * exact Hb1'.
      * apply CGrade_of_Grade. exact H5.
  - (* CaseBeta2 *)
    destruct IHPar1 as [Ha Ha']. destruct IHPar2 as [Hb1 Hb1']. destruct IHPar3 as [Hb2 Hb2'].
    inversion Ha'; subst.
    split.
    + apply (@G_Case P psi psi0 a b1 b2). exact Ha. exact Hb1. exact Hb2. assumption.
    + apply (@G_App P psi b2' psi0 a').
      * exact Hb2'.
      * apply CGrade_of_Grade. exact H5.
  - (* Case *)
    split.
    + apply (@G_Case P psi psi0 a b1 b2). exact (proj1 IHPar1). exact (proj1 IHPar2). exact (proj1 IHPar3). assumption.
    + apply (@G_Case P psi psi0 a' b1' b2'). exact (proj2 IHPar1). exact (proj2 IHPar2). exact (proj2 IHPar3). assumption.
  - (* CPar_Leq *)
    split.
    + apply (@CG_Leq P psi psi0); [exact i | exact (proj1 IHPar)].
    + apply (@CG_Leq P psi psi0); [exact i | exact (proj2 IHPar)].
  - (* CPar_Nleq *)
    split; eapply CG_Nleq; assumption.
Qed.


(* ================= Stage 6: multi-parallel reduction grades and GEq transitivity ================= *)
Lemma MultiPar_Grade : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
  MultiPar P psi a b -> Grade P psi a /\ Grade P psi b.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H.
  - split; assumption.
  - apply Par_Grade in H as [Ha Hb]. destruct IHMultiPar as [Hb' Hc].
    split; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_trans : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
  MultiPar P psi a b -> forall c, MultiPar P psi b c -> MultiPar P psi a c.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H; intros c Hc.
  - exact Hc.
  - eapply MP_Step. exact H. apply IHMultiPar. exact Hc.
Qed.

Lemma GEq_trans : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
  GEq P psi a b -> forall c, GEq P psi b c -> GEq P psi a c.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H using GEq_mind
    with (P0 := fun (P:econtext) (psi phi0:grade) (a b:tm) (_:CEq P psi phi0 a b) =>
                 forall c, CEq P psi phi0 b c -> CEq P psi phi0 a c).
  all: intros c2 Hc; inversion Hc; subst.
  all: try solve [exfalso; match goal with Hl : ?p <= ?q, Hn : ~ (?p <= ?q) |- _ => exact (Hn Hl) end].
  - eapply GEq_Var; eassumption.
  - eapply GEq_Type; eassumption.
  - eapply (@GEq_Pi (L \u L0) P psi psi0 A1 B1 A3 B3).
    + apply (IHGEq A3). assumption.
    + intros x Hx. apply (H0 x (@notin_union_l L L0 x Hx)).
      eauto using notin_union_l, notin_union_r.
  - eapply (@GEq_Abs (L \u L0) P psi psi0 A1 b1 A3 b3).
    + intros x Hx. apply (H x (@notin_union_l L L0 x Hx)).
      eauto using notin_union_l, notin_union_r.
    + eapply IHGEq. eassumption.
  - eapply GEq_App.
    + eapply IHGEq. eassumption.
    + eapply IHGEq0. eassumption.
  - eapply (@GEq_WSigma (L \u L0) P psi psi0 A1 B1 A3 B3).
    + apply (IHGEq A3). assumption.
    + intros x Hx. apply (H0 x (@notin_union_l L L0 x Hx)).
      eauto using notin_union_l, notin_union_r.
  - eapply GEq_WPair.
    + eapply IHGEq. eassumption.
    + eapply IHGEq0. eassumption.
  - eapply (@GEq_LetPair (L \u L0) P psi psi0 a1 b1 a3 b3).
    + apply (IHGEq a3). assumption.
    + intros x Hx. apply (H0 x (@notin_union_l L L0 x Hx)).
      eauto using notin_union_l, notin_union_r.
  - eapply (@GEq_SSigma (L \u L0) P psi psi0 A1 B1 A3 B3).
    + apply (IHGEq A3). assumption.
    + intros x Hx. apply (H0 x (@notin_union_l L L0 x Hx)).
      eauto using notin_union_l, notin_union_r.
  - eapply GEq_SPair.
    + eapply IHGEq. eassumption.
    + eapply IHGEq0. eassumption.
  - eapply GEq_Proj1. eapply IHGEq. eassumption. assumption.
  - eapply GEq_Proj2. eapply IHGEq. eassumption.
  - eapply GEq_Sum. eapply IHGEq1. eassumption. eapply IHGEq2. eassumption.
  - eapply GEq_Inj1. eapply IHGEq. eassumption.
  - eapply GEq_Inj2. eapply IHGEq. eassumption.
  - eapply GEq_Case.
    + eapply IHGEq1. eassumption.
    + eapply IHGEq2. eassumption.
    + eapply IHGEq3. eassumption.
    + assumption.
  - eapply GEq_TyUnit. eassumption.
  - eapply GEq_TmUnit. eassumption.
  - (* CEq_Leq *) eapply CEq_Leq. assumption. eapply IHGEq. eassumption.
  - (* CEq_Nleq *) eapply CEq_Nleq; eassumption.
Qed.


(* ================= Stage 7: shape decomposition of MultiPar on Pi ================= *)
Lemma MultiPar_Pi_decomp : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
  MultiPar P psi a b ->
  forall psi0 A1 B1, a = a_Pi psi0 A1 B1 ->
  exists A1' B1', b = a_Pi psi0 A1' B1' /\
    MultiPar P psi A1 A1' /\
    exists L, forall x, x \notin L ->
      MultiPar ((x,psi)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x))
                                        (open_tm_wrt_tm B1' (a_Var_f x)).
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H as [P psi a Ha | P psi a a' b Hpar Hmp IH];
    intros psi0 A1 B1 EQ; subst a.
  - (* MP_Refl *)
    destruct (@Grade_Pi_body P psi psi0 A1 B1 Ha) as [Lbody HB].
    exists A1, B1. split.
    + reflexivity.
    + split.
      * apply MP_Refl. exact (@Grade_Pi_inv P psi psi0 A1 B1 Ha).
      * exists Lbody. intros x Hx. apply MP_Refl. exact (HB x Hx).
  - (* MP_Step *)
    inversion Hpar; subst.
    + (* Par_Refl *)
      apply (IH psi0 A1 B1 (@Logic.eq_refl tm (a_Pi psi0 A1 B1))).
    + (* Par_Pi *)
      match goal with
      | HpA : Par P psi A1 ?A2,
        HpB : forall x, x \notin ?L -> Par _ psi
                (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm ?B2 (a_Var_f x)) |- _ =>
          destruct (IH psi0 A2 B2 (@Logic.eq_refl tm (a_Pi psi0 A2 B2)))
            as [A2' [B2' [Eb [MpA MpB]]]];
          destruct MpB as [L2 HB2];
          exists A2', B2'; split; [exact Eb | split];
          [ eapply MP_Step; [exact HpA | exact MpA] |
            exists (L \u L2); intros x Hx; eapply MP_Step;
            [ exact (HpB x (@notin_union_l L L2 x Hx)) |
              exact (HB2 x (@notin_union_r L L2 x Hx)) ] ]
      end.
Qed.

Fixpoint close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (n1 : nat) (x1 : tmvar) (a1 : tm) {struct a1} : tm :=
  match a1 with
    | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
    | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
    | a_Pi psi1 A1 B1 => a_Pi psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 B1)
    | a_Abs psi1 A1 a2 => a_Abs psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 a2)
    | a_App a2 psi1 b1 => a_App (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1)
    | a_Type s => a_Type s
    | a_Var_f x2 => if (x1 == x2) then (a_Var_b n1) else (a_Var_f x2)
    | a_Var_b n2 => if (lt_ge_dec n2 n1) then (a_Var_b n2) else (a_Var_b (S n2))
    | a_Sum A1 A2 => a_Sum (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A2)
    | a_Inj1 a2 => a_Inj1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
    | a_Inj2 a2 => a_Inj2 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
    | a_Case psi a2 b1 b2 => a_Case psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b2)
    | a_WSigma psi1 A1 B1 => a_WSigma psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 B1)
    | a_WPair a2 psi1 b1 => a_WPair (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1)
    | a_LetPair psi1 a2 b1 => a_LetPair psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 b1)
    | a_SSigma psi1 A1 B1 => a_SSigma psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 B1)
    | a_SPair a2 psi1 b1 => a_SPair (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1)
    | a_Proj1 psi1 a2 => a_Proj1 psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
    | a_Proj2 psi1 a2 => a_Proj2 psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
  end.

Definition close_tm_wrt_tm x1 a1 := close_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 x1 a1.

Inductive Step : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | S_AppCong : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b a':tm),
     lc_tm b ->
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_App a psi b) (a_App a' psi b)
 | S_Beta : forall (psi:grade) (A a b:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_Abs psi A a) ->
     lc_tm b ->
     Step (a_App  ( (a_Abs psi A a) )  psi b)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  a   b )
 | S_CaseCong : forall (psi:grade) (a b1 b2 a':tm),
     lc_tm b1 ->
     lc_tm b2 ->
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_Case psi a b1 b2) (a_Case psi a' b1 b2)
 | S_Case1Beta : forall (psi:grade) (a b1 b2:tm),
     lc_tm b2 ->
     lc_tm b1 ->
     lc_tm a ->
     Step (a_Case psi  ( (a_Inj1 a) )  b1 b2) (a_App b1 psi a)
 | S_Case2Beta : forall (psi:grade) (a b1 b2:tm),
     lc_tm b1 ->
     lc_tm b2 ->
     lc_tm a ->
     Step (a_Case psi  ( (a_Inj2 a) )  b1 b2) (a_App b2 psi a)
 | S_Proj1Cong : forall (psi:grade) (a a':tm),
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_Proj1 psi a) (a_Proj1 psi a')
 | S_Proj2Cong : forall (psi:grade) (a a':tm),
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_Proj2 psi a) (a_Proj2 psi a')
 | S_Proj1Beta : forall (psi:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a2 ->
     lc_tm a1 ->
     Step (a_Proj1 psi (a_SPair a1 psi a2)) a1
 | S_Proj2Beta : forall (psi:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
     Step (a_Proj2 psi (a_SPair a1 psi a2)) a2
 | S_LetPairCong : forall (psi:grade) (a b a':tm),
     lc_tm (a_LetPair psi a b) ->
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_LetPair psi a b) (a_LetPair psi a' b)
 | S_LetPairBeta : forall (psi:grade) (a1 a2 b:tm),
     lc_tm (a_LetPair psi (a_WPair a1 psi a2) b) ->
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
     Step (a_LetPair psi (a_WPair a1 psi a2) b) (a_App  (open_tm_wrt_tm  b   a1 )   q_Bot  a2).

Inductive P_sub : econtext -> econtext -> Prop :=
 | P_Empty :
     P_sub  nil   nil
 | P_Cons : forall (P1:econtext) (x:tmvar) (psi1:grade) (P2:econtext) (psi2:grade),
      ( psi1  <=  psi2 )  ->
     P_sub P1 P2 ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  P1 )  ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  P2 )  ->
     P_sub  (  ( x ~ psi1 )  ++ P1 )   (  ( x ~ psi2 )  ++ P2 ) .

Inductive ctx_sub : context -> context -> Prop :=
 | CS_Empty :
     ctx_sub  nil   nil
 | CS_ConsTm : forall (W1:context) (x:tmvar) (psi1:grade) (A:tm) (W2:context) (psi2:grade),
      ( psi1  <=  psi2 )  ->
     ctx_sub W1 W2 ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  W1 )  ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  W2 )  ->
      True  ->
     ctx_sub  (  ( x ~( psi1 , A ))  ++ W1 )   (  ( x ~( psi2 , A ))  ++ W2 ) .

Inductive CGrade : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CG_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (phi phi0:grade) (a:tm),
      ( phi0  <=  phi )  ->
     Grade P phi a ->
     CGrade P phi phi0 a
 | CG_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (phi phi0:grade) (a:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
      not (  (  ( phi0  <=  phi )  )  )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CGrade P phi phi0 a
with Grade : econtext -> grade -> tm -> Prop :=
 | G_Type : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
      uniq  P  ->
     Grade P psi (a_Type s)
 | G_Var : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (x:tmvar) (psi0:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      binds  x   psi0   P  ->
     Grade P psi (a_Var_f x)
 | G_Pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm),
     Grade P psi A ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Grade  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Grade P psi (a_Pi psi0 A B)
 | G_Abs : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A b:tm),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Grade  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     CGrade P psi  q_Top  A ->
     Grade P psi (a_Abs psi0 A b)
 | G_App : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (b:tm) (psi0:grade) (a:tm),
     Grade P psi b ->
     CGrade P psi psi0 a ->
     Grade P psi (a_App b psi0 a)
 | G_WSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm),
     Grade P psi A ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Grade  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Grade P psi (a_WSigma psi0 A B)
 | GEq_Inj1 : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1 a1':tm),
     GEq P psi a1 a1' ->
     GEq P psi (a_Inj1 a1) (a_Inj1 a1')
 | GEq_Inj2 : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a2 a2':tm),
     GEq P psi a2 a2' ->
     GEq P psi (a_Inj2 a2) (a_Inj2 a2')
 | GEq_Case : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b1 b2 a' b1' b2':tm),
     GEq P psi a a' ->
     GEq P psi b1 b1' ->
     GEq P psi b2 b2' ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     GEq P psi (a_Case psi0 a b1 b2) (a_Case psi0 a' b1' b2')
 | GEq_TyUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     GEq P psi a_TyUnit a_TyUnit
 | GEq_TmUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     GEq P psi a_TmUnit a_TmUnit.

Inductive CDefEq : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CDefEq_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (phi phi0:grade) (a b:tm),
      ( phi0  <=  phi )  ->
     DefEq P phi a b ->
     CDefEq P phi phi0 a b
 | CDefEq_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (phi phi0:grade) (a b:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     lc_tm b ->
      not (  (  ( phi0  <=  phi )  )  )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CDefEq P phi phi0 a b
with DefEq : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | Eq_Refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     Grade P psi a ->
     DefEq P psi a a
 | Eq_Trans : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a c b:tm),
     DefEq P psi a b ->
     DefEq P psi b c ->
     DefEq P psi a c
 | Eq_Sym : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (b a:tm),
     DefEq P psi a b ->
     DefEq P psi b a
 | Eq_Beta : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
     Grade P psi a ->
     Step a b ->
     Grade P psi b ->
     DefEq P psi a b
 | Eq_Pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     DefEq P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> DefEq  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Pi psi0 A1 B1) (a_Pi psi0 A2 B2)
 | Eq_Abs : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 b1 A2 b2:tm),
     CDefEq P psi  q_Top  A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> DefEq  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Abs psi0 A1 b1) (a_Abs psi0 A2 b2)
 | Eq_App : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (b1:tm) (psi0:grade) (a1 b2 a2:tm),
     DefEq P psi b1 b2 ->
     CDefEq P psi psi0 a1 a2 ->
     DefEq P psi (a_App b1 psi0 a1) (a_App b2 psi0 a2)
 | Eq_PiFst : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A1 A2:tm) (psi0:grade) (B1 B2:tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_Pi psi0 A1 B1) (a_Pi psi0 A2 B2) ->
     DefEq P psi A1 A2
 | Eq_PiSnd : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (B1 a1 B2 a2:tm) (psi0:grade) (A1 A2:tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_Pi psi0 A1 B1) (a_Pi psi0 A2 B2) ->
     DefEq P psi a1 a2 ->
     DefEq P psi  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B1   a1 )   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B2   a2 )
 | Eq_WSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     DefEq P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> DefEq  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_WSigma psi0 A1 B1) (a_WSigma psi0 A2 B2)
 | Eq_WSigmaFst : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A1 A2:tm) (psi0:grade) (B1 B2:tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_WSigma psi0 A1 B1) (a_WSigma psi0 A2 B2) ->
     DefEq P psi A1 A2
 | Eq_WSigmaSnd : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (B1 a B2:tm) (psi0:grade) (A1 A2:tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_WSigma psi0 A1 B1) (a_WSigma psi0 A2 B2) ->
     Grade P psi a ->
     DefEq P psi  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B1   a )   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B2   a )
 | Eq_WPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1:tm) (psi0:grade) (b1 a2 b2:tm),
     CDefEq P psi psi0 a1 a2 ->
     DefEq P psi b1 b2 ->
     DefEq P psi (a_WPair a1 psi0 b1) (a_WPair a2 psi0 b2)
 | Eq_LetPair : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 b1 a2 b2:tm),
     DefEq P psi a1 a2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> DefEq   (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )   psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_LetPair psi0 a1 b1) (a_LetPair psi0 a2 b2)
 | Eq_SSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     DefEq P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> DefEq  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A1 B1) (a_SSigma psi0 A2 B2)
 | Eq_SSigmaFst : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A1 A2:tm) (psi0:grade) (B1 B2:tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A1 B1) (a_SSigma psi0 A2 B2) ->
     DefEq P psi A1 A2
 | Eq_SSigmaSnd : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (B1 a1 B2 a2:tm) (psi0:grade) (A1 A2:tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A1 B1) (a_SSigma psi0 A2 B2) ->
     DefEq P psi a1 a2 ->
     DefEq P psi  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B1   a1 )   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B2   a2 )
 | Eq_SPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1:tm) (psi0:grade) (b1 a2 b2:tm),
     CDefEq P psi psi0 a1 a2 ->
     DefEq P psi b1 b2 ->
     DefEq P psi (a_SPair a1 psi0 b1) (a_SPair a2 psi0 b2)
 | Eq_Proj1 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     DefEq P psi a1 a2 ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a1) (a_Proj1 psi0 a2)
 | Eq_Proj2 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     DefEq P psi a1 a2 ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a1) (a_Proj2 psi0 a2)
 | Eq_Sum : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A1 A2 A1' A2':tm),
     DefEq P psi A1 A1' ->
     DefEq P psi A2 A2' ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Sum A1 A2) (a_Sum A1' A2')
 | Eq_SumFst : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A1 A1' A2 A2':tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_Sum A1 A2) (a_Sum A1' A2') ->
     DefEq P psi A1 A1'
 | Eq_SumSnd : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A2 A2' A1 A1':tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_Sum A1 A2) (a_Sum A1' A2') ->
     DefEq P psi A2 A2'
 | Eq_Inj1 : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1 a1':tm),
     DefEq P psi a1 a1' ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Inj1 a1) (a_Inj1 a1')
 | Eq_Inj2 : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a2 a2':tm),
     DefEq P psi a2 a2' ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Inj2 a2) (a_Inj2 a2')
 | Eq_Case : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b1 b2 a' b1' b2':tm),
     DefEq P psi a a' ->
     DefEq P psi b1 b1' ->
     DefEq P psi b2 b2' ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Case psi0 a b1 b2) (a_Case psi0 a' b1' b2')
 | Eq_TyUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     DefEq P psi a_TyUnit a_TyUnit
 | Eq_TmUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     DefEq P psi a_TmUnit a_TmUnit
 | Eq_SubstIrrel : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (phi:grade) (b1 a1 b2 a2:tm) (psi:grade),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
      True  ->
      True  ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> DefEq  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  phi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
      not (  (  ( psi  <=  phi )  )  )  ->
     DefEq P phi  (open_tm_wrt_tm  b1   a1 )   (open_tm_wrt_tm  b2   a2 ) .

Inductive Typing : context -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | T_Type : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (s1 s2:sort),
      uniq  W  ->
      ( psi  <=   q_C  )  ->
      axiom  s1   s2  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Type s1) (a_Type s2)
 | T_Conv : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a B A:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi a A ->
     DefEq  (labels   (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )  )   q_C  A B ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  B (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi a B
 | T_Var : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (x:tmvar) (A:tm) (psi0:grade),
      uniq  W  ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      binds  x  ( psi0 ,  A )  W  ->
      ( psi  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Var_f x) A
 | T_Pi : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm) (s3 s1 s2:sort),
     Typing W psi A (a_Type s1) ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~( psi , A ))  ++ W )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  (a_Type s2) )  ->
      rule_pi  s1   s2   s3  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Pi psi0 A B) (a_Type s3)
 | T_Abs : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A b B:tm) (s:sort),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~(  (q_join  psi0   psi )  , A ))  ++ W )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C   ( (a_Pi psi0 A B) )  (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi (a_Abs psi0 A b) (a_Pi psi0 A B)
 | T_App : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (b:tm) (psi0:grade) (a B A:tm),
     Typing W psi b (a_Pi psi0 A B) ->
     Typing W  (q_join  psi0   psi )  a A ->
      ( psi0  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_App b psi0 a)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )
 | T_AppIrrel : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (b:tm) (psi0:grade) (a B A:tm),
     Typing W psi b (a_Pi psi0 A B) ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  a A ->
      (  q_C   <  psi0 )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_App b psi0 a)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )
 | T_WSigma : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm) (s3 s1 s2:sort),
     Typing W psi A (a_Type s1) ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~( psi , A ))  ++ W )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  (a_Type s2) )  ->
      rule_sig  s1   s2   s3  ->
     Typing W psi (a_WSigma psi0 A B) (a_Type s3)
 | T_WPair : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b A B:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C   ( (a_WSigma psi0 A B) )  (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W  (q_join  psi0   psi )  a A ->
     Typing W psi b  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )  ->
      ( psi0  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_WPair a psi0 b) (a_WSigma psi0 A B)
 | T_WPairIrrel : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b A B:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C   ( (a_WSigma psi0 A B) )  (a_Type s) ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  a A ->
      (  q_C   <  psi0 )  ->
     Typing W psi b  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_WPair a psi0 b) (a_WSigma psi0 A B)
| T_LetPair : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a c C B A:tm) (s:sort),
       ( forall x , x \notin  L  ->
               Typing ((x ~ (q_C, a_WSigma psi0 A B)) ++ meet_ctx_l q_C W) q_C (open_tm_wrt_tm C (a_Var_f x)) (a_Type s))  ->
       Typing W psi a (a_WSigma psi0 A B) ->
       ( forall x , x \notin  L  ->
         forall y,  y \notin L \u {{x}} ->
               Typing ((x ~ ((q_join psi0 psi), A)) ++ W) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm c (a_Var_f x))
                    (a_Pi q_Bot (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x))
                           (close_tm_wrt_tm y (open_tm_wrt_tm C (a_WPair (a_Var_f x) psi0 (a_Var_f y)))))) ->
       (Typing W psi (a_LetPair psi0 a c)  (open_tm_wrt_tm C a))
 | T_SSigma : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm) (s3 s1 s2:sort),
     Typing W psi A (a_Type s1) ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~( psi , A ))  ++ W )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  (a_Type s2) )  ->
      rule_sig  s1   s2   s3  ->
     Typing W psi (a_SSigma psi0 A B) (a_Type s3)
 | T_SPair : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b A B:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  (a_SSigma psi0 A B) (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W  (q_join  psi0   psi )  a A ->
     Typing W psi b  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )  ->
      ( psi0  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_SPair a psi0 b) (a_SSigma psi0 A B)
 | T_Proj1 : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a A B:tm),
     Typing W psi a (a_SSigma psi0 A B) ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a) A
 | T_Proj2 : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a B A:tm),
     Typing W psi a (a_SSigma psi0 A B) ->
      ( psi0  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   (a_Proj1 psi0 a) )
 | T_Sum : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (A B:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi A (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi B (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi (a_Sum A B) (a_Type s)
 | T_Inj1 : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a1 A1 A2:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi a1 A1 ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  (a_Sum A1 A2) (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi (a_Inj1 a1) (a_Sum A1 A2)
 | T_Inj2 : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a2 A1 A2:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi a2 A2 ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  (a_Sum A1 A2) (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi (a_Inj2 a2) (a_Sum A1 A2)
| T_Case : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a b1 b2 B:tm) (A1 A2 B1 B2:tm) s,
       ( forall z, z \notin    L ->  Typing  (  (  ( z ~(  q_C  , (a_Sum A1 A2) ))  ++  (  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )  )  )  )   q_C  (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f z)) (a_Type s)) ->
     Typing W psi a (a_Sum A1 A2) ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  ->   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )  =   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   (a_Inj1 (a_Var_f x)) )    )  ->
      ( forall y , y \notin  L  ->   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f y) )  =   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   (a_Inj2 (a_Var_f y)) )    )  ->
     Typing W psi b1 (a_Pi psi0 A1 B1) ->
     Typing W psi b2 (a_Pi psi0 A2 B2) ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Case psi0 a b1 b2)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )
 | T_TmUnit : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
      uniq  W  ->
      ( psi  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi a_TyUnit (a_Type s)
 | T_TyUnit : forall (W:context) (psi:grade),
      uniq  W  ->
      ( psi  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi a_TmUnit a_TyUnit.

Inductive CTyping : context -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CT_Leq : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a A:tm),
     Typing W psi a A ->
      ( psi  <=   q_C  )  ->
     CTyping W psi a A
 | CT_Top : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a A:tm),
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  a A ->
      (  q_C   <  psi )  ->
     CTyping W psi a A.

Inductive Ctx : context -> Prop :=
 | Ctx_Empty :
     Ctx  nil
 | Ctx_Cons : forall (W:context) (x:tmvar) (psi0:grade) (A:tm) (s:sort),
     Ctx W ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  A (a_Type s) ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  W )  ->
     Ctx  (  ( x ~( psi0 , A ))  ++ W ) .

Inductive ValueType : tm -> Prop :=
 | ValueType_Type : forall (s:sort),
     ValueType (a_Type s)
 | ValueType_Unit :
     ValueType a_TyUnit
 | ValueType_Pi : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_Pi psi A B) ->
     ValueType (a_Pi psi A B)
 | ValueType_WSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_WSigma psi A B) ->
     ValueType (a_WSigma psi A B)
 | ValueType_SSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_SSigma psi A B) ->
     ValueType (a_SSigma psi A B)
 | ValueType_Sum : forall (A B:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm B ->
     ValueType (a_Sum A B).

Inductive Consistent : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | Consistent_a_Type : forall (s:sort),
     Consistent (a_Type s) (a_Type s)
 | Consistent_a_Unit :
     Consistent a_TyUnit a_TyUnit
 | Consistent_a_Pi : forall (psi:grade) (A B A' B':tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_Pi psi A B) ->
     lc_tm A' ->
     lc_tm (a_Pi psi A' B') ->
     Consistent  ( (a_Pi psi A B) )   ( (a_Pi psi A' B') )
 | Consistent_a_WSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B A' B':tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_WSigma psi A B) ->
     lc_tm A' ->
     lc_tm (a_WSigma psi A' B') ->
     Consistent  ( (a_WSigma psi A B) )   ( (a_WSigma psi A' B') )
 | Consistent_a_SSigma : forall (psi:grade) (A B A' B':tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_SSigma psi A B) ->
     lc_tm A' ->
     lc_tm (a_SSigma psi A' B') ->
     Consistent  (a_SSigma psi A B)   (a_SSigma psi A' B')
 | Consistent_a_Sum : forall (A B A' B':tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm B ->
     lc_tm A' ->
     lc_tm B' ->
     Consistent  ( (a_Sum A B) )   ( (a_Sum A' B') )
 | Consistent_a_Step_R : forall (a b:tm),
     lc_tm b ->
      not ( ValueType a )  ->
     Consistent a b
 | Consistent_a_Step_L : forall (a b:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
      not ( ValueType b )  ->
     Consistent a b.

Inductive CPar : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CPar_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi a1 a2 ->
     CPar P psi psi0 a1 a2
 | CPar_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
      not (  (  ( psi0  <=  psi )  )  )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CPar P psi psi0 a1 a2
with Par : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | Par_Refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     Grade P psi a ->
     Par P psi a a
 | Par_Pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi1:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     Par P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Pi psi1 A1 B1) (a_Pi psi1 A2 B2)
 | Par_AppBeta : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b a' b' A:tm),
     Par P psi a  ( (a_Abs psi0 A a') )  ->
     CPar P psi psi0 b b' ->
     Par P psi (a_App a psi0 b)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  a'   b' )
 | Par_App : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b a' b':tm),
     Par P psi a a' ->
     CPar P psi psi0 b b' ->
     Par P psi (a_App a psi0 b) (a_App a' psi0 b')
 | Par_Abs : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 b1 A2 b2:tm),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     CPar P psi  q_Top  A1 A2 ->
     Par P psi (a_Abs psi0 A1 b1) (a_Abs psi0 A2 b2)
 | Par_WSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi1:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     Par P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Par P psi (a_WSigma psi1 A1 B1) (a_WSigma psi1 A2 B2)
 | Par_WPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1:tm) (psi0:grade) (b1 a2 b2:tm),
     CPar P psi psi0 a1 a2 ->
     Par P psi b1 b2 ->
     Par P psi (a_WPair a1 psi0 b1) (a_WPair a2 psi0 b2)
 | Par_WPairBeta : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 b1 b2 a1' a2':tm),
     Par P psi a1 (a_WPair a1' psi0 a2') ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   (open_tm_wrt_tm  b2   (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Par P psi (a_LetPair psi0 a1 b1) (a_App  (open_tm_wrt_tm  b2   a1' )   q_Bot  a2')
 | Par_LetPair : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 b1 a2 b2:tm),
     Par P psi a1 a2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Par P psi (a_LetPair psi0 a1 b1) (a_LetPair psi0 a2 b2)
 | Par_SSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi1:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     Par P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Par P psi (a_SSigma psi1 A1 B1) (a_SSigma psi1 A2 B2)
 | Par_SPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1:tm) (psi0:grade) (b1 a2 b2:tm),
     CPar P psi psi0 a1 a2 ->
     Par P psi b1 b2 ->
     Par P psi (a_SPair a1 psi0 b1) (a_SPair a2 psi0 b2)
 | Par_Proj1Beta : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a1' a2:tm),
     Par P psi a1 (a_SPair a1' psi0 a2) ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a1) a1'
 | Par_Proj1 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     Par P psi a1 a2 ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a1) (a_Proj1 psi0 a2)
 | Par_Proj2Beta : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2 a1':tm),
     Par P psi a1 (a_SPair a1' psi0 a2) ->
     Par P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a1) a2
 | Par_Proj2 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     Par P psi a1 a2 ->
     Par P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a1) (a_Proj2 psi0 a2)
 | Par_Sum : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A1 A2 A1' A2':tm),
     Par P psi A1 A1' ->
     Par P psi A2 A2' ->
     Par P psi (a_Sum A1 A2) (a_Sum A1' A2')
 | Par_Inj1 : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1 a1':tm),
     Par P psi a1 a1' ->
     Par P psi (a_Inj1 a1) (a_Inj1 a1')
 | Par_Inj2 : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a2 a2':tm),
     Par P psi a2 a2' ->
     Par P psi (a_Inj2 a2) (a_Inj2 a2')
 | Par_CaseBeta1 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b1 b2 b1' a' b2':tm),
     Par P psi a (a_Inj1 a') ->
     Par P psi b1 b1' ->
     Par P psi b2 b2' ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Case psi0 a b1 b2) (a_App b1' psi0 a')
 | Par_CaseBeta2 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b1 b2 b2' a' b1':tm),
     Par P psi a (a_Inj2 a') ->
     Par P psi a (a_Inj2 a') ->
     Par P psi b1 b1' ->
     Par P psi b2 b2' ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Case psi0 a b1 b2) (a_App b2' psi0 a')
 | Par_Case : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b1 b2 a' b1' b2':tm),
     Par P psi a a' ->
     Par P psi b1 b1' ->
     Par P psi b2 b2' ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi (a_Case psi0 a b1 b2) (a_Case psi0 a' b1' b2').

Inductive MultiPar : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | MP_Refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     Grade P psi a ->
     MultiPar P psi a a
 | MP_Step : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a a' b:tm),
     Par P psi a b ->
     MultiPar P psi b a' ->
     MultiPar P psi a a'.

Inductive Joins : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | join : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1 a2 b1 b2:tm),
     MultiPar P psi a1 b1 ->
     MultiPar P psi a2 b2 ->
     GEq P psi b1 b2 ->
     Joins P psi a1 a2.

Inductive Value : tm -> Prop :=
 | V_ValueType : forall (a:tm),
     ValueType a ->
     Value a
 | V_TmUnit :
     Value a_TmUnit
 | V_Abs : forall (psi:grade) (A a:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_Abs psi A a) ->
     Value (a_Abs psi A a)
 | V_WPair : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     lc_tm b ->
     Value (a_WPair a psi b)
 | V_SPair : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     lc_tm b ->
     Value (a_SPair a psi b)
 | V_Inj1 : forall (a:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     Value (a_Inj1 a)
 | V_Inj2 : forall (a:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     Value (a_Inj2 a).

Inductive CMultiPar : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CMP_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     MultiPar P psi a1 a2 ->
     CMultiPar P psi psi0 a1 a2
 | CMP_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
      not (  (  ( psi0  <=  psi )  )  )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CMultiPar P psi psi0 a1 a2.

Inductive CJoins : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CJ_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Joins P psi a1 a2 ->
     CJoins P psi psi0 a1 a2
 | CJ_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
      not (  (  ( psi0  <=  psi )  )  )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CJoins P psi psi0 a1 a2.
