Fixpoint close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (n1 : nat) (x1 : tmvar) (a1 : tm) {struct a1} : tm :=
  match a1 with
    | a_TyUnit => a_TyUnit
    | a_TmUnit => a_TmUnit
    | a_Pi psi1 A1 B1 => a_Pi psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 B1)
    | a_Abs psi1 A1 a2 => a_Abs psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 a2)
    | a_App a2 psi1 b1 => a_App (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1)
    | a_Type s => a_Type s
    | a_Var_f x2 => if (x1 == x2) then (a_Var_b n1) else (a_Var_f x2)
    | a_Var_b n2 => if (lt_ge_dec n2 n1) then (a_Var_b n2) else (a_Var_b (S n2))
    | a_Sum A1 A2 => a_Sum (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A2)
    | a_Inj1 a2 => a_Inj1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
    | a_Inj2 a2 => a_Inj2 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
    | a_Case psi a2 b1 b2 => a_Case psi (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b2)
    | a_WSigma psi1 A1 B1 => a_WSigma psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 B1)
    | a_WPair a2 psi1 b1 => a_WPair (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1)
    | a_LetPair psi1 a2 b1 => a_LetPair psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 b1)
    | a_SSigma psi1 A1 B1 => a_SSigma psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 A1) (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec (S n1) x1 B1)
    | a_SPair a2 psi1 b1 => a_SPair (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2) psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 b1)
    | a_Proj1 psi1 a2 => a_Proj1 psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
    | a_Proj2 psi1 a2 => a_Proj2 psi1 (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec n1 x1 a2)
  end.

Definition close_tm_wrt_tm x1 a1 := close_tm_wrt_tm_rec 0 x1 a1.

Inductive Step : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | S_AppCong : forall (a:tm) (psi:grade) (b a':tm),
     lc_tm b ->
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_App a psi b) (a_App a' psi b)
 | S_Beta : forall (psi:grade) (A a b:tm),
     lc_tm A ->
     lc_tm (a_Abs psi A a) ->
     lc_tm b ->
     Step (a_App  ( (a_Abs psi A a) )  psi b)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  a   b )
 | S_CaseCong : forall (psi:grade) (a b1 b2 a':tm),
     lc_tm b1 ->
     lc_tm b2 ->
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_Case psi a b1 b2) (a_Case psi a' b1 b2)
 | S_Case1Beta : forall (psi:grade) (a b1 b2:tm),
     lc_tm b2 ->
     lc_tm b1 ->
     lc_tm a ->
     Step (a_Case psi  ( (a_Inj1 a) )  b1 b2) (a_App b1 psi a)
 | S_Case2Beta : forall (psi:grade) (a b1 b2:tm),
     lc_tm b1 ->
     lc_tm b2 ->
     lc_tm a ->
     Step (a_Case psi  ( (a_Inj2 a) )  b1 b2) (a_App b2 psi a)
 | S_Proj1Cong : forall (psi:grade) (a a':tm),
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_Proj1 psi a) (a_Proj1 psi a')
 | S_Proj2Cong : forall (psi:grade) (a a':tm),
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_Proj2 psi a) (a_Proj2 psi a')
 | S_Proj1Beta : forall (psi:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a2 ->
     lc_tm a1 ->
     Step (a_Proj1 psi (a_SPair a1 psi a2)) a1
 | S_Proj2Beta : forall (psi:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
     Step (a_Proj2 psi (a_SPair a1 psi a2)) a2
 | S_LetPairCong : forall (psi:grade) (a b a':tm),
     lc_tm (a_LetPair psi a b) ->
     Step a a' ->
     Step (a_LetPair psi a b) (a_LetPair psi a' b)
 | S_LetPairBeta : forall (psi:grade) (a1 a2 b:tm),
     lc_tm (a_LetPair psi (a_WPair a1 psi a2) b) ->
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
     Step (a_LetPair psi (a_WPair a1 psi a2) b) (a_App  (open_tm_wrt_tm  b   a1 )   q_Bot  a2).

Inductive P_sub : econtext -> econtext -> Prop :=
 | P_Empty :
     P_sub  nil   nil
 | P_Cons : forall (P1:econtext) (x:tmvar) (psi1:grade) (P2:econtext) (psi2:grade),
      ( psi1  <=  psi2 )  ->
     P_sub P1 P2 ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  P1 )  ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  P2 )  ->
     P_sub  (  ( x ~ psi1 )  ++ P1 )   (  ( x ~ psi2 )  ++ P2 ) .

Inductive ctx_sub : context -> context -> Prop :=
 | CS_Empty :
     ctx_sub  nil   nil
 | CS_ConsTm : forall (W1:context) (x:tmvar) (psi1:grade) (A:tm) (W2:context) (psi2:grade),
      ( psi1  <=  psi2 )  ->
     ctx_sub W1 W2 ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  W1 )  ->
      ~ AtomSetImpl.In  x  (dom  W2 )  ->
      True  ->
     ctx_sub  (  ( x ~( psi1 , A ))  ++ W1 )   (  ( x ~( psi2 , A ))  ++ W2 ) .

Inductive CGrade : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CG_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (phi phi0:grade) (a:tm),
      ( phi0  <=  phi )  ->
     Grade P phi a ->
     CGrade P phi phi0 a
 | CG_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (phi phi0:grade) (a:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
      not (  (  ( phi0  <=  phi )  )  )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CGrade P phi phi0 a
with Grade : econtext -> grade -> tm -> Prop :=
 | G_Type : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
      uniq  P  ->
     Grade P psi (a_Type s)
 | G_Var : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (x:tmvar) (psi0:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      binds  x   psi0   P  ->
     Grade P psi (a_Var_f x)
 | G_Pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm),
     Grade P psi A ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Grade  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Grade P psi (a_Pi psi0 A B)
 | G_Abs : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A b:tm),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Grade  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     CGrade P psi  q_Top  A ->
     Grade P psi (a_Abs psi0 A b)
 | G_App : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (b:tm) (psi0:grade) (a:tm),
     Grade P psi b ->
     CGrade P psi psi0 a ->
     Grade P psi (a_App b psi0 a)
 | G_WSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm),
     Grade P psi A ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Grade  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Grade P psi (a_WSigma psi0 A B)
 | GEq_Inj1 : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1 a1':tm),
     GEq P psi a1 a1' ->
     GEq P psi (a_Inj1 a1) (a_Inj1 a1')
 | GEq_Inj2 : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a2 a2':tm),
     GEq P psi a2 a2' ->
     GEq P psi (a_Inj2 a2) (a_Inj2 a2')
 | GEq_Case : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b1 b2 a' b1' b2':tm),
     GEq P psi a a' ->
     GEq P psi b1 b1' ->
     GEq P psi b2 b2' ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     GEq P psi (a_Case psi0 a b1 b2) (a_Case psi0 a' b1' b2')
 | GEq_TyUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     GEq P psi a_TyUnit a_TyUnit
 | GEq_TmUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     GEq P psi a_TmUnit a_TmUnit.

Inductive CDefEq : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CDefEq_Leq : forall (P:econtext) (phi phi0:grade) (a b:tm),
      ( phi0  <=  phi )  ->
     DefEq P phi a b ->
     CDefEq P phi phi0 a b
 | CDefEq_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (phi phi0:grade) (a b:tm),
     lc_tm a ->
     lc_tm b ->
      not (  (  ( phi0  <=  phi )  )  )  ->
      uniq  P  ->
     CDefEq P phi phi0 a b
with DefEq : econtext -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | Eq_Refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm),
     Grade P psi a ->
     DefEq P psi a a
 | Eq_Trans : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a c b:tm),
     DefEq P psi a b ->
     DefEq P psi b c ->
     DefEq P psi a c
 | Eq_Sym : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (b a:tm),
     DefEq P psi a b ->
     DefEq P psi b a
 | Eq_Beta : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
     Grade P psi a ->
     Step a b ->
     Grade P psi b ->
     DefEq P psi a b
 | Eq_Pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     DefEq P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> DefEq  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Pi psi0 A1 B1) (a_Pi psi0 A2 B2)
 | Eq_Abs : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 b1 A2 b2:tm),
     CDefEq P psi  q_Top  A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> DefEq  (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Abs psi0 A1 b1) (a_Abs psi0 A2 b2)
 | Eq_App : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (b1:tm) (psi0:grade) (a1 b2 a2:tm),
     DefEq P psi b1 b2 ->
     CDefEq P psi psi0 a1 a2 ->
     DefEq P psi (a_App b1 psi0 a1) (a_App b2 psi0 a2)
 | Eq_PiFst : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A1 A2:tm) (psi0:grade) (B1 B2:tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_Pi psi0 A1 B1) (a_Pi psi0 A2 B2) ->
     DefEq P psi A1 A2
 | Eq_PiSnd : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (B1 a1 B2 a2:tm) (psi0:grade) (A1 A2:tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_Pi psi0 A1 B1) (a_Pi psi0 A2 B2) ->
     DefEq P psi a1 a2 ->
     DefEq P psi  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B1   a1 )   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B2   a2 )
 | Eq_WSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     DefEq P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> DefEq  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_WSigma psi0 A1 B1) (a_WSigma psi0 A2 B2)
 | Eq_WSigmaFst : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A1 A2:tm) (psi0:grade) (B1 B2:tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_WSigma psi0 A1 B1) (a_WSigma psi0 A2 B2) ->
     DefEq P psi A1 A2
 | Eq_WSigmaSnd : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (B1 a B2:tm) (psi0:grade) (A1 A2:tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_WSigma psi0 A1 B1) (a_WSigma psi0 A2 B2) ->
     Grade P psi a ->
     DefEq P psi  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B1   a )   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B2   a )
 | Eq_WPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1:tm) (psi0:grade) (b1 a2 b2:tm),
     CDefEq P psi psi0 a1 a2 ->
     DefEq P psi b1 b2 ->
     DefEq P psi (a_WPair a1 psi0 b1) (a_WPair a2 psi0 b2)
 | Eq_LetPair : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 b1 a2 b2:tm),
     DefEq P psi a1 a2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> DefEq   (  ( x ~ psi0 )  ++ P )   psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_LetPair psi0 a1 b1) (a_LetPair psi0 a2 b2)
 | Eq_SSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     DefEq P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> DefEq  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A1 B1) (a_SSigma psi0 A2 B2)
 | Eq_SSigmaFst : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A1 A2:tm) (psi0:grade) (B1 B2:tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A1 B1) (a_SSigma psi0 A2 B2) ->
     DefEq P psi A1 A2
 | Eq_SSigmaSnd : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (B1 a1 B2 a2:tm) (psi0:grade) (A1 A2:tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A1 B1) (a_SSigma psi0 A2 B2) ->
     DefEq P psi a1 a2 ->
     DefEq P psi  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B1   a1 )   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B2   a2 )
 | Eq_SPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1:tm) (psi0:grade) (b1 a2 b2:tm),
     CDefEq P psi psi0 a1 a2 ->
     DefEq P psi b1 b2 ->
     DefEq P psi (a_SPair a1 psi0 b1) (a_SPair a2 psi0 b2)
 | Eq_Proj1 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     DefEq P psi a1 a2 ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a1) (a_Proj1 psi0 a2)
 | Eq_Proj2 : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     DefEq P psi a1 a2 ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a1) (a_Proj2 psi0 a2)
 | Eq_Sum : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A1 A2 A1' A2':tm),
     DefEq P psi A1 A1' ->
     DefEq P psi A2 A2' ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Sum A1 A2) (a_Sum A1' A2')
 | Eq_SumFst : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A1 A1' A2 A2':tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_Sum A1 A2) (a_Sum A1' A2') ->
     DefEq P psi A1 A1'
 | Eq_SumSnd : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A2 A2' A1 A1':tm),
     DefEq P psi (a_Sum A1 A2) (a_Sum A1' A2') ->
     DefEq P psi A2 A2'
 | Eq_Inj1 : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a1 a1':tm),
     DefEq P psi a1 a1' ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Inj1 a1) (a_Inj1 a1')
 | Eq_Inj2 : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a2 a2':tm),
     DefEq P psi a2 a2' ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Inj2 a2) (a_Inj2 a2')
 | Eq_Case : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a b1 b2 a' b1' b2':tm),
     DefEq P psi a a' ->
     DefEq P psi b1 b1' ->
     DefEq P psi b2 b2' ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     DefEq P psi (a_Case psi0 a b1 b2) (a_Case psi0 a' b1' b2')
 | Eq_TyUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     DefEq P psi a_TyUnit a_TyUnit
 | Eq_TmUnit : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade),
      uniq  P  ->
     DefEq P psi a_TmUnit a_TmUnit
 | Eq_SubstIrrel : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (phi:grade) (b1 a1 b2 a2:tm) (psi:grade),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
      True  ->
      True  ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> DefEq  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  phi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
      not (  (  ( psi  <=  phi )  )  )  ->
     DefEq P phi  (open_tm_wrt_tm  b1   a1 )   (open_tm_wrt_tm  b2   a2 ) .

Inductive Typing : context -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | T_Type : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (s1 s2:sort),
      uniq  W  ->
      ( psi  <=   q_C  )  ->
      axiom  s1   s2  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Type s1) (a_Type s2)
 | T_Conv : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a B A:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi a A ->
     DefEq  (labels   (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )  )   q_C  A B ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  B (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi a B
 | T_Var : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (x:tmvar) (A:tm) (psi0:grade),
      uniq  W  ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
      binds  x  ( psi0 ,  A )  W  ->
      ( psi  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Var_f x) A
 | T_Pi : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm) (s3 s1 s2:sort),
     Typing W psi A (a_Type s1) ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~( psi , A ))  ++ W )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  (a_Type s2) )  ->
      rule_pi  s1   s2   s3  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Pi psi0 A B) (a_Type s3)
 | T_Abs : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A b B:tm) (s:sort),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~(  (q_join  psi0   psi )  , A ))  ++ W )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C   ( (a_Pi psi0 A B) )  (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi (a_Abs psi0 A b) (a_Pi psi0 A B)
 | T_App : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (b:tm) (psi0:grade) (a B A:tm),
     Typing W psi b (a_Pi psi0 A B) ->
     Typing W  (q_join  psi0   psi )  a A ->
      ( psi0  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_App b psi0 a)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )
 | T_AppIrrel : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (b:tm) (psi0:grade) (a B A:tm),
     Typing W psi b (a_Pi psi0 A B) ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  a A ->
      (  q_C   <  psi0 )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_App b psi0 a)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )
 | T_WSigma : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm) (s3 s1 s2:sort),
     Typing W psi A (a_Type s1) ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~( psi , A ))  ++ W )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  (a_Type s2) )  ->
      rule_sig  s1   s2   s3  ->
     Typing W psi (a_WSigma psi0 A B) (a_Type s3)
 | T_WPair : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b A B:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C   ( (a_WSigma psi0 A B) )  (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W  (q_join  psi0   psi )  a A ->
     Typing W psi b  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )  ->
      ( psi0  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_WPair a psi0 b) (a_WSigma psi0 A B)
 | T_WPairIrrel : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b A B:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C   ( (a_WSigma psi0 A B) )  (a_Type s) ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  a A ->
      (  q_C   <  psi0 )  ->
     Typing W psi b  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_WPair a psi0 b) (a_WSigma psi0 A B)
| T_LetPair : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a c C B A:tm) (s:sort),
       ( forall x , x \notin  L  ->
               Typing ((x ~ (q_C, a_WSigma psi0 A B)) ++ meet_ctx_l q_C W) q_C (open_tm_wrt_tm C (a_Var_f x)) (a_Type s))  ->
       Typing W psi a (a_WSigma psi0 A B) ->
       ( forall x , x \notin  L  ->
         forall y,  y \notin L \u {{x}} ->
               Typing ((x ~ ((q_join psi0 psi), A)) ++ W) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm c (a_Var_f x))
                    (a_Pi q_Bot (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x))
                           (close_tm_wrt_tm y (open_tm_wrt_tm C (a_WPair (a_Var_f x) psi0 (a_Var_f y)))))) ->
       (Typing W psi (a_LetPair psi0 a c)  (open_tm_wrt_tm C a))
 | T_SSigma : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (A B:tm) (s3 s1 s2:sort),
     Typing W psi A (a_Type s1) ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Typing  (  ( x ~( psi , A ))  ++ W )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x) )  (a_Type s2) )  ->
      rule_sig  s1   s2   s3  ->
     Typing W psi (a_SSigma psi0 A B) (a_Type s3)
 | T_SPair : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b A B:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  (a_SSigma psi0 A B) (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W  (q_join  psi0   psi )  a A ->
     Typing W psi b  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )  ->
      ( psi0  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_SPair a psi0 b) (a_SSigma psi0 A B)
 | T_Proj1 : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a A B:tm),
     Typing W psi a (a_SSigma psi0 A B) ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a) A
 | T_Proj2 : forall (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a B A:tm),
     Typing W psi a (a_SSigma psi0 A B) ->
      ( psi0  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   (a_Proj1 psi0 a) )
 | T_Sum : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (A B:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi A (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi B (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi (a_Sum A B) (a_Type s)
 | T_Inj1 : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a1 A1 A2:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi a1 A1 ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  (a_Sum A1 A2) (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi (a_Inj1 a1) (a_Sum A1 A2)
 | T_Inj2 : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a2 A1 A2:tm) (s:sort),
     Typing W psi a2 A2 ->
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  (a_Sum A1 A2) (a_Type s) ->
     Typing W psi (a_Inj2 a2) (a_Sum A1 A2)
| T_Case : forall (L:vars) (W:context) (psi psi0:grade) (a b1 b2 B:tm) (A1 A2 B1 B2:tm) s,
       ( forall z, z \notin    L ->  Typing  (  (  ( z ~(  q_C  , (a_Sum A1 A2) ))  ++  (  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )  )  )  )   q_C  (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f z)) (a_Type s)) ->
     Typing W psi a (a_Sum A1 A2) ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  ->   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )  =   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   (a_Inj1 (a_Var_f x)) )    )  ->
      ( forall y , y \notin  L  ->   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f y) )  =   (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   (a_Inj2 (a_Var_f y)) )    )  ->
     Typing W psi b1 (a_Pi psi0 A1 B1) ->
     Typing W psi b2 (a_Pi psi0 A2 B2) ->
      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Typing W psi (a_Case psi0 a b1 b2)  (open_tm_wrt_tm  B   a )
 | T_TmUnit : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (s:sort),
      uniq  W  ->
      ( psi  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi a_TyUnit (a_Type s)
 | T_TyUnit : forall (W:context) (psi:grade),
      uniq  W  ->
      ( psi  <=   q_C  )  ->
     Typing W psi a_TmUnit a_TyUnit.

Inductive CTyping : context -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | CT_Leq : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a A:tm),
     Typing W psi a A ->
      ( psi  <=   q_C  )  ->
     CTyping W psi a A
 | CT_Top : forall (W:context) (psi:grade) (a A:tm),
     Typing  (meet_ctx_l   q_C    W )   q_C  a A ->
      (  q_C   <  psi )  ->
     CTyping W psi a A.

Inductive Ctx : context -> Prop :=
 | Ctx_Empty :
     Ctx  nil
 | Ctx_Cons : forall (W:context) (x:tmvar) (psi0:grade) (A:tm) (s:sort),
     Ctx W ->

(* ---------- value-type tags and opening head stability ---------- *)
(* Same-head (value-type tag) relation, and stability of the head of [open]. *)
Inductive VtTag : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | VtTag_Type : forall s, VtTag (a_Type s) (a_Type s)
 | VtTag_Unit : VtTag a_TyUnit a_TyUnit

Lemma VtTag_VT : forall a b, VtTag a b -> lc_tm a -> lc_tm b -> ValueType a /\ ValueType b.
Proof.
  intros a b H; induction H; intros Ha Hb; split.
  - apply ValueType_Type. - apply ValueType_Type.
  - apply ValueType_Unit. - apply ValueType_Unit.
  - apply ValueType_Pi. * inversion Ha; assumption. * assumption.
  - apply ValueType_Pi. * inversion Hb; assumption. * assumption.
  - apply ValueType_WSigma. * inversion Ha; assumption. * assumption.
  - apply ValueType_WSigma. * inversion Hb; assumption. * assumption.
  - apply ValueType_SSigma. * inversion Ha; assumption. * assumption.
  - apply ValueType_SSigma. * inversion Hb; assumption. * assumption.
  - apply ValueType_Sum. * inversion Ha; assumption. * inversion Ha; assumption.
  - apply ValueType_Sum. * inversion Hb; assumption. * inversion Hb; assumption.

Lemma VtTag_trans : forall a b c, VtTag a b -> VtTag b c -> VtTag a c.

  intros a b c H1 H2. revert c H2. induction H1; intros c' H2; inversion H2; subst; econstructor.

Lemma open_head_stable : forall B a1 a2,

        Deep P phi A1 A2 /\ (forall x, Deep ((x~phi)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x)))) ->

Proof.

  - exact HT.

  Joins P phi a b -> lc_tm a -> lc_tm b -> Consistent a b.
Proof.
  intros P phi a b H Ha Hb. destruct H as [P0 psi a1 a2 b1 b2 Mp1 Mp2 Ge].
  apply Consistent_total; [exact Ha | exact Hb |].
  intros VTa VTb.
  pose proof (MultiPar_VT P0 psi a1 b1 Mp1 VTa) as H1.
  pose proof (MultiPar_VT P0 psi a2 b2 Mp2 VTb) as H2.
  pose proof (GEq_VtTag_form P0 psi b1 b2 Ge a1 H1) as H3.
  apply VtTag_trans with b2; [exact H3 | apply VtTag_sym; exact H2].
Qed.

Arguments Joins_Consistent P phi a b _ _ _.

Lemma Grade_GEq_refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm), Grade P psi a -> GEq P psi a a.
Proof.
  intros P psi a H. induction H using Grade_mind
    with (P0 := fun (P:econtext) (psi phi0:grade) (a:tm) (_:CGrade P psi phi0 a) => CEq P psi phi0 a a).
  all: try (apply CEq_Nleq; assumption).
  all: try (econstructor; eauto).
  all: assumption.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_VT : forall (P:econtext) (phi:grade) (a b:tm),
  MultiPar P phi a b -> ValueType a -> VtTag a b.

Lemma GEq_VtTag_form : forall (P:econtext) (phi:grade) (a b:tm),

  intros P phi a b H. induction H; intros t HT;
    try solve [exfalso; inversion HT];
    try solve [inversion HT; econstructor];
    assumption.

Proof.

  pose proof (GEq_VtTag_form P0 psi b1 b2 Ge a1 H1) as H3.
  apply VtTag_trans with b2; [exact H3 | apply VtTag_sym; exact H2].

  all: try (apply CEq_Nleq; assumption).
  all: try (econstructor; eauto).
  all: assumption.
Qed.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Open Scope grade_scope.

Definition hasV (a:tm) : Prop := exists v, Value v /\ Steps a v.

Inductive R (P:econtext) (phi:grade) : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
| R_intro : forall (a b:tm),
    DefEq P phi a b ->
    Grade P phi a ->
    Grade P phi b ->
    lc_tm a ->
    lc_tm b ->
    (hasV a <-> hasV b) ->
    (forall (v w:tm), Value v -> Steps a v -> Value w -> Steps b w -> VM P phi v w) ->
    R P phi a b
with VM (P:econtext) (phi:grade) : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
| VM_Type : forall (s:sort), VM P phi (a_Type s) (a_Type s)
| VM_Unit : VM P phi a_TyUnit a_TyUnit
| VM_Pi : forall (psi0:grade) (A B A' B':tm),
    R P phi A A' ->
    (forall x:atom, R ((x~phi)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x))
                                         (open_tm_wrt_tm B' (a_Var_f x))) ->
    VM P phi (a_Pi psi0 A B) (a_Pi psi0 A' B')
| VM_WSigma : forall (psi0:grade) (A B A' B':tm),
    R P phi A A' ->
    (forall x:atom, R ((x~phi)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x))
                                         (open_tm_wrt_tm B' (a_Var_f x))) ->
    VM P phi (a_WSigma psi0 A B) (a_WSigma psi0 A' B')
| VM_SSigma : forall (psi0:grade) (A B A' B':tm),
    R P phi A A' ->
    (forall x:atom, R ((x~phi)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x))
                                         (open_tm_wrt_tm B' (a_Var_f x))) ->
    VM P phi (a_SSigma psi0 A B) (a_SSigma psi0 A' B')
| VM_Sum : forall (A B A' B':tm),
    R P phi A A' -> R P phi B B' ->
    VM P phi (a_Sum A B) (a_Sum A' B')
| VM_Abs : forall (psi0:grade) (A b A' b':tm),
    (forall x:atom, R ((x~psi0)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x))
                                          (open_tm_wrt_tm b' (a_Var_f x))) ->
    VM P phi (a_Abs psi0 A b) (a_Abs psi0 A' b')
| VM_WPair : forall (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b a' b':tm),
    (psi0 <= phi -> R P phi a a') ->
    R P phi b b' ->
    VM P phi (a_WPair a psi0 b) (a_WPair a' psi0 b')
| VM_SPair : forall (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b a' b':tm),
    (psi0 <= phi -> R P phi a a') ->
    R P phi b b' ->
    VM P phi (a_SPair a psi0 b) (a_SPair a' psi0 b')
| VM_Inj1 : forall a a', R P phi a a' -> VM P phi (a_Inj1 a) (a_Inj1 a')
| VM_Inj2 : forall a a', R P phi a a' -> VM P phi (a_Inj2 a) (a_Inj2 a')
| VM_refl : forall v, Value v -> Grade P phi v -> VM P phi v v.

Scheme R_mut_ind := Induction for R Sort Prop
with VM_mut_ind := Induction for VM Sort Prop.

Lemma R_deq : forall P phi a b, R P phi a b -> DefEq P phi a b.
Proof. intros P phi a b H; destruct H as [a b De Ga Gb lca lcb hv vm]; exact De. Qed.
Lemma R_grade_left : forall P phi a b, R P phi a b -> Grade P phi a.
Proof. intros P phi a b H; destruct H as [a b De Ga Gb lca lcb hv vm]; exact Ga. Qed.
Lemma R_grade_right : forall P phi a b, R P phi a b -> Grade P phi b.
Proof. intros P phi a b H; destruct H as [a b De Ga Gb lca lcb hv vm]; exact Gb. Qed.
Lemma R_lc_left : forall P phi a b, R P phi a b -> lc_tm a.
Proof. intros P phi a b H; destruct H as [a b De Ga Gb lca lcb hv vm]; exact lca. Qed.
Lemma R_lc_right : forall P phi a b, R P phi a b -> lc_tm b.
Proof. intros P phi a b H; destruct H as [a b De Ga Gb lca lcb hv vm]; exact lcb. Qed.
Lemma R_hasV : forall P phi a b, R P phi a b -> (hasV a <-> hasV b).
Proof. intros P phi a b H; destruct H as [a b De Ga Gb lca lcb hv vm]; exact hv. Qed.
Lemma R_vm : forall P phi a b, R P phi a b ->
  forall v w, Value v -> Steps a v -> Value w -> Steps b w -> VM P phi v w.
Proof. intros P phi a b H; destruct H as [a b De Ga Gb lca lcb hv vm]; exact vm. Qed.

Lemma R_intro_trans : forall P phi a b c,
  DefEq P phi a b ->
  Grade P phi a ->
  lc_tm a ->
  (hasV a <-> hasV b) ->
  (forall v w, Value v -> Steps a v -> Value w -> Steps b w -> VM P phi v w) ->
  R P phi b c ->
  (forall v w, Value v -> Steps a v -> Value w -> Steps b w ->
     forall u, VM P phi w u -> VM P phi v u) ->
  R P phi a c.
Proof.
  intros P phi a b c Dab Ga lca hv vm1 Hbc IH.
  apply R_intro.
  - eapply Eq_Trans; [exact Dab | exact (@R_deq P phi b c Hbc)].
  - exact Ga.
  - exact (R_grade_right Hbc).
  - exact lca.
  - exact (R_lc_right Hbc).
  - exact (iff_trans hv (R_hasV Hbc)).
  - intros x y Vx Sax Vy Scy.
    assert (Hax : hasV a) by (exists x; split; assumption).
    destruct ((proj1 hv) Hax) as [z [Vz Sbz]].
    exact (IH x z Vx Sax Vz Sbz y (@R_vm P phi b c Hbc z y Vz Sbz Vy Scy)).
Qed.

Lemma R_trans : forall P phi a b, R P phi a b -> forall c, R P phi b c -> R P phi a c.
Proof.
  - intros VTv VTw; inversion VTv.
  - intros VTv VTw; inversion VTv.
  - intros VTv VTw; inversion VTv.
  - intros VTv VTw; inversion VTv.
  - intros VTv VTw; apply VtTag_refl; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma R_Consistent_VT : forall P phi a b,
  R P phi a b -> ValueType a -> ValueType b -> Consistent a b.
Proof.
  intros P phi a b H VTa VTb.
  assert (Hvm : VM P phi a b) by
    exact (@R_vm P phi a b H a b (@V_ValueType a VTa) (Steps_refl a)

  assert (Htag : VtTag a b) by exact (@VM_VtTag P phi a b Hvm VTa VTb).
  eapply Consistent_of_VtTag.
  - exact Htag.
  - apply ValueType_lc; exact VTa.
  - apply ValueType_lc; exact VTb.
Qed.

Lemma R_of_step : forall P phi a b,

Proof.

      * assert (E : v = b) by exact (@Steps_value v b Vv Svb).
        subst v. exists b; split; assumption.
    + intros [w [Vw Sbw]].

  - intros v w Vv Sav Vw Sbw.

      subst w. exact (@VM_refl P phi b Vv Gb).
Qed.

Lemma R_Consistent_VT : forall P phi a b,
  R P phi a b -> ValueType a -> ValueType b -> Consistent a b.
Proof.
  intros P phi a b H VTa VTb.
  assert (Hvm : VM P phi a b) by
    exact (@R_vm P phi a b H a b (@V_ValueType a VTa) (Steps_refl a)
             (@V_ValueType b VTb) (Steps_refl b)).
  assert (Htag : VtTag a b) by exact (@VM_VtTag P phi a b Hvm VTa VTb).
  eapply Consistent_of_VtTag.
  - exact Htag.
  - apply ValueType_lc; exact VTa.
  - apply ValueType_lc; exact VTb.
Qed.

Lemma R_of_step : forall P phi a b,
  Grade P phi a -> Step a b -> R P phi a b.
Proof.
  intros P phi a b Ga Sab.
  assert (Gb : Grade P phi b) by exact (@Step_Grade P phi a b Sab Ga).
  apply R_intro.
  - eapply Eq_Beta; [exact Ga | exact Sab | exact Gb].
  - exact Ga.
  - exact Gb.
  - apply (@Grade_lc P phi a Ga).
  - apply (@Grade_lc P phi b Gb).
  - split.
    + intros [v [Vv Sav]].
      destruct (@Steps_join a b (@Steps_step a b b Sab (Steps_refl b)) v Sav)
        as [Sbv | Svb].
      * exists v; split; assumption.
      * assert (E : v = b) by exact (@Steps_value v b Vv Svb).
        subst v. exists b; split; assumption.
    + intros [w [Vw Sbw]].
      exists w; split; [exact Vw | eapply @Steps_step; eassumption].
  - intros v w Vv Sav Vw Sbw.
    destruct (@Steps_join a b (@Steps_step a b b Sab (Steps_refl b)) v Sav)

    + pose proof (@Steps_value_unique b v Sbv Vv w Sbw Vw) as E.
      subst w. exact (@VM_refl P phi v Vv (@Steps_Grade P phi b v Sbv Gb)).
    + pose proof (@Steps_value v b Vv Svb) as E.

(* ---------- Grade/Par/LN layer for DefEq -> Joins ---------- *)

(* ---------- Grade/ CGrade yield reflexive GEq/CEq ---------- *)
Lemma Grade_GEq_refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm), Grade P psi a -> GEq P psi a a.
Proof.
  intros P psi a H. induction H using Grade_mind
    with (P0 := fun (P:econtext) (psi phi0:grade) (a:tm) (_:CGrade P psi phi0 a) => CEq P psi phi0 a a).
  all: try (apply CEq_Nleq; assumption).
  all: try (econstructor; eauto).
  all: assumption.
Qed.
Arguments Grade_GEq_refl : clear implicits.
Arguments Grade_GEq_refl P psi a _.

Lemma CGrade_CEq_refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi phi0:grade) (a:tm), CGrade P psi phi0 a -> CEq P psi phi0 a a.
Proof.
  intros P psi phi0 a H. induction H.
  - apply CEq_Leq; [assumption | apply Grade_GEq_refl; assumption].
  - apply CEq_Nleq; assumption.
Qed.
Arguments CGrade_CEq_refl : clear implicits.
Arguments CGrade_CEq_refl P psi phi0 a _.

Lemma Grade_CPar_refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi phi0:grade) (a:tm), CGrade P psi phi0 a -> CPar P psi phi0 a a.
Proof.
  intros P psi phi0 a H. induction H.
  - apply CPar_Leq; [assumption | apply Par_Refl; assumption].
  - apply CPar_Nleq; assumption.
Qed.
Arguments Grade_CPar_refl : clear implicits.
Arguments Grade_CPar_refl P psi phi0 a _.

(* ---------- Grade inversions (syntactic shape of graded terms) ---------- *)
Lemma Grade_App_inv : forall P psi b psi0 a, Grade P psi (a_App b psi0 a) -> Grade P psi b /\ CGrade P psi psi0 a.
Proof. intros. inversion H. auto. Qed.
Lemma Grade_SPair_inv : forall P psi a psi0 b, Grade P psi (a_SPair a psi0 b) -> CGrade P psi psi0 a /\ Grade P psi b.
Proof. intros. inversion H. auto. Qed.
Lemma Grade_WPair_inv : forall P psi a psi0 b, Grade P psi (a_WPair a psi0 b) -> CGrade P psi psi0 a /\ Grade P psi b.
Proof. intros. inversion H. auto. Qed.
Lemma Grade_Proj1_inv : forall P psi psi0 a, Grade P psi (a_Proj1 psi0 a) -> Grade P psi a /\ psi0 <= psi.
Proof. intros. inversion H. auto. Qed.
Lemma Grade_Proj2_inv : forall P psi psi0 a, Grade P psi (a_Proj2 psi0 a) -> Grade P psi a.
Proof. intros. inversion H. auto. Qed.
Lemma Grade_Inj1_inv : forall P psi a, Grade P psi (a_Inj1 a) -> Grade P psi a.
Proof. intros. inversion H. auto. Qed.
Lemma Grade_Inj2_inv : forall P psi a, Grade P psi (a_Inj2 a) -> Grade P psi a.
Proof. intros. inversion H. auto. Qed.
Lemma Grade_Case_inv : forall P psi psi0 a b1 b2, Grade P psi (a_Case psi0 a b1 b2) -> Grade P psi a /\ Grade P psi b1 /\ Grade P psi b2 /\ psi0 <= psi.
Proof. intros. inversion H. repeat split; auto. Qed.
Lemma Grade_LetPair_inv : forall P psi psi0 a b,
  Grade P psi (a_LetPair psi0 a b) ->
  Grade P psi a /\ (exists L, forall x, x `notin` L -> Grade ((x~psi0)++P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x))).
Proof. intros. inversion H. split; [assumption| eexists; eauto]. Qed.

(* ---------- a single Step is simulated by Par ---------- *)
Lemma Par_of_Step : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
  Grade P psi a -> Step a b -> Grade P psi b -> Par P psi a b.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b Ga S Gb. revert Gb. induction S; intros Gb.
  - (* AppCong *) destruct (Grade_App_inv Ga) as [Gf CGfb]; destruct (Grade_App_inv Gb) as [Gf' _].
    eapply Par_App.
    + apply IHS; assumption.
    + apply Grade_CPar_refl; assumption.
  - (* Beta *) destruct (Grade_App_inv Ga) as [Gabs CGarg].
    eapply Par_AppBeta.
    + eapply Par_Refl; assumption.
    + apply Grade_CPar_refl; assumption.
  - (* CaseCong *) destruct (Grade_Case_inv Ga) as [Ga0 [Gb1 [Gb2 Hle]]].
    destruct (Grade_Case_inv Gb) as [Ga' _].
    eapply Par_Case.
    + apply IHS; assumption.
    + eapply Par_Refl; assumption.
    + eapply Par_Refl; assumption.
    + assumption.
  - (* Case1Beta *) destruct (Grade_Case_inv Ga) as [Ginj [Gb1 [Gb2 Hle]]].
    pose proof (Grade_Inj1_inv Ginj) as Gx.
    eapply Par_CaseBeta1.
    + eapply Par_Inj1. eapply Par_Refl; assumption.
    + eapply Par_Refl; assumption.
    + eapply Par_Refl; assumption.
    + assumption.
  - (* Case2Beta *) destruct (Grade_Case_inv Ga) as [Ginj [Gb1 [Gb2 Hle]]].
    pose proof (Grade_Inj2_inv Ginj) as Gx.
    eapply Par_CaseBeta2.
    + eapply Par_Inj2. eapply Par_Refl; assumption.
    + eapply Par_Refl; assumption.
    + eapply Par_Refl; assumption.
    + assumption.
  - (* Proj1Cong *) destruct (Grade_Proj1_inv Ga) as [Ga0 Hle].
    destruct (Grade_Proj1_inv Gb) as [Ga' _].
    eapply Par_Proj1; [apply IHS; assumption | assumption].
  - (* Proj2Cong *) pose proof (Grade_Proj2_inv Ga) as Ga0.
    pose proof (Grade_Proj2_inv Gb) as Ga'.
    eapply Par_Proj2; apply IHS; assumption.
  - (* Proj1Beta *) destruct (Grade_Proj1_inv Ga) as [Gsp Hle].
    destruct (Grade_SPair_inv Gsp) as [CGa1 Ga2].
    eapply Par_Proj1Beta.
    + eapply Par_SPair; [apply Grade_CPar_refl; assumption | eapply Par_Refl; assumption].
    + assumption.
  - (* Proj2Beta *) pose proof (Grade_Proj2_inv Ga) as Gsp.
    destruct (Grade_SPair_inv Gsp) as [CGa1 Ga2].
    eapply Par_Proj2Beta.
    + eapply Par_SPair; [apply Grade_CPar_refl; assumption | eapply Par_Refl; assumption].
  - (* LetPairCong *) destruct (Grade_LetPair_inv Ga) as [Ga0 [L HG]].
    destruct (Grade_LetPair_inv Gb) as [Ga' _].
    eapply Par_LetPair with (L := L).
    + apply IHS; assumption.
    + intros x Hx. eapply Par_Refl. apply HG; assumption.
  - (* LetPairBeta *) destruct (Grade_LetPair_inv Ga) as [Gwp [L HG]].
    destruct (Grade_WPair_inv Gwp) as [CGa1 Ga2].
    eapply Par_WPairBeta with (L := L).
    + eapply Par_WPair; [apply Grade_CPar_refl; assumption | eapply Par_Refl; assumption].
    + intros x Hx. eapply Par_Refl. apply HG; assumption.
Qed.

(* ---------- GEq/CEq symmetry ---------- *)

(* ---------- symmetry of GEq / CEq ---------- *)
Scheme GEq_mind := Induction for GEq Sort Prop
  with CEq_mind := Induction for CEq Sort Prop.

Lemma GEq_sym : forall (P:econtext) (phi:grade) (a b:tm), GEq P phi a b -> GEq P phi b a.
Proof.
  intros P phi a b H. induction H using GEq_mind
    with (P0 := fun (P:econtext) (psi phi0:grade) (a b:tm) (_:CEq P psi phi0 a b) => CEq P psi phi0 b a).
  all: try (apply CEq_Nleq; assumption).
  all: try (econstructor; eauto).
  all: assumption.
Qed.
Arguments GEq_sym : clear implicits.
Arguments GEq_sym P phi a b _.

Lemma CEq_sym : forall (P:econtext) (phi phi0:grade) (a b:tm), CEq P phi phi0 a b -> CEq P phi phi0 b a.
Proof.
  intros P phi phi0 a b H. induction H.
  - apply CEq_Leq; [assumption | apply GEq_sym; assumption].
  - apply CEq_Nleq; assumption.
Qed.
Arguments CEq_sym : clear implicits.
Arguments CEq_sym P phi phi0 a b _.

(* ---------- DefEq implies a unique context ---------- *)

(* ---------- DefEq endpoints live in unique contexts ---------- *)
Lemma DefEq_uniq : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm), DefEq P psi a b -> uniq P.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H using DefEq_mind
    with (P0 := fun (P:econtext) (psi phi0:grade) (a b:tm) (_:CDefEq P psi phi0 a b) => uniq P).
  all: try solve [match goal with Hg : Grade ?P' ?ps ?a' |- uniq ?P' => exact (Grade_uniq P' ps a' Hg) end].
  all: try assumption.
  - (* SubstIrrel *) destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x Hx].
    exact (@uniq_app_2 _ (x ~ psi) P (H x Hx)).
Qed.
Arguments DefEq_uniq : clear implicits.
Arguments DefEq_uniq P psi a b _.

(* ---------- basic Joins facts ---------- *)

(* ---------- basic Joins facts ---------- *)
Lemma Joins_refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm), Grade P psi a -> Joins P psi a a.
Proof.
  intros P psi a G. eapply join with (b1 := a) (b2 := a).
  - apply MP_Refl; assumption.
  - apply MP_Refl; assumption.
  - apply Grade_GEq_refl; assumption.
Qed.
Arguments Joins_refl : clear implicits.
Arguments Joins_refl P psi a _.

Lemma Joins_sym : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm), Joins P psi a b -> Joins P psi b a.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. destruct H as [P0 ps a1 a2 b1 b2 M1 M2 G].
  eapply join with (b1 := b2) (b2 := b1).
  - exact M2. - exact M1. - apply GEq_sym; exact G.
Qed.
Arguments Joins_sym : clear implicits.
Arguments Joins_sym P psi a b _.

Lemma Joins_beta : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
  Grade P psi a -> Step a b -> Grade P psi b -> Joins P psi a b.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b Ga S Gb. eapply join with (b1 := b) (b2 := b).
  - apply MP_Step with (b := b); [apply Par_of_Step; assumption | apply MP_Refl; assumption].
  - apply MP_Refl; assumption.
  - apply Grade_GEq_refl; assumption.
Qed.
Arguments Joins_beta : clear implicits.
Arguments Joins_beta P psi a b _ _ _.


(* ---------- Grade inversions for compound types ---------- *)
Lemma Grade_Pi_inv : forall P psi psi0 A B, Grade P psi (a_Pi psi0 A B) -> Grade P psi A.
Proof. intros. inversion H. assumption. Qed.
Lemma Grade_WSigma_inv : forall P psi psi0 A B, Grade P psi (a_WSigma psi0 A B) -> Grade P psi A.

Lemma Par_rename : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
  Par P psi a b ->
  forall xr yr, xr <> yr -> xr \notin dom P -> yr \notin dom P ->

    with (P0 := fun (P:econtext) (psi phi0:grade) (a b:tm) (_:CPar P psi phi0 a b) =>
                 forall xr yr, xr <> yr -> xr \notin dom P -> yr \notin dom P ->

    + apply IHPar; assumption.

      assert (Hyd : yr \notin dom ((z,psi)::P)) by (apply (@notin_dom_cons grade z psi P yr); [symmetry; exact Hzy | exact Hy]).
      specialize (H0 z HzL xr yr Hne Hxd Hyd).
      unfold rename_tm in H0.
      rewrite (@subst_open_comm0 B1 xr (a_Var_f yr) z (lc_a_Var_f yr) Hzx) in H0.

    eapply Par_AppBeta with (a' := rename_tm xr yr a') (b' := rename_tm xr yr b').

Lemma Par_rename : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
  Par P psi a b ->
  forall xr yr, xr <> yr -> xr \notin dom P -> yr \notin dom P ->
    Par P psi (rename_tm xr yr a) (rename_tm xr yr b).
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H using Par_mind
    with (P0 := fun (P:econtext) (psi phi0:grade) (a b:tm) (_:CPar P psi phi0 a b) =>
                 forall xr yr, xr <> yr -> xr \notin dom P -> yr \notin dom P ->
                   CPar P psi phi0 (rename_tm xr yr a) (rename_tm xr yr b)).
  all: intros xr yr Hne Hx Hy; unfold rename_tm; simpl.
  - (* Refl *) apply Par_Refl. apply Grade_rename with (xr:=xr) (yr:=yr); assumption.
  - (* Pi *) eapply (@Par_Pi (L \u ({{xr}} \u {{yr}})) P psi psi1
                            (rename_tm xr yr A1) (rename_tm xr yr B1)
                            (rename_tm xr yr A2) (rename_tm xr yr B2)).
    + apply IHPar; assumption.
    + intros z Hz.
      assert (HzL : z \notin L) by (apply (@notin_union_l L ({{xr}} \u {{yr}}) z); exact Hz).
      assert (Hzr : z \notin ({{xr}} \u {{yr}})) by (apply (@notin_union_r L ({{xr}} \u {{yr}}) z); exact Hz).
      assert (Hzx : z <> xr) by (intro E; apply Hzr; apply AtomSetImpl.union_2; subst; apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2; reflexivity).
      assert (Hzy : z <> yr) by (intro E; apply Hzr; apply AtomSetImpl.union_3; subst; apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2; reflexivity).
      assert (Hxd : xr \notin dom ((z,psi)::P)) by (apply (@notin_dom_cons grade z psi P xr); [symmetry; exact Hzx | exact Hx]).
      assert (Hyd : yr \notin dom ((z,psi)::P)) by (apply (@notin_dom_cons grade z psi P yr); [symmetry; exact Hzy | exact Hy]).
      specialize (H0 z HzL xr yr Hne Hxd Hyd).
      unfold rename_tm in H0.
      rewrite (@subst_open_comm0 B1 xr (a_Var_f yr) z (lc_a_Var_f yr) Hzx) in H0.
      rewrite (@subst_open_comm0 B2 xr (a_Var_f yr) z (lc_a_Var_f yr) Hzx) in H0.
      exact H0.
  - (* AppBeta *)
    specialize (IHPar xr yr Hne Hx Hy).
    specialize (IHPar0 xr yr Hne Hx Hy).
    rewrite (@subst_open_term a' b' xr yr Hne).
    eapply Par_AppBeta with (a' := rename_tm xr yr a') (b' := rename_tm xr yr b').
    + unfold rename_tm in IHPar. simpl in IHPar. exact IHPar.
Lemma MultiPar_rename : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
  MultiPar P psi a b ->
  forall xr yr, xr <> yr -> xr \notin dom P -> yr \notin dom P ->
    MultiPar P psi (rename_tm xr yr a) (rename_tm xr yr b).
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H as [P psi a Ha | P psi a a' b Hpar Hmp IH];
    intros xr yr Hne Hx Hy.
  - apply MP_Refl. apply Grade_rename with (xr:=xr) (yr:=yr); assumption.
  - eapply MP_Step with (b := rename_tm xr yr b).
    + apply Par_rename with (xr:=xr) (yr:=yr); assumption.
    + apply IH; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma Steps_Grade : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
  Steps a b -> Grade P psi a -> Grade P psi b.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H as [a | a x b Hs Hrest IH]; intros Ha.
  - exact Ha.
  - apply IH. apply (Step_Grade Hs Ha).
Qed.





Set Implicit Arguments.
Open Scope grade_scope.

Definition hasV (a:tm) : Prop := exists v, Value v /\ Steps a v.

Inductive R (P:econtext) (phi:grade) : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
| R_intro : forall (a b:tm),
    DefEq P phi a b ->
    Grade P phi a ->
    Grade P phi b ->
    lc_tm a ->
    lc_tm b ->
    (hasV a <-> hasV b) ->
    (forall (v w:tm), Value v -> Steps a v -> Value w -> Steps b w -> VM P phi v w) ->
    R P phi a b
with VM (P:econtext) (phi:grade) : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
| VM_Type : forall (s:sort), VM P phi (a_Type s) (a_Type s)
| VM_Unit : VM P phi a_TyUnit a_TyUnit
| VM_Pi : forall (psi0:grade) (A B A' B':tm),
    R P phi A A' ->
    (forall x:atom, R ((x~phi)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x))
                                         (open_tm_wrt_tm B' (a_Var_f x))) ->
    VM P phi (a_Pi psi0 A B) (a_Pi psi0 A' B')
| VM_WSigma : forall (psi0:grade) (A B A' B':tm),
    R P phi A A' ->
    (forall x:atom, R ((x~phi)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x))
                                         (open_tm_wrt_tm B' (a_Var_f x))) ->
    VM P phi (a_WSigma psi0 A B) (a_WSigma psi0 A' B')
| VM_SSigma : forall (psi0:grade) (A B A' B':tm),
    R P phi A A' ->
    (forall x:atom, R ((x~phi)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x))
                                         (open_tm_wrt_tm B' (a_Var_f x))) ->
    VM P phi (a_SSigma psi0 A B) (a_SSigma psi0 A' B')
| VM_Sum : forall (A B A' B':tm),
    R P phi A A' -> R P phi B B' ->
    VM P phi (a_Sum A B) (a_Sum A' B')
| VM_Abs : forall (psi0:grade) (A b A' b':tm),
    (forall x:atom, R ((x~psi0)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x))
                                          (open_tm_wrt_tm b' (a_Var_f x))) ->
    VM P phi (a_Abs psi0 A b) (a_Abs psi0 A' b')
| VM_WPair : forall (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b a' b':tm),
    (psi0 <= phi -> R P phi a a') ->
    R P phi b b' ->
    VM P phi (a_WPair a psi0 b) (a_WPair a' psi0 b')
| VM_SPair : forall (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b a' b':tm),
    (psi0 <= phi -> R P phi a a') ->
    R P phi b b' ->
    VM P phi (a_SPair a psi0 b) (a_SPair a' psi0 b')
| VM_Inj1 : forall a a', R P phi a a' -> VM P phi (a_Inj1 a) (a_Inj1 a')
| VM_Inj2 : forall a a', R P phi a a' -> VM P phi (a_Inj2 a) (a_Inj2 a')
| VM_refl : forall v, Value v -> Grade P phi v -> VM P phi v v.

Scheme R_mut_ind := Induction for R Sort Prop
with VM_mut_ind := Induction for VM Sort Prop.

Lemma R_deq : forall P phi a b, R P phi a b -> DefEq P phi a b.
Proof. intros P phi a b H; destruct H as [a b De Ga Gb lca lcb hv vm]; exact De. Qed.

Proof. intros P phi a b H; destruct H as [a b De Ga Gb lca lcb hv vm]; exact Ga. Qed.
Lemma R_grade_right : forall P phi a b, R P phi a b -> Grade P phi b.
Proof. intros P phi a b H; destruct H as [a b De Ga Gb lca lcb hv vm]; exact Gb. Qed.
Lemma R_lc_left : forall P phi a b, R P phi a b -> lc_tm a.
Proof. intros P phi a b H; destruct H as [a b De Ga Gb lca lcb hv vm]; exact lca. Qed.
Lemma R_lc_right : forall P phi a b, R P phi a b -> lc_tm b.
Proof. intros P phi a b H; destruct H as [a b De Ga Gb lca lcb hv vm]; exact lcb. Qed.

Require Import Qual.geq.
Require Import Qual.defeq.
Require Import Base2.
Require Import GradeR.
Require Import DefEqRename.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Open Scope grade_scope.

Lemma grade_le_self : forall g:grade, g <= g.
Proof. intro g. apply (leq_join g g). apply join_idem. Qed.

Lemma fresh_four : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (b1 b2:tm) x,
  x \notin (L \u (dom P \u (fv_tm_tm b1 \u fv_tm_tm b2))) ->
  x \notin L /\ x \notin dom P /\ x \notin fv_tm_tm b1 /\ x \notin fv_tm_tm b2.
Proof.
  intros L P b1 b2 x Hx. repeat split.
  - apply (@notin_union_l L (dom P \u (fv_tm_tm b1 \u fv_tm_tm b2)) x). exact Hx.
  - apply (@notin_union_l (dom P) (fv_tm_tm b1 \u fv_tm_tm b2) x).
    apply (@notin_union_r L (dom P \u (fv_tm_tm b1 \u fv_tm_tm b2)) x). exact Hx.
  - apply (@notin_union_l (fv_tm_tm b1) (fv_tm_tm b2) x).
    apply (@notin_union_r (dom P) (fv_tm_tm b1 \u fv_tm_tm b2) x).
    apply (@notin_union_r L (dom P \u (fv_tm_tm b1 \u fv_tm_tm b2)) x). exact Hx.
  - apply (@notin_union_r (fv_tm_tm b1) (fv_tm_tm b2) x).
    apply (@notin_union_r (dom P) (fv_tm_tm b1 \u fv_tm_tm b2) x).
    apply (@notin_union_r L (dom P \u (fv_tm_tm b1 \u fv_tm_tm b2)) x). exact Hx.
Qed.

(* DefEq of the result in the related (psi0 = phi) case. *)
Lemma R_body_subst_related_defeq : forall (P:econtext) (phi:grade)
  (b1 b2 a1 a2:tm) (L:vars),
  uniq P ->
  (forall x, x \notin L ->
     DefEq ((x~phi)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x))
                              (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x))) ->
  DefEq P phi a1 a2 ->
  DefEq P phi (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 a1) (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 a2).
Proof.
  intros P phi b1 b2 a1 a2 L Hu Hbody Hargs.
  pose proof (@Eq_Pi L P phi q_Bot a_TyUnit b1 a_TyUnit b2) as Hpi.
  assert (Hpi' : DefEq P phi (a_Pi q_Bot a_TyUnit b1)
                               (a_Pi q_Bot a_TyUnit b2)).
  { eapply Hpi.
    - apply Eq_Refl. apply G_TyUnit. exact Hu.
    - intros x Hx. exact (Hbody x Hx). }
  eapply (@Eq_PiSnd P phi b1 a1 b2 a2 q_Bot a_TyUnit a_TyUnit).
  - exact Hpi'.
  - exact Hargs.
Qed.

(* Grade of the result in the related case. *)
Lemma R_body_subst_related_grade : forall (P:econtext) (phi:grade)
  (b1 b2 a1 a2:tm) (L:vars),
  uniq P ->
  (forall x, x \notin L ->
     R ((x~phi)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x))
                          (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x))) ->
  R P phi a1 a2 ->
  Grade P phi (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 a1) /\
  Grade P phi (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 a2).
Proof.
  intros P phi b1 b2 a1 a2 L Hu Hbody Hargs.
  destruct (atom_fresh (L \u (dom P \u (fv_tm_tm b1 \u fv_tm_tm b2))))
    as [x Hx].
  destruct (@fresh_four L P b1 b2 x Hx) as [HxL [Hxdom [Hxb1 Hxb2]]].
  assert (Hb1 : Grade ((x~phi)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x)))
    by exact (@R_grade_left ((x~phi)++P) phi _ _ (Hbody x HxL)).
  assert (Hb2 : Grade ((x~phi)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x)))
    by exact (@R_grade_right ((x~phi)++P) phi _ _ (Hbody x HxL)).
  split.
  - eapply (@Grade_body_subst P phi phi b1 x a1 Hu Hxdom Hb1).
    + intro; apply (@R_grade_left P phi a1 a2 Hargs).
    + intros _; apply (@Grade_lc P phi a1 (@R_grade_left P phi a1 a2 Hargs)).
    + exact Hxb1.
  - eapply (@Grade_body_subst P phi phi b2 x a2 Hu Hxdom Hb2).
    + intro; apply (@R_grade_right P phi a1 a2 Hargs).
    + intros _; apply (@Grade_lc P phi a2 (@R_grade_right P phi a1 a2 Hargs)).
    + exact Hxb2.
Qed.

(* Related case: the only missing pieces are exactly hasV and VM transfer. *)
Lemma R_body_subst_related_reduce : forall (P:econtext) (phi:grade)
  (b1 b2 a1 a2:tm) (L:vars),
  uniq P ->
  (forall x, x \notin L ->
     DefEq ((x~phi)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x))
                              (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x))) ->
  (forall x, x \notin L ->
     R ((x~phi)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x))
                          (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x))) ->
  DefEq P phi a1 a2 ->
  R P phi a1 a2 ->
  (hasV (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 a1) <-> hasV (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 a2)) ->
  (forall v w, Value v -> Steps (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 a1) v ->
               Value w -> Steps (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 a2) w ->
               VM P phi v w) ->
  R P phi (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 a1) (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 a2).
Proof.
  intros P phi b1 b2 a1 a2 L Hu HD HR HDargs HRargs Hhas Hvm.
  assert (HDeq : DefEq P phi (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 a1)
                              (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 a2))
    by exact (@R_body_subst_related_defeq P phi b1 b2 a1 a2 L Hu HD HDargs).
  destruct (@R_body_subst_related_grade P phi b1 b2 a1 a2 L Hu HR HRargs)
    as [G1 G2].
  apply R_intro.
  - exact HDeq.
  - exact G1.
  - exact G2.
  - apply (@Grade_lc P phi _ G1).
  - apply (@Grade_lc P phi _ G2).
  - exact Hhas.
  - exact Hvm.
Qed.

(* DefEq of the result in the irrelevant (not psi0 <= phi) case. *)
Lemma R_body_subst_irrel_defeq : forall (P:econtext) (phi psib:grade)
  (b1 b2 a1 a2:tm) (L:vars),

Lemma R_body_subst_irrel_defeq : forall (P:econtext) (phi psib:grade)
  (b1 b2 a1 a2:tm) (L:vars),
  (forall x, x \notin L ->
     DefEq ((x~psib)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x))
                                (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x))) ->
  lc_tm a1 -> lc_tm a2 ->
  ~ (psib <= phi) ->
  DefEq P phi (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 a1) (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 a2).
Proof.
  intros P phi psib b1 b2 a1 a2 L Hbody Hl1 Hl2 Hn.
  eapply (@Eq_SubstIrrel L P phi b1 a1 b2 a2 psib).
  - exact Hl1.
  - exact Hl2.
  - exact I.
  - exact I.
  - intros x Hx. exact (Hbody x Hx).
  - exact Hn.
Qed.

(* Grade of the result in the irrelevant case. *)
Lemma R_body_subst_irrel_grade : forall (P:econtext) (phi psib:grade)
  (b1 b2 a1 a2:tm) (L:vars),
  uniq P ->
  (forall x, x \notin L ->
     R ((x~psib)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x))
                            (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x))) ->
  lc_tm a1 -> lc_tm a2 ->
  ~ (psib <= phi) ->
  Grade P phi (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 a1) /\
  Grade P phi (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 a2).
Proof.
  intros P phi psib b1 b2 a1 a2 L Hu HR Hl1 Hl2 Hn.
  destruct (atom_fresh (L \u (dom P \u (fv_tm_tm b1 \u fv_tm_tm b2))))
    as [x Hx].
  destruct (@fresh_four L P b1 b2 x Hx) as [HxL [Hxdom [Hxb1 Hxb2]]].
  assert (Hb1 : Grade ((x~psib)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x)))
    by exact (@R_grade_left ((x~psib)++P) phi _ _ (HR x HxL)).
  assert (Hb2 : Grade ((x~psib)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x)))
    by exact (@R_grade_right ((x~psib)++P) phi _ _ (HR x HxL)).
  split.
  - eapply (@Grade_body_subst P phi psib b1 x a1 Hu Hxdom Hb1).
    + intros Hle. exfalso. exact (Hn Hle).
    + intros _. exact Hl1.
    + exact Hxb1.
  - eapply (@Grade_body_subst P phi psib b2 x a2 Hu Hxdom Hb2).
    + intros Hle. exfalso. exact (Hn Hle).
    + intros _. exact Hl2.
    + exact Hxb2.
Qed.

(* The single-body irrelevance statement.  This is the remaining semantic
   core for the irrelevant branch. *)
Definition Grade_irrel_same_R : Prop :=
  forall (P:econtext) (phi psib:grade) (x:atom) (b a1 a2:tm),
    uniq P ->
    x \notin dom P ->
    x \notin fv_tm_tm b ->
    ~ (psib <= phi) ->
    Grade ((x~psib)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x)) ->
    lc_tm a1 -> lc_tm a2 ->
    R P phi (open_tm_wrt_tm b a1) (open_tm_wrt_tm b a2).

(* Conditional assembly.  Besides same-body irrelevance, we need the body
   relation at the SAME context P, not only at the extended context.  This
   is the exact context-removal bridge that is still missing. *)
Lemma R_body_subst_irrel_from_same :
  Grade_irrel_same_R ->
  forall (P:econtext) (phi psib:grade) (b1 b2 a1 a2:tm) (L:vars),
  uniq P ->
  (forall x, x \notin L ->
     R ((x~psib)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x))
                            (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x))) ->
  (forall x, x \notin L ->
     R P phi (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x))
             (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x))) ->
  lc_tm a1 -> lc_tm a2 ->
  ~ (psib <= phi) ->
  R P phi (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 a1) (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 a2).
Proof.
  intros Hsame P phi psib b1 b2 a1 a2 L Hu HR HRP Hl1 Hl2 Hn.
  destruct (atom_fresh (L \u (dom P \u (fv_tm_tm b1 \u fv_tm_tm b2))))
    as [x Hx].
  destruct (@fresh_four L P b1 b2 x Hx) as [HxL [Hxdom [Hxb1 Hxb2]]].
  assert (HRx : R ((x~psib)++P) phi
                    (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x))
                    (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x))) by exact (HR x HxL).
  assert (HRPx : R P phi (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x))
                          (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x))) by exact (HRP x HxL).
  assert (H1 : R P phi (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 a1)
                         (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x))).
  { eapply Hsame.
    - exact Hu.
    - exact Hxdom.
    - exact Hxb1.
    - exact Hn.
    - exact (@R_grade_left ((x~psib)++P) phi _ _ HRx).
    - exact Hl1.
    - apply lc_a_Var_f. }
  assert (H2 : R P phi (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x))
                         (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 a2)).
  { eapply Hsame.
    - exact Hu.
    - exact Hxdom.
    - exact Hxb2.
    - exact Hn.
    - exact (@R_grade_right ((x~psib)++P) phi _ _ HRx).
    - apply lc_a_Var_f.
    - exact Hl2. }
  exact (@R_trans P phi _ _ H1 _
           (@R_trans P phi _ _ HRPx _ H2)).
Qed.

Lemma R_body_subst_irrel_reduce : forall (P:econtext) (phi psib:grade)
  (b1 b2 a1 a2:tm) (L:vars),
  uniq P ->
  (forall x, x \notin L ->
     DefEq ((x~psib)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x))
                                (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x))) ->
  (forall x, x \notin L ->
     R ((x~psib)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x))
                            (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x))) ->
  lc_tm a1 -> lc_tm a2 ->
  ~ (psib <= phi) ->

(* Grade of the result in the irrelevant case. *)
Lemma R_body_subst_irrel_grade : forall (P:econtext) (phi psib:grade)
  (b1 b2 a1 a2:tm) (L:vars),
  uniq P ->
  (forall x, x \notin L ->
     R ((x~psib)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 (a_Var_f x))
                            (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x))) ->
  lc_tm a1 -> lc_tm a2 ->
  ~ (psib <= phi) ->
  Grade P phi (open_tm_wrt_tm b1 a1) /\
  Grade P phi (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 a2).

  intros P phi psib b1 b2 a1 a2 L Hu HR Hl1 Hl2 Hn.
  destruct (atom_fresh (L \u (dom P \u (fv_tm_tm b1 \u fv_tm_tm b2))))

    by exact (@R_grade_left ((x~psib)++P) phi _ _ (HR x HxL)).
  assert (Hb2 : Grade ((x~psib)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 (a_Var_f x)))
    by exact (@R_grade_right ((x~psib)++P) phi _ _ (HR x HxL)).

Fixpoint size_tm (u:tm) : nat :=
  match u with
  | a_TyUnit => 1 | a_TmUnit => 1 | a_Type _ => 1 | a_Var_f _ => 1 | a_Var_b _ => 1
  | a_Pi _ A B => 1 + size_tm A + size_tm B
  | a_Abs _ A b => 1 + size_tm A + size_tm b
  | a_App a _ b => 1 + size_tm a + size_tm b
  | a_Sum A B => 1 + size_tm A + size_tm B
  | a_Inj1 a => 1 + size_tm a | a_Inj2 a => 1 + size_tm a
  | a_Case _ a b1 b2 => 1 + size_tm a + size_tm b1 + size_tm b2
  | a_WSigma _ A B => 1 + size_tm A + size_tm B
  | a_WPair a _ b => 1 + size_tm a + size_tm b
  | a_LetPair _ a b => 1 + size_tm a + size_tm b
  | a_SSigma _ A B => 1 + size_tm A + size_tm B
  | a_SPair a _ b => 1 + size_tm a + size_tm b
  | a_Proj1 _ a => 1 + size_tm a | a_Proj2 _ a => 1 + size_tm a

Lemma remove_ec_head_eq : forall x g C, remove_ec x ((x,g) :: C) = C.

Lemma binds_remove_ec_imp : forall C x y g, y <> x -> binds y g (remove_ec x C) -> binds y g C.

      * subst. apply binds_cons_2; reflexivity.

Proof.

  - inversion Hb.
  - destruct (CoqEqDec.eq_dec z x) as [E|E].
    + subst. apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[? ?]|Hb].
      * subst. exfalso; apply Hne; reflexivity.
      * exact Hb.
    + apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[? ?]|Hb].
      * subst. apply binds_cons_2; reflexivity.
      * apply binds_cons. apply (IH x y g Hne Hb).

Require Import Qual.geq.
Require Import Qual.defeq.
Require Import Base2.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Open Scope grade_scope.

Definition hasV (a:tm) : Prop := exists v, Value v /\ Steps a v.

Inductive R (P:econtext) (phi:grade) : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
| R_intro : forall (a b:tm),
    DefEq P phi a b ->
    Grade P phi a ->
    Grade P phi b ->
    lc_tm a ->
    lc_tm b ->
    (hasV a <-> hasV b) ->
    (forall (v w:tm), Value v -> Steps a v -> Value w -> Steps b w -> VM P phi v w) ->
    R P phi a b
with VM (P:econtext) (phi:grade) : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
| VM_Type : forall (s:sort), VM P phi (a_Type s) (a_Type s)
| VM_Unit : VM P phi a_TyUnit a_TyUnit
| VM_Pi : forall (psi0:grade) (A B A' B':tm),
    R P phi A A' ->
    (forall x:atom, R ((x~phi)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x))
                                         (open_tm_wrt_tm B' (a_Var_f x))) ->
    VM P phi (a_Pi psi0 A B) (a_Pi psi0 A' B')
| VM_WSigma : forall (psi0:grade) (A B A' B':tm),
    R P phi A A' ->
    (forall x:atom, R ((x~phi)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x))
                                         (open_tm_wrt_tm B' (a_Var_f x))) ->
    VM P phi (a_WSigma psi0 A B) (a_WSigma psi0 A' B')
| VM_SSigma : forall (psi0:grade) (A B A' B':tm),
    R P phi A A' ->
    (forall x:atom, R ((x~phi)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x))
                                         (open_tm_wrt_tm B' (a_Var_f x))) ->
    VM P phi (a_SSigma psi0 A B) (a_SSigma psi0 A' B')
| VM_Sum : forall (A B A' B':tm),
    R P phi A A' -> R P phi B B' ->
    VM P phi (a_Sum A B) (a_Sum A' B')
| VM_Abs : forall (psi0:grade) (A b A' b':tm),
    (forall x:atom, R ((x~psi0)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x))
                                          (open_tm_wrt_tm b' (a_Var_f x))) ->
    VM P phi (a_Abs psi0 A b) (a_Abs psi0 A' b')
| VM_WPair : forall (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b a' b':tm),
    (psi0 <= phi -> R P phi a a') ->
    R P phi b b' ->
    VM P phi (a_WPair a psi0 b) (a_WPair a' psi0 b')
| VM_SPair : forall (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b a' b':tm),
    (psi0 <= phi -> R P phi a a') ->
    R P phi b b' ->
    VM P phi (a_SPair a psi0 b) (a_SPair a' psi0 b')
| VM_Inj1 : forall a a', R P phi a a' -> VM P phi (a_Inj1 a) (a_Inj1 a')
| VM_Inj2 : forall a a', R P phi a a' -> VM P phi (a_Inj2 a) (a_Inj2 a')
| VM_refl : forall v, Value v -> Grade P phi v -> VM P phi v v.

Scheme R_mut_ind := Induction for R Sort Prop
with VM_mut_ind := Induction for VM Sort Prop.

Lemma R_deq : forall P phi a b, R P phi a b -> DefEq P phi a b.
Proof. intros P phi a b H; destruct H as [a b De Ga Gb lca lcb hv vm]; exact De. Qed.
Lemma R_grade_left : forall P phi a b, R P phi a b -> Grade P phi a.
Proof. intros P phi a b H; destruct H as [a b De Ga Gb lca lcb hv vm]; exact Ga. Qed.
Lemma R_grade_right : forall P phi a b, R P phi a b -> Grade P phi b.
Proof. intros P phi a b H; destruct H as [a b De Ga Gb lca lcb hv vm]; exact Gb. Qed.
Lemma R_lc_left : forall P phi a b, R P phi a b -> lc_tm a.
Proof. intros P phi a b H; destruct H as [a b De Ga Gb lca lcb hv vm]; exact lca. Qed.
Lemma R_lc_right : forall P phi a b, R P phi a b -> lc_tm b.
Proof. intros P phi a b H; destruct H as [a b De Ga Gb lca lcb hv vm]; exact lcb. Qed.
Lemma R_hasV : forall P phi a b, R P phi a b -> (hasV a <-> hasV b).
Proof. intros P phi a b H; destruct H as [a b De Ga Gb lca lcb hv vm]; exact hv. Qed.
Lemma R_vm : forall P phi a b, R P phi a b ->
  forall v w, Value v -> Steps a v -> Value w -> Steps b w -> VM P phi v w.
Proof. intros P phi a b H; destruct H as [a b De Ga Gb lca lcb hv vm]; exact vm. Qed.

Lemma R_intro_trans : forall P phi a b c,
  DefEq P phi a b ->
  Grade P phi a ->
  lc_tm a ->
  (hasV a <-> hasV b) ->
  - intros VTv VTw; inversion VTv.
  - intros VTv VTw; inversion VTv.
  - intros VTv VTw; inversion VTv.
  - intros VTv VTw; inversion VTv.
  - intros VTv VTw; inversion VTv.
  - intros VTv VTw; apply VtTag_refl; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma R_Consistent_VT : forall P phi a b,
  R P phi a b -> ValueType a -> ValueType b -> Consistent a b.
Proof.
  intros P phi a b H VTa VTb.
  assert (Hvm : VM P phi a b) by
    exact (@R_vm P phi a b H a b (@V_ValueType a VTa) (Steps_refl a)
             (@V_ValueType b VTb) (Steps_refl b)).
  assert (Htag : VtTag a b) by exact (@VM_VtTag P phi a b Hvm VTa VTb).
  eapply Consistent_of_VtTag.
  - exact Htag.
  - apply ValueType_lc; exact VTa.
  - apply ValueType_lc; exact VTb.
Qed.

Lemma R_of_step : forall P phi a b,
  Grade P phi a -> Step a b -> R P phi a b.
Proof.
  intros P phi a b Ga Sab.
  assert (Gb : Grade P phi b) by exact (@Step_Grade P phi a b Sab Ga).
  apply R_intro.
  - eapply Eq_Beta; [exact Ga | exact Sab | exact Gb].
  - exact Ga.
  - exact Gb.
  - apply (@Grade_lc P phi a Ga).
  - apply (@Grade_lc P phi b Gb).
  - split.
    + intros [v [Vv Sav]].
      destruct (@Steps_join a b (@Steps_step a b b Sab (Steps_refl b)) v Sav)
        as [Sbv | Svb].
      * exists v; split; assumption.
      * assert (E : v = b) by exact (@Steps_value v b Vv Svb).
        subst v. exists b; split; assumption.

Lemma step_det : forall a b c, Step a b -> Step a c -> b = c.
Proof.
  intros a b c H1. revert c. induction H1; intros c H2;
    inversion H2; subst; try reflexivity; try (f_equal; eauto); try no_step.
Qed.

(* ---------- value-type tags and opening head stability ---------- *)
(* Same-head (value-type tag) relation, and stability of the head of [open]. *)
Inductive VtTag : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
 | VtTag_Type : forall s, VtTag (a_Type s) (a_Type s)
 | VtTag_Unit : VtTag a_TyUnit a_TyUnit
 | VtTag_Pi : forall psi A B A' B', VtTag (a_Pi psi A B) (a_Pi psi A' B')
 | VtTag_WSigma : forall psi A B A' B', VtTag (a_WSigma psi A B) (a_WSigma psi A' B')
 | VtTag_SSigma : forall psi A B A' B', VtTag (a_SSigma psi A B) (a_SSigma psi A' B')
 | VtTag_Sum : forall A B A' B', VtTag (a_Sum A B) (a_Sum A' B').

Lemma VtTag_VT : forall a b, VtTag a b -> lc_tm a -> lc_tm b -> ValueType a /\ ValueType b.
Proof.
  intros a b H; induction H; intros Ha Hb; split.
  - apply ValueType_Type. - apply ValueType_Type.
  - apply ValueType_Unit. - apply ValueType_Unit.
  - apply ValueType_Pi. * inversion Ha; assumption. * assumption.
  - apply ValueType_Pi. * inversion Hb; assumption. * assumption.
  - apply ValueType_WSigma. * inversion Ha; assumption. * assumption.
  - apply ValueType_WSigma. * inversion Hb; assumption. * assumption.
  - apply ValueType_SSigma. * inversion Ha; assumption. * assumption.
  - apply ValueType_SSigma. * inversion Hb; assumption. * assumption.
  - apply ValueType_Sum. * inversion Ha; assumption. * inversion Ha; assumption.
  - apply ValueType_Sum. * inversion Hb; assumption. * inversion Hb; assumption.
Qed.
Lemma VtTag_sym : forall a b, VtTag a b -> VtTag b a.
Proof. intros a b H; induction H; econstructor. Qed.
Lemma VtTag_trans : forall a b c, VtTag a b -> VtTag b c -> VtTag a c.
Proof.
  intros a b c H1 H2. revert c H2. induction H1; intros c' H2; inversion H2; subst; econstructor.
Qed.
Lemma VtTag_refl : forall a, ValueType a -> VtTag a a.
Proof. intros a H; induction H; econstructor. Qed.

Lemma open_head_stable : forall B a1 a2,
  B <> a_Var_b 0 -> ValueType (open_tm_wrt_tm B a1) ->
  VtTag (open_tm_wrt_tm B a1) (open_tm_wrt_tm B a2).
Proof.
  intros B. destruct B; intros a1 a2 Hneq HVT.
  - (* TyUnit *) simpl. econstructor.
  - (* TmUnit *) simpl in HVT; inversion HVT.
  - (* Pi *) simpl in *; inversion HVT; subst; econstructor.
  - (* Abs *) simpl in HVT; inversion HVT.
  - (* App *) simpl in HVT; inversion HVT.
  - (* Type *) simpl in *; inversion HVT; subst; econstructor.
  - (* Var_b *) destruct n.
    + exfalso; apply Hneq; reflexivity.
    + simpl in HVT; inversion HVT.
  - (* Var_f *) simpl in HVT; inversion HVT.
  - (* Sum *) simpl in *; inversion HVT; subst; econstructor.
  - (* Inj1 *) simpl in HVT; inversion HVT.
  - (* Inj2 *) simpl in HVT; inversion HVT.
  - (* Case *) simpl in HVT; inversion HVT.
  - (* WSigma *) simpl in *; inversion HVT; subst; econstructor.
  - (* WPair *) simpl in HVT; inversion HVT.
  - (* LetPair *) simpl in HVT; inversion HVT.
  - (* SSigma *) simpl in *; inversion HVT; subst; econstructor.
  - (* SPair *) simpl in HVT; inversion HVT.
  - (* Proj1 *) simpl in HVT; inversion HVT.
  - (* Proj2 *) simpl in HVT; inversion HVT.
Qed.

(* ---------- consistency bookkeeping ---------- *)
(* From agreement of value-type heads (plus local closure) to [Consistent]. *)
Lemma Consistent_of_VtTag : forall a b, VtTag a b -> lc_tm a -> lc_tm b -> Consistent a b.
Proof.
  intros a b H. induction H; intros Ha Hb.
  - apply Consistent_a_Type.
  - apply Consistent_a_Unit.
  - apply Consistent_a_Pi.
    + inversion Ha; assumption. + assumption. + inversion Hb; assumption. + assumption.
  - apply Consistent_a_WSigma.
    + inversion Ha; assumption. + assumption. + inversion Hb; assumption. + assumption.
  - apply Consistent_a_SSigma.
    + inversion Ha; assumption. + assumption. + inversion Hb; assumption. + assumption.
  - apply Consistent_a_Sum.
    + inversion Ha; assumption. + inversion Ha; assumption.
    + inversion Hb; assumption. + inversion Hb; assumption.
Qed.
Arguments Consistent_of_VtTag : clear implicits.
Arguments Consistent_of_VtTag a b _ _ _.

Lemma Consistent_refl : forall a, lc_tm a -> Consistent a a.
Proof.
  intros a H. destruct a; try solve [apply Consistent_a_Step_R; [exact H | intro H'; inversion H']].
  - (* TyUnit *) apply Consistent_a_Unit.
  - (* Pi *) apply Consistent_a_Pi; [inversion H; assumption | assumption | inversion H; assumption | assumption].
  - (* Type *) apply Consistent_a_Type.
  - (* Sum *) apply Consistent_a_Sum; try (inversion H; assumption); try assumption.
  - (* WSigma *) apply Consistent_a_WSigma; [inversion H; assumption | assumption | inversion H; assumption | assumption].
  - (* SSigma *) apply Consistent_a_SSigma; [inversion H; assumption | assumption | inversion H; assumption | assumption].
Qed.

Ltac vt_build :=
  match goal with
  | |- ValueType (a_Type _) => apply ValueType_Type
  | |- ValueType a_TyUnit => apply ValueType_Unit
  | Ha : lc_tm (a_Pi _ _ _) |- ValueType (a_Pi _ _ _) => apply ValueType_Pi; [inversion Ha; assumption | exact Ha]
  | Ha : lc_tm (a_WSigma _ _ _) |- ValueType (a_WSigma _ _ _) => apply ValueType_WSigma; [inversion Ha; assumption | exact Ha]
  | Ha : lc_tm (a_SSigma _ _ _) |- ValueType (a_SSigma _ _ _) => apply ValueType_SSigma; [inversion Ha; assumption | exact Ha]
  | Ha : lc_tm (a_Sum _ _) |- ValueType (a_Sum _ _) => apply ValueType_Sum; [inversion Ha; assumption | inversion Ha; assumption]
  end.

Lemma Consistent_total : forall a b, lc_tm a -> lc_tm b ->
  (ValueType a -> ValueType b -> VtTag a b) -> Consistent a b.
Proof.
  intros a. destruct a; intros b Ha Hb Htag;
    try solve [apply Consistent_a_Step_R; [exact Hb | intro H'; inversion H']];
    destruct b;
    try solve [apply Consistent_a_Step_L; [exact Ha | intro H'; inversion H']].
  all: try solve [exfalso; pose proof (Htag ltac:(vt_build) ltac:(vt_build)) as HT; inversion HT].
  all: apply Consistent_of_VtTag; [ pose proof (Htag ltac:(vt_build) ltac:(vt_build)) as HT; exact HT | exact Ha | exact Hb ].
Qed.

Inductive Steps : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
| Steps_refl : forall a, Steps a a
| Steps_step : forall a b c, Step a b -> Steps b c -> Steps a c.

(* ---------- deep invariant (reduction-aware, inductive carrier) ---------- *)
Inductive Deep (P:econtext) (phi:grade) : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
| Deep_Type : forall s, Deep P phi (a_Type s) (a_Type s)
| Deep_Unit : Deep P phi a_TyUnit a_TyUnit
| Deep_Pi : forall psi A1 B1 A2 B2,
    Deep P phi A1 A2 ->
    (forall x, Deep ((x~phi)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x))) ->
    Deep P phi (a_Pi psi A1 B1) (a_Pi psi A2 B2)
| Deep_WSigma : forall psi A1 B1 A2 B2,
    Deep P phi A1 A2 ->
    (forall x, Deep ((x~phi)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x))) ->
    Deep P phi (a_WSigma psi A1 B1) (a_WSigma psi A2 B2)
| Deep_SSigma : forall psi A1 B1 A2 B2,
    Deep P phi A1 A2 ->
    (forall x, Deep ((x~phi)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x))) ->
    Deep P phi (a_SSigma psi A1 B1) (a_SSigma psi A2 B2)
| Deep_Sum : forall A1 B1 A2 B2,
    Deep P phi A1 A2 -> Deep P phi B1 B2 ->
    Deep P phi (a_Sum A1 B1) (a_Sum A2 B2)
| Deep_NonVT : forall a b,
    lc_tm a -> lc_tm b -> Consistent a b ->
    (forall u, ValueType u -> Steps a u -> exists v, Steps b v /\ ValueType v /\ VtTag u v) ->
    (forall v, ValueType v -> Steps b v -> exists u, Steps a u /\ ValueType u /\ VtTag u v) ->
    (forall psi A1 B1 A2 B2, Steps a (a_Pi psi A1 B1) -> Steps b (a_Pi psi A2 B2) ->
        Deep P phi A1 A2 /\ (forall x, Deep ((x~phi)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x)))) ->
    (forall psi A1 B1 A2 B2, Steps a (a_WSigma psi A1 B1) -> Steps b (a_WSigma psi A2 B2) ->
        Deep P phi A1 A2 /\ (forall x, Deep ((x~phi)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x)))) ->
    (forall psi A1 B1 A2 B2, Steps a (a_SSigma psi A1 B1) -> Steps b (a_SSigma psi A2 B2) ->
        Deep P phi A1 A2 /\ (forall x, Deep ((x~phi)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x)))) ->
    (forall A1 B1 A2 B2, Steps a (a_Sum A1 B1) -> Steps b (a_Sum A2 B2) ->
        Deep P phi A1 A2 /\ Deep P phi B1 B2) ->
    Deep P phi a b.

(* ---------- parallel reduction / Joins -> Consistent ---------- *)

(* ---------- Parallel reduction preserves value-type tags ---------- *)
Lemma Par_VtTag_form : forall (P:econtext) (phi:grade) (a b:tm),
  Par P phi a b -> forall t, VtTag t a -> VtTag t b.
Proof.
  intros P phi a b H. induction H; intros t HT;
    try solve [exfalso; inversion HT];
    try solve [inversion HT; econstructor];
    assumption.
Qed.
Arguments Par_VtTag_form : clear implicits.
Arguments Par_VtTag_form P phi a b _ _ _.

Lemma MultiPar_VtTag : forall (P:econtext) (phi:grade) (a b:tm),
  MultiPar P phi a b -> forall t, VtTag t a -> VtTag t b.
Proof.
  intros P phi a b H. induction H; intros t HT.
  - exact HT.
  - apply IHMultiPar. exact (Par_VtTag_form _ _ _ _ H t HT).
Qed.
Arguments MultiPar_VtTag : clear implicits.
Arguments MultiPar_VtTag P phi a b _ _ _.

Lemma MultiPar_VT : forall (P:econtext) (phi:grade) (a b:tm),
  MultiPar P phi a b -> ValueType a -> VtTag a b.
Proof.
  intros P phi a b H HVT. exact (MultiPar_VtTag _ _ _ _ H a (VtTag_refl HVT)).
Qed.
Arguments MultiPar_VT : clear implicits.
Arguments MultiPar_VT P phi a b _ _.

(* ---------- GEq preserves value-type tags ---------- *)
Lemma GEq_VtTag_form : forall (P:econtext) (phi:grade) (a b:tm),
  GEq P phi a b -> forall t, VtTag t a -> VtTag t b.
Proof.
  intros P phi a b H. induction H; intros t HT;
    try solve [exfalso; inversion HT];
    try solve [inversion HT; econstructor];
    assumption.
Qed.
Arguments GEq_VtTag_form : clear implicits.
Arguments GEq_VtTag_form P phi a b _ _ _.

(* ---------- Joins imply consistency ---------- *)
Lemma Joins_Consistent : forall (P:econtext) (phi:grade) (a b:tm),
  Joins P phi a b -> lc_tm a -> lc_tm b -> Consistent a b.
Proof.
  intros P phi a b H Ha Hb. destruct H as [P0 psi a1 a2 b1 b2 Mp1 Mp2 Ge].
  apply Consistent_total; [exact Ha | exact Hb |].
  intros VTa VTb.
  pose proof (MultiPar_VT P0 psi a1 b1 Mp1 VTa) as H1.
  pose proof (MultiPar_VT P0 psi a2 b2 Mp2 VTb) as H2.
  pose proof (GEq_VtTag_form P0 psi b1 b2 Ge a1 H1) as H3.
  apply VtTag_trans with b2; [exact H3 | apply VtTag_sym; exact H2].
Qed.
Arguments Joins_Consistent : clear implicits.
Arguments Joins_Consistent P phi a b _ _ _.

(* ---------- GEq/CEq symmetry ---------- *)

(* ---------- symmetry of GEq / CEq ---------- *)
Scheme GEq_mind := Induction for GEq Sort Prop
  with CEq_mind := Induction for CEq Sort Prop.

Lemma GEq_sym : forall (P:econtext) (phi:grade) (a b:tm), GEq P phi a b -> GEq P phi b a.
Proof.
  intros P phi a b H. induction H using GEq_mind
    with (P0 := fun (P:econtext) (psi phi0:grade) (a b:tm) (_:CEq P psi phi0 a b) => CEq P psi phi0 b a).
  all: try (apply CEq_Nleq; assumption).
  all: try (econstructor; eauto).
  all: assumption.
Qed.
Arguments GEq_sym : clear implicits.
Arguments GEq_sym P phi a b _.

Lemma CEq_sym : forall (P:econtext) (phi phi0:grade) (a b:tm), CEq P phi phi0 a b -> CEq P phi phi0 b a.
Proof.
  intros P phi phi0 a b H. induction H.
  - apply CEq_Leq; [assumption | apply GEq_sym; assumption].
  - apply CEq_Nleq; assumption.
Qed.
Arguments CEq_sym : clear implicits.
Arguments CEq_sym P phi phi0 a b _.

(* ---------- DefEq implies a unique context ---------- *)

(* ---------- DefEq endpoints live in unique contexts ---------- *)
Lemma DefEq_uniq : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm), DefEq P psi a b -> uniq P.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H using DefEq_mind
    with (P0 := fun (P:econtext) (psi phi0:grade) (a b:tm) (_:CDefEq P psi phi0 a b) => uniq P).
  all: try solve [match goal with Hg : Grade ?P' ?ps ?a' |- uniq ?P' => exact (Grade_uniq P' ps a' Hg) end].
  all: try assumption.
  - (* SubstIrrel *) destruct (atom_fresh L) as [x Hx].
    exact (@uniq_app_2 _ (x ~ psi) P (H x Hx)).
Qed.
Arguments DefEq_uniq : clear implicits.
Arguments DefEq_uniq P psi a b _.

Lemma Joins_refl : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm), Grade P psi a -> Joins P psi a a.
Proof.
  intros P psi a G. eapply join with (b1 := a) (b2 := a).
  - apply MP_Refl; assumption.
  - apply MP_Refl; assumption.
  - apply Grade_GEq_refl; assumption.

Lemma Joins_sym : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm), Joins P psi a b -> Joins P psi b a.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. destruct H as [P0 ps a1 a2 b1 b2 M1 M2 G].
  eapply join with (b1 := b2) (b2 := b1).
  - exact M2. - exact M1. - apply GEq_sym; exact G.

Lemma MultiPar_Pi_fst : forall P psi a b, MultiPar P psi a b ->
  forall psi0 A1 B1, a = a_Pi psi0 A1 B1 -> exists A1', MultiPar P psi A1 A1'.

Lemma Par_of_Step : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
  Grade P psi a -> Step a b -> Grade P psi b -> Par P psi a b.
Proof.

    + apply Grade_CPar_refl; assumption.
  - (* CaseCong *) destruct (Grade_Case_inv Ga) as [Ga0 [Gb1 [Gb2 Hle]]].
    destruct (Grade_Case_inv Gb) as [Ga' _].
    eapply Par_Case.
    + apply IHS; assumption.
    + eapply Par_Refl; assumption.
    + eapply Par_Refl; assumption.
    + assumption.
  - (* Case1Beta *) destruct (Grade_Case_inv Ga) as [Ginj [Gb1 [Gb2 Hle]]].
    pose proof (Grade_Inj1_inv Ginj) as Gx.
    eapply Par_CaseBeta1.
    + eapply Par_Inj1. eapply Par_Refl; assumption.
    + eapply Par_Refl; assumption.
    + eapply Par_Refl; assumption.
    + assumption.
  - (* Case2Beta *) destruct (Grade_Case_inv Ga) as [Ginj [Gb1 [Gb2 Hle]]].
    pose proof (Grade_Inj2_inv Ginj) as Gx.
    eapply Par_CaseBeta2.
    + eapply Par_Inj2. eapply Par_Refl; assumption.
    + eapply Par_Refl; assumption.

Lemma MultiPar_Pi_decomp : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
  MultiPar P psi a b ->

  exists A1' B1', b = a_Pi psi0 A1' B1' /\
    MultiPar P psi A1 A1' /\
    exists L, forall x, x \notin L ->
      MultiPar ((x,psi)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x))
                                        (open_tm_wrt_tm B1' (a_Var_f x)).

  intros P psi a b H. induction H as [P psi a Ha | P psi a a' b Hpar Hmp IH];
    intros psi0 A1 B1 EQ; subst a.

    destruct (@Grade_Pi_body P psi psi0 A1 B1 Ha) as [Lbody HB].

    + (* Par_Refl *)

            as [A2' [B2' [Eb [MpA MpB]]]];

          [ eapply MP_Step; [exact HpA | exact MpA] |
            exists (L \u L2); intros x Hx; eapply MP_Step;
            [ exact (HpB x (@notin_union_l L L2 x Hx)) |

  x <> y ->

     : forall (A : Type) (E : list (atom * A)) (x : atom),

binds_app_1
     : forall (A : Type) (x : atom) (a : A) (E F : list (atom * A)),

binds_app_l

     : forall (A : Type) (x : AtomSetImpl.elt) (E : list (atom * A)),

binds_In
     : forall (A : Type) (x : atom) (a : A) (E : list (atom * A)),

binds_cons_1
     : forall (A : Type) (x y : atom) (a b : A) (E : list (atom * A)),

binds_cons_2

Require Import Qual.geq.
Require Import Qual.defeq.
Require Import Base3.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Open Scope grade_scope.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Renaming a *bound econtext binder*: source context
   R ++ (x,g) :: Q, target context R ++ (y,g) :: Q.
   Unlike Grade_rename, the renamed atom is in the context.      *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma uniq_binder_rename : forall (R:econtext) x y g Q,
  uniq (R ++ (x,g) :: Q) ->
  x <> y ->
  x \notin dom R -> y \notin dom R ->
  x \notin dom Q -> y \notin dom Q ->
  uniq (R ++ (y,g) :: Q).
Proof.
  induction R as [|(z,h) R' IH]; intros x y g Q Hu Hxy HxR HyR HxQ HyQ.
  - simpl in *. inversion Hu; subst.
    apply (@uniq_cons grade y g Q H2 HyQ).
  - simpl in *. inversion Hu; subst.
    assert (HzR : z \notin dom R') by (simpl in H3; exact H3).
    assert (Hzx : z <> x) by (intro E; subst z; apply H3; apply AtomSetImpl.add_1; reflexivity).
    assert (Hzy : z <> y) by (intro E; subst z; apply HyR; simpl; apply AtomSetImpl.add_1; reflexivity).
    assert (HzQ : z \notin dom Q).
    { intro Hin. apply H3. apply AtomSetImpl.add_2.
      apply (@notin_union_l (dom R') (dom ((x,g)::Q)) z).
      apply (proj1 (@notin_union_iff (dom R') (dom ((x,g)::Q)) z)).
      split; [exact HzR |].
      apply AtomSetImpl.add_2. exact Hin. }
    assert (HxR' : x \notin dom R') by (intro Hin; apply HxR; simpl; apply AtomSetImpl.add_2; exact Hin).
    assert (HyR' : y \notin dom R') by (intro Hin; apply HyR; simpl; apply AtomSetImpl.add_2; exact Hin).
    apply (@uniq_cons grade z h (R' ++ (y,g) :: Q)).
    + apply IH; assumption.
    + simpl. apply AtomSetImpl.add_intro.
      * exact Hzy.
      * split; [exact HzR' |].
        apply AtomSetImpl.add_intro; [exact HzQ |].
        exact (fun H => Hzx (proj1 (proj1 (proj1 H)))).
Qed.

Lemma uniq_binder_rename : forall (R:econtext) x y g Q,
  uniq (R ++ (x,g) :: Q) ->
  x <> y ->
  x \notin dom R -> y \notin dom R ->
  x \notin dom Q -> y \notin dom Q ->
  uniq (R ++ (y,g) :: Q).
Proof.
  intros R x y g Q Hu Hxy HxR HyR HxQ HyQ.
  assert (HuEnd : uniq ((x,g) :: Q)).
  { destruct (proj1 (@uniq_app_iff grade R ((x,g)::Q)) Hu) as [_ [H1 _]].
    exact H1. }
  assert (HuR : uniq R).
  { destruct (proj1 (@uniq_app_iff grade R ((x,g)::Q)) Hu) as [H1 _].
    exact H1. }
  assert (HuQ : uniq Q) by (inversion HuEnd; assumption).
  assert (Hrm : remove_ec x (R ++ (x,g) :: Q) = R ++ Q)
    by (apply remove_ec_binder_middle; assumption).
  assert (HuRQ : uniq (R ++ Q)).
  { rewrite <- Hrm. apply uniq_remove_ec. exact Hu. }
  assert (HyRQ : y \notin dom (R ++ Q)).
  { intro Hin. apply binds_In_inv in Hin as [h Hb].
    destruct (@binds_app_1 grade y h R Q Hb) as [HbR|HbQ].
    - exact (HyR (@binds_In grade y h R HbR)).
    - exact (HyQ (@binds_In grade y h Q HbQ)). }
  assert (HuEndY : uniq ((R ++ Q) ++ (y,g) :: nil))
    by (apply (@uniq_app_one grade (R++Q) y g HuRQ HyRQ)).

                             (R ++ (Q ++ (y,g) :: nil))).

  - exact Hperm.
  - exact HuEndY.

Lemma binds_binder_rename_other : forall (R Q:econtext) x y g v h,
  v <> x -> v <> y ->
  binds v h (R ++ (x,g) :: Q) ->
  binds v h (R ++ (y,g) :: Q).
Proof.
  induction R as [|(z,k) R' IH]; intros Q x y g v h Hvx Hvy Hb.
  - simpl in *. apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[E1 E2]|Hb].
    + subst. exfalso. apply Hvx. reflexivity.
    + apply binds_cons; [exact Hvy | exact Hb].
  - simpl in *. apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[E1 E2]|Hb].
    + subst. apply binds_cons_2; reflexivity.
    + apply binds_cons. apply (IH Q x y g v h Hvx Hvy Hb).
Qed.
