Lemma DefEq_Grade : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
  DefEq P psi a b -> Grade P psi a /\ Grade P psi b.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H using DefEq_mind
    with (P0 := fun (P:econtext) (psi phi0:grade) (a b:tm) (_:CDefEq P psi phi0 a b) =>
                 CGrade P psi phi0 a /\ CGrade P psi phi0 b).
  - (* Refl *) split; assumption.
  - (* Trans *) destruct IHDefEq1 as [Ha _]. destruct IHDefEq2 as [_ Hc]. split; assumption.
  - (* Sym *) destruct IHDefEq as [Ha Hb]. split; assumption.
  - (* Beta *) split; assumption.
  - (* Pi *)
    split.
    + apply (@G_Pi L P psi psi0 A1 B1).
      * exact (proj1 IHDefEq).
      * intros x Hx. exact (proj1 (H0 x Hx)).
    + apply (@G_Pi L P psi psi0 A2 B2).
      * exact (proj2 IHDefEq).
      * intros x Hx. exact (proj2 (H0 x Hx)).
  - (* Abs *)
    split.
    + apply (@G_Abs L P psi psi0 A1 b1).
      * intros x Hx. exact (proj1 (H x Hx)).
      * exact (proj1 IHDefEq).
    + apply (@G_Abs L P psi psi0 A2 b2).
      * intros x Hx. exact (proj2 (H x Hx)).
      * exact (proj2 IHDefEq).
  - (* App *)
    split.
    + apply (@G_App P psi b1 psi0 a1).
      * exact (proj1 IHDefEq).
      * exact (proj1 IHDefEq0).
    + apply (@G_App P psi b2 psi0 a2).
      * exact (proj2 IHDefEq).
      * exact (proj2 IHDefEq0).
  - (* PiFst *)
    destruct IHDefEq as [Hp1 Hp2]. split.
    + exact (@Grade_Pi_inv P psi psi0 A1 B1 Hp1).
    + exact (@Grade_Pi_inv P psi psi0 A2 B2 Hp2).
  - (* PiSnd *)
    destruct IHDefEq1 as [Hp1 Hp2]. destruct IHDefEq2 as [Ha1 Ha2].
    destruct (@Grade_Pi_body P psi psi0 A1 B1 Hp1) as [L1 HB1].
    destruct (@Grade_Pi_body P psi psi0 A2 B2 Hp2) as [L2 HB2].
    split.
    + destruct (atom_fresh (L1 \u (dom P \u fv_tm_tm B1))) as [x Hx].
      destruct (@fresh3_facts L1 P B1 x Hx) as [HL [Hdom Hfv]].
      exact (@Grade_body_subst P psi psi B1 x a1
               (@Grade_uniq P psi (a_Pi psi0 A1 B1) Hp1) Hdom (HB1 x HL)
               (fun _ => Ha1) (fun Hn => match Hn (grade_le_refl psi) with end) Hfv).
    + destruct (atom_fresh (L2 \u (dom P \u fv_tm_tm B2))) as [x Hx].
      destruct (@fresh3_facts L2 P B2 x Hx) as [HL [Hdom Hfv]].
      exact (@Grade_body_subst P psi psi B2 x a2
               (@Grade_uniq P psi (a_Pi psi0 A2 B2) Hp2) Hdom (HB2 x HL)
               (fun _ => Ha2) (fun Hn => match Hn (grade_le_refl psi) with end) Hfv).
  - (* WSigma *)
    split.
    + apply (@G_WSigma L P psi psi0 A1 B1).
      * exact (proj1 IHDefEq).
      * intros x Hx. exact (proj1 (H0 x Hx)).
    + apply (@G_WSigma L P psi psi0 A2 B2).
      * exact (proj2 IHDefEq).
      * intros x Hx. exact (proj2 (H0 x Hx)).
  - (* WSigmaFst *)
    destruct IHDefEq as [Hp1 Hp2]. split.
    + exact (@Grade_WSigma_inv P psi psi0 A1 B1 Hp1).
    + exact (@Grade_WSigma_inv P psi psi0 A2 B2 Hp2).
  - (* WSigmaSnd *)
    destruct IHDefEq as [Hp1 Hp2].
    destruct (@Grade_WSigma_body P psi psi0 A1 B1 Hp1) as [L1 HB1].
    destruct (@Grade_WSigma_body P psi psi0 A2 B2 Hp2) as [L2 HB2].
    split.
    + destruct (atom_fresh (L1 \u (dom P \u fv_tm_tm B1))) as [x Hx].
      destruct (@fresh3_facts L1 P B1 x Hx) as [HL [Hdom Hfv]].
      exact (@Grade_body_subst P psi psi B1 x a
               (@Grade_uniq P psi (a_WSigma psi0 A1 B1) Hp1) Hdom (HB1 x HL)
               (fun _ => g) (fun Hn => match Hn (grade_le_refl psi) with end) Hfv).
    + destruct (atom_fresh (L2 \u (dom P \u fv_tm_tm B2))) as [x Hx].
      destruct (@fresh3_facts L2 P B2 x Hx) as [HL [Hdom Hfv]].
      exact (@Grade_body_subst P psi psi B2 x a
               (@Grade_uniq P psi (a_WSigma psi0 A2 B2) Hp2) Hdom (HB2 x HL)
               (fun _ => g) (fun Hn => match Hn (grade_le_refl psi) with end) Hfv).
  - (* WPair *)

    + apply (@G_WPair P psi a1 psi0 b1).
      * exact (proj1 IHDefEq).
      * exact (proj1 IHDefEq0).
    + apply (@G_WPair P psi a2 psi0 b2).
      * exact (proj2 IHDefEq).
      * exact (proj2 IHDefEq0).
  - (* LetPair *)
    split.
    + apply (@G_LetPair L P psi psi0 a1 b1).
      * exact (proj1 IHDefEq).
      * intros x Hx. exact (proj1 (H0 x Hx)).
    + apply (@G_LetPair L P psi psi0 a2 b2).
      * exact (proj2 IHDefEq).
      * intros x Hx. exact (proj2 (H0 x Hx)).

      * intros x Hx. exact (proj1 (H0 x Hx)).
    + apply (@G_SSigma L P psi psi0 A2 B2).
      * exact (proj2 IHDefEq).
      * intros x Hx. exact (proj2 (H0 x Hx)).
  - (* SSigmaFst *)

    + exact (@Grade_SSigma_inv P psi psi0 A1 B1 Hp1).
    + exact (@Grade_SSigma_inv P psi psi0 A2 B2 Hp2).

    destruct IHDefEq1 as [Hp1 Hp2]. destruct IHDefEq2 as [Ha1 Ha2].
    destruct (@Grade_SSigma_body P psi psi0 A1 B1 Hp1) as [L1 HB1].
    destruct (@Grade_SSigma_body P psi psi0 A2 B2 Hp2) as [L2 HB2].
    split.
    + destruct (atom_fresh (L1 \u (dom P \u fv_tm_tm B1))) as [x Hx].
      destruct (@fresh3_facts L1 P B1 x Hx) as [HL [Hdom Hfv]].
      exact (@Grade_body_subst P psi psi B1 x a1
               (@Grade_uniq P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A1 B1) Hp1) Hdom (HB1 x HL)
               (fun _ => Ha1) (fun Hn => match Hn (grade_le_refl psi) with end) Hfv).
    + destruct (atom_fresh (L2 \u (dom P \u fv_tm_tm B2))) as [x Hx].
      destruct (@fresh3_facts L2 P B2 x Hx) as [HL [Hdom Hfv]].
      exact (@Grade_body_subst P psi psi B2 x a2
               (@Grade_uniq P psi (a_SSigma psi0 A2 B2) Hp2) Hdom (HB2 x HL)
               (fun _ => Ha2) (fun Hn => match Hn (grade_le_refl psi) with end) Hfv).
  - (* SPair *)

Inductive Steps : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
| Steps_refl : forall a, Steps a a
| Steps_step : forall a b c, Step a b -> Steps b c -> Steps a c.

(* ---------- deep invariant (reduction-aware, inductive carrier) ---------- *)
Inductive Deep (P:econtext) (phi:grade) : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
| Deep_Type : forall s, Deep P phi (a_Type s) (a_Type s)
| Deep_Unit : Deep P phi a_TyUnit a_TyUnit
| Deep_Pi : forall psi A1 B1 A2 B2,
    Deep P phi A1 A2 ->
    (forall x, Deep ((x~phi)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x))) ->
    Deep P phi (a_Pi psi A1 B1) (a_Pi psi A2 B2)

    Deep P phi A1 A2 ->
    (forall x, Deep ((x~phi)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x))) ->
    Deep P phi (a_WSigma psi A1 B1) (a_WSigma psi A2 B2)

Lemma Par_VtTag_form : forall (P:econtext) (phi:grade) (a b:tm),
  Par P phi a b -> forall t, VtTag t a -> VtTag t b.
Proof.
  intros P phi a b H. induction H; intros t HT;
    try solve [exfalso; inversion HT];
    try solve [inversion HT; econstructor];
    assumption.
Qed.
Arguments Par_VtTag_form : clear implicits.
Arguments Par_VtTag_form P phi a b _ _ _.

Lemma MultiPar_VtTag : forall (P:econtext) (phi:grade) (a b:tm),
  MultiPar P phi a b -> forall t, VtTag t a -> VtTag t b.
Proof.
  intros P phi a b H. induction H; intros t HT.
  - exact HT.
  - apply IHMultiPar. exact (Par_VtTag_form _ _ _ _ H t HT).
Qed.
Arguments MultiPar_VtTag : clear implicits.
Arguments MultiPar_VtTag P phi a b _ _ _.

Lemma MultiPar_VT : forall (P:econtext) (phi:grade) (a b:tm),
  MultiPar P phi a b -> ValueType a -> VtTag a b.
Proof.
  intros P phi a b H HVT. exact (MultiPar_VtTag _ _ _ _ H a (VtTag_refl HVT)).
Qed.
Arguments MultiPar_VT : clear implicits.
Arguments MultiPar_VT P phi a b _ _.

Lemma GEq_VtTag_form : forall (P:econtext) (phi:grade) (a b:tm),
  GEq P phi a b -> forall t, VtTag t a -> VtTag t b.
Proof.
  intros P phi a b H. induction H; intros t HT;
    try solve [exfalso; inversion HT];
    try solve [inversion HT; econstructor];
    assumption.
Qed.
Arguments GEq_VtTag_form : clear implicits.
Arguments GEq_VtTag_form P phi a b _ _ _.

(* ---------- Joins imply consistency ---------- *)
Lemma Joins_Consistent : forall (P:econtext) (phi:grade) (a b:tm),
  Joins P phi a b -> lc_tm a -> lc_tm b -> Consistent a b.
Proof.
  intros P phi a b H Ha Hb. destruct H as [P0 psi a1 a2 b1 b2 Mp1 Mp2 Ge].
  apply Consistent_total; [exact Ha | exact Hb |].
  intros VTa VTb.
  pose proof (MultiPar_VT P0 psi a1 b1 Mp1 VTa) as H1.
  pose proof (MultiPar_VT P0 psi a2 b2 Mp2 VTb) as H2.
  pose proof (GEq_VtTag_form P0 psi b1 b2 Ge a1 H1) as H3.
  apply VtTag_trans with b2; [exact H3 | apply VtTag_sym; exact H2].
Qed.

Lemma ValueType_no_step : forall a, ValueType a -> forall b, ~ Step a b.
Proof.
  intros a H; induction H; intros b S; inversion S.
Qed.

Lemma Value_no_step : forall a, Value a -> forall b, ~ Step a b.
Proof.
  intros a H; induction H; intros y S.
  - exact (ValueType_no_step H S).
  - inversion S.
  - inversion S.
  - inversion S.
  - inversion S.
  - inversion S.
  - inversion S.
Qed.

Lemma Steps_value : forall a b, Value a -> Steps a b -> a = b.
Proof.
  intros a b Hv H; induction H.
  - reflexivity.
  - exfalso. eapply Value_no_step; eauto.
Qed.


(* ================= Stage 15: steps from a common source are linearly ordered ================= *)
Lemma Steps_join : forall a b, Steps a b -> forall c, Steps a c -> Steps b c \/ Steps c b.
Proof.
  intros a b H. induction H as [a | a x b Hs Hrest IH]; intros c Hc.
  - left. exact Hc.
  - inversion Hc; subst.
    + right. eapply Steps_step; [exact Hs | exact Hrest].
    + assert (x = b0) as E by (eapply step_det; eassumption); subst.
      apply (IH c H0).
Qed.


(* ================= Stage 16: consistency when a side is not a value type ================= *)
Lemma Consistent_of_not_value : forall a b, lc_tm a -> lc_tm b ->
  (~ ValueType a \/ ~ ValueType b) -> Consistent a b.
Proof.
  intros a b Ha Hb [Hna|Hnb].
  - apply Consistent_a_Step_R; assumption.
  - apply Consistent_a_Step_L; assumption.
Qed.


(* ================= Stage 17: unique value endpoint of a reduction ================= *)
Lemma Steps_value_unique : forall a b, Steps a b -> Value b ->
  forall c, Steps a c -> Value c -> b = c.
Proof.
  intros a b Hb Hvb c Hc Hvc.
  destruct (@Steps_join a b Hb c Hc) as [Hbc|Hcb].
  - eapply (@Steps_value b c); [exact Hvb | exact Hbc].
  - symmetry. eapply (@Steps_value c b); [exact Hvc | exact Hcb].
Qed.

Lemma Steps_VT_unique : forall a b, Steps a b -> ValueType b ->
  forall c, Steps a c -> ValueType c -> b = c.
Proof.
  intros. eapply Steps_value_unique;
    [exact H | apply V_ValueType; exact H0 | exact H1 | apply V_ValueType; exact H2].
Qed.


(* ================= Stage 18: Steps is transitive ================= *)
Lemma Steps_trans : forall a b, Steps a b -> forall c, Steps b c -> Steps a c.
Proof.
  intros a b H. induction H as [a | a x b Hs Hrest IH]; intros c Hc.
  - exact Hc.
  - eapply Steps_step; [exact Hs | apply IH; exact Hc].
Qed.


(* ================= Stage 19: Steps preserves Grade ================= *)
Lemma Steps_Grade : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
  Steps a b -> Grade P psi a -> Grade P psi b.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H as [a | a x b Hs Hrest IH]; intros Ha.
  - exact Ha.
  - apply IH. apply (Step_Grade Hs Ha).
Qed.

Require Import Qual.geq.
Require Import Qual.defeq.
Require Import Base3.
Require Import BinderRename.
Require Import BinderRename2.
From Stdlib Require Import List Permutation.
From Stdlib Require Import Lia.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Open Scope grade_scope.

Lemma close_open_id_gen : forall (B:tm) (k:nat) (z:atom),
  z \notin fv_tm_tm B ->
  close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k z (open_tm_wrt_tm_rec k (a_Var_f z) B) = B.
Proof.
  induction B as
    [| |psi A IHA B IHB |psi A IHA b IHb |a IHa psi b IHb |sq |m |y |A1 IHA1 A2 IHA2 |a IHa |a IHa
    |psi a IHa b1 IHb1 b2 IHb2 |psi A IHA B IHB |a IHa psi b IHb |psi a IHa b IHb
    |psi A IHA B IHB |a IHa psi b IHb |psi a IHa |psi a IHa ];
    intros k z Hz; simpl in *.
  - reflexivity. - reflexivity.
  - f_equal.
    + apply IHA. apply (@notin_union_l (fv_tm_tm A) (fv_tm_tm B) z). exact Hz.
    + apply IHB. apply (@notin_union_r (fv_tm_tm A) (fv_tm_tm B) z). exact Hz.
  - f_equal.
    + apply IHA. apply (@notin_union_l (fv_tm_tm A) (fv_tm_tm b) z). exact Hz.
    + apply IHb. apply (@notin_union_r (fv_tm_tm A) (fv_tm_tm b) z). exact Hz.
  - f_equal.
    + apply IHa. apply (@notin_union_l (fv_tm_tm a) (fv_tm_tm b) z). exact Hz.
    + apply IHb. apply (@notin_union_r (fv_tm_tm a) (fv_tm_tm b) z). exact Hz.
  - reflexivity.
  - (* Var_b *) destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec m k) as [[Hlt|Heq]|Hgt]; simpl.
    + destruct (lt_ge_dec m k) as [Hle|Hnle]; [reflexivity | exfalso; lia].
    + subst m. simpl.
      match goal with
      | |- context [@CoqEqDec.eq_dec tmvar ?I z z] =>
          destruct (@CoqEqDec.eq_dec tmvar I z z) as [E|E]
      end.
      * reflexivity.
      * exfalso; apply E; reflexivity.
    + destruct (lt_ge_dec (m-1) k) as [Hle|Hnle].
      * exfalso; lia.
      * f_equal. lia.
  - (* Var_f y *) simpl.
    match goal with
    | |- context [@CoqEqDec.eq_dec tmvar ?I z y] =>
        destruct (@CoqEqDec.eq_dec tmvar I z y) as [E|E]
    end.
    + exfalso. apply Hz. simpl. subst y. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2. reflexivity.
    + reflexivity.
  - (* Sum *) f_equal.
    + apply IHA1. apply (@notin_union_l (fv_tm_tm A1) (fv_tm_tm A2) z). exact Hz.
    + apply IHA2. apply (@notin_union_r (fv_tm_tm A1) (fv_tm_tm A2) z). exact Hz.
  - (* Inj1 *) f_equal. apply IHa. exact Hz.
  - (* Inj2 *) f_equal. apply IHa. exact Hz.
  - (* Case *) f_equal.
    + apply IHa. intro H; apply Hz; simpl; apply AtomSetImpl.union_2; exact H.
    + apply IHb1. intro H; apply Hz; simpl; apply AtomSetImpl.union_3; apply AtomSetImpl.union_2; exact H.
    + apply IHb2. intro H; apply Hz; simpl; apply AtomSetImpl.union_3; apply AtomSetImpl.union_3; exact H.
  - (* WSigma *) f_equal.
    + apply IHA. apply (@notin_union_l (fv_tm_tm A) (fv_tm_tm B) z). exact Hz.
    + apply IHB. apply (@notin_union_r (fv_tm_tm A) (fv_tm_tm B) z). exact Hz.
  - (* WPair *) f_equal.
    + apply IHa. apply (@notin_union_l (fv_tm_tm a) (fv_tm_tm b) z). exact Hz.
    + apply IHb. apply (@notin_union_r (fv_tm_tm a) (fv_tm_tm b) z). exact Hz.
  - (* LetPair *) f_equal.
    + apply IHa. apply (@notin_union_l (fv_tm_tm a) (fv_tm_tm b) z). exact Hz.
    + apply IHb. apply (@notin_union_r (fv_tm_tm a) (fv_tm_tm b) z). exact Hz.
  - (* SSigma *) f_equal.
    + apply IHA. apply (@notin_union_l (fv_tm_tm A) (fv_tm_tm B) z). exact Hz.
    + apply IHB. apply (@notin_union_r (fv_tm_tm A) (fv_tm_tm B) z). exact Hz.
  - (* SPair *) f_equal.
    + apply IHa. apply (@notin_union_l (fv_tm_tm a) (fv_tm_tm b) z). exact Hz.
    + apply IHb. apply (@notin_union_r (fv_tm_tm a) (fv_tm_tm b) z). exact Hz.
  - (* Proj1 *) f_equal. apply IHa. exact Hz.
  - (* Proj2 *) f_equal. apply IHa. exact Hz.
Qed.

Lemma close_open_id : forall (B:tm) z,
  z \notin fv_tm_tm B ->
  close_tm_wrt_tm z (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f z)) = B.
Proof. intros. apply (@close_open_id_gen B 0 z). assumption. Qed.

Lemma notin_fv_close_rec : forall (u:tm) (k:nat) z,
  z \notin fv_tm_tm (close_tm_wrt_tm_rec k z u).
Proof.
  induction u as
    [| |psi A IHA B IHB |psi A IHA b IHb |a IHa psi b IHb |sq |m |y |A1 IHA1 A2 IHA2 |a IHa |a IHa
    |psi a IHa b1 IHb1 b2 IHb2 |psi A IHA B IHB |a IHa psi b IHb |psi a IHa b IHb
    |psi A IHA B IHB |a IHa psi b IHb |psi a IHa |psi a IHa ];
    intros k z Hz; simpl in *.
  - exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 Hz).
  - exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 Hz).
  - apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in Hz as [HA|HB].
    + exact (IHA k z HA). + exact (IHB (S k) z HB).
  - apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in Hz as [HA|HB].
    + exact (IHA k z HA). + exact (IHb (S k) z HB).
  - apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in Hz as [HA|HB].
    + exact (IHa k z HA). + exact (IHb k z HB).
  - exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 Hz).
  - destruct (lt_ge_dec m k); simpl in *; exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 Hz).
  - revert Hz.
    match goal with
    | |- context [@CoqEqDec.eq_dec tmvar ?I z y] =>
        destruct (@CoqEqDec.eq_dec tmvar I z y) as [E|E]
    end; intros Hz.
    + simpl in Hz. exact (AtomSetImpl.empty_1 Hz).
    + simpl in Hz. apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_1 in Hz. apply E. symmetry. exact Hz.
  - apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in Hz as [HA|HB].
    + exact (IHA1 k z HA). + exact (IHA2 k z HB).
  - exact (IHa k z Hz).
  - exact (IHa k z Hz).
  - apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in Hz as [HA|HB].
    + exact (IHa k z HA).
    + apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in HB as [HB1|HB2].
      * exact (IHb1 k z HB1). * exact (IHb2 k z HB2).
  - apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in Hz as [HA|HB].
    + exact (IHA k z HA). + exact (IHB (S k) z HB).
  - apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in Hz as [HA|HB].
    + exact (IHa k z HA). + exact (IHb k z HB).
  - apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in Hz as [HA|HB].
    + exact (IHa k z HA). + exact (IHb (S k) z HB).
  - apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in Hz as [HA|HB].
    + exact (IHA k z HA). + exact (IHB (S k) z HB).
  - apply AtomSetImpl.union_1 in Hz as [HA|HB].
    + exact (IHa k z HA). + exact (IHb k z HB).
  - exact (IHa k z Hz).
  - exact (IHa k z Hz).
Qed.

Lemma notin_fv_close : forall (u:tm) z,
  z \notin fv_tm_tm (close_tm_wrt_tm z u).
Proof. intros. apply (@notin_fv_close_rec u 0 z). Qed.

Lemma rename_close_open : forall (u:tm) z y,
  z <> y -> lc_tm u ->
  rename_tm z y u = open_tm_wrt_tm (close_tm_wrt_tm z u) (a_Var_f y).
Proof.
  intros. symmetry. apply (@open_close_lc_at_rename u 0 z y H).
  apply lc_tm_lc_at_0. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_Pi_same_domain_intro : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade)
  (A B1 B2:tm) (L:vars),
  Grade P psi A ->
  (forall x, x \notin L ->
     MultiPar ((x,psi)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x))
                                  (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x))) ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_Pi psi0 A B1) (a_Pi psi0 A B2).
Proof.
  intros P psi psi0 A B1 B2 L GA HB.
  destruct (atom_fresh (L \u (dom P \u (fv_tm_tm B1 \u fv_tm_tm B2)))) as [z Hz].
  assert (HzL : z \notin L) by (apply (@notin_union_l L (dom P \u (fv_tm_tm B1 \u fv_tm_tm B2)) z); exact Hz).
  assert (HzD : z \notin dom P) by (apply (@notin_union_l (dom P) (fv_tm_tm B1 \u fv_tm_tm B2) z);
      apply (@notin_union_r L (dom P \u (fv_tm_tm B1 \u fv_tm_tm B2)) z); exact Hz).
  assert (HzB1 : z \notin fv_tm_tm B1) by (apply (@notin_union_l (fv_tm_tm B1) (fv_tm_tm B2) z);
      apply (@notin_union_r (dom P) (fv_tm_tm B1 \u fv_tm_tm B2) z);
      apply (@notin_union_r L (dom P \u (fv_tm_tm B1 \u fv_tm_tm B2)) z); exact Hz).
  assert (HzB2 : z \notin fv_tm_tm B2) by (apply (@notin_union_r (fv_tm_tm B1) (fv_tm_tm B2) z);
      apply (@notin_union_r (dom P) (fv_tm_tm B1 \u fv_tm_tm B2) z);
      apply (@notin_union_r L (dom P \u (fv_tm_tm B1 \u fv_tm_tm B2)) z); exact Hz).
  assert (Haux : forall (Pc:econtext), Pc = ((z,ps)::P) ->
      forall (t u:tm), MultiPar Pc ps t u ->
      forall B, z \notin fv_tm_tm B -> t = open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f z) ->
        MultiPar P ps (a_Pi psi0 A B) (a_Pi psi0 A (close_tm_wrt_tm z u))).
  { intros Pc EP t u Hmp. revert Pc EP.
    induction Hmp as [Pc ps w Hg | Pc ps s v w Hpar Htail IH];
      intros Pc0 EP B Hfv Et; subst Pc0.
    - (* Refl *) rewrite Et. rewrite (@close_open_id B z Hfv).
      apply MP_Refl. apply (@G_Pi (dom P \u {{z}}) P ps psi0 A B).
      + exact GA.
      + intros y Hy.
        assert (HyD : y \notin dom P) by (apply (@notin_union_l (dom P) {{z}} y); exact Hy).
        assert (Hyz : y <> z) by (apply (@neq_of_notin_singleton z y);
             apply (@notin_union_r (dom P) {{z}} y); exact Hy).
        assert (Hzy : z <> y) by (symmetry; exact Hyz).
        pose proof (@Grade_rename_binder_gen nil P z y ps Hzy
                      (fun H => AtomSetImpl.empty_1 H) HyD ps (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f z)) Hg) as Hyg.
        simpl in Hyg. unfold rename_tm in Hyg.
        rewrite (@subst_open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f y) z Hfv) in Hyg.
        exact Hyg.
    - (* Step *) subst s.
      set (B' := close_tm_wrt_tm z v).
      assert (HfvB' : z \notin fv_tm_tm B') by (subst B'; apply notin_fv_close).
      assert (Ev : v = open_tm_wrt_tm B' (a_Var_f z)).
      { subst B'. symmetry. apply (@open_close_lc_at v 0 z).
        apply lc_tm_lc_at_0. apply Grade_lc.
        exact (proj1 (@Par_Grade ((z,ps)::P) ps (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f z)) v Hpar)). }
      eapply MP_Step.
      + eapply (@Par_Pi (dom P \u {{z}}) P ps psi0 A B').
        * apply Par_Refl. exact GA.
        * intros y Hy.
          assert (HyD : y \notin dom P) by (apply (@notin_union_l (dom P) {{z}} y); exact Hy).
          assert (Hyz : y <> z) by (apply (@neq_of_notin_singleton z y);
               apply (@notin_union_r (dom P) {{z}} y); exact Hy).
          assert (Hzy : z <> y) by (symmetry; exact Hyz).
          assert (Hlcv : lc_tm v) by (apply Grade_lc;
              exact (proj2 (@Par_Grade ((z,ps)::P) ps (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f z)) v Hpar))).
          pose proof (@Par_rename_binder_gen nil P z y ps Hzy
                        (fun H => AtomSetImpl.empty_1 H) HyD ps
                        (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f z)) v Hpar) as HparY.
          simpl in HparY. unfold rename_tm in HparY.
          rewrite (@subst_open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f y) z Hfv) in HparY.
          rewrite (@rename_close_open v z y Hzy Hlcv) in HparY.
          exact HparY.
      + apply IH; [reflexivity | exact HfvB' | exact Ev].
  }
  pose proof (Haux ((z,ps)::P) (@Logic.eq_refl econtext ((z,ps)::P)) (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f z))
                (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f z)) (HB z HzL) B1 HzB1
                (@Logic.eq_refl tm (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f z)))) as Hres.
  rewrite (@close_open_id B2 z HzB2) in Hres.
  exact Hres.
Qed.

Require Import Qual.geq.
Require Import Qual.defeq.
Require Import Base3.
From Stdlib Require Import List Permutation.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Open Scope grade_scope.

Ltac fresh_from Hy :=
  match type of Hy with
  | ?y \notin (?L \u (?D \u {{?x}})) =>
      let HL := fresh "HL" in let HD := fresh "HD" in let Hx := fresh "Hx" in
      assert (HL : y \notin L) by (apply (@notin_union_l L (D \u {{x}}) y); exact Hy);
      assert (HD : y \notin D) by (apply (@notin_union_l D {{x}} y);
                                    apply (@notin_union_r L (D \u {{x}}) y); exact Hy);
      assert (Hx : y <> x) by (apply (@neq_of_notin_singleton x y);
                                 apply (@notin_union_r D {{x}} y);
                                 apply (@notin_union_r L (D \u {{x}}) y); exact Hy)
  end.

Lemma Grade_irrel_GEq_gen :
  forall (C:econtext) (psi:grade) (t:tm), Grade C psi t ->
  forall (x:atom) (psib:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
    uniq C -> binds x psib C -> ~ (psib <= psi) ->
    lc_tm a1 -> lc_tm a2 ->
    GEq (remove_ec x C) psi (subst_tm_tm a1 x t) (subst_tm_tm a2 x t).
Proof.
  intros C psi t H. induction H using Grade_mind
    with (P0 := fun (C:econtext) (psi phi0:grade) (t:tm) (_:CGrade C psi phi0 t) =>
      forall (x:atom) (psib:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
        uniq C -> binds x psib C -> ~ (psib <= psi) ->
        lc_tm a1 -> lc_tm a2 ->
        CEq (remove_ec x C) psi phi0 (subst_tm_tm a1 x t) (subst_tm_tm a2 x t)).
  all: intros xx pp aa bb Huu Hbb Hnn Hla Hlb.
  - (* G_Type *) simpl. apply GEq_Type. apply uniq_remove_ec. exact Huu.
  - (* G_Var *) simpl. destruct (CoqEqDec.eq_dec x xx) as [E|E].
    + subst x. exfalso. pose proof (@binds_unique grade xx pp psi0 P Hbb b Huu) as Heq.
      apply Hnn. rewrite Heq. exact i.
    + apply (@GEq_Var (remove_ec xx P) psi x psi0).
      * apply uniq_remove_ec. exact Huu.
      * apply (@binds_remove_ec_neq P xx x psi0); [exact E | exact b].
      * exact i.
  - (* G_Pi *) simpl.
    eapply (@GEq_Pi (L \u (dom P \u {{xx}})) (remove_ec xx P) psi psi0
             (subst_tm_tm aa xx A) (subst_tm_tm aa xx B)
             (subst_tm_tm bb xx A) (subst_tm_tm bb xx B)).
    + exact (IHGrade xx pp aa bb Huu Hbb Hnn Hla Hlb).
    + intros y Hy. fresh_from Hy.
      assert (Huy : uniq ((y,psi)::P)).
      { apply uniq_push; assumption. }
      assert (Hby : binds xx pp ((y,psi)::P)).
      { apply binds_cons. exact Hbb. }
      pose proof (H0 y HL xx pp aa bb Huy Hby Hnn Hla Hlb) as Hres.
      rewrite (@remove_ec_head_neq_not xx y psi P Hx) in Hres.
      rewrite (@subst_open_comm0 B xx aa y Hla Hx) in Hres.
      rewrite (@subst_open_comm0 B xx bb y Hlb Hx) in Hres.
      exact Hres.
  - (* G_Abs *) simpl.
    eapply (@GEq_Abs (L \u (dom P \u {{xx}})) (remove_ec xx P) psi psi0
             (subst_tm_tm aa xx A) (subst_tm_tm aa xx b)
             (subst_tm_tm bb xx A) (subst_tm_tm bb xx b)).
    + intros y Hy. fresh_from Hy.
      assert (Huy : uniq ((y,psi0)::P)).
      { apply uniq_push; assumption. }
      assert (Hby : binds xx pp ((y,psi0)::P)).
      { apply binds_cons. exact Hbb. }
      pose proof (H y HL xx pp aa bb Huy Hby Hnn Hla Hlb) as Hres.
      rewrite (@remove_ec_head_neq_not xx y psi0 P Hx) in Hres.
      rewrite (@subst_open_comm0 b xx aa y Hla Hx) in Hres.
      rewrite (@subst_open_comm0 b xx bb y Hlb Hx) in Hres.
      exact Hres.
    + exact (IHGrade xx pp aa bb Huu Hbb Hnn Hla Hlb).
  - (* G_App *) simpl. eapply GEq_App.
    + exact (IHGrade xx pp aa bb Huu Hbb Hnn Hla Hlb).
    + exact (IHGrade0 xx pp aa bb Huu Hbb Hnn Hla Hlb).
  - (* G_WSigma *) simpl.
    eapply (@GEq_WSigma (L \u (dom P \u {{xx}})) (remove_ec xx P) psi psi0
             (subst_tm_tm aa xx A) (subst_tm_tm aa xx B)
             (subst_tm_tm bb xx A) (subst_tm_tm bb xx B)).
    + exact (IHGrade xx pp aa bb Huu Hbb Hnn Hla Hlb).
    + intros y Hy. fresh_from Hy.
      assert (Huy : uniq ((y,psi)::P)).
      { apply uniq_push; assumption. }
      assert (Hby : binds xx pp ((y,psi)::P)).
      { apply binds_cons. exact Hbb. }
      pose proof (H0 y HL xx pp aa bb Huy Hby Hnn Hla Hlb) as Hres.
      rewrite (@remove_ec_head_neq_not xx y psi P Hx) in Hres.
      rewrite (@subst_open_comm0 B xx aa y Hla Hx) in Hres.
      rewrite (@subst_open_comm0 B xx bb y Hlb Hx) in Hres.
      exact Hres.
  - (* G_WPair *) simpl. eapply GEq_WPair.
    + exact (IHGrade xx pp aa bb Huu Hbb Hnn Hla Hlb).

Lemma MultiPar_Pi_decomp : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
  MultiPar P psi a b ->
  forall psi0 A1 B1, a = a_Pi psi0 A1 B1 ->
  exists A1' B1', b = a_Pi psi0 A1' B1' /\
    MultiPar P psi A1 A1' /\
    exists L, forall x, x \notin L ->
      MultiPar ((x,psi)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x))
                                        (open_tm_wrt_tm B1' (a_Var_f x)).
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H as [P psi a Ha | P psi a a' b Hpar Hmp IH];
    intros psi0 A1 B1 EQ; subst a.
  - (* MP_Refl *)
    destruct (@Grade_Pi_body P psi psi0 A1 B1 Ha) as [Lbody HB].
    exists A1, B1. split.
    + reflexivity.
    + split.
      * apply MP_Refl. exact (@Grade_Pi_inv P psi psi0 A1 B1 Ha).
      * exists Lbody. intros x Hx. apply MP_Refl. exact (HB x Hx).
  - (* MP_Step *)
    inversion Hpar; subst.
    + (* Par_Refl *)
      apply (IH psi0 A1 B1 (@Logic.eq_refl tm (a_Pi psi0 A1 B1))).
    + (* Par_Pi *)
      match goal with
      | HpA : Par P psi A1 ?A2,
        HpB : forall x, x \notin ?L -> Par _ psi
                (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm ?B2 (a_Var_f x)) |- _ =>
          destruct (IH psi0 A2 B2 (@Logic.eq_refl tm (a_Pi psi0 A2 B2)))
            as [A2' [B2' [Eb [MpA MpB]]]];
          destruct MpB as [L2 HB2];
          exists A2', B2'; split; [exact Eb | split];
          [ eapply MP_Step; [exact HpA | exact MpA] |
            exists (L \u L2); intros x Hx; eapply MP_Step;
            [ exact (HpB x (@notin_union_l L L2 x Hx)) |
              exact (HB2 x (@notin_union_r L L2 x Hx)) ] ]
      end.

Require Import Qual.geq.
Require Import Qual.defeq.
Require Import Base3.

From Stdlib Require Import List Permutation.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Open Scope grade_scope.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Renaming a *bound econtext binder*: source context
   R ++ (x,g) :: Q, target context R ++ (y,g) :: Q.
   Unlike Grade_rename, the renamed atom is in the context.      *)
(* ============================================================ *)

Lemma remove_ec_binder_middle : forall (R Q:econtext) x g,
  x \notin dom R -> x \notin dom Q ->
  remove_ec x (R ++ (x,g) :: Q) = R ++ Q.
Proof.
  induction R as [|(z,h) R' IH]; intros Q x g HxR HxQ.
  - change (remove_ec x ((x,g) :: Q) = Q). apply remove_ec_head_eq.
  - assert (Hzx : z <> x).
    { intro E. subst z. apply HxR. apply AtomSetImpl.add_1. reflexivity. }
    change (remove_ec x ((z,h) :: (R' ++ (x,g) :: Q)) =
            (z,h) :: (R' ++ Q)).
    rewrite (@remove_ec_head_neq x z h (R' ++ (x,g) :: Q) Hzx).
    rewrite IH.
    + reflexivity.
    + intro Hin. apply HxR. apply AtomSetImpl.add_2. exact Hin.
    + exact HxQ.
Qed.

Lemma uniq_binder_rename : forall (R:econtext) x y g Q,
  uniq (R ++ (x,g) :: Q) ->
  x <> y ->
  y \notin dom R ->
  y \notin dom Q ->
  uniq (R ++ (y,g) :: Q).
Proof.
  intros R x y g Q Hu Hxy HyR HyQ.
  assert (HuEnd : uniq ((x,g) :: Q)).
  { destruct (proj1 (@uniq_app_iff grade R ((x,g)::Q)) Hu) as [_ [H1 _]].
    exact H1. }
  assert (HuR : uniq R).
  { destruct (proj1 (@uniq_app_iff grade R ((x,g)::Q)) Hu) as [H1 _].
    exact H1. }
  assert (HuQ : uniq Q) by (inversion HuEnd; assumption).
  assert (HxR : x \notin dom R).
  { destruct (proj1 (@uniq_app_iff grade R ((x,g)::Q)) Hu) as [_ [_ HdR]].
    assert (HdR' : disjoint ((x,g) :: Q) R) by exact (disjoint_sym_1 grade grade R ((x,g)::Q) HdR).
    exact (proj1 (proj1 (@disjoint_cons_l grade grade x g Q R) HdR')). }
  assert (HxQ : x \notin dom Q) by (inversion HuEnd; assumption).
  assert (Hrm : remove_ec x (R ++ (x,g) :: Q) = R ++ Q)
    by (apply remove_ec_binder_middle; assumption).
  assert (HuRQ : uniq (R ++ Q)).
  { rewrite <- Hrm. apply uniq_remove_ec. exact Hu. }
  assert (HyRQ : y \notin dom (R ++ Q)).
  { intro Hin. apply binds_In_inv in Hin as [h Hb].
    destruct (@binds_app_1 grade y h R Q Hb) as [HbR|HbQ].
    - exact (HyR (@binds_In grade y h R HbR)).
    - exact (HyQ (@binds_In grade y h Q HbQ)). }
  assert (HuEndY0 : uniq ((R ++ Q) ++ (y,g) :: nil))
    by (apply (@uniq_app_one grade (R++Q) y g HuRQ HyRQ)).
  rewrite <- app_assoc in HuEndY0.
  assert (HuEndY : uniq (R ++ Q ++ (y,g) :: nil)) by exact HuEndY0.
  assert (Hperm : Permutation (R ++ (y,g) :: Q)
                             (R ++ (Q ++ (y,g) :: nil))).
  { apply Permutation_app; [apply Permutation_refl | apply Permutation_cons_append]. }
  exact (@uniq_perm grade (R ++ (Q ++ (y,g) :: nil)) (R ++ (y,g) :: Q)
           (Permutation_sym Hperm) HuEndY).
Qed.

Lemma uniq_middle_left_notin : forall (R Q:econtext) x g,
  uniq (R ++ (x,g) :: Q) -> x \notin dom R.
Proof.
  intros R Q x g Hu.
  destruct (proj1 (@uniq_app_iff grade R ((x,g)::Q)) Hu) as [_ [_ HdR]].
  assert (HdR' : disjoint ((x,g) :: Q) R) by exact (disjoint_sym_1 grade grade R ((x,g)::Q) HdR).
  exact (proj1 (proj1 (@disjoint_cons_l grade grade x g Q R) HdR')).
Qed.

Lemma uniq_middle_right_notin : forall (R Q:econtext) x g,
  uniq (R ++ (x,g) :: Q) -> x \notin dom Q.
Proof.
  intros R Q x g Hu.
  assert (HuEnd : uniq ((x,g) :: Q)).
  { destruct (proj1 (@uniq_app_iff grade R ((x,g)::Q)) Hu) as [_ [H1 _]]. exact H1. }
  inversion HuEnd. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma binds_binder_rename_other : forall (R Q:econtext) x y g v h,
  v <> x -> v <> y ->
  binds v h (R ++ (x,g) :: Q) ->
  binds v h (R ++ (y,g) :: Q).
Proof.
  induction R as [|(z,k) R' IH]; intros Q x y g v h Hvx Hvy Hb.
  - simpl in *. apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[E1 E2]|Hb].
    + subst. exfalso. apply Hvx. reflexivity.
    + apply binds_cons; exact Hb.
  - simpl in *. apply binds_cons_1 in Hb as [[E1 E2]|Hb].
    + subst. apply binds_cons_2; reflexivity.
    + apply binds_cons. apply (IH Q x y g v h Hvx Hvy Hb).
Qed.

Lemma binds_binder_rename_x : forall (R Q:econtext) y g,
  binds y g (R ++ (y,g) :: Q).
Proof.
  intros. apply (@binds_app_r grade y g R ((y,g)::Q)).
  apply (@binds_cons_2 grade y y g g Q (@Logic.eq_refl atom y) (@Logic.eq_refl grade g)).
Qed.

Lemma Grade_rename_binder_gen : forall (R Q:econtext) x y g,
  x <> y ->
  y \notin dom R ->
  y \notin dom Q ->
  forall (psi:grade) (a:tm),
    Grade (R ++ (x,g) :: Q) psi a ->
    Grade (R ++ (y,g) :: Q) psi (rename_tm x y a).
Proof.
  intros R Q x y g Hxy HyR HyQ psi a H.
  remember (R ++ (x,g) :: Q) as P eqn:EP.
  revert R Q g EP HyR HyQ.
  induction H using Grade_mind
    with (P0 := fun (P:econtext) (psi phi0:grade) (u:tm) (_:CGrade P psi phi0 u) =>
                 forall (R Q:econtext) g,
                   P = R ++ (x,g) :: Q ->
                   y \notin dom R ->
                   y \notin dom Q ->
                   CGrade (R ++ (y,g) :: Q) psi phi0 (rename_tm x y u)).
  all: intros R0 Q0 g0 EP0 HyR0 HyQ0; unfold rename_tm; simpl.
  - (* G_Type *) subst. eapply G_Type.
    exact (@uniq_binder_rename R0 x y g0 Q0 u Hxy HyR0 HyQ0).
  - (* G_Var *) subst. simpl. destruct (CoqEqDec.eq_dec x0 x) as [E|E].
    + subst x0. assert (Heq : psi0 = g0).
      { eapply (@binds_unique grade x psi0 g0 (R0 ++ (x,g0) :: Q0)).
====
Lemma Par_rename_binder_gen : forall (R Q:econtext) x y g,
  x <> y ->
  y \notin dom R ->
  y \notin dom Q ->
  forall (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
    Par (R ++ (x,g) :: Q) psi a b ->
    Par (R ++ (y,g) :: Q) psi (rename_tm x y a) (rename_tm x y b).
Proof.
  intros R Q x y g Hxy HyR HyQ psi a b H.
  remember (R ++ (x,g) :: Q) as Pc eqn:EP.
  revert R Q g EP HyR HyQ.
  induction H using Par_mind
    with (P0 := fun (Pc:econtext) (psig phi0:grade) (u v:tm) (_:CPar Pc psig phi0 u v) =>
                 forall (R Q:econtext) g,
                   Pc = R ++ (x,g) :: Q ->
                   y \notin dom R ->
                   y \notin dom Q ->
                   CPar (R ++ (y,g) :: Q) psig phi0 (rename_tm x y u) (rename_tm x y v)).
  all: intros R0 Q0 gr EP0 HyR0 HyQ0; subst; unfold rename_tm; simpl.
  - (* Refl *) apply Par_Refl.
    exact (@Grade_rename_binder_gen R0 Q0 x y gr Hxy HyR0 HyQ0 psi a g).
  - (* Pi *) eapply (@Par_Pi (L \u ({{x}} \u {{y}})) (R0 ++ (y,gr) :: Q0) psi psi1
                            (rename_tm x y A1) (rename_tm x y B1)
                            (rename_tm x y A2) (rename_tm x y B2)).
    + apply IHPar; [reflexivity|exact HyR0|exact HyQ0].
    + intros z Hz.
      assert (HzL : z \notin L) by (apply (@notin_union_l L ({{x}} \u {{y}}) z); exact Hz).
      assert (Hzxy : z \notin ({{x}} \u {{y}})) by (apply (@notin_union_r L ({{x}} \u {{y}}) z); exact Hz).
      assert (Hzx : z <> x) by (intro E; apply Hzxy; apply AtomSetImpl.union_2; subst; apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2; reflexivity).
      assert (Hzy : z <> y) by (intro E; apply Hzxy; apply AtomSetImpl.union_3; subst; apply AtomSetImpl.singleton_2; reflexivity).
      assert (HyRz : y \notin dom ((z,psi)::R0))
        by (apply (@notin_dom_cons grade z psi R0 y); [symmetry; exact Hzy | exact HyR0]).
      assert (EPz : (z,psi)::(R0 ++ (x,gr)::Q0) = ((z,psi)::R0) ++ (x,gr)::Q0).
      { reflexivity. }
      specialize (H0 z HzL ((z,psi)::R0) Q0 gr EPz HyRz HyQ0).
      unfold rename_tm in H0.
      rewrite (@subst_open_comm0 B1 x (a_Var_f y) z (lc_a_Var_f y) Hzx) in H0.
      rewrite (@subst_open_comm0 B2 x (a_Var_f y) z (lc_a_Var_f y) Hzx) in H0.
      exact H0.
  - (* AppBeta *)
    specialize (IHPar R0 Q0 gr (@Logic.eq_refl econtext (R0 ++ (x,gr)::Q0)) HyR0 HyQ0).
    specialize (IHPar0 R0 Q0 gr (@Logic.eq_refl econtext (R0 ++ (x,gr)::Q0)) HyR0 HyQ0).
    rewrite (@subst_open_term a' b' x y Hxy).
    eapply Par_AppBeta with (a' := rename_tm x y a') (b' := rename_tm x y b').
    + unfold rename_tm in IHPar. simpl in IHPar. exact IHPar.
    + exact IHPar0.
  - (* App *) eapply Par_App.
    + apply IHPar; [reflexivity|exact HyR0|exact HyQ0].
    + apply IHPar0; [reflexivity|exact HyR0|exact HyQ0].
====
Lemma MultiPar_rename_binder_gen : forall (R Q:econtext) x y g,
  x <> y ->
  y \notin dom R ->
  y \notin dom Q ->
  forall (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
    MultiPar (R ++ (x,g) :: Q) psi a b ->
    MultiPar (R ++ (y,g) :: Q) psi (rename_tm x y a) (rename_tm x y b).
Proof.
  intros R Q x y g Hxy HyR HyQ psi a b H.
  remember (R ++ (x,g) :: Q) as Pc eqn:EP.
  revert R Q g EP HyR HyQ.
  induction H as [Pc psig u Hu | Pc psig u v w Hpar Hmp IH];
    intros R Q g EP HyR HyQ; subst.
  - apply MP_Refl.
    exact (@Grade_rename_binder_gen R Q x y g Hxy HyR HyQ psig u Hu).
  - eapply MP_Step with (b := rename_tm x y w).
    + exact (@Par_rename_binder_gen R Q x y g Hxy HyR HyQ psig u w Hpar).
    + exact (IH R Q g (@Logic.eq_refl econtext (R ++ (x,g)::Q)) HyR HyQ).
Qed.

Lemma Par_Grade : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
  Par P psi a b -> Grade P psi a /\ Grade P psi b.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H using Par_mind
    with (P0 := fun (P:econtext) (psi phi0:grade) (a b:tm) (_:CPar P psi phi0 a b) =>
                 CGrade P psi phi0 a /\ CGrade P psi phi0 b).
  - (* Refl *) split; assumption.
  - (* Pi *)
    split.
    + apply (@G_Pi L P psi psi1 A1 B1).
      * exact (proj1 IHPar).
      * intros x Hx. exact (proj1 (H0 x Hx)).
    + apply (@G_Pi L P psi psi1 A2 B2).
      * exact (proj2 IHPar).
      * intros x Hx. exact (proj2 (H0 x Hx)).
  - (* AppBeta *)
    destruct IHPar as [Ha Habs]. destruct IHPar0 as [Hb1 Hb2].
    inversion Habs; subst.
    split.
    + apply (@G_App P psi a psi0 b). exact Ha. exact Hb1.
    + destruct (atom_fresh (L \u (dom P \u fv_tm_tm a'))) as [x Hx].
      destruct (@fresh3_facts L P a' x Hx) as [HL [Hdom Hfv]].
      exact (@Grade_open_arg P psi psi0 b' x a'
               (Grade_uniq P psi a Ha) Hdom (H4 x HL) Hb2 Hfv).
  - (* App *)
    split.
    + apply (@G_App P psi a psi0 b). exact (proj1 IHPar). exact (proj1 IHPar0).
    + apply (@G_App P psi a' psi0 b'). exact (proj2 IHPar). exact (proj2 IHPar0).
  - (* Abs *)
    split.
    + apply (@G_Abs L P psi psi0 A1 b1).
      * intros x Hx. exact (proj1 (H x Hx)).
      * exact (proj1 IHPar).
    + apply (@G_Abs L P psi psi0 A2 b2).
      * intros x Hx. exact (proj2 (H x Hx)).
      * exact (proj2 IHPar).
  - (* WSigma *)
    split.
    + apply (@G_WSigma L P psi psi1 A1 B1).
      * exact (proj1 IHPar).
      * intros x Hx. exact (proj1 (H0 x Hx)).
    + apply (@G_WSigma L P psi psi1 A2 B2).
      * exact (proj2 IHPar).
      * intros x Hx. exact (proj2 (H0 x Hx)).
  - (* WPair *)
    split.
    + apply (@G_WPair P psi a1 psi0 b1). exact (proj1 IHPar). exact (proj1 IHPar0).
    + apply (@G_WPair P psi a2 psi0 b2). exact (proj2 IHPar). exact (proj2 IHPar0).

Require Import Qual.geq.
Require Import Qual.defeq.
Require Import Base3.
Require Import BinderRename.
Require Import BinderRename2.
Require Import CloseOpen.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Open Scope grade_scope.

Lemma MPI_aux_gen : forall (C:econtext) (psi:grade) (t u:tm),
  MultiPar C psi t u ->
  forall (P:econtext) (z:atom) (psi0:grade) (A B:tm),
    C = ((z,psi)::P) ->
    Grade P psi A ->
    z \notin fv_tm_tm B ->
    t = open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f z) ->
    MultiPar P psi (a_Pi psi0 A B) (a_Pi psi0 A (close_tm_wrt_tm z u)).
Proof.
  intros C psi t u Hmp.
  induction Hmp as [C psi t Hg | C psi t v u Hpar Htail IH].
  - (* Refl *) intros P z psi0 A B EP GA Hfv Et.
    subst C. rewrite Et. rewrite (@close_open_id B z Hfv).
    apply MP_Refl. apply (@G_Pi (dom P \u {{z}}) P psi psi0 A B).
    + exact GA.
    + intros y Hy.
      assert (HyD : y \notin dom P) by (apply (@notin_union_l (dom P) {{z}} y); exact Hy).
      assert (Hyz : y <> z) by (apply (@neq_of_notin_singleton z y);
           apply (@notin_union_r (dom P) {{z}} y); exact Hy).
      assert (Hzy : z <> y) by (symmetry; exact Hyz).
      pose proof (@Grade_rename_binder_gen nil P z y psi Hzy
                    (fun H => AtomSetImpl.empty_1 H) HyD psi
                    (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f z)) Hg) as Hyg.
      simpl in Hyg. unfold rename_tm in Hyg.
      rewrite (@subst_open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f y) z Hfv) in Hyg.
      exact Hyg.
  - (* Step *) intros P z psi0 A B EP GA Hfv Et.
    subst C. subst t.
    set (B' := close_tm_wrt_tm z v).
    assert (HfvB' : z \notin fv_tm_tm B') by (subst B'; apply notin_fv_close).
    assert (Hlcv : lc_tm v) by (apply Grade_lc;
      exact (proj2 (@Par_Grade ((z,psi)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f z)) v Hpar))).
    assert (Ev : v = open_tm_wrt_tm B' (a_Var_f z)).
    { subst B'. symmetry. apply (@open_close_lc_at v 0 z). apply lc_tm_lc_at_0. exact Hlcv. }
    eapply MP_Step.
    + eapply (@Par_Pi (dom P \u {{z}}) P psi psi0 A B').
      * apply Par_Refl. exact GA.
      * intros y Hy.
        assert (HyD : y \notin dom P) by (apply (@notin_union_l (dom P) {{z}} y); exact Hy).
        assert (Hyz : y <> z) by (apply (@neq_of_notin_singleton z y);
             apply (@notin_union_r (dom P) {{z}} y); exact Hy).
        assert (Hzy : z <> y) by (symmetry; exact Hyz).
        pose proof (@Par_rename_binder_gen nil P z y psi Hzy
                      (fun H => AtomSetImpl.empty_1 H) HyD psi
                      (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f z)) v Hpar) as HparY.
        simpl in HparY. unfold rename_tm in HparY.
        rewrite (@subst_open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f y) z Hfv) in HparY.
        rewrite (@rename_close_open v z y Hzy Hlcv) in HparY.
        exact HparY.
    + exact (IH P z psi0 A B' EP GA HfvB' Ev).
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_Pi_same_domain_intro_ours : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade)
  (A B1 B2:tm) (L:vars),
  Grade P psi A ->
  (forall x, x \notin L ->
     MultiPar ((x,psi)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x))
                                  (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x))) ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_Pi psi0 A B1) (a_Pi psi0 A B2).
Proof.
  intros P psi psi0 A B1 B2 L GA HB.
  destruct (atom_fresh (L \u (dom P \u (fv_tm_tm B1 \u fv_tm_tm B2)))) as [z Hz].
  assert (HzL : z \notin L) by (apply (@notin_union_l L (dom P \u (fv_tm_tm B1 \u fv_tm_tm B2)) z); exact Hz).
  assert (HzB1 : z \notin fv_tm_tm B1) by (apply (@notin_union_l (fv_tm_tm B1) (fv_tm_tm B2) z);
      apply (@notin_union_r (dom P) (fv_tm_tm B1 \u fv_tm_tm B2) z);
      apply (@notin_union_r L (dom P \u (fv_tm_tm B1 \u fv_tm_tm B2)) z); exact Hz).
  assert (HzB2 : z \notin fv_tm_tm B2) by (apply (@notin_union_r (fv_tm_tm B1) (fv_tm_tm B2) z);
      apply (@notin_union_r (dom P) (fv_tm_tm B1 \u fv_tm_tm B2) z);
      apply (@notin_union_r L (dom P \u (fv_tm_tm B1 \u fv_tm_tm B2)) z); exact Hz).
  pose proof (@MPI_aux_gen ((z,psi)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f z))
                (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f z)) (HB z HzL) P z psi0 A B1
                (@Logic.eq_refl econtext ((z,psi)::P)) GA HzB1
                (@Logic.eq_refl tm (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f z)))) as Hres.
  rewrite (@close_open_id B2 z HzB2) in Hres.
  exact Hres.
Qed.
EOF

Require Import Qual.geq.
Require Import Qual.defeq.
Require Import Base3.
Require Import BinderRename.
Require Import BinderRename2.
Require Import CloseOpen.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Open Scope grade_scope.

Lemma MPI_aux_gen : forall (C:econtext) (psi:grade) (t u:tm),
  MultiPar C psi t u ->
  forall (P:econtext) (z:atom) (psi0:grade) (A B:tm),
    C = ((z,psi)::P) ->
    Grade P psi A ->
    z \notin fv_tm_tm B ->
    t = open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f z) ->
    MultiPar P psi (a_Pi psi0 A B) (a_Pi psi0 A (close_tm_wrt_tm z u)).
Proof.
  intros C psi t u Hmp.
  induction Hmp as [C psi t Hg | C psi t v u Hpar Htail IH].
  - (* Refl *) intros P z psi0 A B EP GA Hfv Et.
    subst C. subst t. rewrite (@close_open_id B z Hfv).
    apply MP_Refl. apply (@G_Pi (dom P \u {{z}}) P psi psi0 A B).
    + exact GA.
    + intros y Hy.
      assert (HyD : y \notin dom P) by (apply (@notin_union_l (dom P) {{z}} y); exact Hy).
      assert (Hyz : y <> z) by (apply (@neq_of_notin_singleton z y);
           apply (@notin_union_r (dom P) {{z}} y); exact Hy).
      assert (Hzy : z <> y) by (symmetry; exact Hyz).
      pose proof (@Grade_rename_binder_gen nil P z y psi Hzy
                    (fun H => AtomSetImpl.empty_1 H) HyD psi
                    (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f z)) Hg) as Hyg.
      simpl in Hyg. unfold rename_tm in Hyg.
      rewrite (@subst_open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f y) z Hfv) in Hyg.
      exact Hyg.
  - (* Step *) intros P z psi0 A B EP GA Hfv Et.
    subst C. subst t.
    set (B' := close_tm_wrt_tm z v).
    assert (HfvB' : z \notin fv_tm_tm B') by (subst B'; apply notin_fv_close).
    assert (Hlcv : lc_tm v) by
      exact (@Grade_lc ((z,psi)::P) psi v
              (proj2 (@Par_Grade ((z,psi)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f z)) v Hpar))).
    assert (Ev : v = open_tm_wrt_tm B' (a_Var_f z)).
    { subst B'. symmetry. apply (@open_close_lc_at v 0 z). apply lc_tm_lc_at_0. exact Hlcv. }
    eapply MP_Step.
    + eapply (@Par_Pi (dom P \u {{z}}) P psi psi0 A B').
      * apply Par_Refl. exact GA.
      * intros y Hy.
        assert (HyD : y \notin dom P) by (apply (@notin_union_l (dom P) {{z}} y); exact Hy).
        assert (Hyz : y <> z) by (apply (@neq_of_notin_singleton z y);
             apply (@notin_union_r (dom P) {{z}} y); exact Hy).
        assert (Hzy : z <> y) by (symmetry; exact Hyz).
        pose proof (@Par_rename_binder_gen nil P z y psi Hzy
                      (fun H => AtomSetImpl.empty_1 H) HyD psi
                      (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f z)) v Hpar) as HparY.
        simpl in HparY. unfold rename_tm in HparY.
        rewrite (@subst_open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f y) z Hfv) in HparY.
        rewrite (@rename_close_open v z y Hzy Hlcv) in HparY.
        exact HparY.
    + exact (IH P z psi0 A B' EP GA HfvB' Ev).
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_Pi_same_domain_intro_ours : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade)
  (A B1 B2:tm) (L:vars),
  Grade P psi A ->
  (forall x, x \notin L ->
     MultiPar ((x,psi)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x))
                                  (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x))) ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_Pi psi0 A B1) (a_Pi psi0 A B2).
Proof.
  intros P psi psi0 A B1 B2 L GA HB.
  destruct (atom_fresh (L \u (dom P \u (fv_tm_tm B1 \u fv_tm_tm B2)))) as [z Hz].
  assert (HzL : z \notin L) by (apply (@notin_union_l L (dom P \u (fv_tm_tm B1 \u fv_tm_tm B2)) z); exact Hz).
  assert (HzB1 : z \notin fv_tm_tm B1) by (apply (@notin_union_l (fv_tm_tm B1) (fv_tm_tm B2) z);
      apply (@notin_union_r (dom P) (fv_tm_tm B1 \u fv_tm_tm B2) z);
      apply (@notin_union_r L (dom P \u (fv_tm_tm B1 \u fv_tm_tm B2)) z); exact Hz).
  assert (HzB2 : z \notin fv_tm_tm B2) by (apply (@notin_union_r (fv_tm_tm B1) (fv_tm_tm B2) z);
      apply (@notin_union_r (dom P) (fv_tm_tm B1 \u fv_tm_tm B2) z);
      apply (@notin_union_r L (dom P \u (fv_tm_tm B1 \u fv_tm_tm B2)) z); exact Hz).
  pose proof (@MPI_aux_gen ((z,psi)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f z))
                (open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f z)) (HB z HzL) P z psi0 A B1
                (@Logic.eq_refl econtext ((z,psi)::P)) GA HzB1
                (@Logic.eq_refl tm (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f z)))) as Hres.
  rewrite (@close_open_id B2 z HzB2) in Hres.
  exact Hres.
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_Sum_fst_aux : forall (C:econtext) (g:grade) (a a':tm),
  MultiPar C g a a' ->
  forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (B:tm),
    C = P -> g = psi -> Grade P psi B ->

Proof.

    eapply MP_Step.
    + eapply (@Par_Sum P psi a a0 B B).
      * exact Hpar.
      * apply Par_Refl. exact HB.
    + apply (IH P psi B); [reflexivity | reflexivity | exact HB].
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_Sum_snd_aux : forall (C:econtext) (g:grade) (b b':tm),
  MultiPar C g b b' ->
  forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A:tm),
    C = P -> g = psi -> Grade P psi A ->
    MultiPar P psi (a_Sum A b) (a_Sum A b').
Proof.
  intros C g b b' H.
  induction H as [C g b Hb | C g b b0 b' Hpar Htail IH].
  - intros P psi A EC Eg HA. subst C. subst g.
    apply MP_Refl. apply (@G_Sum P psi A b). exact HA. exact Hb.
  - intros P psi A EC Eg HA. subst C. subst g.
    eapply MP_Step.
    + eapply (@Par_Sum P psi A A b b0).
      * apply Par_Refl. exact HA.
      * exact Hpar.
    + apply (IH P psi A); [reflexivity | reflexivity | exact HA].
Qed.

Lemma MultiPar_Sum_intro : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (A1 A2 B1 B2:tm),
  MultiPar P psi A1 A2 -> MultiPar P psi B1 B2 ->
  MultiPar P psi (a_Sum A1 B1) (a_Sum A2 B2).
Proof.
  intros P psi A1 A2 B1 B2 HA HB.
  pose proof (@MultiPar_Sum_fst_aux P psi A1 A2 HA P psi B1
                (@Logic.eq_refl econtext P) (@Logic.eq_refl grade psi)
                (proj1 (@MultiPar_Grade P psi B1 B2 HB))) as H1.
  pose proof (@MultiPar_Sum_snd_aux P psi B1 B2 HB P psi A2
                (@Logic.eq_refl econtext P) (@Logic.eq_refl grade psi)
                (proj2 (@MultiPar_Grade P psi A1 A2 HA))) as H2.

Inductive CPar : econtext -> grade -> grade -> tm -> tm -> Prop :=

      ( psi0  <=  psi )  ->
     Par P psi a1 a2 ->
     CPar P psi psi0 a1 a2
 | CPar_Nleq : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (a1 a2:tm),
     lc_tm a1 ->
     lc_tm a2 ->
      not (  (  ( psi0  <=  psi )  )  )  ->
      uniq  P  ->

     Grade P psi a ->

 | Par_Pi : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi1:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),
     Par P psi A1 A2 ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Par  (  ( x ~ psi )  ++ P )  psi  ( open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x) )   ( open_tm_wrt_tm B2 (a_Var_f x) )  )  ->

 | Par_AppBeta : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b a' b' A:tm),

 | Par_App : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b a' b':tm),

 | Par_SSigma : forall (L:vars) (P:econtext) (psi psi1:grade) (A1 B1 A2 B2:tm),

      uniq  P  ->

     CGrade P psi  q_Top  A ->

     Grade P psi b ->

     Grade P psi (a_WSigma psi0 A B)
 | G_WPair : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b:tm),
     CGrade P psi psi0 a ->

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Coq.Structures.Orders.

Require Import Stdlib.Init.Sumbool.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import ssreflect.

Module Type GradeSig.

Parameter grade : Set.

Parameter q_Top : grade.

Parameter q_Bot : grade.

Parameter q_C   : grade.

Parameter q_R   : grade.

Parameter q_eqb  : grade -> grade -> bool.

Parameter q_leb  : grade -> grade -> bool.

Parameter q_join : grade -> grade -> grade.

Parameter q_meet : grade -> grade -> grade.

Parameter q_eq   : grade -> grade.

Definition t := grade.

Definition eq := @Logic.eq grade.

Definition eqb  := q_eqb.

Parameter q_eq_dec : forall (A : grade) (B : grade), { A = B } + { not (A = B) }.

Parameter eqb_eq : forall (n m : grade), q_eqb n m = true <-> n = m.

Definition eq_equiv : Equivalence (@Logic.eq grade) := eq_equivalence.

Definition eq_dec := q_eq_dec.

Include BackportEq.

Definition leb  := q_leb.

Definition le n m := is_true (q_leb n m).

Definition q_lt n m := is_true (q_leb n m) /\ n <> m.

Definition size_grade : grade -> nat := fun _ => 1%nat.

Declare Scope grade_scope.

Bind Scope grade_scope with grade.

Local Open Scope grade_scope.

Infix "=?" := q_eqb (at level 70) : grade_scope.

Infix "<=?" := q_leb (at level 70) : grade_scope.

Notation "q1 <= q2" := (is_true (q_leb q1 q2)) (at level 70)  : grade_scope.

Notation "q1 < q2" := (q_lt q1 q2) (at level 70)  : grade_scope.

Notation "x * y"  := (q_join x y) : grade_scope.

Notation "x + y " := (q_meet x y)  : grade_scope.

Parameter join_assoc : forall a b c, a * (b * c) = (a * b) * c.

Parameter join_comm  : forall a b, a * b = b * a.

Parameter meet_assoc : forall a b c, a + (b + c) = (a + b) + c.

Parameter meet_comm : forall a b, a + b = b + a.

Parameter absorb_meet : forall a b, a * (a + b) = a.

Parameter absorb_join : forall a b, a + (a * b) = a.

Parameter join_idem : forall a, a * a = a.

Parameter meet_idem : forall psi, psi + psi = psi.

Parameter join_Top_r : forall a, a * q_Top = q_Top.

Parameter meet_Bot_r : forall a, a + q_Bot = q_Bot.

Parameter order_q_C_dec : forall q, { q <= q_C } + { q_C < q }.

Parameter leb_leq  : forall (n m : grade), (n <=? m) = true <-> n <= m.

Parameter join_leq : forall a b,  a <= b -> (a * b) = b.

Parameter leq_join : forall a b, (a * b) = b -> a <= b.

Parameter meet_leq : forall a b,  a <= b -> (a + b) = a.

Parameter leq_meet : forall a b, (a + b) = a -> a <= b.

End GradeSig.

Declare Module Grade : GradeSig.

Export Grade.

Section GradeFacts.

Local Open Scope grade_scope.

End GradeFacts.

Inductive R (P:econtext) (phi:grade) : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
| R_intro : forall (a b:tm),
    DefEq P phi a b ->
    Grade P phi a ->
    Grade P phi b ->
    lc_tm a ->
    lc_tm b ->
    (hasV a <-> hasV b) ->
    (forall (v w:tm), Value v -> Steps a v -> Value w -> Steps b w -> VM P phi v w) ->
    R P phi a b
with VM (P:econtext) (phi:grade) : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
| VM_Type : forall (s:sort), VM P phi (a_Type s) (a_Type s)
| VM_Unit : VM P phi a_TyUnit a_TyUnit
| VM_Pi : forall (psi0:grade) (A B A' B':tm),
    R P phi A A' ->
    (forall x:atom, R ((x~phi)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x))
                                         (open_tm_wrt_tm B' (a_Var_f x))) ->
    VM P phi (a_Pi psi0 A B) (a_Pi psi0 A' B')
| VM_WSigma : forall (psi0:grade) (A B A' B':tm),
    R P phi A A' ->
    (forall x:atom, R ((x~phi)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x))
                                         (open_tm_wrt_tm B' (a_Var_f x))) ->
    VM P phi (a_WSigma psi0 A B) (a_WSigma psi0 A' B')
| VM_SSigma : forall (psi0:grade) (A B A' B':tm),
    R P phi A A' ->
    (forall x:atom, R ((x~phi)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm B (a_Var_f x))
                                         (open_tm_wrt_tm B' (a_Var_f x))) ->
    VM P phi (a_SSigma psi0 A B) (a_SSigma psi0 A' B')
| VM_Sum : forall (A B A' B':tm),
    R P phi A A' -> R P phi B B' ->
    VM P phi (a_Sum A B) (a_Sum A' B')
| VM_Abs : forall (psi0:grade) (A b A' b':tm),
    (forall x:atom, R ((x~psi0)++P) phi (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x))
                                          (open_tm_wrt_tm b' (a_Var_f x))) ->
    VM P phi (a_Abs psi0 A b) (a_Abs psi0 A' b')
| VM_WPair : forall (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b a' b':tm),
    (psi0 <= phi -> R P phi a a') ->
    R P phi b b' ->
    VM P phi (a_WPair a psi0 b) (a_WPair a' psi0 b')
| VM_SPair : forall (a:tm) (psi0:grade) (b a' b':tm),
    (psi0 <= phi -> R P phi a a') ->
    R P phi b b' ->
    VM P phi (a_SPair a psi0 b) (a_SPair a' psi0 b')
| VM_Inj1 : forall a a', R P phi a a' -> VM P phi (a_Inj1 a) (a_Inj1 a')
| VM_Inj2 : forall a a', R P phi a a' -> VM P phi (a_Inj2 a) (a_Inj2 a')
| VM_refl : forall v, Value v -> Grade P phi v -> VM P phi v v.

Scheme R_mut_ind := Induction for R Sort Prop
with VM_mut_ind := Induction for VM Sort Prop.

Lemma R_deq : forall P phi a b, R P phi a b -> DefEq P phi a b.
Proof. intros P phi a b H; destruct H as [a b De Ga Gb lca lcb hv vm]; exact De. Qed.
Lemma R_grade_left : forall P phi a b, R P phi a b -> Grade P phi a.
Proof. intros P phi a b H; destruct H as [a b De Ga Gb lca lcb hv vm]; exact Ga. Qed.
Lemma R_grade_right : forall P phi a b, R P phi a b -> Grade P phi b.
Proof. intros P phi a b H; destruct H as [a b De Ga Gb lca lcb hv vm]; exact Gb. Qed.

Proof. intros P phi a b H; destruct H as [a b De Ga Gb lca lcb hv vm]; exact lca. Qed.

Proof. intros P phi a b H; destruct H as [a b De Ga Gb lca lcb hv vm]; exact lcb. Qed.
Lemma R_hasV : forall P phi a b, R P phi a b -> (hasV a <-> hasV b).
Proof. intros P phi a b H; destruct H as [a b De Ga Gb lca lcb hv vm]; exact hv. Qed.
Lemma R_vm : forall P phi a b, R P phi a b ->
  forall v w, Value v -> Steps a v -> Value w -> Steps b w -> VM P phi v w.
Proof. intros P phi a b H; destruct H as [a b De Ga Gb lca lcb hv vm]; exact vm. Qed.

Lemma R_intro_trans : forall P phi a b c,
  DefEq P phi a b ->
  Grade P phi a ->
  lc_tm a ->
  (hasV a <-> hasV b) ->
  (forall v w, Value v -> Steps a v -> Value w -> Steps b w -> VM P phi v w) ->
  R P phi b c ->
  (forall v w, Value v -> Steps a v -> Value w -> Steps b w ->
     forall u, VM P phi w u -> VM P phi v u) ->
  R P phi a c.
Proof.
  intros P phi a b c Dab Ga lca hv vm1 Hbc IH.
Lemma R_refl : forall P phi a, Grade P phi a -> R P phi a a.
Proof.
  intros P phi a Ga. apply R_intro.
  - eapply Eq_Refl; exact Ga.
  - exact Ga.
  - exact Ga.
  - exact (@Grade_lc P phi a Ga).
  - exact (@Grade_lc P phi a Ga).
  - split; auto.
  - intros v w Vv Sav Vw Saw.
    assert (E : v = w) by exact (@Steps_value_unique a v Sav Vv w Saw Vw).
    subst w. exact (@VM_refl P phi v Vv (@Steps_Grade P phi a v Sav Ga)).
Qed.

Lemma VM_VtTag : forall P phi v w, VM P phi v w -> ValueType v -> ValueType w -> VtTag v w.
Proof.
  intros P phi v w H.
  induction H using VM_mut_ind
    with (P := fun P phi a b (_:R P phi a b) => True)
         (P0 := fun P phi v w (_:VM P phi v w) => ValueType v -> ValueType w -> VtTag v w).
  - exact I.
  - intros; apply VtTag_Type.
  - intros; apply VtTag_Unit.
  - intros; apply VtTag_Pi.
  - intros; apply VtTag_WSigma.
  - intros; apply VtTag_SSigma.
  - intros; apply VtTag_Sum.
  - intros VTv VTw; inversion VTv.
  - intros VTv VTw; inversion VTv.
  - intros VTv VTw; inversion VTv.
  - intros VTv VTw; inversion VTv.
  - intros VTv VTw; inversion VTv.
  - intros VTv VTw; apply VtTag_refl; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma R_Consistent_VT : forall P phi a b,
  R P phi a b -> ValueType a -> ValueType b -> Consistent a b.
Proof.
  intros P phi a b H VTa VTb.
  assert (Hvm : VM P phi a b) by
    exact (@R_vm P phi a b H a b (@V_ValueType a VTa) (Steps_refl a)
             (@V_ValueType b VTb) (Steps_refl b)).
  assert (Htag : VtTag a b) by exact (@VM_VtTag P phi a b Hvm VTa VTb).
  eapply Consistent_of_VtTag.
  - exact Htag.
  - apply ValueType_lc; exact VTa.
  - apply ValueType_lc; exact VTb.
Qed.

Lemma R_of_step : forall P phi a b,
  Grade P phi a -> Step a b -> R P phi a b.
Proof.
  intros P phi a b Ga Sab.
  assert (Gb : Grade P phi b) by exact (@Step_Grade P phi a b Sab Ga).
  apply R_intro.
  - eapply Eq_Beta; [exact Ga | exact Sab | exact Gb].
  - exact Ga.
  - exact Gb.
  - apply (@Grade_lc P phi a Ga).
  - apply (@Grade_lc P phi b Gb).
  - split.
    + intros [v [Vv Sav]].
      destruct (@Steps_join a b (@Steps_step a b b Sab (Steps_refl b)) v Sav)
        as [Sbv | Svb].
      * exists v; split; assumption.
      * assert (E : v = b) by exact (@Steps_value v b Vv Svb).
        subst v. exists b; split; assumption.
    + intros [w [Vw Sbw]].
      exists w; split; [exact Vw | eapply @Steps_step; eassumption].
  - intros v w Vv Sav Vw Sbw.
    destruct (@Steps_join a b (@Steps_step a b b Sab (Steps_refl b)) v Sav)
      as [Sbv | Svb].
    + pose proof (@Steps_value_unique b v Sbv Vv w Sbw Vw) as E.
      subst w. exact (@VM_refl P phi v Vv (@Steps_Grade P phi b v Sbv Gb)).
    + pose proof (@Steps_value v b Vv Svb) as E.
      subst v. pose proof (@Steps_value b w Vv Sbw) as E2.
      subst w. exact (@VM_refl P phi b Vv Gb).
Qed.

Lemma R_Type_TmUnit_false : forall P phi s, ~ R P phi (a_Type s) a_TmUnit.
Proof.
  intros P phi s H.
  pose proof (@R_vm P phi (a_Type s) a_TmUnit H (a_Type s) a_TmUnit
    (@V_ValueType (a_Type s) (ValueType_Type s)) (Steps_refl (a_Type s))
    V_TmUnit (Steps_refl a_TmUnit)) as Hvm.
  inversion Hvm.
Qed.

Lemma GEq_VtTag_form : forall (P:econtext) (phi:grade) (a b:tm),
  GEq P phi a b -> forall t, VtTag t a -> VtTag t b.
Proof.
  intros P phi a b H. induction H; intros t HT;
    try solve [exfalso; inversion HT];
    try solve [inversion HT; econstructor];
    assumption.
Qed.
Arguments GEq_VtTag_form : clear implicits.

Lemma Joins_Consistent : forall (P:econtext) (phi:grade) (a b:tm),
  Joins P phi a b -> lc_tm a -> lc_tm b -> Consistent a b.
Proof.
  intros P phi a b H Ha Hb. destruct H as [P0 psi a1 a2 b1 b2 Mp1 Mp2 Ge].

  intros VTa VTb.
  pose proof (MultiPar_VT P0 psi a1 b1 Mp1 VTa) as H1.
  pose proof (MultiPar_VT P0 psi a2 b2 Mp2 VTb) as H2.
  pose proof (GEq_VtTag_form P0 psi b1 b2 Ge a1 H1) as H3.
  apply VtTag_trans with b2; [exact H3 | apply VtTag_sym; exact H2].
Qed.
Arguments Joins_Consistent : clear implicits.

Lemma DefEq_Grade : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),

Proof.

      * exact (proj1 IHDefEq).
      * intros x Hx. exact (proj1 (H0 x Hx)).

Lemma R_intro_trans : forall P phi a b c,
  DefEq P phi a b ->
  Grade P phi a ->
  lc_tm a ->
  (hasV a <-> hasV b) ->
  (forall v w, Value v -> Steps a v -> Value w -> Steps b w -> VM P phi v w) ->
  R P phi b c ->
  (forall v w, Value v -> Steps a v -> Value w -> Steps b w ->
     forall u, VM P phi w u -> VM P phi v u) ->
  R P phi a c.
Proof.
  intros P phi a b c Dab Ga lca hv vm1 Hbc IH.
  apply R_intro.
  - eapply Eq_Trans; [exact Dab | exact (@R_deq P phi b c Hbc)].
  - exact Ga.
  - exact (R_grade_right Hbc).
  - exact lca.
  - exact (R_lc_right Hbc).
  - exact (iff_trans hv (R_hasV Hbc)).
  - intros x y Vx Sax Vy Scy.
    assert (Hax : hasV a) by (exists x; split; assumption).
    destruct ((proj1 hv) Hax) as [z [Vz Sbz]].
    exact (IH x z Vx Sax Vz Sbz y (@R_vm P phi b c Hbc z y Vz Sbz Vy Scy)).
Qed.

Lemma R_trans : forall P phi a b, R P phi a b -> forall c, R P phi b c -> R P phi a c.
Proof.
  intros P phi a b H.
  induction H using R_mut_ind
    with (P := fun P phi a b (_:R P phi a b) => forall c, R P phi b c -> R P phi a c)
         (P0 := fun P phi v w (_:VM P phi v w) => forall u, VM P phi w u -> VM P phi v u).
  - intros c Hbc.
    eapply R_intro_trans; [ exact d | exact g | exact l | exact i | exact v | exact Hbc | exact H ].
  - intros u Hu; exact Hu.
  - intros u Hu; exact Hu.
  - intros u Hu; inversion Hu; subst;
      [ apply VM_Pi; firstorder | apply VM_Pi; [exact H | exact r] ].
  - intros u Hu; inversion Hu; subst;
      [ apply VM_WSigma; firstorder | apply VM_WSigma; [exact H | exact r] ].
  - intros u Hu; inversion Hu; subst;
      [ apply VM_SSigma; firstorder | apply VM_SSigma; [exact H | exact r] ].
  - intros u Hu; inversion Hu; subst;
      [ apply VM_Sum; firstorder | apply VM_Sum; [exact H | exact H0] ].
  - intros u Hu; inversion Hu; subst;
      [ apply VM_Abs; firstorder | apply VM_Abs; exact r ].
  - intros u Hu; inversion Hu; subst.
    + apply VM_WPair.
      * intro i. apply H.
        { exact i. }
        { match goal with Hx : psi0 <= phi -> R P phi a' ?x |- R P phi a' ?x => exact (Hx i) end. }
      * apply IHR.
        match goal with Hx : R P phi b' ?x |- R P phi b' ?x => exact Hx end.
    + apply VM_WPair.
      * intro i. exact (r i).
      * exact H0.
  - intros u Hu; inversion Hu; subst.
    + apply VM_SPair.
      * intro i. apply H.
        { exact i. }
        { match goal with Hx : psi0 <= phi -> R P phi a' ?x |- R P phi a' ?x => exact (Hx i) end. }

Require Import Qual.geq.
Require Import Qual.defeq.
Require Import Base2.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Open Scope grade_scope.

(* The target is equivalent to head/tag coherence on the two endpoints:
   [Consistent] can only fail when both endpoints are value types with
   different heads.  The prefix already contains [Consistent_total], which
   packages exactly this observation. *)
Theorem DefEq_Consistent_from_VtTag :
  (forall (P:econtext) (phi:grade) (a b:tm),
      DefEq P phi a b -> ValueType a -> ValueType b -> VtTag a b) ->
  forall S D A B, DefEq S D A B -> Consistent A B.
Proof.
  intros HVT S D A B H.
  apply Consistent_total.
  - exact (proj1 (@DefEq_lc S D A B H)).
  - exact (proj2 (@DefEq_lc S D A B H)).
  - intros HA HB. exact (HVT S D A B H HA HB).
Qed.

(* Restatement of the residual invariant as a named proposition. *)
Definition DefEq_VtTag_Coherence : Prop :=
  forall (P:econtext) (phi:grade) (a b:tm),
    DefEq P phi a b -> ValueType a -> ValueType b -> VtTag a b.

Require Import Qual.geq.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Open Scope grade_scope.

(* Core invariant: only ValueType/tag/reduction information, no structural
   clauses for non-ValueType heads.  This is the part relevant to Consistent. *)
Inductive VTC : tm -> tm -> Prop :=
| VTC_intro : forall (a b:tm),
    lc_tm a ->
    lc_tm b ->
    (ValueType a -> ValueType b -> VtTag a b) ->
    (ValueType a -> ValueType b \/ (exists b', Step b b' /\ ValueType b' /\ VtTag a b')) ->
    (ValueType b -> ValueType a \/ (exists a', Step a a' /\ ValueType a' /\ VtTag a' b)) ->
    (forall (a':tm), Step a a' -> ValueType a' -> VTC a' b) ->
    (forall (b':tm), Step b b' -> ValueType b' -> VTC a b') ->
    VTC a b.

Lemma VTC_lca : forall a b, VTC a b -> lc_tm a.
Proof.
  intros a b H.
  induction H as [a0 b0 lca lcb tag rvt lvt stepL IHstepL stepR IHstepR].
  exact lca.
Qed.

Lemma VTC_lcb : forall a b, VTC a b -> lc_tm b.
Proof.
  intros a b H.
  induction H as [a0 b0 lca lcb tag rvt lvt stepL IHstepL stepR IHstepR].
  exact lcb.
Qed.

Lemma VTC_tag : forall a b, VTC a b ->
  ValueType a -> ValueType b -> VtTag a b.
Proof.
  intros a b H.
  induction H as [a0 b0 lca lcb tag rvt lvt stepL IHstepL stepR IHstepR].
  intros Va Vb. exact (tag Va Vb).
Qed.

Lemma VTC_rvt : forall a b, VTC a b -> ValueType a ->
  ValueType b \/ (exists b', Step b b' /\ ValueType b' /\ VtTag a b').
Proof.
  intros a b H.
  induction H as [a0 b0 lca lcb tag rvt lvt stepL IHstepL stepR IHstepR].
  intros Va. exact (rvt Va).
Qed.

Lemma VTC_lvt : forall a b, VTC a b -> ValueType b ->
  ValueType a \/ (exists a', Step a a' /\ ValueType a' /\ VtTag a' b).
Proof.
  intros a b H.
  induction H as [a0 b0 lca lcb tag rvt lvt stepL IHstepL stepR IHstepR].
  intros Vb. exact (lvt Vb).
Qed.

Lemma VTC_stepL : forall a b, VTC a b ->
  forall a', Step a a' -> ValueType a' -> VTC a' b.

Require Import Qual.geq.

From Stdlib Require Import Lia.

Set Implicit Arguments.

(* ============================================================ *)
(* Infrastructure for the proof of DefEq_Consistent.            *)

(* ---------- size ---------- *)
Fixpoint size_tm (u:tm) : nat :=
  match u with
  | a_TyUnit => 1 | a_TmUnit => 1 | a_Type _ => 1 | a_Var_f _ => 1 | a_Var_b _ => 1
  | a_Pi _ A B => 1 + size_tm A + size_tm B
  | a_Abs _ A b => 1 + size_tm A + size_tm b
  | a_App a _ b => 1 + size_tm a + size_tm b
  | a_Sum A B => 1 + size_tm A + size_tm B
  | a_Inj1 a => 1 + size_tm a | a_Inj2 a => 1 + size_tm a
  | a_Case _ a b1 b2 => 1 + size_tm a + size_tm b1 + size_tm b2
  | a_WSigma _ A B => 1 + size_tm A + size_tm B
  | a_WPair a _ b => 1 + size_tm a + size_tm b
  | a_LetPair _ a b => 1 + size_tm a + size_tm b
  | a_SSigma _ A B => 1 + size_tm A + size_tm B
  | a_SPair a _ b => 1 + size_tm a + size_tm b
  | a_Proj1 _ a => 1 + size_tm a | a_Proj2 _ a => 1 + size_tm a
  end.

Lemma size_tm_pos : forall u, (1 <= size_tm u)%nat.
Proof. destruct u; simpl; lia. Qed.

(* ---------- level-indexed local closedness ---------- *)
Fixpoint lc_at (k:nat) (u:tm) : Prop :=
  match u with
  | a_TyUnit => True
  | a_TmUnit => True
  | a_Type _ => True
  | a_Var_f _ => True
  | a_Var_b n => Nat.lt n k
  | a_Pi _ A B => lc_at k A /\ lc_at (S k) B
  | a_Abs _ A b => lc_at k A /\ lc_at (S k) b
  | a_App a _ b => lc_at k a /\ lc_at k b
  | a_Sum A B => lc_at k A /\ lc_at k B
  | a_Inj1 a => lc_at k a
  | a_Inj2 a => lc_at k a
  | a_Case _ a b1 b2 => lc_at k a /\ lc_at k b1 /\ lc_at k b2
  | a_WSigma _ A B => lc_at k A /\ lc_at (S k) B
  | a_WPair a _ b => lc_at k a /\ lc_at k b
  | a_LetPair _ a b => lc_at k a /\ lc_at (S k) b
  | a_SSigma _ A B => lc_at k A /\ lc_at (S k) B
  | a_SPair a _ b => lc_at k a /\ lc_at k b
  | a_Proj1 _ a => lc_at k a
  | a_Proj2 _ a => lc_at k a
  end.

Lemma lc_at_mono : forall u k j, (k <= j)%nat -> lc_at k u -> lc_at j u.
Proof.
  induction u; simpl; intros k j Hle H; auto; try tauto.

(* ================= Stage 5: parallel reduction preserves grades ================= *)
Scheme Par_mind := Induction for Par Sort Prop
  with CPar_mind := Induction for CPar Sort Prop.

Lemma CGrade_leq_Grade : forall (P:econtext) (psi phi0:grade) (a:tm),
  CGrade P psi phi0 a -> phi0 <= psi -> Grade P psi a.
Proof.
  intros P psi phi0 a H Hle. inversion H; subst.
  - assumption.
  - exfalso. match goal with Hn : ~ (_ <= _) |- False => exact (Hn Hle) end.
Qed.

Lemma CGrade_side : forall (P:econtext) (psi phi0:grade) (a:tm),
  CGrade P psi phi0 a ->
  (phi0 <= psi -> Grade P psi a) /\ (~ (phi0 <= psi) -> lc_tm a).
Proof.
  intros P psi phi0 a H. split.
  - apply CGrade_leq_Grade. exact H.
  - intro Hn. inversion H; subst.
    + exfalso. match goal with Hl : _ <= _ |- False => exact (Hn Hl) end.
    + assumption.
Qed.

Lemma CGrade_of_Grade : forall (P:econtext) (psi phi0:grade) (a:tm),
  Grade P psi a -> CGrade P psi phi0 a.
Proof.
  intros P psi phi0 a H. destruct (q_leb phi0 psi) eqn:E.
  - apply CG_Leq. exact E. assumption.
  - apply CG_Nleq.
    + apply (Grade_lc P psi a). assumption.
    + unfold is_true. rewrite E. discriminate.
    + apply (Grade_uniq P psi a). assumption.
Qed.

Lemma Grade_open_arg : forall (P:econtext) (psi psi0:grade) (b:tm) (x:atom) (body:tm),
  uniq P -> x \notin dom P ->
  Grade ((x,psi0)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm body (a_Var_f x)) ->
  CGrade P psi psi0 b ->
  x \notin fv_tm_tm body ->
  Grade P psi (open_tm_wrt_tm body b).
Proof.
  intros P psi psi0 b x body Hu Hxdom Hbody Hc Hfv.
  destruct (@CGrade_side P psi psi0 b Hc) as [Hg Hl].
  apply (@Grade_body_subst P psi psi0 body x b Hu Hxdom Hbody Hg Hl Hfv).
Qed.

Lemma Par_Grade : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
  Par P psi a b -> Grade P psi a /\ Grade P psi b.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H using Par_mind
    with (P0 := fun (P:econtext) (psi phi0:grade) (a b:tm) (_:CPar P psi phi0 a b) =>
                 CGrade P psi phi0 a /\ CGrade P psi phi0 b).
  - (* Refl *) split; assumption.
  - (* Pi *)
    split.
    + apply (@G_Pi L P psi psi1 A1 B1).
      * exact (proj1 IHPar).
      * intros x Hx. exact (proj1 (H0 x Hx)).
    + apply (@G_Pi L P psi psi1 A2 B2).
      * exact (proj2 IHPar).
      * intros x Hx. exact (proj2 (H0 x Hx)).
  - (* AppBeta *)
    destruct IHPar as [Ha Habs]. destruct IHPar0 as [Hb1 Hb2].
    inversion Habs; subst.
    split.
    + apply (@G_App P psi a psi0 b). exact Ha. exact Hb1.
    + destruct (atom_fresh (L \u (dom P \u fv_tm_tm a'))) as [x Hx].
      destruct (@fresh3_facts L P a' x Hx) as [HL [Hdom Hfv]].
      exact (@Grade_open_arg P psi psi0 b' x a'
               (Grade_uniq P psi a Ha) Hdom (H4 x HL) Hb2 Hfv).
  - (* App *)
    split.
    + apply (@G_App P psi a psi0 b). exact (proj1 IHPar). exact (proj1 IHPar0).
    + apply (@G_App P psi a' psi0 b'). exact (proj2 IHPar). exact (proj2 IHPar0).
  - (* Abs *)
    split.
    + apply (@G_Abs L P psi psi0 A1 b1).
      * intros x Hx. exact (proj1 (H x Hx)).
      * exact (proj1 IHPar).
    + apply (@G_Abs L P psi psi0 A2 b2).
      * intros x Hx. exact (proj2 (H x Hx)).
      * exact (proj2 IHPar).
  - (* WSigma *)
    split.
    + apply (@G_WSigma L P psi psi1 A1 B1).
      * exact (proj1 IHPar).
      * intros x Hx. exact (proj1 (H0 x Hx)).
    + apply (@G_WSigma L P psi psi1 A2 B2).
      * exact (proj2 IHPar).
      * intros x Hx. exact (proj2 (H0 x Hx)).
  - (* WPair *)
    split.
    + apply (@G_WPair P psi a1 psi0 b1). exact (proj1 IHPar). exact (proj1 IHPar0).
    + apply (@G_WPair P psi a2 psi0 b2). exact (proj2 IHPar). exact (proj2 IHPar0).
  - (* WPairBeta *)
    destruct IHPar as [Ha Ha'].
    inversion Ha'; subst.
    split.
    + apply (@G_LetPair L P psi psi0 a1 b1). exact Ha.
      intros x Hx. exact (proj1 (H0 x Hx)).
    + apply (@G_App P psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b2 a1') q_Bot a2').
      * destruct (atom_fresh (L \u (dom P \u fv_tm_tm b2))) as [x Hx].
        destruct (@fresh3_facts L P b2 x Hx) as [HL [Hdom Hfv]].
        exact (@Grade_open_arg P psi psi0 a1' x b2
                 (Grade_uniq P psi a1 Ha) Hdom (proj2 (H0 x HL)) H5 Hfv).
      * apply CGrade_of_Grade. exact H7.
  - (* LetPair *)
    split.
    + apply (@G_LetPair L P psi psi0 a1 b1). exact (proj1 IHPar).
      intros x Hx. exact (proj1 (H0 x Hx)).
    + apply (@G_LetPair L P psi psi0 a2 b2). exact (proj2 IHPar).
      intros x Hx. exact (proj2 (H0 x Hx)).
  - (* SSigma *)
    split.
    + apply (@G_SSigma L P psi psi1 A1 B1).
      * exact (proj1 IHPar).
      * intros x Hx. exact (proj1 (H0 x Hx)).
    + apply (@G_SSigma L P psi psi1 A2 B2).
      * exact (proj2 IHPar).
      * intros x Hx. exact (proj2 (H0 x Hx)).
  - (* SPair *)
    split.
    + apply (@G_SPair P psi a1 psi0 b1). exact (proj1 IHPar). exact (proj1 IHPar0).
    + apply (@G_SPair P psi a2 psi0 b2). exact (proj2 IHPar). exact (proj2 IHPar0).
  - (* Proj1Beta *)
    destruct IHPar as [Ha Ha'].
    inversion Ha'; subst.
    split.
    + apply (@G_Proj1 P psi psi0 a1). exact Ha. assumption.
    + apply (@CGrade_leq_Grade P psi psi0 a1'). exact H4. assumption.
  - (* Proj1 *)
    split.
    + apply (@G_Proj1 P psi psi0 a1). exact (proj1 IHPar). assumption.
    + apply (@G_Proj1 P psi psi0 a2). exact (proj2 IHPar). assumption.
  - (* Proj2Beta *)
    destruct IHPar as [Ha Ha'].
    inversion Ha'; subst.
    split.
    + apply (@G_Proj2 P psi psi0 a1). exact Ha.
    + exact H6.
  - (* Proj2 *)
    split.
    + apply (@G_Proj2 P psi psi0 a1). exact (proj1 IHPar).
    + apply (@G_Proj2 P psi psi0 a2). exact (proj2 IHPar).
  - (* Sum *)
    split.
    + apply (@G_Sum P psi A1 A2). exact (proj1 IHPar1). exact (proj1 IHPar2).
    + apply (@G_Sum P psi A1' A2'). exact (proj2 IHPar1). exact (proj2 IHPar2).
  - (* Inj1 *)
    split.
    + eapply G_Inj1. exact (proj1 IHPar).
    + eapply G_Inj1. exact (proj2 IHPar).
  - (* Inj2 *)
    split.
    + eapply G_Inj2. exact (proj1 IHPar).
    + eapply G_Inj2. exact (proj2 IHPar).
  - (* CaseBeta1 *)
    destruct IHPar1 as [Ha Ha']. destruct IHPar2 as [Hb1 Hb1']. destruct IHPar3 as [Hb2 Hb2'].
    inversion Ha'; subst.

Lemma MultiPar_Grade : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),

Proof.

Lemma MultiPar_trans : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
  MultiPar P psi a b -> forall c, MultiPar P psi b c -> MultiPar P psi a c.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H; intros c Hc.
  - exact Hc.
  - eapply MP_Step. exact H. apply IHMultiPar. exact Hc.
Qed.

Lemma GEq_trans : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
  GEq P psi a b -> forall c, GEq P psi b c -> GEq P psi a c.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H using GEq_mind
    with (P0 := fun (P:econtext) (psi phi0:grade) (a b:tm) (_:CEq P psi phi0 a b) =>

(* ================= Stage 7: shape decomposition of MultiPar on Pi ================= *)
Lemma MultiPar_Pi_decomp : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
  MultiPar P psi a b ->
  forall psi0 A1 B1, a = a_Pi psi0 A1 B1 ->
  exists A1' B1', b = a_Pi psi0 A1' B1' /\
    MultiPar P psi A1 A1' /\
    exists L, forall x, x \notin L ->
      MultiPar ((x,psi)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x))
                                        (open_tm_wrt_tm B1' (a_Var_f x)).
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H as [P psi a Ha | P psi a a' b Hpar Hmp IH];
    intros psi0 A1 B1 EQ; subst a.
  - (* MP_Refl *)
    destruct (@Grade_Pi_body P psi psi0 A1 B1 Ha) as [Lbody HB].
    exists A1, B1. split.
    + reflexivity.
    + split.
      * apply MP_Refl. exact (@Grade_Pi_inv P psi psi0 A1 B1 Ha).
      * exists Lbody. intros x Hx. apply MP_Refl. exact (HB x Hx).
  - (* MP_Step *)
    inversion Hpar; subst.
    + (* Par_Refl *)
      apply (IH psi0 A1 B1 (@Logic.eq_refl tm (a_Pi psi0 A1 B1))).
    + (* Par_Pi *)
      match goal with
      | HpA : Par P psi A1 ?A2,
        HpB : forall x, x \notin ?L -> Par _ psi
                (open_tm_wrt_tm B1 (a_Var_f x)) (open_tm_wrt_tm ?B2 (a_Var_f x)) |- _ =>
          destruct (IH psi0 A2 B2 (@Logic.eq_refl tm (a_Pi psi0 A2 B2)))
            as [A2' [B2' [Eb [MpA MpB]]]];
          destruct MpB as [L2 HB2];
          exists A2', B2'; split; [exact Eb | split];
          [ eapply MP_Step; [exact HpA | exact MpA] |
            exists (L \u L2); intros x Hx; eapply MP_Step;
            [ exact (HpB x (@notin_union_l L L2 x Hx)) |
              exact (HB2 x (@notin_union_r L L2 x Hx)) ] ]
      end.
Qed.

    forall x, x \notin L -> Grade ((x,psi0)::P) psi (open_tm_wrt_tm b (a_Var_f x)).
Proof.
  intros. inversion H; subst. eexists. split; eassumption.
Qed.

Lemma Step_Grade : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
  Step a b -> Grade P psi a -> Grade P psi b.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H. induction H; intros Ha.

    apply (@G_App P psi a' psi0 b). apply IHStep. exact Hfa. exact Hcb.
  - (* Beta *) destruct (@Grade_App_inv P psi (a_Abs psi0 A a) psi0 b Ha) as [Hfa Hcb].

Lemma CPar_diamond_from_par :
  forall
    (par_diamond : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b c:tm),
        Par P psi a b -> Par P psi a c ->
        exists b' c', MultiPar P psi b b' /\ MultiPar P psi c c' /\ GEq P psi b' c'),
    forall (P:econtext) (psi phi0:grade) (a b c:tm),

        (phi0 <= psi -> MultiPar P psi c c') /\
        CEq P psi phi0 b' c'.

  intros par_diamond P psi phi0 a b c H1 H2.

Set Implicit Arguments.
Open Scope grade_scope.

Definition PD (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b c:tm) : Prop :=
  exists b' c', MultiPar P psi b b' /\ MultiPar P psi c c' /\ GEq P psi b' c'.

Lemma Par_diamond_Refl_left : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a c:tm),
  Par P psi a c -> PD P psi a a c.
Proof.
  intros P psi a c H2.
  pose proof (proj2 (@Par_Grade P psi a c H2)) as Gc.
  exists c, c. split.
  - eapply MP_Step. exact H2. apply MP_Refl. exact Gc.
  - split.
    + apply MP_Refl. exact Gc.
    + apply Grade_GEq_refl. exact Gc.
Qed.

Lemma Par_diamond_Refl_right : forall (P:econtext) (psi:grade) (a b:tm),
  Par P psi a b -> PD P psi a b a.
Proof.
  intros P psi a b H1.
  pose proof (proj2 (@Par_Grade P psi a b H1)) as Gb.
  exists b, b. split.
  - apply MP_Refl. exact Gb.
  - split.
    + eapply MP_Step. exact H1. apply MP_Refl. exact Gb.
    + apply Grade_GEq_refl. exact Gb.
Qed.

                    P psi psi0 a1 a2 a3 ltac:(simpl; lia) cpar1 cpar2)
          as [A1 [A2 [MCA1 [MCA2 CA]]]];
        destruct (IH b1 ltac:(simpl; lia) P psi b2 b3 pbody1 pbody2)
          as [B1 [B2 [MB1 [MB2 GB]]]];
        destruct (q_leb psi0 psi) eqn:E

      * (* psi0 <= psi *)
        pose proof (MCA1 E) as MA1. pose proof (MCA2 E) as MA2.
        pose proof (@MultiPar_WPair_intro P psi psi0 a2 A1 b2 B1 MA1
                      (proj2 (@Par_Grade P psi b1 b2 pbody1))
                      (fun _ => MB1) E) as ML.
        pose proof (@MultiPar_WPair_intro P psi psi0 a3 A2 b3 B2 MA2
                      (proj2 (@Par_Grade P psi b1 b3 pbody2))
                      (fun _ => MB2) E) as MR.
        exists (a_WPair A1 psi0 B1), (a_WPair A2 psi0 B2). split;
        [ exact ML | split; [ exact MR | apply GEq_WPair; assumption ] ].

        -- exact GB.
Qed.
